arsenic.meaning: a chemical element. Arsenic is an extremely poisonous white powder.（砷）

art.meaning: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture（艺术，美术（尤指绘画、雕刻、雕塑））；examples of objects such as paintings, drawings or sculptures（艺术作品；美术作品）；the skill of creating objects such as paintings and drawings, especially when you study it（艺术技巧）；art, music, theatre, literature, etc. when you think of them as a group（（统称）艺术）

artery.meaning: any of the tubes that carry blood from the heart to other parts of the body（动脉）；a large and important road, river, railway/railroad line, etc.（干线（指主要公路、河流、铁路线等））；ar·ter·ial /ɑːˈtɪəriəl; NAmEɑːrˈtɪriəl/ adj. [only before noun] arterial blood/disease（动脉血/病）

arthritis.meaning: a disease that causes pain and swelling in one or more joints of the body（关节炎）

arthropod.meaning: an invertebrate animal such as an insect, spider, or crab, that has its skeleton on the outside of its body and has joints on its legs（节肢动物）

article.meaning: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine（（报刊上的）文章，论文，报道）；(law 律) a separate item in an agreement or a contract（（协议、契约的）条款，项）；(formal) a particular item or separate thing, especially one of a set（物件，物品（尤指整套中的一件））；(grammar 语法) the words a and an (the indefinite article) or the (the definite article)（冠词（a 和 an 为不定冠词，the 为定冠词））

articulate.meaning: (formal) to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words（明确表达；清楚说明）；to speak, pronounce or play sth in a clear way（口齿清楚；清晰吐（词）；清晰发（音））；(formal) to be related to sth so that together the two parts form a whole（与 … 合成整体）；(technical 术语) to be joined to sth else by a joint, so that movement is possible; to join sth in this way（用关节连接；链合；铰接）

artificial.meaning: made or produced to copy sth natural; not real（人工的；人造的；假的）；created by people; not happening naturally（人为的；非自然的）；not what it appears to be（虚假的；假装的）；ar·ti·fi·ci·al·ity /ˌɑːtɪˌfɪʃiˈæləti; NAmEˌɑːrtɪˌfɪʃiˈæləti/ noun [U] ar·ti·fi·cial·ly ★ /ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃəli; NAmEˌɑːrtɪˈfɪʃəli/ adv. artificially created lakes（人工湖泊）

artillery.meaning: large, heavy guns which are often moved on wheels（（统称）火炮）；the section of an army trained to use these guns（炮兵部队）

artisan.meaning: a person who does skilled work, making things with their hands（工匠；手艺人）

artist.meaning: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings（艺术家；（尤指）画家）；a professional entertainer such as a singer, a dancer or an actor（专业演员；艺人）

artistic.meaning: connected with art or artists（艺术的；艺术家的）；showing a natural skill in or enjoyment of art, especially being able to paint or draw well（有艺术天赋的；（尤指）有美术才能的）；done with skill and imagination; attractive or beautiful（有艺术性的；精美的）

artistry.meaning: the skill of an artist（艺术技巧）

artwork.meaning: photographs and pictures prepared for books, magazines, etc.（（书刊等上的）插图，图片）；a work of art, especially one in a museum（（尤指博物馆里的）艺术作品）

as.meaning: used to describe sb/sth appearing to be sb/sth else（像；如同）；used to describe the fact that sb/sth has a particular job or function（作为；当作）；used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations（（比较时用）像 … 一样，如同）；used to say that sth happens in the same way（（指事情以同样的方式发生）和 … 一样）

ascend.meaning: to rise; to go up; to climb up（上升；升高；登高）

ascent.meaning: the act of climbing or moving up; an upward journey（上升；升高；登高）；an upward path or slope（上坡；上坡路）；(formal) the process of moving forward to a better position or of making progress（前进；提高；进步）

ascertain.meaning: to find out the true or correct information about sth（查明；弄清）

ascribe.meaning: to consider or state that a book, etc. was written by a particular person（认为 … 是（某人）所写）；to consider that sth is caused by a particular thing or person（把 … 归因于；认为 … 是由于）；to consider that sb/sth has or should have a particular quality（认为 … 具有）；ascrib·able /əˈskraɪbəbl; NAmEəˈskraɪbəbl/ adj. ascribable~ to sb/sthTheir success is ascribable to the quality of their goods.（他们的成功在于商品的质量。）

asean.meaning: Association of South East Asian Nations（东盟；东南亚国家联盟）

ash.meaning: Action on Smoking and Health (an organization in the UK that tries to make people stop smoking by showing how dangerous it is)（吸烟与健康行动组织，英国控烟组织（通过说明吸烟的危害性倡导戒烟））

ashamed.meaning: feeling shame or embarrassment about sb/sth or because of sth you have done（惭愧；羞愧；尴尬）；unwilling to do sth because of shame or embarrassment（因惭愧而不情愿；因尴尬而勉强）

ashore.meaning: towards, onto or on land, having come from an area of water such as the sea or a river（向（或在）岸上；向（或在）陆地）

ashtray.meaning: a container into which people who smoke put ash, cigarette ends, etc.（烟灰缸）

asian.meaning: a person from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia（亚洲人）；of or connected with Asia（亚洲的）

aside.meaning: to one side; out of the way（到旁边；在旁边）；to be used later（留；存）；used after nouns to say that except for one thing, sth is true（（用于名词后）除 … 以外）；(in the theatre（戏剧）

ask.meaning: to say or write sth in the form of a question, in order to get information（问；询问）；You cannot say ‘ask to sb’.（不能说 ask to sb：）；to tell sb that you would like them to do sth or that you would like sth to happen（要求；请求）；to say that you would like sb to give you sth（请求，恳求（给予）；征求）

aspect.meaning: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc; a way in which it may be considered（方面；层面）；(formal) the appearance of a place, a situation or a person（样子；外观；外表）；(formal) the direction in which a building, window, piece of land, etc. faces; the side of a building that faces a particular direction（朝向；方位）；(grammar 语法) the form of a verb that shows, for example, whether the action happens once or repeatedly, is completed or still continuing（（动词的）体（如表示动作等发生一次或多次、已完成或正在进行））

asphalt.meaning: a thick black sticky substance used especially for making the surface of roads（沥青；柏油）

aspiration.meaning: a strong desire to have or do sth（渴望；抱负；志向）；(phonetics 语音) the action of pronouncing a word with a /h/ sound, as in house（发送气音；送气）

aspire.meaning: to have a strong desire to achieve or to become sth（渴望（成就）；有志（成为））

aspirin.meaning: a drug used to reduce pain, fever and inflammation（阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药））

ass.meaning: (taboo, slang) the part of the body that you sit on; your bottom（屁股；腚）；(BrE) (informal) a stupid person（蠢人；笨蛋）；(BrE) (old use) a donkey（驴）；(slang) (especially NAmE) a rude way of telling sb to hurry（别磨磨蹭蹭的；赶快）

assassinate.meaning: to murder an important or famous person, especially for political reasons（（尤为政治目的的）暗杀；行刺）；as·sas·sin·ation assassination assassinations /əˌsæsɪˈneɪʃn; NAmEəˌsæsəˈneɪʃn/ noun [U, C] The president survived a number of assassination attempts.（总统在数次暗杀企图中幸免于难。）

assault.meaning: the crime of attacking sb physically（侵犯他人身体（罪）；侵犯人身罪）；(by an army, etc.（军队等）；the act of attacking a building, an area, etc. in order to take control of it（攻击；突击；袭击）；the act of trying to achieve sth that is difficult or dangerous（（向困难或危险事物发起的）冲击）

assemblage.meaning: a collection of things; a group of people（（人、物的）聚集，集聚）

assemble.meaning: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group（聚集；集合；收集）；to fit together all the separate parts of sth, for example a piece of furniture（装配；组装）

assembly.meaning: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country（立法机构；会议；议会）；the meeting together of a group of people for a particular purpose; a group of people who meet together for a particular purpose（集会；（统称）集会者）；a meeting of the teachers and students in a school, usually at the start of the day, to give information, discuss school events or say prayers together（（全校师生的）晨会，朝会）；the process of putting together the parts of sth such as a vehicle or piece of furniture（装配；组装；总成）

assert.meaning: to state clearly and firmly that sth is true（明确肯定；断言）；to behave in a confident and determined way so that other people pay attention to your opinions（坚持自己的主张；表现坚定）；to make other people recognize your right or authority to do sth, by behaving firmly and confidently（维护自己的权利（或权威））；to start to have an effect（生效；起作用）

assertion.meaning: a statement saying that you strongly believe sth to be true（认定；断言）；the act of stating, using or claiming sth strongly（声称；使用；主张）

assess.meaning: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of sb/sth（评估，评定（性质、质量））；to calculate the amount or value of sth（估算，估定，核定（数量、价值））

assessment.meaning: an opinion or a judgement about sb/sth that has been thought about very carefully（看法；评价）；the act of judging or forming an opinion about sb/sth（评定；核定；判定）；an amount that has been calculated and that must be paid（核定的付款额）

asset.meaning: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to sb/sth（有价值的人（或事物）；有用的人（或事物））；a thing of value, especially property, that a person or company owns, which can be used or sold to pay debts（资产；财产）

assign.meaning: to give sb sth that they can use, or some work or responsibility（分配（某物）；分派，布置（工作、任务等））；to provide a person for a particular task or position（指定；指派）；to send a person to work under the authority of sb or in a particular group（委派；派遣）；to say that sth has a particular value or function, or happens at a particular time or place（确定（价值、功能、时间、地点））

assignment.meaning: a task or piece of work that sb is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies（（分派的）工作，任务）；the act of giving sth to sb; the act of giving sb a particular task（（工作等的）分派，布置）

assimilate.meaning: to fully understand an idea or some information so that you are able to use it yourself（透彻理解；消化；吸收）；to become, or allow sb to become, a part of a country or community rather than remaining in a separate group（（使）同化）；to make an idea, a person's attitude, etc. fit into sth or be acceptable（使吸收，使接受（想法、态度等））

assist.meaning: to help sb to do sth（帮助；协助；援助）；to help sth to happen more easily（促进）；an action in hockey, baseball, etc. in which a player helps another player on the same team to score a goal or point（（曲棍球等）助攻；（棒球等）助杀）

assistance.meaning: help or support（帮助；援助；支持）

assistant.meaning: a person who helps or supports sb, usually in their job（助理；助手）；(BrE) a student at university or college who spends time in a foreign country teaching his or her own language in a school（助教（在国外留学的大学生，教授本国语））；(often in titles（常用于头衔）；having a rank below a senior person and helping them in their work（助理的；副的）

associate.meaning: to make a connection between people or things in your mind（联想；联系）；to spend time with sb, especially a person or people that sb else does not approve of（交往；（尤指）混在一起）；(formal) to show that you support or agree with sth（表明支持；表示同意）；(often in titles（常用于头衔）

associated.meaning: if one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other（有关联的；相关的）；if a person is associated with an organization, etc. they support it（有联系的）；used in the name of a business company that is made up of a number of smaller companies（（用于联合企业的名称）联合的）

association.meaning: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose（协会；社团；联盟）；a connection or relationship between people or organizations（联合；合伙；关联；交往）；an idea or a memory that is suggested by sb/sth; a mental connection between ideas（联想；联系）；a connection between things where one is caused by the other（因果关系）

associative.meaning: relating to the association of ideas or things（联想的）；(mathematics 数) giving the same result no matter what order the parts of a calculation are done, for example (a × b) × c = a × (b × c)（结合的）

assorted.meaning: of various different sorts（各种各样的；混杂的；什锦的）

assortment.meaning: a collection of different things or of different types of the same thing（各种各样）

assume.meaning: to think or accept that sth is true but without having proof of it（假定；假设；认为）；(formal) to take or begin to have power or responsibility（承担（责任）；就（职）；取得（权力））；(formal) to begin to have a particular quality or appearance（呈现（外观、样子）；显露（特征））；(formal) to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality（装出；假装）

assumption.meaning: a belief or feeling that sth is true or that sth will happen, although there is no proof（假定；假设）；(formal) the act of taking or beginning to have power or responsibility（（责任的）承担；担任；（权力的）获得）

assurance.meaning: a statement that sth will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it（保证；担保）；belief in your own abilities or strengths（自信）；(BrE) a type of insurance in which money is paid out when sb dies or after an agreed period of time（人寿保险）

assure.meaning: to tell sb that sth is definitely true or is definitely going to happen, especially when they have doubts about it（使确信；向 … 保证）；(formal) to make yourself certain about sth（弄清；查明）；to make sth certain to happen（确保；使确定）；(BrE) to insure sth, especially against sb's death（保险（尤指人寿险））

assured.meaning: confident in yourself and your abilities（自信的；有把握的）；certain to happen（必将发生的；确定的）；(of a person（人）；certain to get sth（肯定得到）

asterisk.meaning: the symbol ( * ) placed next to a particular word or phrase to make people notice it or to show that more information is given in another place（星号（置于词语旁以引起注意或另有注释））；as·ter·isk verb asterisk~ sthI've asterisked the tasks I want you to do first.（我在要你首先完成的任务旁边标上了星号。）

asteroid.meaning: any one of the many small planets that go around the sun（小行星）

asthma.meaning: a medical condition of the chest that makes breathing difficult（气喘；哮喘）

astonish.meaning: to surprise sb very much（使十分惊讶；使大为惊奇；使吃惊）

astonishment.meaning: a feeling of very great surprise（惊讶；惊异）

astound.meaning: to surprise or shock sb very much（使震惊；使大惊）

astray.meaning: to become lost; to be stolen（丢失；被盗）；to go in the wrong direction or to have the wrong result（走错方向；误入歧途）

astrology.meaning: the study of the positions of the stars and the movements of the planets in the belief that they influence human affairs（占星术；占星学）；astro·logic·al /ˌæstrəˈlɒdʒɪkl; NAmEˌæstrəˈlɑːdʒɪkl/ adj. astrological influences（占星术的影响）

astronaut.meaning: a person whose job involves travelling and working in a spacecraft（宇航员；航天员；（台）太空人）

astronomer.meaning: a scientist who studies astronomy（天文学家）

astronomical.meaning: connected with astronomy（天文学的；天文的）；(of an amount, a price, etc.（数量、价格等）；very large（极其巨大的）；astro·nom·ic·al·ly /ˌæstrəˈnɒmɪkli; NAmEˌæstrəˈnɑːmɪkli/ adv. Interest rates are astronomically high.（利率极高。）

astronomy.meaning: the scientific study of the sun, moon, stars, planets, etc.（天文学）

astute.meaning: very clever and quick at seeing what to do in a particular situation, especially how to get an advantage（精明的；狡猾的）

as yet.meaning: until now or until a particular time in the past（直到现在；直至过去某时）

asylum.meaning: protection that a government gives to people who have left their own country, usually because they were in danger for political reasons（（政治）庇护，避难）；(old use) a hospital where people who were mentally ill could be cared for, often for a long time（精神病院）

asymmetric.meaning: having two sides or parts that are not the same in size or shape（不对称的）；(technical 术语) not equal, for example in the way each side or part behaves（不对等的）

at.meaning: used to say where sth/sb is or where sth happens（在（某处））；used to say where sb works or studies（在（表示学习或工作地点））；used to say when sth happens（在（某时间或时刻））；used to state the age at which sb does sth（在 … 岁时）

atheist.meaning: a person who believes that God does not exist（无神论者）

athlete.meaning: a person who competes in sports（运动员）；(BrE) a person who competes in sports such as running and jumping（田径运动员）；a person who is good at sports and physical exercise（擅长运动的人；健儿）

athletic.meaning: physically strong, fit and active（健壮的）；(BrE) connected with sports such as running, jumping and throwing (= athletics)（体育运动的；田径运动的）；ath·let·ical·ly /æθˈletɪkli; NAmEæθˈletɪkli/ adv. ath·leti·cism /æθˈletɪsɪzəm; NAmEæθˈletɪsɪzəm/ noun [U] She moved with great athleticism about the court.（她在球场上矫健地奔跑活动。）

atlas.meaning: a book of maps（地图册；地图集）

atmosphere.meaning: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth（（围绕地球的）大气，大气层，大气圈）；a mixture of gases that surrounds another planet or a star（（围绕其他天体的）气体）；the air in a room or in a confined space; the air around a place（（房间、封闭空间或某处的）空气）；the feeling or mood that you have in a particular place or situation; a feeling between two people or in a group of people（气氛；氛围）

atmospheric.meaning: related to the earth's atmosphere（大气的；大气层的）；creating an exciting or emotional mood（令人激动的；使人动感情的）

atom.meaning: the smallest part of a chemical element that can take part in a chemical reaction（原子）

atomic.meaning: connected with atoms or an atom（原子的；与原子有关的）；related to the energy that is produced when atoms are split; related to weapons that use this energy（原子能的；原子武器的）

atop.meaning: on top of; at the top of（在 … 顶上）

attach.meaning: to fasten or join one thing to another（把 … 固定，把 … 附（在 … 上））；to believe that sth is important or worth thinking about（认为有重要性（或意义、价值、分量等）；重视）；to join sb for a time, sometimes when you are not welcome or have not been invited（（有时不受欢迎或未受邀请而）参加，和 … 在一起，缠着）；(formal) to be connected with sb/sth; to connect sth to sth（（使）与 … 有联系；与 … 有关连）

attached.meaning: full of affection for sb/sth（依恋；爱慕）；working for or forming part of an organization（附属于；为 … 工作）；joined to sth（所附的）

attachment.meaning: a strong feeling of affection for sb/sth（依恋；爱慕）；belief in and support for an idea or a set of values（信念；信仰；忠诚；拥护）；a tool that you can fix onto a machine, to make it do another job（（机器的）附件，附加装置，附属物）；the act of joining one thing to another; a thing that joins two things together（连接；连接物）

attack.meaning: an act of using violence to try to hurt or kill sb（袭击；攻击）；an act of trying to kill or injure the enemy in war, using weapons such as guns and bombs（（在战争中使用武器的）进攻，攻击）；strong criticism of sb/sth in speech or in writing（（口头或书面的）抨击，非难）；an action that you take to try to stop or change sth that you feel is bad（抑制；打击；处理）

attacker.meaning: a person who attacks sb（攻击者；袭击者；进攻者）

attain.meaning: to succeed in getting sth, usually after a lot of effort（（通常经过努力）获得，得到）；to reach a particular age, level or condition（达到（某年龄、水平、状况））

attainment.meaning: (BrE) something that you achieved（成就；造诣）；success in achieving sth（达到；获得）

attempt.meaning: an act of trying to do sth, especially sth difficult, often with no success（企图；试图；尝试）；an act of trying to kill sb（杀人企图）；an effort to do better than sth, such as a very good performance in sport（（为超越某事物的）尝试，努力）；to make an effort or try to do sth, especially sth difficult（努力；尝试；试图）

attempted.meaning: (of a crime, etc.（犯罪等）；that sb has tried to do but without success（未遂的）

attend.meaning: (rather formal) to be present at an event（出席；参加）；(formal) to go regularly to a place（经常去，定期去（某处））；(formal) to pay attention to what sb is saying or to what you are doing（注意；专心）；(formal) to happen at the same time as sth（伴随发生）

attendance.meaning: the act of being present at a place, for example at school（出席；参加；上学；到场）；the number of people present at an organized event（出席人数）；(formal) to be present at a special event（出席（特别活动））；(formal) to be with or near sb in order to help them if necessary（陪侍；随侍（某人）左右；服侍）

attendant.meaning: a person whose job is to serve or help people in a public place（服务员；侍者）；a person who takes care of and lives or travels with an important person or a sick or disabled person（（要人的）侍从，随从；（病人的）护理者）；(formal) closely connected with sth that has just been mentioned（伴随的；随之而来的）

attention.meaning: the act of listening to, looking at or thinking about sth/sb carefully（注意；专心；留心；注意力）；interest that people show in sb/sth（兴趣；关注）；things that sb does to try to please you or to show their interest in you（殷勤；关心）；special care, action or treatment（特别照料（或行动、处理））

attraction.meaning: a feeling of liking sb, especially sexually（（尤指两性间的）爱慕，吸引）；an interesting or enjoyable place to go or thing to do（向往的地方；有吸引力的事）；a feature, quality or person that makes sth seem interesting and enjoyable, and worth having or doing（有吸引力的特征（或品质、人））；(physics 物) a force that pulls things towards each other（吸引力）

attractive.meaning: (of a person（人）；pleasant to look at, especially in a sexual way（性感的；妩媚的；英俊的；诱人的）；(of a thing or a place（物或地方）；pleasant（吸引人的；令人愉快的）

attributive.meaning: (of adjectives or nouns（形容词或名词）；used before a noun to describe it（（用于所修饰的名词前）定语的）；at·tribu·tive·ly /əˈtrɪbjətɪvli; NAmEəˈtrɪbjətɪvli/ adv. Some adjectives can only be used attributively.（有些形容词只能用作定语。）

auction.meaning: a public event at which things are sold to the person who offers the most money for them（拍卖）；to sell sth at an auction（拍卖）；to sell sth at an auction, especially sth that is no longer needed or wanted（拍卖掉（尤指不再需要的物品））

avenue.meaning: a street in a town or city（（城镇的）大街）；(BrE) a wide straight road with trees on both sides, especially one leading to a big house（林荫道（尤指通往大住宅者））；a choice or way of making progress towards sth（选择；途径；手段）

He was attractive and averagely intelligent.（他讨人喜欢，智力一般。）

avoid.meaning: to prevent sth bad from happening（避免；防止）；to keep away from sb/sth; to try not to do sth（回避；避开；躲避）；to prevent yourself from hitting sth（避免撞到（某物））；(informal) to try very hard not to meet sb, do sth, etc.（像避瘟疫似地躲着某人（或某事物）；尽量避开某人（或某事物））

award.meaning: (often in names of particular awards（常用于奖项名称）；a prize such as money, etc. for sth that sb has done（奖；奖品；奖金；奖状）；an increase in the amount of money sb earns（（收入的）增加）；the amount of money that a court decides should be given to sb who has won a case; the decision to give this money（（赔偿）裁定额；（赔偿）裁决）

aware.meaning: knowing or realizing sth（知道；意识到；明白）；noticing that sth is present, or that sth is happening（察觉到；发觉；发现）；(used with an adverb（与副词连用）；interested in and knowing about sth, and thinking it is important（对 … 有兴趣的；有 … 意识的）

bazaar.meaning: (in some Eastern countries) a street or an area of a town where there are many small shops（（某些东方国家的）集市）；(in Britain, the US, etc.) a sale of goods, often items made by hand, to raise money for a charity or for people who need help（（英、美等国的）义卖）

be.meaning: to exist; to be present（有；存在）；to be located; to be in a place（位于；在（某处））；to happen at a time or in a place（（在某时或某地）发生）；to remain in a place（留在（某地）；逗留）

beach.meaning: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle ), beside the sea or a lake（海滩；沙滩；海滨；湖滨）；to come or bring sth out of the water and onto the beach（（使）上岸；把 … 拖上岸）

beacon.meaning: a light that is placed somewhere to guide vehicles and warn them of danger（（指引车船等的）灯标，灯塔；立标）；a radio station whose signal helps ships and aircraft to find their position（（导航）无线电信标台）；(in the past) a fire lit on top of a hill as a signal（（旧时）烽火）

bead.meaning: a small piece of glass, wood, etc. with a hole through it, that can be put on a string with others of the same type and worn as jewellery, etc.（（有孔的）珠子）；a rosary（（玫瑰）念珠）；a small drop of liquid（（液体的）小滴）；(especially NAmE) to aim carefully at sb/sth before shooting a gun（（射击前）瞄准）

beak.meaning: the hard pointed or curved outer part of a bird's mouth（鸟喙）；(humorous) a person's nose, especially when it is large and/or pointed（鹰钩鼻；尖鼻；鼻子）；(old-fashioned) (BrE slang) a person in a position of authority, especially a judge（掌权者；（尤指）法官）

beam.meaning: a line of light, electric waves or particles（光线；（电波的）波束；（粒子的）束）；a long piece of wood, metal, etc. used to support weight, especially as part of the roof in a building（梁）；a wooden bar that is used in the sport of gymnastics for people to move and balance on（平衡木）；a wide and happy smile（笑容；眉开眼笑）

bean.meaning: a seed, or pod containing seeds, of a climbing plant, eaten as a vegetable. There are several types of bean and the plants that they grow on are also called beans.（豆；菜豆；豆荚；豆科植物）；(usually in compounds（通常构成复合词）；a seed from a coffee plant, or some other plants（（咖啡树或其他某些植物的）籽实）；(of a person（人）

bear.meaning: (used with can/could in negative sentences and questions（在否定句和疑问句中与 can / could 连用）；to be able to accept and deal with sth unpleasant（承受；忍受）；to not be suitable for sth（不适于某事（或做某事））；(formal) to take responsibility for sth（承担责任）

beard.meaning: hair that grows on the chin and cheeks of a man's face; similar hair that grows on some animals（（人的）胡须，络腮胡子；（动物的）颔毛，须）；beard·ed /ˈbɪədɪd; NAmEˈbɪrdɪd/ adj. a bearded face/man（有胡子的脸/男子）；to go to see an important or powerful person to tell them that you disagree with them, that you want sth, etc.（进狮穴捋狮须（敢于触犯有权势者））

bearing.meaning: the way in which sth is related to sth or influences it（关系；影响）；the way in which you stand, walk or behave（姿态；举止）；(technical 术语) a direction measured from a fixed point using a compass（（用罗盘测定的）方位）；(technical 术语) a part of a machine that supports a moving part, especially one that is turning（（机器的）承座；（尤指）轴承）

bearish.meaning: showing or expecting a fall in the prices of shares（熊市的；（证券市场）看跌的）

beast.meaning: (old-fashioned or formal) an animal, especially one that is large or dangerous, or one that is unusual（（尤指大型或凶猛、独特的）动物，兽）；a person who is cruel and whose behaviour is uncontrolled（性情凶残的人；行为粗暴的人）；(informal, often humorous) an unpleasant person or thing（讨厌的人（或事物））；(informal) a thing of a particular kind（（某种）东西）

beat.meaning: to defeat sb in a game or competition（（在比赛或竞争中）赢，打败（某人））；(informal) to get control of sth（控制）；(informal) to be too difficult for sb（难倒）；(rather informal) to do or be better than sth（比 … 更好；赛过；胜过）

beater.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a tool used for beating things（拍打器；搅拌器）；a person employed to drive birds and animals out of bushes, etc., into the open, so they can be shot for sport（驱猎物者（受雇将鸟兽从树丛中赶到开阔地供人射猎））；(in compounds（构成复合词）

beau.meaning: a woman's male lover or friend（（女性的）男友，情郎）

beautician.meaning: a person, usually a woman, whose job is to give beauty treatments to the face and body（美容师）

beautiful.meaning: having beauty; pleasing to the senses or to the mind（美丽的；美好的）；very good or skilful（很好的；出色的；巧妙的）

beautifully.meaning: in a beautiful way（美好地；美妙地；漂亮地）；very well; in a pleasing way（很好；令人满意地）

beautify.meaning: to make sb/sth beautiful or more beautiful（美化；使更美丽）

beauty.meaning: the quality of being pleasing to the senses or to the mind（美；美丽）；a person or thing that is beautiful（美人；美好的东西）；an excellent example of its type（极好的榜样；典型的例子）；a pleasing feature（好处；优点）

beaver.meaning: an animal with a wide flat tail and strong teeth. Beavers live in water and on land and can build dams (= barriers across rivers) made of pieces of wood and mud. It is an official symbol of Canada.（河狸，海狸（生活在水边，会筑坝，是加拿大的象征））；the fur of the beaver, used in making hats and clothes（海狸毛皮（用以制作衣帽））；(taboo, slang) (especially NAmE) the area around a woman's sex organs（女子阴部）；(informal) to work very hard at sth（忙于（某事）；勤奋工作）

because.meaning: for the reason that（因为）；because of ★ /; NAmE/ prep. They are here because of us.（他们是因为我们来这里的。）

become.meaning: to start to be sth（开始变得；变成；成为）；(formal) to be suitable for sb（适合（某人）；（与 … ）相称）；(formal) to look attractive on sb（使（人）显得漂亮；使好看）；used to ask what has happened or what will happen to sb/sth（（遭遇）如何；（结果）怎么样）

bed.meaning: the abbreviation for ‘Bachelor of Education’ (a first university degree in education)（教育学士（全写为 Bachelor of Education，大学教育学的初级学位））

bedding.meaning: the sheets and covers that you put on a bed, often also the mattress and the pillows（寝具；铺盖）；straw, etc. for animals to sleep on（（给动物歇息的）垫草）

bedpan.meaning: a container used as a toilet by a person who is too ill/sick to get out of bed（（卧床病人用的）便盆）

bedroom.meaning: a room for sleeping in（卧室）；having the number of bedrooms mentioned（有 … 个卧室的）；used as a way of referring to sexual activity（房事的；男女性爱的）

bee.meaning: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting. Bees live in large groups and make honey (= a sweet sticky substance that is good to eat).（蜜蜂）；(NAmE) a meeting in a group where people combine work, competition and pleasure（（集工作、竞赛、娱乐为一体的）聚会）；(informal) an excellent person or thing（出类拔萃的人（或物））；(informal) to think or talk about sth all the time and to think that it is very important（一心想着；念念不忘；总认为很重要）

beef.meaning: meat that comes from a cow（牛肉）；(informal) a complaint（抱怨；牢骚）；(informal) to complain a lot about sb/sth（老是抱怨；大发牢骚）；(informal) to make sth bigger, better, more interesting, etc.（使更大（或更好、更有意思等））

beer.meaning: an alcoholic drink made from malt and flavoured with hops. There are many types of beer.（啤酒）；a glass, bottle or can of beer（一杯（或一瓶、一罐）啤酒）

beetle.meaning: an insect, often large and black, with a hard case on its back, covering its wings. There are several types of beetle.（甲虫）；the English names for the original Volkswagen small car with a round shape at the front and the back（“甲壳虫”（英国人用以指称一款圆头圆顶的原大众牌的小汽车））；(BrE) (informal) to move somewhere quickly（快速移动）

befit.meaning: (formal) to be suitable and good enough for sb/sth（适合；对 … 相称）

before.meaning: earlier than sb/sth（在 … 以前）；(rather formal) used to say that sb/sth is in a position in front of sb/sth（在 … 面前（或前面））；used to say that sb/sth is ahead of sb/sth in an order or arrangement（（次序或排列）在前面）；used to say that sth is facing sb in the future（（表示面临或临近））

beforehand.meaning: earlier; before sth else happens or is done（预先；事先）

befriend.meaning: to become a friend of sb, especially sb who needs your help（（尤指和需要帮助者）做朋友；友善相待）

beg.meaning: to ask sb for sth especially in an anxious way because you want or need it very much（恳求；祈求；哀求）；to ask sb for money, food, etc., especially in the street（乞讨；行乞）；if a dog begs, it sits on its back legs with its front legs in the air, waiting to be given sth（（狗蹲坐在后腿上将前腿抬起）等食物）；(formal) to ask sb for permission to do sth（请求准许做某事）

beggar.meaning: a person who lives by asking people for money or food（乞丐；叫花子）；(BrE) (informal) used with an adjective to describe sb in a particular way（（与形容词连用）家伙）；(saying) people say beggars can't be choosers when there is no choice and sb must be satisfied with what is available（要饭就不能嫌馊；给什么就得要什么）；to make sb/sth very poor（使贫穷；使匮乏）

begin.meaning: to start doing sth; to do the first part of sth（开始；启动）；to start to happen or exist, especially from a particular time（起始；开始存在（或进行））；to be sth first, before becoming sth else（起初是；本来是）；to have sth as the first part or the point where sth starts（（从 … ）开始；（以 … ）为起点）

beginner.meaning: a person who is starting to learn sth and cannot do it very well yet（新手；初学者）

beginning.meaning: the time when sth starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.（开头；开端；开始部分）；the first or early ideas, signs or stages of sth（原始思想；前兆；初级阶段）；the first sign of sth ending（结束的前兆；结局的开始）

behalf.meaning: (US) in order to help sb（为帮助某人）；as the representative of sb or instead of them（代表（或代替）某人）；in order to help sb（为帮助某人）；because of sb; for sb（因为某人；为了某人）

behave.meaning: to do things in a particular way（表现）；In spoken English people often use like instead of as if or as though, especially in NAmE.（英语口语中，尤其是美式英语，常用 like 代替 as if 或 as though）；This is not considered correct in written BrE.（英式英语书面语中，此用法被视为不正确。）；to do things in a way that people think is correct or polite（表现得体；有礼貌）

behaviour.meaning: the way that sb behaves, especially towards other people（行为；举止；态度）；the way a person, an animal, a plant, a chemical, etc. behaves or functions in a particular situation（（人、动植物、化学品等的）表现方式，活动方式）；be·hav·iour·al (especially US be·hav·ior·al) /bɪˈheɪvjərəl; NAmEbɪˈheɪvjərəl/ adj. children with behavioural difficulties（有行为问题的儿童）；be·hav·iour·al·ly (especially US be·hav·ior·al·ly /bɪˈheɪvjərəli; NAmEbɪˈheɪvjərəli/) adv. IDM be on your best beˈhaviour to behave in the most polite way you can（尽量表现得体）

behind.meaning: at or towards the back of sb/sth, and often hidden by it or them（在（或向）… 的后面；在（或向）… 的背面）；making less progress than sb/sth（落后于）；giving support to or approval of sb/sth（支持；赞成）；responsible for starting or developing sth（是 … 产生（或发展）的原因）

behindhand.meaning: late in doing sth or in paying money that is owed（拖欠；拖拉）

being.meaning: existence（存在；生存）；a living creature（生物）；(formal) your mind and all of your feelings（思想感情；身心）

belie.meaning: to give a false impression of sb/sth（掩饰；遮掩；给人以假象）；to show that sth cannot be true or correct（显示（某事）不正确；证明（某事）错误）

belief.meaning: a strong feeling that sth/sb exists or is true; confidence that sth/sb is good or right（相信；信心）；an opinion about sth; sth that you think is true（看法；信念）；something that you believe, especially as part of your religion（信仰；宗教信仰）；(in a way that is) too great, difficult, etc. to be believed（令人难以置信）

believable.meaning: that can be believed（可相信的；可信任的）

believe.meaning: to feel certain that sth is true or that sb is telling you the truth（相信；认为真实）；to think that sth is true or possible, although you are not completely certain（把（某事）当真；认为有可能）；to have the opinion that sth is right or true（认定；看作）；used to say that you are surprised or annoyed at sth（（表示对某事吃惊或恼怒））

bell.meaning: a hollow metal object, often shaped like a cup, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes（铃（声）；钟（声））；an electrical device which makes a ringing sound when a button on it is pushed; the sound that it makes, used as a signal or a warning（电铃（声））；(BrE) (informal) to call sb by telephone（打电话给某人）

belle.meaning: a beautiful woman; the most beautiful woman in a particular place（美女；（某地）最美的女人）

bellow.meaning: to shout in a loud deep voice, especially because you are angry（大声吼叫；怒吼）；when a large animal such as a bull bellows, it makes a loud deep sound（（公牛等）吼叫）；bel·low noun to let out a bellow of rage/pain（发出怒吼；疼痛地叫喊）

belly.meaning: the part of the body below the chest（腹部；肚子）；(literary) the round or curved part of an object（（物体的）圆形或凸起部分）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type of belly mentioned（腹部 … 形的）

belong.meaning: to be in the right or suitable place（应在（某处））；to feel comfortable and happy in a particular situation or with a particular group of people（适应；合得来）；be·long·ing /bɪˈlɒŋɪŋ; NAmEbɪˈlɔːŋɪŋ/ noun [U] to feel a sense of belonging（有一种归属感）；to be owned by sb（属于某人；归某人所有）

belongings.meaning: the things that you own which can be moved, for example not land or buildings（动产；财物）

beloved.meaning: loved very much by sb; very popular with sb（钟爱的；深受喜爱的）；loved very much（深爱的；亲爱的）；(old use or literary) a person who is loved very much by sb（心爱的人）

below.meaning: at or to a lower level or position than sb/sth（在（或到）… 下面）；of a lower amount or standard than sb/sth（（数量）少于；（标准）低于）；of a lower rank or of less importance than sb/sth（（级别、重要性）低于）；at or to a lower level, position or place（在（或到）下面）

belt.meaning: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the waist（腰带；皮带）；a continuous band of material that moves round and is used to carry things along or to drive machinery（传送带；传动带）；an area with particular characteristics or where a particular group of people live（地带；地区）；(informal) an act of hitting sth/sb hard（狠打；猛击）

beluga.meaning: a type of small whale（白鲸）；a type of large fish that lives in rivers and lakes in eastern Europe（欧洲鳇，欧鳇（大型鲟鱼））；a type of caviar (= fish eggs), from a beluga（鲟鱼鱼子酱）

bemoan.meaning: (formal) to complain or say that you are not happy about sth（哀怨；悲叹）

bench.meaning: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood（（木制）长凳，长椅）；(law 律) a judge in court or the seat where he/she sits; the position of being a judge or magistrate（法官；法官席位；法官（或裁判官）的职位）；(in the British Parliament) a seat where a particular group of politicians sit（（英国议会的）议员席）；(sport 体) the seats where players sit when they are not playing in the game（场边的运动员休息区）

bend.meaning: (especially of sb's body or head（尤指人的身体或头部）；to lean, or make sth lean, in a particular direction（（使）倾斜，偏向）；if you bend your arm, leg, etc. or if it bends, you move it so that it is no longer straight（（使四肢等）弯曲）；to force sth that was straight into an angle or a curve（把 … 弄弯（或折起））

beneath.meaning: in or to a lower position than sb/sth; under sb/sth（在（或往）… 下面；在（或往）… 下方）；not good enough for sb（（对某人来说）不够好）；be·neath adv. Her careful make-up hid the signs of age beneath.（她细腻的化妆掩盖了她年龄的痕迹。）

beneficial.meaning: (formal) improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect（有利的；有帮助的；有用的）

beneficiary.meaning: a person who gains as a result of sth（受益者；受惠人）；a person who receives money or property when sb dies（遗产继承人）

benefit.meaning: an advantage that sth gives you; a helpful and useful effect that sth has（优势；益处；成效）；(BrE) money provided by the government to people who need financial help because they are unemployed, ill/sick, etc.（福利费（政府对失业者、病人等提供的补助金））；an advantage that you get from a company in addition to the money that you earn; money from an insurance company（（公司发的）奖金，补贴；（保险公司发的）给付）；an event such as a performance, a dinner, etc., organized in order to raise money for a particular person or charity（慈善（或公益）活动）

benevolent.meaning: (especially of people in authority（尤指当权者）；kind, helpful and generous（慈善的；行善的；乐善好施的）；used in the names of some organizations that give help and money to people in need（（用于慈善机构名称））

benign.meaning: (of people（人）；kind and gentle; not hurting anybody（善良的；和善的；慈祥的）；(of tumours growing in the body（体内生长的肿瘤）；not dangerous or likely to cause death（良性的）

bent.meaning: not straight（弯曲的）；(of a person（人）；not able to stand up straight, usually as a result of being old or ill/sick（（因年老或生病）驼背的，弯腰的）；(of a person in authority（当权者）

benzene.meaning: a clear liquid obtained from petroleum and coal tar, used in making plastics and many chemical products（苯）

bequest.meaning: money or property that you ask to be given to a particular person when you die（遗产；遗赠）

berg.meaning: a mountain or group of mountains（山；群山；山脉）；the Drakensberg, a group of tall mountains in South Africa（（南非）德拉肯斯山脉）

berry.meaning: a small fruit that grows on a bush. There are several types of berry, some of which can be eaten.（浆果；莓）

berth.meaning: a place to sleep on a ship or train, or in a caravan/camper（（船或火车等的）卧铺，舱位，铺位）；a place where a ship or boat can stop and stay, usually in a harbour（（船的）泊位，锚地）；to put a ship in a berth or keep it there; to sail into a berth（（使船）停泊）

beset.meaning: (formal) to affect sb/sth in an unpleasant or harmful way（困扰；威胁）

beside.meaning: next to or at the side of sb/sth（在旁边（或附近））；compared with sb/sth（与 … 相比）；to not be important or closely related to the main thing you are talking about（无关紧要；离题；不相关）；unable to control yourself because of the strength of emotion you are feeling（（情绪上）失去自制力；失常）

besides.meaning: in addition to sb/sth; apart from sb/sth（除 … 之外（还））；used for making an extra comment that adds to what you have just said（而且；再说）；in addition; also（此外；以及；也）

besiege.meaning: to surround a building, city, etc. with soldiers until the people inside are forced to let you in（围困；包围）；(especially of sth unpleasant or annoying（尤指令人不快或烦恼的事）；to surround sb/sth in large numbers（团团围住）；to send so many letters, ask so many questions, etc. that it is difficult for sb to deal with them all（（用大量的信件、提问等）使某人应接不暇）

best.meaning: of the most excellent type or quality（最好的；最出色的；最优秀的）；most enjoyable; happiest（最愉快的；最幸福的）；most suitable or appropriate（最合适的；最恰当的）；most; to the greatest extent（最；最高程度地）

bestow.meaning: (formal) to give sth to sb, especially to show how much they are respected（给予；授予；献给）

best-seller.meaning: a product, usually a book, which is bought by large numbers of people（畅销品；畅销书）；ˌbest-ˈselling /; NAmE/ adj. a best-selling novel/author（畅销小说；畅销书作者）

bet.meaning: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result（下赌注（于）；用 … 打赌）；(informal) used to say that you are almost certain that sth is true or that sth will happen（敢说；八成儿）；used to show that you can understand what sb is feeling, describing, etc.（（表示理解）有同感，当然）；used to tell sb that you do not believe what they have just said（（表示不相信对方的话））

betray.meaning: to give information about sb/sth to an enemy（出卖；泄露（机密））；to hurt sb who trusts you, especially by not being loyal or faithful to them（辜负；对 … 不忠）；to ignore your principles or beliefs in order to achieve sth or gain an advantage for yourself（背叛（原则或信仰））；to tell sb or make them aware of a piece of information, a feeling, etc., usually without meaning to（（无意中）泄露信息，流露情感）

betrayal.meaning: the act of betraying sb/sth or the fact of being betrayed（（被）背叛，出卖）

better.meaning: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as sth else（较好的；更好的）；more able or skilled（能力更强的；更熟练的）；more suitable or appropriate（更合适的；更恰当的）；less ill/sick or unhappy（（病势）好转的，见轻的；舒畅些的）

betting.meaning: the act of risking money, etc. on the unknown result of an event（打赌；赌钱）；(informal) it seems likely that …（很可能；大概会）

between.meaning: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.（（空间上）在 … 中间，介于 … 之间）；in the period of time that separates two days, years, events, etc.（（时间上）在 … 之间，在 … 中间）；at some point along a scale from one amount, weight, distance, etc. to another（（数量、重量、距离等）介于 … 之间）；(of a line（界线）

beverage.meaning: any type of drink except water（（除水以外的）饮料）

beware.meaning: (used only in infinitives and in orders（仅用于不定式和命令）；if you tell sb to beware, you are warning them that sb/sth is dangerous and that they should be careful（当心；小心；提防）

bewilder.meaning: to confuse sb（使迷惑；使糊涂）；be·wil·dered /bɪˈwɪldəd; NAmEbɪˈwɪldərd/ adj. He turned around, with a bewildered look on his face.（他转过身来，满脸困惑。）

beyond.meaning: on or to the further side of sth（在（或向）… 较远的一边）；later than a particular time（晚于；迟于）；more than sth（超出；除 … 之外）；used to say that sth is not possible（（表示不可能））

bias.meaning: a strong feeling in favour of or against one group of people, or one side in an argument, often not based on fair judgement（偏见；偏心；偏向）；an interest in one thing more than others; a special ability（偏爱；特殊能力）；the bias of a piece of cloth is an edge cut diagonally across the threads（斜纹）；to unfairly influence sb's opinions or decisions（使有偏见；使偏心；使偏向）

bible.meaning: the holy book of the Christian religion, consisting of the Old Testament and the New Testament（基督教的《圣经》（包括《旧约》和《新约》））；the holy book of the Jewish religion, consisting of the Torah (or Law), the Prophets and the Writings（犹太教的《圣经》（包括《律法书》、《先知书》以及《圣录》））；a copy of the holy book of the Christian or Jewish religion（一册（基督教或犹太教的）《圣经》）；a book containing important information on a subject, that you refer to very often（权威著作（或参考书））

biblical.meaning: connected with the Bible; in the Bible（有关《圣经》的；《圣经》中的）；very great; on a large scale（宏大的；大规模的）；(humorous) to have had sex with sb（与某人发生过性关系）

bibliography.meaning: a list of books or articles about a particular subject or by a particular author; the list of books, etc. that have been used by sb writing an article, etc.（（某一专题或作家的）书目，索引；参考书目）；the study of the history of books and their production（目录学；文献学；书志学）

bicycle.meaning: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet（自行车；脚踏车）；(old-fashioned) to go somewhere on a bicycle（骑自行车）

bid.meaning: to offer to pay a particular price for sth, especially at an auction（出价；（尤指拍卖中）喊价）；to offer to do work or provide a service for a particular price, in competition with other companies, etc.（投标）；(used especially in newspapers（尤用于报章）；to try to do, get or achieve sth（努力争取；企图获得）

bidding.meaning: the act of offering prices, especially at an auction（（尤指拍卖中的）出价，喊价）；the act of offering to do sth or to provide sth for a particular price（投标）；(in some card games（某些牌戏中）；the process of stating the number of points that players think they will win（叫牌）

big.meaning: large in size, degree, amount, etc.（（体积、程度、数量等）大的，巨大的）；(informal) older（年龄较大的）；(rather informal) important; serious（重大的；严重的）；(of a plan（计划）

bike.meaning: a bicycle（自行车；脚踏车）；a motorcycle（摩托车）；(BrE) (informal) a rude way of telling sb to go away（走开；滚开）；(informal) to go somewhere on a bicycle or motorcycle（骑自行车（或摩托车）；骑车）

bilateral.meaning: involving two groups of people or two countries（双方的；双边的）；(medical 医) involving both of two parts or sides of the body or brain（（身体部位）两侧的，对称的；（大脑）两半球的）

bilingual.meaning: able to speak two languages equally well（会说两种语言的）；using two languages; written in two languages（用两种语言（写）的）；bi·lin·gual noun Welsh/English bilinguals（会说威尔士语和英语的人）

bill.meaning: a piece of paper that shows how much you owe sb for goods or services（账单）；a written suggestion for a new law that is presented to a country's parliament so that its members can discuss it（（提交议会讨论的）议案，法案）；a programme of entertainment at a theatre, etc.（（剧院等的）节目单）；a notice in a public place to advertise an event（海报；招贴；广告）

billion.meaning: ; one thousand million（十亿）；You say a, one, two, several, etc. billion without a final ‘s’ on ‘billion’. Billions (of … ) can be used if there is no number or quantity before it. Always use a plural verb with billion or billions, except when an amount of money is mentioned.（说 a, one, two, several, etc. billion 时， billion 后面不加 s。若前面没有数目或数量，可用 billions (of...)。除非指金额，billion 和 billions 均用复数动词）；There are more examples of how to use numbers at the entry for hundred.（更多数词用法示例见 hundred 条。）；(informal) a very large amount（数以十亿计；大量）

billionaire.meaning: an extremely rich person, who has at least a thousand million pounds, dollars, etc. in money or property（巨富；亿万富翁）

bin.meaning: a container that you put waste in（垃圾箱）；a large container, usually with a lid, for storing things in（（有盖）大容器，箱，柜）；(BrE) (informal) to throw sth away（扔掉；丢弃）

bind.meaning: (formal) to tie sb/sth with rope, string, etc. so that they cannot move or are held together firmly（捆绑；系）；(formal) to tie a long thin piece of cloth around sth（（用长布条）缠绕）；to unite people, organizations, etc. so that they live or work together more happily or effectively（（使）联合在一起，结合）；to force sb to do sth by making them promise to do it or by making it their duty to do it（约束；迫使）

binding.meaning: that must be obeyed because it is accepted in law（必须遵守的；有法律约束力的）；the cover that holds the pages of a book together（（书籍的）封皮）；cloth that is fastened to the edge of sth to protect or decorate it（镶边；绲边）；a device on a ski that holds the heel and toe of your boot in place and releases the boot automatically if you fall（（滑雪板的）皮靴固定装置）

binge.meaning: (informal) a short period of time when sb does too much of a particular activity, especially eating or drinking alcohol（（短时间的）狂热活动，寻欢作乐，大吃大喝）；to eat or drink too much, especially without being able to control yourself（大吃大喝；狂欢作乐）

biochemist.meaning: a scientist who studies biochemistry（生（物）化学家）

biochemistry.meaning: the scientific study of the chemistry of living things（生物化学）；the chemical structure and behaviour of a living thing（生物的化学结构和特性）

biodegradable.meaning: a substance or chemical that is biodegradable can be changed to a harmless natural state by the action of bacteria, and will therefore not damage the environment（可生物降解的）

biodiversity.meaning: the existence of a large number of different kinds of animals and plants which make a balanced environment（生态多样性（大量各种生物的共存以维持生态环境平衡））

biographer.meaning: a person who writes the story of another person's life（传记作家）

biography.meaning: the story of a person's life written by sb else; this type of writing（传记；传记作品）

biological.meaning: connected with the science of biology（生物学的）；connected with the processes that take place within living things（生物的；与生命过程有关的）；(of washing powder, etc.（洗衣粉等）；using enzymes (= chemical substances that are found in plants and animals) to get clothes, etc. clean（加（生化）酶的）

biologist.meaning: a scientist who studies biology（生物学家）

biology.meaning: the scientific study of the life and structure of plants and animals（生物学）；the way in which the body and cells of a living thing behave（生理）

biome.meaning: the characteristic plants and animals that exist in a particular type of environment, for example in a forest or desert（生物群系（类似环境条件的植物和动物群落））

biotechnology.meaning: the use of living cells and bacteria in industrial and scientific processes（生物技术）；bio·tech·no·logic·al /ˌbaɪəʊteknəˈlɒdʒɪkl; NAmEˌbaɪoʊteknəˈlɑːdʒɪkl/biotechnological research（生物科技研究）

biotic.meaning: of or related to living things（生物的；生命的）

bipedal.meaning: (of animals（动物）；using only two legs for walking（双足行走的；两腿行走的）

birch.meaning: a tree with smooth bark and thin branches, that grows in northern countries（桦树；白桦树）；the hard pale wood of the birch tree（桦木）；the practice of hitting sb with a bunch of birch sticks, as a punishment（用桦木条抽打（作为惩罚））

bird.meaning: a creature that is covered with feathers and has two wings and two legs. Most birds can fly.（鸟；禽）；(BrE) (slang, sometimes offensive) a way of referring to a young woman（姑娘；妞）；(informal) a person of a particular type, especially sb who is strange or unusual in some way（某类人；（尤指）古怪的人，不寻常的人）；(informal) to not be important or practical（不重要；不实际）

birth.meaning: the time when a baby is born; the process of being born（出生；诞生；分娩）；the beginning of a new situation, idea, place, etc.（创始；起源）；a person's origin or the social position of their family（出身；门第）；to produce a baby or young animal（生孩子；产崽）

birthday.meaning: the day in each year which is the same date as the one on which you were born（生日）；(humorous) not wearing any clothes（光着身子；裸体）

birthplace.meaning: the house or area where a person was born, especially a famous person（（尤指名人的）出生时的住宅，出生地）；the place where sth first happened（发源地；发祥地）

birthright.meaning: a thing that sb has a right to because of the family or country they were born in, or because it is a basic right of all humans（与生俱来的权利（或所有物）；基本人权）

biscuit.meaning: (BrE) a small flat dry cake for one person, usually sweet, and baked until crisp（饼干）；(NAmE) a soft bread roll, often eaten with gravy（松饼（食用时常佐以肉汁））；a pale yellowish-brown colour（淡黄褐色）；(informal) to be the most surprising, annoying, etc. thing that has happened or that sb has done（空前惊人；极其讨厌）

bishop.meaning: a senior priest in charge of the work of the Church in a city or district（主教）；a piece used in the game of chess that is shaped like a bishop's hat and can move any number of squares in a diagonal line（（国际象棋中的）象；（台）（西洋棋中的）主教）

bison.meaning: a large wild animal of the cow family that is covered with hair. There are two types of bison, the N American (also called buffalo) and the European.（野牛（分北美野牛和欧洲野牛两类））

bit.meaning: (used as an adverb（用作副词）；rather（有点儿；稍微）；(especially BrE) a short time or distance（稍顷；短距离）；(especially BrE) a small amount or piece of sth（小量；小块）

bitch.meaning: a female dog（母狗）；(slang, disapproving) an offensive way of referring to a woman, especially an unpleasant one（泼妇；讨厌的女人）；(slang) a thing that causes problems or difficulties（棘手的事；难办的事）；(informal) a complaint about sb/sth or a conversation in which you complain about them（怨言；牢骚）

bite.meaning: to use your teeth to cut into or through sth（咬）；to wound sb by making a small hole or mark in their skin（叮；蜇；咬）；if a fish bites, it takes food from the hook of a fishing line and may get caught（咬饵；上钩）；to have an unpleasant effect（产生不良影响）

bitter.meaning: (of arguments, disagreements, etc.（争论、分歧等）；very serious and unpleasant, with a lot of anger and hatred involved（激烈而不愉快的；充满愤怒与仇恨的）；(of people（人）；feeling angry and unhappy because you feel that you have been treated unfairly（愤愤不平的）

bitterly.meaning: in a way that shows feelings of sadness or anger（伤心地；愤怒地）；(describing unpleasant or sad feelings（形容不快或伤痛）；extremely（极其；非常）；very cold（非常寒冷；严寒）

bitumen.meaning: a black sticky substance obtained from oil, used for covering roads or roofs（沥青）；(AustralE) (informal) the surface of a road that is covered with tar（沥青路面；柏油路面）

bizarre.meaning: very strange or unusual（极其怪诞的；异乎寻常的）；bi·zarre·ly /bɪˈzɑːli; NAmEbɪˈzɑːrli/ adv. bizarrely dressed（穿着奇装异服）

black.meaning: having the very darkest colour, like night or coal（黑的；黑色的）；without light; completely dark（黑暗的；漆黑的）；belonging to a race of people who have dark skin; connected with black people（黑色人种的；黑人的）；without milk（不加牛奶的）

blackbird.meaning: a European bird: the male is black with a yellow beak and the female is brown with a brown beak（乌鸫（见于欧洲，雄鸟黑羽黄喙，雌鸟棕色））；a black N American bird, larger than the European blackbird, related to the starling（黑鹂（见于北美洲））

blackboard.meaning: a large board with a smooth black or dark green surface that teachers write on with a piece of chalk（黑板）

blacken.meaning: to make sth black; to become black（（使）变黑）；to say unpleasant things that give people a bad opinion of sb（抹黑；丑化；败坏 … 的名誉）

blackmail.meaning: the crime of demanding money from a person by threatening to tell sb else a secret about them（勒索；敲诈）；the act of putting pressure on a person or a group to do sth they do not want to do, for example by making threats or by making them feel guilty（胁迫；威胁；恐吓）；to force sb to give you money or do sth for you by threatening them, for example by saying you will tell people a secret about them（勒索；敲诈；要挟；胁迫）

blackout.meaning: a period when there is no light as a result of an electrical power failure（断电；停电）；a situation when the government or the police will not allow any news or information on a particular subject to be given to the public（新闻封锁）；(especially BrE) a period of time during a war when all lights must be put out or covered at night, so that they cannot be seen by an enemy attacking by air（灯火管制（期））；(BrE) a covering for windows that stops light being seen from outside, or light from outside from coming into a room（不透光窗罩（或窗帘））

blacksmith.meaning: a person whose job is to make and repair things made of iron, especially horseshoes（铁匠（尤指打马蹄铁者））

bladder.meaning: an organ that is shaped like a bag in which liquid waste (= urine) collects before it is passed out of the body（膀胱）；a bag made of rubber, leather, etc. that can be filled with air or liquid, such as the one inside a football（皮囊，气囊（如球胆））

blade.meaning: the flat part of a knife, tool or machine, which has a sharp edge or edges for cutting（刀身；刀片；刀刃）；one of the flat parts that turn around in an engine or on a helicopter（（机器上旋转的）叶片；桨叶）；the flat wide part of an oar (= one of the long poles that are used to row a boat) that goes in the water（（船桨的）桨叶，桨身）；a single flat leaf of grass（（草的）叶片）

blame.meaning: to think or say that sb/sth is responsible for sth bad（把 … 归咎于；责怪；指责）；to be responsible for sth bad（对（坏事）负有责任）；(informal) used to advise sb not to do sth, when you think they will do it despite your advice（（劝阻别人时说）别怪我）；(informal) used to say that you think that what sb did was reasonable and the right thing to do（我不怪你（或她等）；你（或她等）的做法是可以理解的）

bland.meaning: with little colour, excitement or interest; without anything to attract attention（平淡的；乏味的）；not having a strong or interesting taste（清淡的；无滋味的）；showing no strong emotions or excitement; not saying anything very interesting（沉稳的；无动于衷的；讲话枯燥的）

blank.meaning: empty, with nothing written, printed or recorded on it（空白的）；(of a wall or screen（墙壁或屏幕）；empty; with no pictures, marks or decoration（空的；无图画（或标记、装饰）的）；showing no feeling, understanding or interest（没表情的；不理解的；不感兴趣的）

blanket.meaning: a large cover, often made of wool, used especially on beds to keep people warm（毯子；毛毯）；a thick layer or covering of sth（厚层；厚的覆盖层）；including or affecting all possible cases, situations or people（包括所有情形（或人员）的；总括的；综合的）；(formal) to cover sth completely with a thick layer（以厚层覆盖）

blast.meaning: an explosion or a powerful movement of air caused by an explosion（爆炸；（爆炸引起的）气浪，冲击波）；a sudden strong movement of air（突如其来的强劲气流）；a sudden loud noise, especially one made by a musical instrument that you blow, or by a whistle or a car horn（（吹奏乐器、哨子、汽车喇叭等突然发出的）响声，吹奏声，轰鸣）；(used especially in newspapers（尤用于报章）

blaze.meaning: to burn brightly and strongly（熊熊燃烧）；to shine brightly（闪耀；发亮光）；(formal) if sb's eyes blaze, they look extremely angry（怒视；（怒火）燃烧）；to make news or information widely known by telling people about it in a way they are sure to notice（大肆宣扬）

bleach.meaning: to become white or pale by a chemical process or by the effect of light from the sun; to make sth white or pale in this way（（使）变白，漂白，晒白，褪色）；a chemical that is used to make sth become white or pale and as a disinfectant (= to prevent infection from spreading)（漂白剂）

bleak.meaning: (of a situation（状况）；not encouraging or giving any reason to have hope（不乐观的；无望的；暗淡的）；(of the weather（天气）；cold and unpleasant（阴冷的）

bleed.meaning: to lose blood, especially from a wound or an injury（流血；失血）；(in the past（旧时）；to take blood from sb as a way of treating disease（给（某人）放血）；(informal) to force sb to pay a lot of money over a period of time（长期榨取（某人的钱））

blend.meaning: to mix two or more substances together（使混合；掺和）；to form a mixture with sth（（和某物）混合；融合）；to combine with sth in an attractive or effective way; to combine sth in this way（（使）调和，协调，融合）；to produce sth by mixing different types together（调制；配制）

bless.meaning: to ask God to protect sb/sth（求上帝降福；祝福）；to make sth holy by saying a prayer over it（祝圣）；(formal) to call God holy; to praise God（称颂上帝；赞美上帝）；(old-fashioned, informal) used to express surprise（（表示惊奇））

blessing.meaning: God's help and protection, or a prayer asking for this（上帝的恩宠；祝福；祝颂）；approval of or permission for sth（赞同；许可）；something that is good or helpful（好事；有益之事）；something that seems to be a problem at first, but that has good results in the end（因祸得福；祸中有福）

blind.meaning: not able to see（瞎的；失明的）；people who are blind（盲人）；not noticing or realizing sth（（对某事）视而不见的，未察觉的）；(of strong feelings（强烈的感觉）

blindfold.meaning: something that is put over sb's eyes so they cannot see（障眼物；眼罩）；to cover sb's eyes with a piece of cloth or other covering so that they cannot see（（用布等）蒙住眼睛）；with the eyes covered（被蒙住眼睛）

blink.meaning: when you blink or blink your eyes or your eyes blink, you shut and open your eyes quickly（眨眼睛）；to shine with an unsteady light; to flash on and off（闪烁）；to try to control tears or clear your eyes by blinking（眨眼控制泪水（或挤掉脏东西））；the act of shutting and opening your eyes very quickly（眨眼睛）

blip.meaning: a change in a process or situation, usually when it gets worse for a short time before it gets better; a temporary problem（变故；暂时性问题）；a short high sound made by an electronic device（（电子装置发出的）短促尖声）；a small flashing point of light on a radar screen, representing an object（（雷达屏幕上代表物体的）光点）

bliss.meaning: extreme happiness（极乐）；(especially BrE) to reach a state of perfect happiness, when you are not aware of anything else（欣喜若狂；乐不可支）

blister.meaning: a swelling on the surface of the skin that is filled with liquid and is caused, for example, by rubbing or burning（（皮肤上摩擦或烫起等的）水疱，疱）；a similar swelling, filled with air or liquid, on metal, painted wood or another surface（（金属、油漆过的木头或其他表面上的）泡，气泡，水泡）；to form blisters; to make sth form blisters（（使）起水疱，起疱）；when a surface blisters or sth blisters it, it swells and cracks（（使表皮等）涨破，爆裂）

bloc.meaning: a group of countries that work closely together because they have similar political interests（（政治利益一致的）国家集团）

block.meaning: a large piece of a solid material that is square in shape and usually has flat sides（（方形平面）大块；立方体）；(BrE) a tall building that contains flats or offices; buildings that form part of a school, hospital, etc. which are used for a particular purpose（（公寓、办公、教学、医院等）大楼；（成组建筑中的）一栋楼房）；a group of buildings with streets on all sides（四面临街的一方块楼群；街区）；(NAmE) the length of one side of a piece of land or group of buildings, from the place where one street crosses it to the next（（两条街道之间的）一段街区）

blockage.meaning: a thing that blocks flow or movement, for example of a liquid in a narrow place（造成阻塞的东西；阻塞物）；the state of being blocked（堵塞；阻塞）

capital.meaning: the most important town or city of a country, usually where the central government operates from（首都；国都）；a large amount of money that is invested or is used to start a business（资本；资金；启动资金）；wealth or property that is owned by a business or a person（财富；财产）；(technical 术语) people who use their money to start businesses, considered as a group（资方）

capitalism.meaning: an economic system in which a country's businesses and industry are controlled and run for profit by private owners rather than by the government（资本主义）

capitalist.meaning: a person who supports capitalism（资本主义者）；a person who owns or controls a lot of wealth and uses it to produce more wealth（资本家）；based on the principles of capitalism（资本主义的）

capitalize.meaning: to write or print a letter of the alphabet as a capital; to begin a word with a capital letter（用大写字母书写（或印刷）；把 … 首字母大写）；(business 商) to sell possessions in order to change them into money（变卖资产；变现）；(business 商) to provide a company etc. with the money it needs to function（为 … 提供运营资本（或资金））；cap·it·al·iza·tion, -isa·tion /ˌkæpɪtəlaɪˈzeɪʃn; NAmEˌkæpɪtələˈzeɪʃn/ noun [U, sing.] PHR V ˈcapitalize on/upon sth to gain a further advantage for yourself from a situation（充分利用；从 … 中获得更多的好处）

capitulate.meaning: to agree to do sth that you have been refusing to do for a long time（屈服；屈从）；to stop resisting an enemy and accept that you are defeated（投降）

capsize.meaning: if a boat capsizes or sth capsizes it, it turns over in the water（（船）翻，倾覆）

capsule.meaning: a small container which has a measured amount of a medicine inside and which dissolves when you swallow it（（装药物的）胶囊）；a small plastic container with a substance or liquid inside（（装物或装液体的）小塑料容器）；the part of a spacecraft in which people travel and that often separates from the main rocket（太空舱；航天舱）；(technical 术语) a shell or container for seeds or eggs in some plants and animals（（植物的）荚，蒴果；（动物的）囊，被膜）

captain.meaning: the person in charge of a ship or commercial aircraft（船长；机长）；an officer of fairly high rank in the navy, the army and the US air force（（海军）上校；（陆军或美国空军的）上尉）；the leader of a group of people, especially a sports team（首领；领导者；（尤指运动队的）队长）；an officer of high rank in a US police or fire department（（美国警察局的）副巡长；（美国消防署的）中队长）

caption.meaning: words that are printed underneath a picture, cartoon, etc. that explain or describe it（（图片、漫画等的）说明文字）；to write a caption for a picture, photograph, etc.（给（图片、照片等）加说明文字）

captivate.meaning: to keep sb's attention by being interesting, attractive, etc.（迷住；使着迷）

captive.meaning: kept as a prisoner or in a confined space; unable to escape（被监禁的；被关起来的；被困住的）；not free to leave a particular place or to choose what you want to do（人身自由受限制的；受控制的；无权选择的）；a person who is kept as a prisoner, especially in a war（囚徒；俘虏；战俘）

capture.meaning: to catch a person or an animal and keep them as a prisoner or in a confined space（俘虏；俘获；捕获）；to take control of a place, building, etc. using force（用武力夺取；攻取；攻占）；to succeed in getting control of sth that other people are also trying to control（夺得；赢得；争得）；to make sb interested in sth（引起（注意、想像、兴趣））

car.meaning: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that can carry a small number of passengers（小汽车；轿车）；a separate section of a train（火车车厢）；(BrE) (in compounds（构成复合词）；a coach/ car on a train of a particular type（（某种类型的）火车车厢）

caravan.meaning: a road vehicle without an engine that is pulled by a car, designed for people to live and sleep in, especially when they are on holiday/vacation（旅行拖车，宿营拖车（无发动机，由其他车拖动，多供度假时住宿用））；(BrE) a covered vehicle that is pulled by a horse and used for living in（（供居住用的）有篷马车，大篷车）；a group of people with vehicles or animals who are travelling together, especially across the desert（（尤指穿越沙漠的）旅行队，车队）

carbohydrate.meaning: a substance such as sugar or starch that consists of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen. Carbohydrates in food provide the body with energy and heat.（碳水化合物；糖类）；foods such as bread, potatoes and rice that contain a lot of carbohydrate（含碳水化合物的食物；淀粉质食物）

carbon.meaning: a chemical element. Carbon is found in all living things, existing in a pure state as diamond and graphite and buckminsterfullerene.（碳）；used when referring to the gas carbon dioxide in terms of the effect it has on the earth's climate in causing global warming（碳（指导致全球变暖的二氧化碳气体））；a piece of carbon paper（复写纸）

carbonate.meaning: a salt that contains carbon and oxygen together with another chemical（碳酸盐）

carboniferous.meaning: producing or containing coal（产煤（或炭）的；含煤（或炭）的）；of the period in the earth's history when layers of coal were formed underground（石炭纪的）

carcass.meaning: the dead body of an animal, especially of a large one or of one that is ready for cutting up as meat（动物尸体；（尤指供食用的）畜体）

card.meaning: (BrE) thick stiff paper（卡片纸；厚纸片；薄纸板）；a small piece of stiff paper or plastic with information on it, especially information about sb's identity（（尤指显示个人资料的）卡片）；a small piece of plastic, especially one given by a bank or shop/store, used for buying things or obtaining money（信用卡；现金卡；储值卡）；a piece of stiff paper that is folded in the middle and has a picture on the front of it, used for sending sb a message with your good wishes, an invitation, etc.（贺卡；慰问卡；请柬）

cardboard.meaning: stiff material like very thick paper, often used for making boxes（硬纸板，卡纸板（常用于制造盒子））；not seeming real or genuine（不真实的；虚假的）

cardiac.meaning: connected with the heart or heart disease（心脏的；心脏病的）

cardinal.meaning: a priest of the highest rank in the Roman Catholic Church. Cardinals elect and advise the Pope.（枢机；枢机主教）；a number, such as 1, 2 and 3, used to show quantity rather than order（基数；纯数）；a N American bird. The male cardinal is bright red.（红衣凤头鸟（见于北美，雄鸟为鲜红色））；(formal) most important; having other things based on it（最重要的；基本的）

care.meaning: the process of caring for sb/sth and providing what they need for their health or protection（照料；照顾；照看；护理）；attention or thought that you give to sth that you are doing so that you will do it well and avoid mistakes or damage（小心；谨慎）；(formal) a feeling of worry or anxiety; something that causes problems or anxiety（忧虑；焦虑；引起烦恼的事；令人焦虑的事）；used when writing to sb at another person's address（（以别人的地址给某人写信时用）由某人转交）

career.meaning: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes（生涯；职业）；the period of time that you spend in your life working or doing a particular thing（经历；事业）；(of a person or vehicle（人或车辆）；to move forward very quickly, especially in an uncontrolled way（（尤指失控地）猛冲，疾驰，飞奔）

careful.meaning: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging sth or doing sth wrong（小心；注意；谨慎）；giving a lot of attention to details（细致的；精心的；慎重的）；care·ful·ly ★ /ˈkeəfəli; NAmEˈkerfəli/ adv. careless.meaning: not giving enough attention and thought to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes（不小心的；不仔细的；粗心的）；resulting from a lack of attention and thought（粗心造成的；疏忽引起的）；(formal) not at all worried about sth（不担忧的；无忧无虑的）；not showing interest or effort（淡漠的；不关心的；漫不经心的）

caress.meaning: to touch sb/sth gently, especially in a sexual way or in a way that shows affection（抚摩；爱抚）；a gentle touch or kiss to show you love sb（抚摩；爱抚；亲吻）

cargo.meaning: the goods carried in a ship or plane（（船或飞机装载的）货物）

caribbean.meaning: the region consisting of the Caribbean Sea and its islands, including the West Indies, and the coasts which surround it（加勒比海地区（指加勒比海及其岛屿，包括西印度群岛及其周围海岸））；connected with the Caribbean（加勒比海地区的；加勒比海诸岛的）

caribou.meaning: a N American reindeer（北美驯鹿）

carnation.meaning: a white, pink, red or yellow flower, often worn as a decoration on formal occasions（香石竹；康乃馨）

carnival.meaning: a public festival, usually one that happens at a regular time each year, that involves music and dancing in the streets, for which people wear brightly coloured clothes（狂欢节；嘉年华）；an outdoor entertainment at which people can play games to win prizes, buy food and drink, etc., usually arranged to make money for a special purpose（露天游乐会；义卖游乐会）；(formal) an exciting or brightly coloured mixture of things（激动人心的事物组合；五彩缤纷的事物组合）

carol.meaning: a Christian religious song sung at Christmas（圣诞颂歌）；to sing sth in a cheerful way（欢乐地唱）

carousel.meaning: a moving belt from which you collect your bags at an airport（（机场的）行李传送带）

carp.meaning: a large freshwater fish that is used for food（鲤鱼）；to keep complaining about sb/sth in an annoying way（不停地抱怨；唠叨）

carpenter.meaning: a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures（木工；木匠）

carpet.meaning: a thick woven material made of wool, etc. for covering floors or stairs（地毯）；a piece of carpet used as a floor covering, especially when shaped to fit a room（（尤指铺满房间的一块）地毯）；(literary) a thick layer of sth on the ground（覆盖地面的一层厚东西）；(informal) (especially NAmE) called to see sb in authority because you have done sth wrong（（因做错事）被上司叫去训斥）

carriage.meaning: a separate section of a train for carrying passengers（（火车的）客车厢）；a road vehicle, usually with four wheels, that is pulled by one or more horses and was used in the past to carry people（（旧时载客的）四轮马车）；(formal) the act or cost of transporting goods from one place to another（运输；运费）；a moving part of a machine that supports or moves another part, for example on a typewriter（（打字机等机器上的）滑动托架）

carrier.meaning: a company that carries goods or passengers from one place to another, especially by air（（尤指经营空运的）运输公司）；a military vehicle or ship that carries soldiers or equipment from one place to another（军输车；运输舰；航空母舰）；a person or animal that passes a disease to other people or animals but does not suffer from it（带菌者，病原携带者（自身不受感染而传播疾病的人或动物））；a metal frame that is fixed to a bicycle and used for carrying bags（（自行车的）载物架）

carrot.meaning: a long pointed orange root vegetable（胡萝卜）；a reward promised to sb in order to persuade them to do sth（（为说服人做事所许诺的）酬报，好处）；if you use the carrot and stick approach, you persuade sb to try harder by offering them a reward if they do, or a punishment if they do not（胡萝卜加大棒；威逼利诱）

carry.meaning: to support the weight of sb/sth and take them or it from place to place; to take sb/sth from one place to another（拿；提；搬；扛；背；抱；运送）；to have sth with you and take it wherever you go（携带；佩戴）；to contain and direct the flow of water, electricity, etc.（输送，传输，传送（水、电等））；if a person, an insect, etc. carries a disease, they are infected with it and might spread it to others although they might not become sick themselves（传播；传染）

cart.meaning: a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse and used for carrying loads（（两轮或四轮）运货马车）；a light vehicle with wheels that you pull or push by hand（手推车；手拉车）；a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things（手推车；手拉车）；a small car, often without a roof or doors, used for a particular purpose（（常指无顶无门的）专用小汽车）

cartilage.meaning: the strong white tissue that is important in support and especially in joints to prevent the bones rubbing against each other（软骨）

cartography.meaning: the art or process of drawing or making maps（制图学；地图绘制）

carton.meaning: a light cardboard or plastic box or pot for holding goods, especially food or liquid; the contents of a carton（（尤指装食品或液体的）硬纸盒，塑料盒，塑料罐；硬纸盒（或塑料盒）所装物品）；(NAmE) a large container in which goods are packed in smaller containers（（内装小盒的）大包装盒）

cartoon.meaning: an amusing drawing in a newspaper or magazine, especially one about politics or events in the news（（报刊中尤与政治或时事有关的）漫画，讽刺画）；a film/movie made by photographing a series of gradually changing drawings or models, so that they look as if they are moving（动画片；卡通片）；(technical 术语) a drawing made by an artist as a preparation for a painting（草图；底图）

carve.meaning: to make objects, patterns, etc. by cutting away material from wood or stone（雕刻）；to write sth on a surface by cutting into it（刻）；to cut a large piece of cooked meat into smaller pieces for eating（把（熟肉）切成块）；to work hard in order to have a successful career, reputation, etc.（艰苦创业；奋斗取得（事业、名声等））

carving.meaning: an object or a pattern made by cutting away material from wood or stone（雕刻品；雕刻图案；雕像）；the art of making objects in this way（雕刻术）

cascade.meaning: a small waterfall, especially one of several falling down a steep slope with rocks（小瀑布（尤指一连串瀑布中的一支））；a large amount of water falling or pouring down（倾泻；流注）；(formal) a large amount of sth hanging down（大簇的下垂物）；(formal) a large number of things falling or coming quickly at the same time（倾泻（或涌出）的东西）

case.meaning: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type（具体情况；事例；实例）；the true situation（实情；事实）；a situation that relates to a particular person or thing（特殊情况）；a matter that is being officially investigated, especially by the police（（尤指警方）侦查的案情，调查的案件）

cash.meaning: money in the form of coins or notes/bills（现金）；(informal) money in any form（（任何形式的）金钱，资金）；with immediate payment of cash（即付现款；即期付款）；(BrE) (informal) if you pay for goods and services cash in hand, you pay in cash, especially so that the person being paid can avoid paying tax on the amount（现金支付（尤指受款人可避税））

cashier.meaning: a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a bank, shop/store, hotel, etc.（出纳员）；to make sb leave the army, navy, etc. because they have done sth wrong（开除 … 的军职）

cassette.meaning: a small flat plastic case containing tape for playing or recording music or sound（磁带盒；盒式磁带；（台）卡式磁带）；a plastic case containing film that can be put into a camera（胶片盒）

cast.meaning: to look, smile, etc. in a particular direction（向 … 投以（视线、笑容等））；to make light, a shadow, etc. appear in a particular place（投射（光、影子等））；to say, do or suggest sth that makes people doubt sth or think that sb is less honest, good, etc.（使人怀疑；造谣中伤）；to throw one end of a fishing line into a river, etc.（投（钓线）；抛（钓钩））

casting.meaning: the process of choosing actors for a play or film/movie（角色分配；演员挑选）；an object made by pouring hot liquid metal, etc. into a mould (= a specially shaped container)（铸件；铸造品）

cast-iron.meaning: made of cast iron（铸铁制的）；(BrE) very strong or certain; that cannot be broken or fail（有力的；确实的；坚定不移的）

castle.meaning: a large strong building with thick high walls and towers, built in the past by kings or queens, or other important people, to defend themselves against attack（城堡；堡垒）；(in chess（国际象棋）；any of the four pieces placed in the corner squares of the board at the start of the game, usually made to look like a castle（车；城堡）；(BrE) (to have) plans or dreams that are not likely to happen or come true（（建）空中楼阁；幻想；空想）

casual.meaning: not showing much care or thought; seeming not to be worried; not wanting to show that sth is important to you（不经意的；无忧无虑的；漫不经心的；不在乎的）；without paying attention to detail（马虎的；疏忽的）；not formal（非正式的；随便的）；(BrE) not permanent; not done, or doing sth regularly（临时的；不定期的）

cat.meaning: a small animal with soft fur that people often keep as a pet. Cats catch and kill birds and mice.（猫）；a wild animal of the cat family（猫科动物）；(informal) to be the best thing, person, idea, etc.（最棒的东西（或人、主意等））；to tell a secret carelessly or by mistake（（无意中）泄露秘密）

catalogue.meaning: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy（目录；目录簿）；a long series of things that happen (usually bad things)（一连串（糟糕）事）；to arrange a list of things in order in a catalogue; to record sth in a catalogue（列入目录；编入目录）；to give a list of things connected with a particular person, event, etc.（记载，登记（某人、某事等的详情））

catch.meaning: to stop and hold a moving object, especially in your hands（接住；截住；拦住）；to hold a liquid when it falls（接（落下的液体））；to take hold of sb/sth（抓住；握住）；to capture a person or an animal that tries or would try to escape（逮住；捕捉；捕获）

catching.meaning: (of a disease（疾病）；easily caught by one person from another（有传染性）；(of an emotion or a mood（情感或情绪）；passing quickly from one person to another（有感染力）

catechism.meaning: a set of questions and answers that are used for teaching people about the beliefs of the Christian religion（（基督教的）教理问答）

category.meaning: a group of people or things with particular features in common（（人或事物的）类别，种类）

cater.meaning: to provide food and drinks for a social event（（为社交活动）提供饮食，承办餐宴）；to provide the things that a particular person or situation needs or wants（满足需要；适合）

caterpillar.meaning: a small creature like a worm with legs, that develops into a butterfly or moth (= flying insects with large, sometimes brightly coloured, wings). Caterpillars eat the leaves of plants.（毛虫，蠋（蝴蝶或蛾的幼虫））

cathedral.meaning: the main church of a district, under the care of a bishop (= a priest of high rank)（主教座堂；教区总教堂）

catholic.meaning: (technical 术语) connected with all Christians or the whole Christian Church（全体基督教徒的；基督教会的）；(formal) including many or most things（包罗万象的；广泛的）

cattle.meaning: cows and bulls that are kept as farm animals for their milk or meat（牛）
