charity.meaning: an organization for helping people in need（慈善机构（或组织））；the aim of giving money, food, help, etc. to people who are in need（慈善；赈济；施舍）；(formal) kindness and sympathy towards other people, especially when you are judging them（仁爱；宽容；宽厚）；(saying) you should help and care for your own family, etc. before you start helping other people（博爱始于自家）

charm.meaning: the power of pleasing or attracting people（魅力；魔力；吸引力）；a feature or quality that is pleasing or attractive（迷人的特征；吸引人的特性；妩媚）；a small object worn on a chain or bracelet, that is believed to bring good luck（（链或手镯上的）吉祥小饰物）；an act or words believed to have magic power（魔法；咒语；符咒）

charming.meaning: very pleasant or attractive（令人着迷的；迷人的；吸引人的）；(ironic, informal) used to show that you have a low opinion of sb's behaviour（（表示对某人的行为评价不高）真是太好了）

chart.meaning: a page or sheet of information in the form of diagrams, lists of figures, etc.（图表）；a detailed map of the sea（海图）；(especially BrE) a list, produced each week, of the songs or albums that have sold the most copies or been downloaded the most（（歌曲或唱片每周销售或下载数量）排行榜）；(informal) (especially NAmE) extremely high in level（高得离谱；高极了）

charter.meaning: a written statement describing the rights that a particular group of people should have（（说明某部分民众应有权利的）宪章）；a written statement of the principles and aims of an organization（（表明某一组织之宗旨和原则的）宪章，章程）；an official document stating that a ruler or government allows a new organization, town or university to be established and gives it particular rights（（统治者或政府准许成立新的组织、城镇、大学等并授予某种权利的）特许状，许可证，凭照）；(BrE) a law or policy that seems likely to help people do sth bad（（法律或政策的）不完善，漏洞，缺陷）

chary.meaning: not willing to risk doing sth; fearing possible problems if you do sth（不愿冒风险的；小心谨慎的；谨小慎微的）

chase.meaning: to run, drive, etc. after sb/sth in order to catch them（追赶；追逐；追捕）；to try to obtain or achieve sth, for example money, work or success（努力获得；争取得到）；(informal) to try to persuade sb to have a sexual relationship with you（追求；求爱）；(informal) to persuade sb to do sth that they should have done already（催促）

chasm.meaning: (literary) a deep crack or opening in the ground（（地上的）深裂口，裂隙，深坑）；(formal) a very big difference between two people or groups, for example because they have different attitudes（（两个人或团体之间的）巨大分歧，显著差别）

chaste.meaning: (old-fashioned) not having sex with anyone; only having sex with the person that you are married to（贞洁的；忠贞的）；(formal) not expressing sexual feelings（不含有性意味的；纯洁的）；(formal) simple and plain in style; not decorated（（风格）简朴的，朴实的；不修饰的）；chaste·ly /ˈtʃeɪstli; NAmEˈtʃeɪstli/ adv. He kissed her chastely on the cheek.（他在她的脸上留下了纯洁的一吻。）

chat.meaning: to talk in a friendly informal way to sb（闲聊；闲谈；聊天）；to exchange messages with other people on the Internet, especially in a chat room（（尤指在网上聊天室的）闲聊，聊天，交谈）；(BrE) (informal) to talk in a friendly way to sb you are sexually attracted to（（受异性吸引而）亲昵地攀谈，与某人搭讪）；(especially BrE) a friendly informal conversation（闲聊；闲谈；聊天）

chateau.meaning: a castle or large country house in France（（法国的）城堡，乡间别墅）

chatter.meaning: to talk quickly and continuously, especially about things that are not important（喋喋不休；唠叨；饶舌）；(of teeth（牙齿）；to knock together continuously because you are cold or frightened（（因冷或害怕）打颤）；(of birds or monkeys（禽或猴）

cheap.meaning: costing little money or less money than you expected（花钱少的；便宜的；廉价的）；charging low prices（收费低廉的）；(disapproving) low in price and quality（价低质劣的）；unpleasant or unkind and rather obvious（令人讨厌的；明显不友好的；不和善的）

cheapen.meaning: to make sb lose respect for himself or herself（使丧失威信；使贬低）；to make sth lower in price（降低 … 的价格）；to make sth appear to have less value（使贬值；贬低）

cheaply.meaning: without spending or costing much money（便宜地；廉价地；低廉地）

cheat.meaning: to trick sb or make them believe sth which is not true（欺骗；蒙骗）；to act in a dishonest way in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game, a competition, an exam, etc.（（尤指在游戏、比赛、考试等中）作弊，舞弊）；(of sb who is married or who has a regular sexual partner（已婚或有固定性伴侣的人）；to have a secret sexual relationship with sb else（与他人有秘密性关系；对某人不忠（或不贞））

cheater.meaning: a person who cheats, especially in a game（（尤指游戏中的）作弊者，骗子）

check.meaning: to examine sth to see if it is correct, safe or acceptable（检查；审查；核查；检验）；to find out if sth/sb is present, correct or true or if sth is how you think it is（查明；查看；核实；弄确实）；to control sth; to stop sth from increasing or getting worse（控制；抑制；阻止）；to stop yourself from saying or doing sth or from showing a particular emotion（克制，抑制（做某事或表露感情））

check-up.meaning: an examination of sth, especially a medical one to make sure that you are healthy（检查；（尤指）体格检查）

cheek.meaning: either side of the face below the eyes（面颊；脸颊）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type of cheeks mentioned（有 … 面颊的；面颊 … 的）；(informal) either of the buttocks（半边屁股）

cheeky.meaning: rude in an amusing or an annoying way（厚脸皮的；鲁莽的；放肆的）

cheep.meaning: (of young birds（雏鸟）；to make short high sounds（唧唧叫；吱吱叫）

cheer.meaning: a shout of joy, support or praise（欢呼声；喝彩声）；(NAmE) a special song or poem used by cheerleaders（（拉拉队的）加油歌，加油诗）；(formal or literary) an atmosphere of happiness（欢乐（或幸福）的气氛）；to shout loudly, to show support or praise for sb, or to give them encouragement（欢呼；喝彩；加油）

cheerful.meaning: happy, and showing it by the way that you behave（快乐的；高兴的；兴高采烈的）；giving you a feeling of happiness（令人愉快的）；cheer·ful·ly ★ /ˈtʃɪəfəli; NAmEˈtʃɪrfəli/ adv. to laugh/nod/whistle cheerfully（欢快地笑/点头/吹口哨）

cheerless.meaning: (of a place, etc.（地方等）；without warmth or colour so it makes you feel depressed（阴冷的；阴暗的；阴郁的）

cheese.meaning: a type of food made from milk that can be either soft or hard and is usually white or yellow in colour; a particular type of this food（干酪；奶酪）；what you ask sb to say before you take their photograph（“茄子”（要求照相的人说的口形词））

chef.meaning: a professional cook, especially the most senior cook in a restaurant, hotel, etc.（厨师；（尤指餐馆、旅馆等的）主厨，厨师长）

chemical.meaning: connected with chemistry（与化学有关的；化学的）；produced by or using processes which involve changes to atoms or molecules（用化学方法制造的；化学作用的）；chem·ic·al·ly AW /ˈkemɪkli; NAmEˈkemɪkli/ adv. chemist.meaning: a person whose job is to prepare and sell medicines, and who works in a shop（药剂师；药商）；(BrE) a shop/store that sells medicines and usually also soap, make-up, etc.（药房；（通常也出售肥皂、化妆品等的）药店）；a scientist who studies chemistry（化学家）

chemistry.meaning: the scientific study of the structure of substances, how they react when combined or in contact with one another, and how they behave under different conditions（化学）；(technical 术语) the chemical structure and behaviour of a particular substance（物质的化学组成（或性质））；the relationship between two people, usually a strong sexual attraction（（常指有强烈性吸引力的）两人间的关系）

cheque.meaning: a printed form that you can write on and sign as a way of paying for sth instead of using money（支票）

cherish.meaning: to love sb/sth very much and want to protect them or it（珍爱；钟爱；爱护）；to keep an idea, a hope or a pleasant feeling in your mind for a long time（抱有（信念、希望）；怀有（好感）；怀念）

cherry.meaning: a small soft round fruit with shiny red or black skin and a large seed inside（樱桃）；a tree on which cherries grow, or a similar tree, grown for its flowers（樱桃树；樱花树）；the wood of the cherry tree（樱桃木）；a bright red colour（樱桃色；鲜红色）

chess.meaning: a game for two people played on a board marked with black and white squares on which each playing piece (representing a king, queen, castle, etc.) is moved according to special rules. chest.meaning: the top part of the front of the body, between the neck and the stomach（胸部；胸膛）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type of chest mentioned（有 … 胸的；胸部 … 的）；a large strong box, usually made of wood, used for storing things in and/or moving them from one place to another（（常为木制的）大箱子）

chestnut.meaning: a large tree with spreading branches, that produces smooth brown nuts inside cases which are covered with spikes. There are several types of chestnut tree.（栗树）；a smooth brown nut of a chestnut tree, some types of which can be eaten（栗子；板栗）；a deep reddish-brown colour（栗色；深红棕色）；a horse of a reddish-brown colour（栗色马；红棕马）

chew.meaning: to bite food into small pieces in your mouth with your teeth to make it easier to swallow（咀嚼；嚼碎）；to bite sth continuously, for example because you are nervous or to taste it（（因为紧张等）咬住，不停地啃；（为尝味道）不停地咀嚼）；(informal) to have a long friendly talk with sb about sth（（长时间）闲聊，闲扯）；(NAmE) (informal) to tell sb angrily that you do not approve of their actions（气愤地骂（某人））

chic.meaning: very fashionable and elegant（时髦的；优雅的；雅致的）；chic noun [U] a perfectly dressed woman with an air of chic that was unmistakably French（一位衣着讲究、明显地流露出法国式优雅姿态的女士）

chick.meaning: a baby bird, especially a baby chicken（雏鸟；（尤指）雏鸡，小鸡）；(old-fashioned, sometimes offensive) a way of referring to a young woman（少女；少妇；小妞儿）

chicken.meaning: a large bird that is often kept for its eggs or meat（鸡）；meat from a chicken（鸡肉）；a situation in which it is difficult to tell which one of two things was the cause of the other（鸡与蛋孰先难定的情况；因果难定的问题）；to play a game in which people do sth dangerous for as long as they can to show how brave they are. chief.meaning: most important（最重要的；首要的；主要的）；highest in rank（最高级别的；为首的；首席的）；(in nouns（构成名词）；of the highest rank（最高级别的；为首的）

chiefly.meaning: not completely, but as a most important part（主要地；首要地）

chihuahua.meaning: a very small dog with smooth hair（奇瓦瓦狗（体型小，毛平滑））

child.meaning: a young human who is not yet an adult（儿童；小孩）；a son or daughter of any age（儿子；女儿）；a person who is strongly influenced by the ideas and attitudes of a particular time or person（深受 … 影响的人）；(disapproving) an adult who behaves like a child and is not mature or responsible（孩子气的人；幼稚的人；不负责任的人）

childhood.meaning: the period of sb's life when they are a child（童年；幼年；孩童时期）；a time in the life of an adult person when they behave like a child again（老小孩时期；行为像小孩的晚年时期）

childish.meaning: connected with or typical of a child（孩子的；孩子气的；稚嫩的）；(of an adult（成人）；behaving in a stupid or silly way（幼稚的；天真的）；child·ish·ly /ˈtʃaɪldɪʃli; NAmEˈtʃaɪldɪʃli/ adv. to behave childishly（举止幼稚）

childless.meaning: having no children（无子女的；无后代的）

childlike.meaning: having the qualities that children usually have, especially innocence（孩子般的；童稚的；单纯的；（尤指）天真无邪的）

chill.meaning: a feeling of being cold（寒冷；寒意；凉意）；an illness caused by being cold and wet, causing fever and shivering (= shaking of the body)（着凉；受寒）；a feeling of fear（害怕的感觉）；to make sb very cold（使很冷；使冰冷）

chilly.meaning: (especially of the weather or a place, but also of people（尤指天气或地方，亦指人）；too cold to be comfortable（寒冷的；阴冷的）；not friendly（不友好的；冷淡的；冷漠的）

chime.meaning: (of a bell or a clock（铃或钟）；to ring; to show the time by making a ringing sound（鸣响；敲响；报时）；to join or interrupt a conversation（插嘴；打断谈话）；(of plans, ideas, etc.（计划、主意等）

chimney.meaning: a structure through which smoke or steam is carried up away from a fire, etc. and through the roof of a building; the part of this that is above the roof（烟囱；烟道；（屋顶上的）烟囱管）；(technical 术语) a narrow opening in an area of rock that a person can climb up（（岩石间可供攀登的）狭孔，狭缝）

chimpanzee.meaning: a small intelligent African ape (= an animal like a large monkey without a tail)（黑猩猩）

chin.meaning: the part of the face below the mouth and above the neck（颏；下巴）；(informal) used to tell sb to try to stay cheerful even though they are in a difficult or unpleasant situation（振作起来；不气馁；不灰心）；to accept a difficult or unpleasant situation without complaining, trying to make excuses, etc.（（无怨无悔地）承受某事）；(NAmE) to be damaged or badly affected by something（受损；受到严重影响）

china.meaning: white clay which is baked and used for making delicate cups, plates, etc.（瓷；瓷料）；cups, plates, etc. that are made of china（瓷制品；瓷器）

chinese.meaning: from or connected with China（中国的）；a person from China, or whose family was originally from China（中国人；华裔；华人）；the language of China（中国话；汉语；中文）

chip.meaning: the place from which a small piece of wood, glass, etc. has broken from an object（（木头、玻璃等的）缺口，缺损处）；a small piece of wood, glass, etc. that has broken or been broken off an object（（木头、玻璃等破损后留下的）碎屑，碎片，碎渣）；a long thin piece of potato fried in oil or fat（油炸土豆条；炸薯条）；a thin round slice of potato that is fried until hard then dried and eaten cold. chisel.meaning: a tool with a sharp flat edge at the end, used for shaping wood, stone or metal（凿子；錾子）；to cut or shape wood or stone with a chisel（（用凿子）凿，刻，雕）；(informal) (especially NAmE) to get money or some advantage from sb by cheating them（欺骗；欺诈；宰（人））

chivalry.meaning: polite and kind behaviour that shows a sense of honour, especially by men towards women（（尤指男人对女人的）彬彬有礼，殷勤，体贴）；(in the Middle Ages) the religious and moral system of behaviour which the perfect knight was expected to follow（（中世纪的）骑士制度）

chloride.meaning: a compound of chlorine and another chemical element（氯化物）

chlorine.meaning: a chemical element. Chlorine is a poisonous greenish gas with a strong smell. It is often used in swimming pools to keep the water clean.（氯；氯气）

chlorophyll.meaning: the green substance in plants that absorbs light from the sun to help them grow（叶绿素）

chocolate.meaning: a hard brown sweet food made from cocoa beans, used in cooking to add flavour to cakes, etc. or eaten as a sweet/candy（巧克力；朱古力）；a sweet/candy that is made of or covered with chocolate（巧克力糖；夹心巧克力糖）；a dark brown colour（深褐色；巧克力色）

choice.meaning: an act of choosing between two or more possibilities; something that you can choose（选择；挑选；抉择）；the right to choose or the possibility of choosing（选择权；选择的可能性）；a person or thing that is chosen（入选者；被选中的东西）；the number or range of different things from which to choose（供选择的品种；可选的范围）

choir.meaning: a group of people who sing together, for example in church services or public performances（（教堂的）唱诗班；（公开演出的）合唱团，歌唱队）；the part of a church where the choir sits during services（（教堂）唱经楼，唱诗席）

cholesterol.meaning: a substance found in blood, fat and most tissues of the body. Too much cholesterol can cause heart disease.（胆固醇）

chomp.meaning: to eat or bite food noisily（大声地吃（或咬、咀嚼食物））

choose.meaning: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available（选择；挑选；选取）；to prefer or decide to do sth（宁愿；情愿；决定）；there is very little difference between two or more things or people（不相上下；难分高低；相差无几）

choosy.meaning: careful in choosing; difficult to please（精挑细选的；爱挑剔的；难以取悦的）

chop.meaning: to cut sth into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife（切碎；剁碎；砍；劈）；(informal) to reduce sth by a large amount; to stop sth（（大幅度地）削减，降低；取消；终止）；to hit sb/sth with a short downward stroke or blow（向下猛击）；(BrE) (informal) to keep changing your mind or what you are doing（变化无常；反复变换）

choppy.meaning: (of the sea, etc.（海洋等）；with a lot of small waves; not calm（波浪起伏的；不平静的）；(of a style of writing（写作文体）；containing a lot of short sentences and changing topics too often（不连贯的；支离破碎的）

chopstick.meaning: either of a pair of thin sticks that are used for eating with, especially in some Asian countries（筷子）

choral.meaning: connected with, written for or sung by a choir (= a group of singers)（唱诗班的；为唱诗班谱写的；由唱诗班演唱的；合唱的）

chord.meaning: (music 音) two or more notes played together（和弦；和音）；(mathematics 数) a straight line that joins two points on a curve（弦）；to say or do sth that makes people feel sympathy or enthusiasm（引起同情（或共鸣））

chore.meaning: a task that you do regularly（日常事务；例行工作）；an unpleasant or boring task（令人厌烦的任务；乏味无聊的工作）

choreography.meaning: the art of designing and arranging the steps and movements in dances, especially in ballet; the steps and movements in a particular ballet or show（（尤指芭蕾舞的）编舞艺术，舞蹈设计）

chorus.meaning: part of a song that is sung after each verse（副歌）；a piece of music, usually part of a larger work, that is written for a choir (= a group of singers)（合唱曲）；(often in names（常用于名称）；a large group of singers（合唱团；歌咏队）

christ.meaning: the man that Christians believe is the son of God and on whose teachings the Christian religion is based（基督；耶稣基督）；(taboo, informal) a swear word that many people find offensive, used to show that you are angry, annoyed or surprised（（很多人认为含冒犯意，表示愤怒、烦恼或惊讶）天哪）

christian.meaning: based on or believing the teachings of Jesus Christ（基督教的；信奉基督教的）；connected with Christians（基督教徒的）；showing the qualities that are thought of as typical of a Christian; good and kind（有基督教徒品行的；慈善的；仁慈的；友爱的）；a person who believes in the teachings of Jesus Christ or has been baptized in a Christian church（基督徒；基督教徒）

christianity.meaning: the religion that is based on the teachings of Jesus Christ and the belief that he was the son of God（基督教）

christmas.meaning: December, the day when Christians celebrate the birth of Christ（圣诞节（12 月 25 日））；the period that includes Christmas Day and the days close to it（圣诞节期间）

chromosome.meaning: one of the very small structures like threads in the nuclei (= central parts) of animal and plant cells, that carry the genes（染色体）；chromo·somal /ˌkrəʊməˈsəʊməl; NAmEˌkroʊməˈsoʊməl/ adj. chromosomal abnormalities（染色体畸形）

chronic.meaning: (especially of a disease（尤指疾病）；lasting for a long time; difficult to cure or get rid of（长期的；慢性的；难以治愈（或根除）的）；having had a disease for a long time（长期患病的）；(BrE) (informal) very bad（糟透的；拙劣的）

chronicle.meaning: a written record of events in the order in which they happened（编年史；历史）；(formal) to record events in the order in which they happened（把 … 载入编年史；按事件顺序记载）

chronological.meaning: (of a number of events（许多事件）；arranged in the order in which they happened（按发生时间顺序排列的）；(formal) the number of years a person has lived as opposed to their level of physical, mental or emotional development（按时间计算的（年龄）（相对于身体、智力或情感方面的发展而言））

chronology.meaning: the order in which a series of events happened; a list of these events in order（按事件发生的年代排列的顺序；年表）

chug.meaning: to move making the sound of an engine running slowly（（发动机缓慢运转时）发出突突声）；(NAmE) (slang) to drink all of sth quickly without stopping（一饮而尽；一口气喝完）；the sound made by a chugging engine（（发动机的）突突声）

chunk.meaning: a thick solid piece that has been cut or broken off sth（厚块；厚片；大块）；(informal) a fairly large amount of sth（相当大的量）；(linguistics 语言) a phrase or group of words which can be learnt as a unit by sb who is learning a language. Examples of chunks are ‘Can I have the bill, please?’ and ‘Pleased to meet you’.（话语组成部分；组块）

church.meaning: a building where Christians go to worship（（基督教的）教堂，礼拜堂）；a service or services in a church（礼拜；礼拜仪式）；a particular group of Christians（基督教教派）；the ministers of the Christian religion; the institution of the Christian religion（基督教牧师；基督教机构）

churn.meaning: if water, mud, etc. churns, or if sth churns it (up), it moves or is moved around violently（剧烈搅动；猛烈翻腾）；if your stomach churns or if sth churns your stomach, you feel a strong, unpleasant feeling of worry, disgust or fear（反胃，恶心（忧虑、厌恶或恐惧的强烈感觉））；to feel or to make sb feel upset or emotionally confused（（使）感到不安，心烦意乱）；to turn and stir milk in a special container in order to make butter（用搅乳器搅乳（制作黄油））

cider.meaning: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of apples（苹果酒）；a drink made from the juice of apples that does not contain alcohol（苹果汁）；a glass of cider（一杯苹果酒（或苹果汁））

cigar.meaning: a roll of dried tobacco leaves that people smoke, like a cigarette but bigger and without paper around it（雪茄烟）

cigarette.meaning: a thin tube of paper filled with tobacco, for smoking（香烟；纸烟；卷烟）

cinema.meaning: a building in which films/movies are shown（电影院）；when you go to the cinema or to the movies, you go to a cinema/movie theater to see a film/movie（（去电影院）看电影）；films/movies as an art or an industry（电影艺术；电影制片业）

circadian.meaning: connected with the changes in the bodies of people or animals over each period of 24 hours（（每 24 小时人或动物体内变化）昼夜节律的，生理节奏的）

circle.meaning: a completely round flat shape（圆；圆形）；the line that forms the edge of a circle（圆周；圆圈）；a thing or a group of people or things shaped like a circle（圆形物；环状物；圈；环）；an upper floor of a theatre or cinema/movie theater where the seats are arranged in curved rows（（剧院或电影院的）弧形楼座）

circuit.meaning: a line, route, or journey around a place（环行；环行路线）；the complete path of wires and equipment along which an electric current flows（电路；线路）；(in sport（体育运动）；a series of games or matches in which the same players regularly take part（巡回赛）

circular.meaning: shaped like a circle; round（圆形的；环形的；圆的）；moving around in a circle（环行的；绕圈的）；(of an argument or a theory（论点或理论）；using an idea or a statement to prove sth which is then used to prove the idea or statement at the beginning（循环论证的（以一种观点证明另一观点，接着再用后一种观点反过来去证明前一观点））

circulate.meaning: when a liquid, gas, or air circulates or is circulated, it moves continuously around a place or system（（液体或气体）环流，循环）；if a story, an idea, information, etc. circulates or if you circulate it, it spreads or it is passed from one person to another（传播；流传；散布）；to send goods or information to all the people in a group（传送；传递；传阅）；to move around a group, especially at a party, talking to different people（（尤指在聚会上）往来应酬，周旋）

circulation.meaning: the movement of blood around the body（血液循环）；the passing or spreading of sth from one person or place to another（传递；流传；流通）；the fact that sb takes part in social activities at a particular time（（某段时间的）社交活动，交际）；the usual number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold each day, week, etc.（（报刊）发行量，销售量）

circulatory.meaning: relating to the circulation of the blood（血液循环的）

circumference.meaning: a line that goes around a circle or any other curved shape; the length of this line（圆周；圆周长）

circumscribe.meaning: (formal) to limit sb/sth's freedom, rights, power, etc.（限制，约束（自由、权利、权力等））；(technical 术语) to draw a circle around another shape（画 … 的外接圆）

circumstance.meaning: the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action（条件；环境；状况）；the conditions of a person's life, especially the money they have（境况；境遇；（尤指）经济状况）；(formal) situations and events that affect and influence your life and that are not in your control（命运；客观环境）；used before or after a statement to show that you have thought about the conditions that affect a situation before making a decision or a statement（在这种情况下；既然如此）

circumvent.meaning: to find a way of avoiding a difficulty or a rule（设法回避；规避）；to go or travel around sth that is blocking your way（绕过；绕行；绕道旅行）

circus.meaning: a group of entertainers, sometimes with trained animals, who perform skilful or amusing acts in a show that travels around to different places（马戏团）；a show performed by circus entertainers, usually in a large tent called a big top（马戏表演（常在大帐篷里进行））；(informal, disapproving) a group of people or an event that attracts a lot of attention（引人注意的人（或事）；热闹场面）；(used in some place names（用于一些地名）

citadel.meaning: (in the past) a castle on high ground in or near a city where people could go when the city was being attacked（（旧时的）城堡，要塞，堡垒）

citation.meaning: words or lines taken from a book or a speech（引语；引文；引述）；an official statement about sth special that sb has done, especially about acts of courage in a war（表彰；表扬；（尤指对战争中英勇表现的）嘉奖令）；an act of citing or being cited（（被）引用，引证）

cite.meaning: to mention sth as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying（提及（原因）；举出（示例）；列举）；to speak or write the exact words from a book, an author, etc.（引用；引述；援引）；(law 律) to order sb to appear in court; to name sb officially in a legal case（传唤；传讯）；to mention sb officially or publicly because they deserve special praise（嘉奖；表彰；表扬）

citizen.meaning: a person who has the legal right to belong to a particular country（公民）；a person who lives in a particular place（居民；市民）

citizenry.meaning: all the citizens of a particular town, country, etc.（全体市民（或公民））

citizenship.meaning: the legal right to belong to a particular country（公民权利（或资格））；the state of being a citizen and accepting the responsibilities of it（公民身分（或义务））

city.meaning: a large and important town（都市；城市）；(BrE) a town that has been given special rights by a king or queen, usually one that has a cathedral（（由国王或女王授予特权，通常有大教堂的）特许市）；(NAmE) a town that has been given special rights by the state government（（由政府授予特权的）特权市）；all the people who live in a city（全市居民）

civet.meaning: a wild animal like a cat, that lives in central Africa and Asia（灵猫，麝猫（分布于中非和亚洲））；a substance with a strong smell, obtained from a civet, and used in making perfume（麝猫香，灵猫香（用于制作香水））

civic.meaning: officially connected with a town or city（市政的；城市的；城镇的）；connected with the people who live in a town or city（市民的；城镇居民的）

civil.meaning: connected with the people who live in a country（国民的；平民的）；connected with the state rather than with religion or with the armed forces（国家的，政府的（非宗教或军事的））；involving personal legal matters and not criminal law（民事的（非刑事的））；polite in a formal way but possibly not friendly（有礼貌的；客气的）

civilian.meaning: a person who is not a member of the armed forces or the police（平民；老百姓；庶民）；ci·vil·ian adj. [usually before noun] He left the army and returned to civilian life.（他从军队退了役，重新过上平民百姓的生活。）

civility.meaning: polite behaviour（彬彬有礼的行为；礼貌；客气）；remarks that are said only in order to be polite（客套话；客气话）

civilization.meaning: a state of human society that is very developed and organized（文明）；a society, its culture and its way of life during a particular period of time or in a particular part of the world（（特定时期和地区的）社会文明）；all the people in the world and the societies they live in, considered as a whole（文明世界；文明社会）；(often humorous) a place that offers you the comfortable way of life of a modern society（人类文明的生活）

civilize.meaning: to educate and improve a person or a society; to make sb's behaviour or manners better（教化；开化；使文明；使有教养）

claim.meaning: to say that sth is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it（宣称；声称；断言）；to demand or ask for sth because you believe it is your legal right to own or to have it（要求（拥有）；索取；认领）；to ask for money from the government or a company because you have a right to it（索要；索取）；to get or take sb's attention（引起注意）

claimant.meaning: a person who claims sth because they believe they have a right to it（要求者；索要者）；(BrE) a person who is receiving money from the state because they are unemployed, etc.（（因失业等）领取救济金者）

clam.meaning: a shellfish that can be eaten. It has a shell in two parts that can open and close.（蛤；蛤蜊；蚌）；(informal) to refuse to speak, especially when sb asks you about sth（（尤指被询问时）拒绝说话，拒不开口，闭口不言）

clamp.meaning: to hold sth tightly, or fasten two things together, with a clamp（（用夹具）夹紧，夹住，固定）；to hold or fasten sth very tightly so that it does not move; to be held tightly（紧紧抓住；紧夹住；被抓住；被夹紧）；(BrE) to fix a clamp to a car's wheel so that the car cannot be driven away（用夹锁锁住（车轮））；to take strict action in order to prevent sth, especially crime（严厉打击（犯罪等））

clan.meaning: a group of families who are related to each other, especially in Scotland（（尤指苏格兰的）宗族，氏族，家族）；(informal, sometimes humorous) a very large family, or a group of people who are connected because of a particular thing（庞大的家族；宗派；帮派；小集团）

clap.meaning: to hit your open hands together several times to show that you approve of or have enjoyed sth（鼓掌，拍手（表示赞许或欣赏））；to hit your open hands together（拍手；击掌）；to lightly hit sb with your open hand, usually in a friendly way（（常指友好地）轻拍某人的背（或肩））；to put sth/sb somewhere quickly and suddenly（急速放置）

clarify.meaning: (formal) to make sth clearer or easier to understand（使更清晰易懂；阐明；澄清）；to make sth, especially butter, pure by heating it（（尤指通过加热使黄油）纯净，净化）；clari·fi·ca·tion AW clarification clarifications /ˌklærəfɪˈkeɪʃn; NAmEˌklærəfɪˈkeɪʃn/ noun [U, C] I am seeking clarification of the regulations.（我正在努力弄清楚这些规则。）

clarity.meaning: the quality of being expressed clearly（清晰；清楚；明确）；the ability to think about or understand sth clearly（清晰的思维（或理解）能力）；if a picture, substance or sound has clarity, you can see or hear it very clearly, or see through it easily（（画、物质或声音的）清晰，清楚，清澈）

clash.meaning: a short fight between two groups of people（（两群人之间的）打斗，打架，冲突）；an argument between two people or groups of people who have different beliefs and ideas（争论；辩论；争执）；the difference that exists between two things that are opposed to each other（差别；差异；分歧）；a situation in which two events happen at the same time so that you cannot go to or see them both（（时间上的）冲突，矛盾）

clasp.meaning: to hold sth tightly in your hand（握紧；攥紧；抓紧）；to hold sb/sth tightly with your arms around them（抱紧；紧紧拥抱）；to fasten sth with a clasp（扣紧；扣住；扣牢）；a device that fastens sth, such as a bag or the ends of a belt or a piece of jewellery（（包、皮带或首饰的）扣子，扣环）

class.meaning: a group of students who are taught together（班；班级）；an occasion when a group of students meet to be taught（课；上课）；a series of classes on a particular subject（（某科目的）系列课程）；(especially NAmE) a group of students who finish their studies at school, college or university in a particular year（同届毕业生）

classic.meaning: accepted or deserving to be accepted as one of the best or most important of its kind（最优秀的；第一流的）；with all the features you would expect to find; very typical（有特点的；有代表性的；典型的）；elegant, but simple and traditional in style or design; not affected by changes in fashion（（风格或设计）典雅的，古朴的；传统的）；(informal) people say That's classic! when they find sth very amusing, when they think sb has been very stupid or when sth annoying, but not surprising, happens（惹笑的；愚蠢（或令人讨厌）而又不足为奇的）

classical.meaning: widely accepted and used for a long time; traditional in style or idea（古典的；经典的；传统的）；connected with or influenced by the culture of ancient Greece and Rome（和古希腊与古罗马文化相关的；受古希腊与古罗马文化影响的）；(of music（音乐）；written in a Western musical tradition, usually using an established form (for example a symphony) and not played on electronic instruments. Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.（古典的）

classicism.meaning: a style of art and literature that is simple and elegant and is based on the styles of ancient Greece and Rome. Classicism was popular in Europe in the 18th century.（古典主义（基于古希腊与古罗马风格，18 世纪盛行于欧洲））；a style or form that has simple, natural qualities and pleasing combinations of parts（古典风格）

classification.meaning: the act or process of putting people or things into a group or class (= of classifying them)（分类；归类；分级）；a group, class, division, etc. into which sb or sth is put（类别；等级；门类）；(biology 生) the act of putting animals, plants, etc. into groups, classes or divisions according to their characteristics（（动植物等的）分类学，分类法）；(technical 术语) a system of arranging books, tapes, magazines, etc. in a library into groups according to their subject（（图书馆的书、磁带、杂志等的）分类系统，编目）

classified.meaning: (of information（信息）；officially secret and available only to particular people（机密的；保密的）；with information arranged in groups according to subjects（分类的；归类的）

classify.meaning: to arrange sth in groups according to features that they have in common（分类；归类）；to decide which type or group sb/sth belongs to（划分；区分；界定）

classmate.meaning: a person who is or was in the same class as you at school or college（同班同学）

classroom.meaning: a room where a class of children or students is taught（教室；课堂）

clatter.meaning: if hard objects clatter, they knock together and make a loud noise（（硬物相碰）发出响亮的撞击声）；to move making a loud noise like hard objects knocking together（移动发出（像硬物碰撞）的响声）；clat·ter (also clat·ter·ing) noun [sing.] the clatter of horses' hoofs（嗒嗒的马蹄声）

clause.meaning: (grammar 语法) a group of words that includes a subject and a verb, and forms a sentence or part of a sentence（从句；分句；子句）；an item in a legal document that says that a particular thing must or must not be done（（法律文件的）条款）

clavichord.meaning: an early type of musical instrument, like a piano with a very soft tone（古钢琴；击弦键琴）

claw.meaning: one of the sharp curved nails on the end of an animal's or a bird's foot（（动物或禽类的）爪，脚爪）；a long, sharp curved part of the body of some types of shellfish, used for catching and holding things（（水生有壳动物的）螯，钳）；part of a tool or machine, like a claw, used for holding, pulling or lifting things（爪形夹具；（机械的）爪）；(disapproving) if a woman gets her claws into a man, she tries hard to make him marry her or to have a relationship with her（（女人）死死缠住（男人））

clay.meaning: a type of heavy, sticky earth that becomes hard when it is baked and is used to make things such as pots and bricks（黏土；陶土）

clean.meaning: not dirty（洁净的；干净的）；having a clean appearance and clean surroundings（爱干净的；爱整洁的）；free from harmful or unpleasant substances（无有害物的；无污染的）；with nothing written on it（空白的；未写过的）

cleaner.meaning: a person whose job is to clean other people's houses or offices, etc.（清洁工）；a machine or substance that is used for cleaning（吸尘器；清洁剂；去污剂）；a shop/store where clothes, curtains, etc. are cleaned, especially with chemicals（干洗店）；to steal all of sb's money, etc., or to get it using a trick（将某人洗劫一空；抢光（或骗尽）某人的钱财）

cleanliness.meaning: the state of being clean or the habit of keeping things clean（清洁；干净；爱干净的习惯）

cleanly.meaning: easily and smoothly in one movement（干净利落地；利索地）；in a clean way（清洁地；干净地）

clear.meaning: easy to understand and not causing any confusion（清晰易懂的；明白清楚的；不含混的）；obvious and leaving no doubt at all（明显的；显然的；明确的）；having or feeling no doubt or confusion（无疑的；清楚的；明白的）；thinking in a sensible and logical way, especially in a difficult situation（（尤指在困境中）思维敏锐而有逻辑的，头脑清醒的）

clearance.meaning: the removal of things that are not wanted（清除；排除；清理）；the amount of space or distance that is needed between two objects so that they do not touch each other（净空；间距；间隙）；official permission that is given to sb before they can work somewhere, have particular information, or do sth they want to do（（录用或准许接触机密以前的）审查许可，审核批准）；official permission for a person or vehicle to enter or leave an airport or a country（（人、交通工具进出机场或出入境的）许可，准许）

clear-cut.meaning: definite and easy to see or identify（明确的；明显的；易辨认的）

clearing.meaning: an open space in a forest where there are no trees（林中空地）；(in Britain) the system used by universities to find students for the places on their courses that have not been filled shortly before the beginning of the academic year（（英国大学的）补录（学年开始前补招学生填补空缺名额））

clearly.meaning: in a way that is easy to see or hear（清楚地；清晰地）；in a way that is sensible and easy to understand（明白地；易懂地）；used to emphasize that what you are saying is obvious and true（明显地；显然地）

clement.meaning: (especially of weather（尤指天气）；mild and pleasant（温和的；温暖的）；showing kindness and mercy to sb who is being punished（（对受惩罚的人）仁慈的，宽恕的，宽容的）

clench.meaning: when you clench your hands, teeth, etc., or when they clench, you press or squeeze them together tightly, usually showing that you are angry, determined or upset（（通常表示愤怒、决心或不安时）捏紧，攥紧（拳头等），咬紧（牙齿等））；to hold sth tightly and firmly（握紧；抓牢；攥住）

clergy.meaning: the priests or ministers of a religion, especially of the Christian Church（（统称）圣职人员，神职人员）

clergyman.meaning: a male priest or minister in the Christian Church（（男）圣职人员，神职人员）

clerical.meaning: connected with office work（办公室工作的）；connected with the clergy (= priests)（圣职人员的；神职人员的）

clerk.meaning: a person whose job is to keep the records or accounts in an office, shop/store, etc.（职员；簿记员；文书）；an official in charge of the records of a council, court, etc.（（议会、法院等的）书记员）；(both NAmE) a person whose job is dealing with people arriving at or leaving a hotel（旅馆服务台接待员）；(NAmE) to work as a clerk（当职员（或文书、书记员））

clever.meaning: (especially BrE) quick at learning and understanding things（聪明的；聪颖的）；(especially BrE) skilful（熟练的；灵巧的）；showing intelligence or skill, for example in the design of an object, in an idea or sb's actions（精巧的；精明的）；(BrE) (informal, disapproving) quick with words in a way that annoys people or does not show respect（油腔滑调的）

click.meaning: to make or cause sth to make a short sharp sound（（使）发出咔哒声，咔哒（或咔嚓）响）；to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing one of the buttons on a mouse or touch pad（（用鼠标或在触控板上）点击，单击）；(informal) to suddenly become clear or understood（突然明白；恍然大悟；茅塞顿开）；(informal) to become friends with sb at once; to become popular with sb（（与某人）顷刻成为朋友；受（某人）的欢迎）

client.meaning: a person who uses the services or advice of a professional person or organization（委托人；当事人；客户）；(computing 计) a computer that is linked to a server（（连接在服务器上的）客户机）

clientele.meaning: all the customers or clients of a shop/store, restaurant, organization, etc.（（统称）顾客，主顾，客户）

cliff.meaning: a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or ocean（（常指海洋边的）悬崖，峭壁）

climactic.meaning: (of an event or a point in time（事情或时刻）；very exciting, most important（非常激动人心的；高潮的；最重要的）

climate.meaning: the regular pattern of weather conditions of a particular place（气候）；an area with particular weather conditions（气候区）；a general attitude or feeling; an atmosphere or a situation which exists in a particular place（倾向；思潮；风气；环境气氛）

climatic.meaning: connected with the climate of a particular area（与某一地区气候有关的）

climax.meaning: the most exciting or important event or point in time（（重要事情或时刻的）高潮，极点，顶点）；the most exciting part of a play, piece of music, etc. that usually happens near the end（（戏剧、音乐等通常接近结束时出现的）高潮）；the highest point of sexual pleasure（性高潮）；to come to or form the best, most exciting, or most important point in sth（达成（或形成）极点（或顶点、高潮））

climb.meaning: to go up sth towards the top（攀登；爬）；to move somewhere, especially with difficulty or effort（（尤指吃力地向某处）爬）；to go up mountains or climb rocks as a hobby or sport（登山，攀岩（作为业余爱好或运动））；to go higher in the sky（爬升；上升）

climbing.meaning: the sport or activity of climbing rocks or mountains（登山运动；攀岩活动）

cling.meaning: to hold on tightly to sb/sth（抓紧；紧握；紧抱）；to stick to sth（粘住；附着）；(usually disapproving) to stay close to sb, especially because you need them emotionally（（尤指因感情需要而）依恋，依附）；to be unwilling to get rid of sth, or stop doing sth（不愿放弃；坚持）

clinging.meaning: (of clothes or material（衣服或衣料）；sticking to the body and showing its shape（紧身的；贴身的）；(usually disapproving) needing another person too much（（对别人）依赖性强的，离不开的）

clinic.meaning: a building or part of a hospital where people can go for special medical treatment or advice（诊所；（医院的）门诊部）；(especially BrE) a period of time during which doctors give special medical treatment or advice（门诊时间；会诊时间）；(especially BrE) a private hospital or one that treats health problems of a particular kind（私人诊所；专科医院）；(NAmE) a building where visiting patients can get medical treatment; a building shared by a group of doctors who work together（门诊治疗部；医疗中心）

clinical.meaning: relating to the examination and treatment of patients and their illnesses（临床的；临床诊断的）；(disapproving) cold and calm and without feeling or sympathy（冷淡的；无动于衷的；无同情心的）；(of a room, building, etc.（房间、建筑物等）；very plain; without decoration（简陋的；无装饰的）

clip.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a small metal or plastic object used for holding things together or in place（（金属或塑料的）夹子，回形针）；a piece of jewellery that fastens to your clothes（首饰别针）；the act of cutting sth to make it shorter（剪短；修剪）

clipper.meaning: a tool for cutting small pieces off things（剪具）；a fast sailing ship, used in the past（（旧时的）快速帆船）

cloak.meaning: a type of coat that has no sleeves, fastens at the neck and hangs loosely from the shoulders, worn especially in the past（（尤指旧时的）披风，斗篷）；(literary) a thing that hides or covers sb/sth（遮盖物）；(literary) to cover or hide sth（遮盖；掩盖）；cloaked /kləʊkt; NAmEkloʊkt/ adj. a tall cloaked figure (= a person wearing a cloak)（一个穿着披风、身材很高的人）

clock.meaning: an instrument for measuring and showing time, in a room or on the wall of a building (not worn or carried like a watch)（时钟；钟）；if you do sth against the clock, you do it fast in order to finish before a particular time（抢时间；争分夺秒）；all day and all night without stopping（日夜不停；夜以继日）；to change the time shown by clocks, usually by one hour, when the time changes officially, for example at the beginning and end of summer（（夏时制开始和结束时）把时钟拨快/拨回（一般为一个小时））

clockwise.meaning: moving around in the same direction as the hands of a clock（顺时针方向（的））

clone.meaning: (biology 生) a plant or an animal that is produced naturally or artificially from the cells of another plant or animal and is therefore exactly the same as it（克隆动物（或植物）；无性繁殖动物（或植物）；复制动物（或植物））；(sometimes disapproving) a person or thing that seems to be an exact copy of another（好像一模一样的人；复制品；仿造品；翻版）；(computing 计) a computer designed to work in exactly the same way as another, usually one made by a different company and more expensive（复制器；仿制机）；to produce an exact copy of an animal or a plant from its cells（以无性繁殖技术复制；克隆）

close.meaning: to put sth into a position so that it covers an opening; to get into this position（关；关闭；闭上）；to move the parts of sth together so that it is no longer open（合上；合拢）；to make the work of a shop/store, etc. stop for a period of time; to not be open for people to use（（使）关门，关闭（一段时间）；不开放）；if a company, shop/store, etc. closes, or if you close it, it stops operating as a business（停业；关闭；歇业；倒闭）

closed.meaning: shut（关闭；封闭）；shut, especially of a shop/store or public building that is not open for a period of time（关闭；（尤指一段时间）停止营业，不开放）；not willing to accept outside influences or new ideas（封闭的；闭关自守的；不愿接受新思想的）；limited to a particular group of people; not open to everyone（只限于某些人的；仅为少数人的；不向公众开放的）

closet.meaning: (especially NAmE) a small room or a space in a wall with a door that reaches the floor, used for storing things（贮藏室；壁橱）；to admit sth openly that you kept secret before, especially because of shame or embarrassment（公开承认秘密（尤指因耻辱或尴尬而一直保守着的秘密）；“出柜”）；used to describe people who want to keep some fact about themselves secret（隐藏（身分）的；不公开（个人信息）的）；to put sb in a room away from other people, especially so that they can talk privately with sb, or so that they can be alone（把 … 关在房间里（尤指为了私下会谈或避免他人打扰））

close-up.meaning: a photograph, or picture in a film/movie, taken very close to sb/sth so that it shows a lot of detail（（照片、电影画面的）特写，特写镜头）

cloth.meaning: material made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, etc.（布；布料）；(often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a piece of cloth, often used for a special purpose, especially cleaning things or covering a table（一块布；（尤指）一块抹布，一块桌布）；(literary) used to refer to Christian priests as a group（（统称）牧师，神父）

clothe.meaning: (formal) to dress sb/yourself（给 … 穿衣）；to provide clothes for sb to wear（为（某人）提供衣服）

clothes.meaning: the things that you wear, such as trousers/pants, dresses and jackets（衣服；服装）

clothing.meaning: clothes, especially a particular type of clothes（衣服；（尤指某种）服装）

cloud.meaning: a grey or white mass made of very small drops of water, that floats in the sky（云；云朵）；a large mass of sth in the air, for example dust or smoke, or a number of insects flying all together（云状物（如尘雾、烟雾、一群飞行的昆虫））；something that makes you feel sad or anxious（阴影；忧郁；焦虑；令人忧虑的事）；(saying) every sad or difficult situation has a positive side（黑暗中总有一线光明；朵朵乌云衬银边，处处黑暗透光明）

cloudy.meaning: (of the sky or the weather（天空或天气）；covered with clouds; with a lot of clouds（被云遮住的；阴云密布的；阴天的；多云的）；(of liquids（液体）；not clear or transparent（不清澈的；不透明的；浑浊的）

clover.meaning: a small wild plant that usually has three leaves on each stem and purple, pink or white flowers that are shaped like balls（三叶草；车轴草）；(informal) to have enough money to be able to live a very comfortable life（过舒适优裕的生活）

clown.meaning: an entertainer who wears funny clothes and a large red nose and does silly things to make people laugh（丑角；小丑）；(disapproving) a person that you disapprove of because they act in a stupid way（蠢货；笨蛋）；(often disapproving) to behave in a silly way, especially in order to make other people laugh（（尤指为逗人笑而故意）做出蠢相）

club.meaning: (especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a group of people who meet together regularly, for a particular activity, sport, etc.（俱乐部；社团；会）；the building or rooms that a particular club uses（（俱乐部使用的）建筑设施，活动室）；(BrE) a professional sports organization that includes the players, managers, owners and members（职业运动俱乐部）

clue.meaning: an object, a piece of evidence or some information that helps the police solve a crime（（帮助警方破案的）线索，迹象）；a fact or a piece of evidence that helps you discover the answer to a problem（（问题答案的）线索，提示）；some words or a piece of information that helps you find the answers to a crossword, a game or a question（（纵横填字谜、游戏或问题的）提示词语，解答提示）；to know nothing about sth or about how to do sth（一无所知；不知怎么做）

clump.meaning: a small group of things or people very close together, especially trees or plants; a bunch of sth such as grass or hair（（尤指树或植物的）丛，簇，束，串；（人的）群，组；（草的）堆；（毛发的）缕）；the sound made by sb putting their feet down very heavily（沉重的脚步声）；(especially BrE) to put your feet down noisily and heavily as you walk（以沉重的脚步行走）；to come together or be brought together to form a tight group（聚集；被聚集成群）

clumsy.meaning: (of people and animals（人和动物）；moving or doing things in a very awkward way（笨拙的；不灵巧的）；(of actions and statements（行动和陈述）；done without skill or in a way that offends people（无技巧的；冒犯人的；不得体的）

cluster.meaning: a group of things of the same type that grow or appear close together（（同类物丛生或聚集的）簇，团，束，串）；a group of people, animals or things close together（（人或动物的）群，团，组；（物品的）堆，批）；(phonetics 语音) a group of consonants which come together in a word or phrase, for example /str/ at the beginning of string（辅音丛；辅音连缀）；to come together in a small group or groups（群聚；聚集）

clutch.meaning: to hold sb/sth tightly（紧握；抱紧；抓紧）；to take hold of sth suddenly, because you are afraid or in pain（（因害怕或痛苦）突然抓住）；to try to quickly get hold of sth/sb（试图一把抓住）；the pedal in a car or other vehicle that you press with your foot so that you can change gear（（汽车等起换挡功能的）离合器踏板）

c/o.meaning: (used on letters to a person staying at sb else's house) care of（（用于投递给寄居人的信件上）由 … 转交）

coach.meaning: a person who trains a person or team in sport（（体育运动的）教练）；(BrE) a person who gives private lessons to sb, often to prepare them for an exam（私人教师；（多指）考前辅导教师）；(BrE) a comfortable bus for carrying passengers over long distances（长途汽车；长途客车）；a large closed vehicle with four wheels, pulled by horses, used in the past for carrying passengers（（旧时载客的）四轮大马车）

coal.meaning: a hard black mineral that is found below the ground and burnt to produce heat（煤）；a piece of coal, especially one that is burning（（尤指燃烧着的）煤块）；(BrE) to take goods to a place where there are already plenty of them; to supply sth where it is not needed（多此一举）

coal-fired.meaning: using coal as fuel（用煤作燃料的；烧煤的）

coalition.meaning: a government formed by two or more political parties working together（（两党或多党）联合政府）；a group formed by people from several different groups, especially political ones, agreeing to work together for a particular purpose（（尤指多个政治团体的）联合体，联盟）；the act of two or more groups joining together（联合；结合；联盟）

coarse.meaning: (of skin or cloth（皮肤或布料）；rough（粗糙的；粗织的）；consisting of relatively large pieces（粗的；大颗粒的）；rude and offensive, especially about sex（粗鲁无礼的，粗俗的（尤指涉及性的））

coast.meaning: the land beside or near to the sea or ocean（海岸；海滨）；(informal) there is no danger of being seen or caught（没有被发现（或抓住）的危险）；(of a car or a bicycle（汽车或自行车）；to move, especially down a hill, without using any power（（尤指不用动力向山坡下）滑行，惯性滑行）

coastal.meaning: of or near a coast（沿海的；靠近海岸的）

coastline.meaning: the land along a coast, especially when you are thinking of its shape or appearance（海岸线；海岸地形（或轮廓）；沿海地带）

coat.meaning: a piece of outdoor clothing that is worn over other clothes to keep warm or dry. Coats have sleeves and may be long or short.（外套；外衣；大衣）；(NAmE) (old-fashioned in BrE) a jacket that is worn as part of a suit（（套装的）外套）；the fur, hair or wool that covers an animal's body（动物皮毛）；a layer of paint or some other substance that covers a surface（涂料层；覆盖层）

coating.meaning: a thin layer of a substance covering a surface（（薄的）覆盖层，涂层）

coax.meaning: to persuade sb to do sth by talking to them in a kind and gentle way（哄劝；劝诱）；to gently persuade sb to do sth or give you sth（哄劝；哄诱得到）

cobalt.meaning: a chemical element. Cobalt is a hard silver-white metal, often mixed with other metals and used to give a deep blue-green colour to glass.（钴）；a deep blue-green colour（深蓝色；钴蓝）

cobble.meaning: (old-fashioned) to make or repair shoes（制（鞋）；修补（鞋））；to produce sth quickly and without great care or effort, so that it can be used but is not perfect（草率匆忙地制作；胡乱拼凑；粗制滥造）

cocaine.meaning: a powerful drug that some people take illegally for pleasure and can become addicted to. Doctors sometimes use it as an anaesthetic.（可卡因；古柯碱）

cock.meaning: an adult male chicken（公鸡；雄鸡）；(especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a male of any other bird（雄禽）；(taboo, slang) a penis（鸡巴）

cocktail.meaning: a drink usually made from a mixture of one or more spirits (= strong alcoholic drinks) and fruit juice. It can also be made without alcohol.（鸡尾酒）；a dish of small pieces of food, usually served cold（凉菜；冷盘）；a mixture of different substances, usually ones that do not mix together well（（常指掺合不太相容的）混合物）

coconut.meaning: the large nut of a tropical tree called a coconut palm. It grows inside a hard shell and contains a soft white substance that can be eaten and juice that can be drunk.（椰子）；the soft white substance inside a coconut, used in cooking（（用于烹调的）椰子肉，椰蓉）

cod.meaning: cash on delivery or (in American English) collect on delivery (payment for goods will be made when the goods are delivered)（货到付款；交货付现）

code.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a system of words, letters, numbers or symbols that represent a message or record information secretly or in a shorter form（密码；暗码；电码；代码）；(computing 计) a system of computer programming instructions（编码）；a set of moral principles or rules of behaviour that are generally accepted by society or a social group（道德准则；行为规范）

codify.meaning: (technical 术语) to arrange laws, rules, etc. into a system（把 … 编成法典）

coed.meaning: a female student at a co-educational school or college（（男女同校的）女生）

coefficient.meaning: (mathematics 数) a number which is placed before another quantity and which multiplies it, for example 3 in the quantity 3x（系数）；(physics 物) a number that measures a particular property (= characteristic) of a substance（（测定物质某种特性的）系数）

coerce.meaning: (formal) to force sb to do sth by using threats（强迫；胁迫；迫使）

coexist.meaning: (formal) to exist together in the same place or at the same time, especially in a peaceful way（共存；（尤指）和平共处）

coffee.meaning: the roasted seeds (called coffee beans) of a tropical bush; a powder made from them（（烘烤过的）咖啡豆；咖啡粉）；a hot drink made from coffee powder and boiling water. It may be drunk with milk and/or sugar added.（咖啡（热饮料））；a cup of coffee（一杯咖啡）；the colour of coffee mixed with milk; light brown（咖啡色；浅褐色；浅棕色）

coffin.meaning: a box in which a dead body is buried or cremated（棺材；棺椁；棺木；灵柩）

cog.meaning: one of a series of teeth on the edge of a wheel that fit between the teeth on the next wheel and cause it to move（（齿轮的）轮牙，轮齿，嵌齿）；(informal) a person who is a small part of a large organization（（大机构中的）小职员，小成员）

cognition.meaning: the process by which knowledge and understanding is developed in the mind（认知；感知；认识）

cognitive.meaning: connected with mental processes of understanding（认知的；感知的；认识的）

coherence.meaning: the situation in which all the parts of sth fit together well（连贯性；条理性）

coherent.meaning: (of ideas, thoughts, arguments, etc.（看法、思想、论点等）；logical and well organized; easy to understand and clear（合乎逻辑的；有条理的；清楚易懂的）；(of a person（人）；able to talk and express yourself clearly（有表达能力的；能把自己的意思说清楚的）

cohesion.meaning: (formal) the act or state of keeping together（粘合；结合；凝聚性）；(physics 物) (chemistry 化) the force causing molecules of the same substance to stick together（内聚力）

cohesive.meaning: forming a united whole（结成一个整体的）；causing people or things to become united（使结合的；使凝结的；使内聚的）

coil.meaning: to wind into a series of circles; to make sth do this（（使）缠绕，盘绕）；a series of circles formed by winding up a length of rope, wire, etc.（（绳索、金属线等的）圈，卷，盘）；one circle of rope, wire, etc. in a series（一圈（绳索、金属线等））；a length of wire, wound into circles, that can carry electricity（线圈；绕组）

coin.meaning: a small flat piece of metal used as money（（一枚）硬币；金属货币）；money made of metal（（统称）硬币）；to invent a new word or phrase that other people then begin to use（创造（新词语））；to make coins out of metal（（用金属）铸币，造硬币）

coinage.meaning: the coins used in a particular place or at a particular time; coins of a particular type（（统称某地或某时期的）金属货币；（某种）硬币）；the system of money used in a particular country（（国家的）货币制度）；a word or phrase that has been invented recently; the process of inventing a word or phrase（新创的词语；新词语的创造）

coincide.meaning: (of two or more events（两件或更多的事情）；to take place at the same time（同时发生）；(of ideas, opinions, etc.（想法、意见等）；to be the same or very similar（相同；相符；极为类似）

coincidence.meaning: the fact of two things happening at the same time by chance, in a surprising way（（令人吃惊的）巧合，巧事）；(formal) the fact of things being present at the same time（同时存在；并存）；(formal) the fact of two or more opinions, etc. being the same（（意见等的）相同，相符，一致）

coincident.meaning: (formal) happening in the same place or at the same time（在同一地方发生的；同时发生的）

coke.meaning: a black substance that is produced from coal and burnt to provide heat（焦炭）

cold.meaning: having a lower than usual temperature; having a temperature lower than the human body（寒冷的；冷的）；not heated; cooled after being cooked（未热过的；已凉的；冷却的）；(of a person（人）；without emotion; unfriendly（冷漠的；不友好的）

cold-blooded.meaning: (of people and their actions（人及其行为）；showing no feelings or pity for other people（冷酷的；无情的；残酷的）；(of animals, for example fish or snakes（动物，如鱼或蛇）；having a body temperature that depends on the temperature of the surrounding air or water（冷血的）

coldly.meaning: without any emotion or warm feelings; in an unfriendly way（冷淡地；冷漠地；不友好地）

coldness.meaning: the lack of warm feelings; unfriendly behaviour（冷淡；冷漠；不友好的举止）；the state of being cold（冷；寒冷）

collaborate.meaning: to work together with sb in order to produce or achieve sth（合作；协作）；(disapproving) to help the enemy who has taken control of your country during a war（通敌；勾结敌人）

collaboration.meaning: the act of working with another person or group of people to create or produce sth（合作；协作）；a piece of work produced by two or more people or groups of people working together（合作成果（或作品））；(disapproving) the act of helping the enemy during a war when they have taken control of your country（通敌；勾结敌人）

collaborative.meaning: involving, or done by, several people or groups of people working together（合作的；协作的；协力的）

collaborator.meaning: a person who works with another person to create or produce sth such as a book（合作者；协作者；合著者）；(disapproving) a person who helps the enemy in a war, when they have taken control of the person's country（通敌者）

collagen.meaning: a protein found in skin and bone, sometimes injected into the body, especially the face, to improve its appearance（胶原蛋白，胶原（存在于皮肤和骨骼的蛋白质，可通过注射来美容等））

collapse.meaning: to fall down or fall in suddenly, often after breaking apart（（突然）倒塌，坍塌）；to fall down (and usually become unconscious), especially because you are very ill/sick（（尤指因病重而）倒下，昏倒，晕倒）；(informal) to sit or lie down and relax, especially after working hard（（尤指工作劳累后）坐下，躺下放松）；to fail suddenly or completely（突然失败；崩溃；瓦解）

collapsible.meaning: that can be folded flat or made into a smaller shape that uses less space（可折叠的；可套缩的）

collar.meaning: the part around the neck of a shirt, jacket or coat that usually folds down（衣领；领子）；a band of leather or plastic put around the neck of an animal, especially a dog（（动物，尤指狗的）颈圈）；(technical 术语) a band made of a strong material that is put round sth, such as a pipe or a piece of machinery, to make it stronger or to join two parts together（（管子或机器部件的）圈，箍）；to capture sb and hold them tightly so that they cannot escape from you（抓住；捉住；揪住；逮住）

colleague.meaning: a person that you work with, especially in a profession or a business（同事；同僚；同仁）

collector.meaning: (especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a person who collects things, either as a hobby or as a job（收集者；收藏家）；the chief officer of a district in some S Asian countries（（南亚某些国家的）地方行政长官）

college.meaning: (often in names（常用于名称）；(in Britain) a place where students go to study or to receive training after they have left school（（英国）学院，职业学校，技术学校）；(in the US) a university where students can study for a degree after they have left school（（美国）大学）；(CanE) a place where you can study for higher or more specialist qualifications after you finish high school（高等专科学校；高等职业学院）

colonel.meaning: an officer of high rank in the army, the marines, or the US air force（（陆军、海军陆战队或美国空军）上校）

colonnade.meaning: a row of stone columns with equal spaces between them, usually supporting a roof（列柱；柱廊）

coloration.meaning: the natural colours and patterns on a plant or an animal（（植物或动物的）自然色彩，自然花纹）

coloured.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；having a particular colour or different colours（有 … 色的；色彩 … 的）；(of a person（人）；from a race that does not have white skin（有色人种的）

column.meaning: a tall, solid, vertical post, usually round and made of stone, which supports or decorates a building or stands alone as a monument（柱；（通常为）圆形石柱；纪念柱）；a thing shaped like a column（圆柱状物；柱形物）；one of the vertical sections into which the printed page of a book, newspaper, etc. is divided（（书、报纸等印刷页上的）栏）；a part of a newspaper or magazine which appears regularly and deals with a particular subject or is written by a particular writer（（报刊的）专栏，栏目）

comb.meaning: a flat piece of plastic or metal with a row of thin teeth along one side, used for making your hair neat; a smaller version of this worn by women in their hair to hold it in place or as a decoration（梳子；篦子；压发梳）；the act of using a comb on your hair（梳理（头发））；the soft, red piece of flesh on the head of a male chicken（（公鸡的）鸡冠）；to pull a comb through your hair in order to make it neat（梳，梳理（头发））

comer.meaning: anyone who is interested in, or comes forward for, sth, especially a competition（（尤指对比赛）感兴趣的人，到场者，参加者）；(with adjectives（与形容词连用）；a person who arrives somewhere（到达者）；(NAmE) (informal) a person who is likely to be successful（可能成功者）

communication.meaning: the activity or process of expressing ideas and feelings or of giving people information（表达；交流；交际；传递）；methods of sending information, especially telephones, radio, computers, etc. or roads and railways（通信；交通联系）；(formal) a message, letter or telephone call（信息；书信；电话）

communism.meaning: a political movement that believes in an economic system in which the state controls the means of producing everything on behalf of the people. compact.meaning: smaller than is usual for things of the same kind（小型的；袖珍的）；using or filling only a small amount of space（紧凑的；体积小的）；closely and firmly packed together（紧密的；坚实的）；(of a person or an animal（人或动物）

companionship.meaning: the pleasant feeling that you have when you have a friendly relationship with sb and are not alone（友情；交谊；友谊）

company.meaning: (often in names（常用于名称）；a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services（公司；商号；商行）；a group of people who work or perform together（剧团；演出团）；the fact of being with sb else and not alone（陪伴；做伴）

comparable.meaning: similar to sb/sth else and able to be compared（类似的；可比较的）；com·par·abil·ity /ˌkɒmpərəˈbɪləti; NAmEˌkɑːmpərəˈbɪləti/ noun [U] Each group will have the same set of questions, in order to ensure comparability.（为确保可比性，每一组将得到一套同样的问题。）

comparative.meaning: connected with studying things to find out how similar or different they are（比较的；相比的）；measured or judged by how similar or different it is to sth else（比较而言的；相对的）；(grammar 语法) relating to adjectives or adverbs that express more in amount, degree or quality, for example better, worse, slower and more difficult（（形容词或副词）比较级的（如 better、worse、slower 和 more difficult））；(grammar 语法) the form of an adjective or adverb that expresses more in amount, degree or quality（（形容词或副词的）比较级形式）

compare.meaning: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different（比较；对比）；to be similar to sb/sth else, either better or worse（与 … 类似（或相似））；to show or state that sb/sth is similar to sb/sth else（表明 … 与 … 相似；将 … 比作）；if two or more people compare notes, they each say what they think about the same event, situation, etc.（（与 … ）交换看法（或意见等））

comparison.meaning: the process of comparing two or more people or things（比较）；an occasion when two or more people or things are compared（对比；相比）；used especially at the beginning of a sentence when the next thing that is mentioned is compared with sth in the previous sentence（（尤用于句首）比较起来，较之）；when compared with sb/sth（（与 … ）相比较）

compartment.meaning: one of the separate sections which a coach/car on a train is divided into（（铁路客车车厢分隔成的）隔间）；one of the separate sections that sth such as a piece of furniture or equipment has for keeping things in（（家具或设备等的）分隔间，隔层）

compass.meaning: an instrument for finding direction, with a needle that always points to the north（罗盘；罗经；指南针；罗盘仪）；an instrument with two long thin parts joined together at the top, used for drawing circles and measuring distances on a map（圆规；两脚规）；(formal) a range or an extent, especially of what can be achieved in a particular situation（范围；范畴；界限）

compassion.meaning: a strong feeling of sympathy for people who are suffering and a desire to help them（同情；怜悯）

compatibility.meaning: the ability of people or things to live or exist together without problems（和睦相处；并存；相容）；the ability of machines, especially computers, and computer programs to be used together（（尤指计算机及程序的）兼容性，相容性）

compatible.meaning: (of machines, especially computers（机器，尤指计算机）；able to be used together（可共用的；兼容的）；(of ideas, methods or things（想法、方法或事物）；able to exist or be used together without causing problems（可共存的；可共用的；兼容的）

compel.meaning: to force sb to do sth; to make sth necessary（强迫；迫使；使必须）；(not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to cause a particular reaction（引起反应）

compelling.meaning: that makes you pay attention to it because it is so interesting and exciting（引人入胜的；扣人心弦的）；so strong that you must do sth about it（非常强烈的；不可抗拒的）；that makes you think it is true（令人信服的）；com·pel·ling·ly /kəmˈpelɪŋli; NAmEkəmˈpelɪŋli/ adv. compellingly attractive（具有无法抗拒的魅力）

compensate.meaning: to provide sth good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss, etc.（补偿；弥补）；to pay sb money because they have suffered some damage, loss, injury, etc.（给（某人）赔偿（或赔款））；com·pen·sa·tory AW /ˌkɒmpenˈseɪtəri; NAmEkəmˈpensətɔːri/ adj. compensation.meaning: something, especially money, that sb gives you because they have hurt you, or damaged sth that you own; the act of giving this to sb（补偿（或赔偿）物；（尤指）赔偿金，补偿金；赔偿）；things that make a bad situation better（弥补的事物；（对不利局面的）补偿）

compete.meaning: to try to be more successful or better than sb else who is trying to do the same as you（竞争；对抗）；to take part in a contest or game（参加比赛（或竞赛））

competence.meaning: the ability to do sth well（能力；胜任）；(law 律) the power that a court, an organization or a person has to deal with sth（（法庭、机构或人的）权限，管辖权）；(technical 术语) a skill that you need in a particular job or for a particular task（技能；本领）

competition.meaning: a situation in which people or organizations compete with each other for sth that not everyone can have（竞争；角逐）；an event in which people compete with each other to find out who is the best at sth（比赛；竞赛）；the people who are competing against sb（竞争者；对手）

competitive.meaning: used to describe a situation in which people or organizations compete against each other（竞争的）；as good as or better than others（（与 … ）一样好的；（比 … ）更好的；有竞争力的）；(of a person（人）；trying very hard to be better than others（努力竞争的；一心求胜的）

competitor.meaning: a person or an organization that competes against others, especially in business（（尤指商业方面的）竞争者，对手）；a person who takes part in a competition（参赛者；竞赛者）

compile.meaning: to produce a book, list, report, etc. by bringing together different items, articles, songs, etc.（编写（书、列表、报告等）；编纂）；(computing 计) to translate instructions from one computer language into another so that a particular computer can understand them（编译）

complaint.meaning: a reason for not being satisfied; a statement that sb makes saying that they are not satisfied（不满的原因；抱怨；埋怨；投诉；控告）；the act of complaining（抱怨；埋怨；投诉）；an illness, especially one that is not serious, and often one that affects a particular part of the body（（尤指不严重、常影响身体某部位的）疾病）

complexion.meaning: the natural colour and condition of the skin on a person's face（面色；肤色；气色）；the general character of sth（（事物的）性质，特性）；to change the way that a situation appears（使形势改观）

complexity.meaning: the state of being formed of many parts; the state of being difficult to understand（复杂性；难懂）；the features of a problem or situation that are difficult to understand（难题；难以理解的局势）

compliance.meaning: the practice of obeying rules or requests made by people in authority（服从；顺从；遵从）

complicated.meaning: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand（复杂的；难懂的）

complication.meaning: a thing that makes a situation more complicated or difficult（使更复杂化（或更困难）的事物）；(medical 医) a new problem or illness that makes treatment of a previous one more complicated or difficult（并发症）

compliment.meaning: a remark that expresses praise or admiration of sb（赞扬；称赞）；(formal) polite words or good wishes, especially when used to express praise and admiration（致意；问候；祝贺）；to tell sb that you like or admire sth they have done, their appearance, etc.（赞美；称赞；钦佩）

comply.meaning: to obey a rule, an order, etc.（遵从；服从；顺从）

compo.meaning: money that is paid to a worker if he/she gets injured at work（工伤赔偿费）

component.meaning: one of several parts of which sth is made（组成部分；成分；部件）；com·pon·ent adj. [only before noun] Break the problem down into its component parts.（把这个问题分解成若干组成部分。）

compose.meaning: (formal) to combine together to form a whole（组成，构成（一个整体））；to write music（作曲；创作（音乐））；to write a letter, etc. usually with a lot of care and thought（撰写（信函、讲稿、诗歌等））；(formal) to manage to control your feelings or expression（使镇静；使平静）

comprehension.meaning: the ability to understand（理解力；领悟能力）；an exercise that trains students to understand a language（（语言学习中的）理解练习（或训练））

computation.meaning: an act or the process of calculating sth（计算；计算过程）

computer.meaning: an electronic machine that can store, organize and find information, do calculations and control other machines（计算机；电脑）

concave.meaning: (of an outline or a surface（轮廓或表面）；curving in（凹的；凹面的）

conceal.meaning: to hide sb/sth（隐藏；隐瞒；掩盖）

conceited.meaning: having too much pride in yourself and what you do（自负的；骄傲自大的）

conceivable.meaning: that you can imagine or believe（可想像的；可信的）；con·ceiv·ably AW /kənˈsiːvəbli; NAmEkənˈsiːvəbli/ adv. The disease could conceivably be transferred to humans.（这种疾病可能会传染给人类。）

conceive.meaning: (formal) to form an idea, a plan, etc. in your mind; to imagine sth（想出（主意、计划等）；想像；构想；设想）；when a woman conceives or conceives a child, she becomes pregnant（怀孕；怀胎）

concentrated.meaning: showing determination to do sth（决心要做的；全力以赴的）；(of a substance（物质）；made stronger because water or other substances have been removed（浓缩的）；if sth exists or happens in a concentrated way, there is a lot of it in one place or at one time（密集的；集中的）

concentration.meaning: the ability to direct all your effort and attention on one thing, without thinking of other things（专心；专注）；the process of people directing effort and attention on a particular thing（关注；重视）；a lot of sth in one place（集中；聚集）；the amount of a substance in a liquid or in another substance（浓度；含量）

concentric.meaning: (of circles（圆）；having the same centre（同心的）

concept.meaning: an idea or a principle that is connected with sth abstract（概念；观念）

conception.meaning: the process of forming an idea or a plan（构思；构想；设想）；an understanding or a belief of what sth is or what sth should be（理解（认为某事怎样或应该怎样））；the process of an egg being fertilized inside a woman's body so that she becomes pregnant（怀孕；受孕）

conceptual.meaning: related to or based on ideas（概念（上）的；观念（上）的）；con·cep·tu·al·ly AW /kənˈseptʃuəli; NAmEkənˈseptʃuəli/ adv. conceptually similar/distinct（概念上相似/不同）

concern.meaning: to affect sb/sth; to involve sb/sth（影响；涉及；牵涉）；to be about sth（与 … 有关；涉及）；to worry sb（让（某人）担忧）；to take an interest in sth（（对 … ）感兴趣）

concerned.meaning: worried and feeling concern about sth（担心的；忧虑的）；interested in sth（感兴趣的；关切的；关注的）

concerning.meaning: about sth; involving sb/sth（关于；涉及）

concert.meaning: a public performance of music（音乐会；演奏会）；(formal) working together with sb/sth（与 … 合作（或同心协力））

concession.meaning: something that you allow or do, or allow sb to have, in order to end an argument or to make a situation less difficult（让步；妥协）；the act of giving sth or allowing sth; the act of conceding（承认；给予；许可；让步）；(BrE) a reduction in an amount of money that has to be paid; a ticket that is sold at a reduced price to a particular group of people（减价；（对某类人的）减价票）；a right or an advantage that is given to a group of people, an organization, etc., especially by a government or an employer（（尤指由政府或雇主给予的）特许权，优惠）
