persecute.meaning: to treat sb in a cruel and unfair way, especially because of their race, religion or political beliefs（（因种族、宗教或政治信仰）迫害，残害，压迫）；to deliberately annoy sb all the time and make their life unpleasant（骚扰；打扰；为 … 找麻烦）；per·se·cu·tion persecution persecutions /ˌpɜːsɪˈkjuːʃn; NAmEˌpɜːrsɪˈkjuːʃn/ noun [U, C] the victims of religious persecution（宗教迫害的受难者）

perseverance.meaning: the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties（毅力；韧性；不屈不挠的精神）

persevere.meaning: to continue trying to do or achieve sth despite difficulties（坚持；孜孜以求）

persian.meaning: a person from ancient Persia, or modern Persia, now called Iran（波斯人）；the official language of Iran（波斯语）

persist.meaning: to continue to do sth despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable（顽强地坚持；执着地做）；to continue to exist（维持；保持；持续存在）

persistence.meaning: the fact of continuing to try to do sth despite difficulties, especially when other people are against you and think that you are being annoying or unreasonable（坚持；锲而不舍）；the state of continuing to exist for a long period of time（持续存在；维持）

persistent.meaning: determined to do sth despite difficulties, especially when other people are against you and think that you are being annoying or unreasonable（执着的；不屈不挠的；坚持不懈的）；continuing for a long period of time without interruption, or repeated frequently, especially in a way that is annoying and cannot be stopped（连绵的；持续的；反复出现的）；per·sist·ent·ly AW /pəˈsɪstəntli; NAmEpərˈsɪstəntli/ adv. They have persistently denied claims of illegal dealing.（他们一再否认进行非法交易的说法。）

person.meaning: a human as an individual（人；个人）；(formal or disapproving) a human, especially one who is not identified（人；某人）；(in compounds（构成复合词）；a person working in the area of business mentioned; a person concerned with the thing mentioned（从事 … 工作（或担任 … 职务）的人；人员）

personal.meaning: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else（个人的；私人的）；connected with individual people, especially their feelings, characters and relationships（人际的；个性的）；not connected with a person's job or official position（私人的；私事的）；done by a particular person rather than by sb who is acting for them（亲自做的）

personality.meaning: the various aspects of a person's character that combine to make them different from other people（性格；个性；人格）；the qualities of a person's character that make them interesting and attractive（魅力；气质；气度）；a famous person, especially one who works in entertainment or sport（名人，风云人物（尤指娱乐界或体育界的））；a person whose strong character makes them noticeable（性格鲜明的人；有突出个性的人）

personalize.meaning: to mark sth in some way to show that it belongs to a particular person（在 … 上标明主人姓名）；to design or change sth so that it is suitable for the needs of a particular person（为个人特制（或专设））；to refer to particular people when discussing a general subject（针对个人；个人化）；per·son·al·ized, -ised /; NAmE/ adj. a highly personalized service（高度个性化的服务）

personally.meaning: used to show that you are giving your own opinion about sth（就本人而言；就个人意见）；by a particular person rather than by sb acting for them（本人；亲自）；in a way that is connected with one particular person rather than a group of people（个别地；单个地）；in a way that is intended to be offensive（无礼地；冒犯地）

personnel.meaning: the people who work for an organization or one of the armed forces（（组织或军队中的）全体人员，职员）；the department in a company that deals with employing and training people（人事部门）

perspective.meaning: a particular attitude towards sth; a way of thinking about sth（态度；观点；思考方法）；the ability to think about problems and decisions in a reasonable way without exaggerating their importance（客观判断力；权衡轻重的能力）；the art of creating an effect of depth and distance in a picture by representing people and things that are far away as being smaller than those that are nearer the front（透视法）；(formal) a view, especially one in which you can see far into the distance（景观；远景）

perspire.meaning: to produce sweat on your body（出汗；排汗；发汗）

persuade.meaning: to make sb do sth by giving them good reasons for doing it（劝说；说服）；to make sb believe that sth is true（使信服；使相信）

persuasion.meaning: the act of persuading sb to do sth or to believe sth（说服；劝说）；a particular set of beliefs, especially about religion or politics（（宗教或政治）信仰）

persuasive.meaning: able to persuade sb to do or believe sth（有说服力的；令人信服的）；per·sua·sive·ly /pəˈsweɪsɪvli; NAmEpərˈsweɪsɪvli/ adv. They argue persuasively in favour of a total ban on handguns.（他们以雄辩的论据支持全面禁用手枪。）

pertain.meaning: to exist or to apply in a particular situation or at a particular time（存在；适用）；(formal) to be connected with sth/sb（与 … 相关；关于）

pertinent.meaning: appropriate to a particular situation（有关的；恰当的；相宜的）

perturb.meaning: (formal) to make sb worried or anxious（使焦虑；使不安）；per·turbed /pəˈtɜːbd; NAmEpərˈtɜːrbd/ adj. a perturbed young man（烦恼的年轻人）

peruse.meaning: (formal or humorous) to read sth, especially in a careful way（细读；研读）；per·usal perusal perusals /pəˈruːzl; NAmEpəˈruːzl/ noun [U, sing.] The agreement was signed after careful perusal.（合同是仔细阅读以后才签署的。）

pervade.meaning: (formal) to spread through and be noticeable in every part of sth（渗透；弥漫；遍及）

pervasive.meaning: existing in all parts of a place or thing; spreading gradually to affect all parts of a place or thing（遍布的；充斥各处的；弥漫的）

perverse.meaning: showing deliberate determination to behave in a way that most people think is wrong, unacceptable or unreasonable（执拗的；任性的；不通情理的）；per·verse·ly /pəˈvɜːsli; NAmEpərˈvɜːrsli/ adv. She seemed perversely proud of her criminal record.（她似乎不通人事，拿自己的前科当荣耀。）；per·vers·ity /; NAmE/ noun [U] He refused to attend out of sheer perversity.（他拒不出席，纯属任性固执。）

pervert.meaning: to change a system, process, etc. in a bad way so that it is not what it used to be or what it should be（败坏；使走样；误导；误用）；to affect sb in a way that makes them act or think in an immoral or unacceptable way（腐蚀；侵害；使堕落）；(law 律) to tell a lie or to do sth in order to prevent the police, etc. from finding out the truth about a crime（作伪证；妨碍司法）；a person whose sexual behaviour is not thought to be normal or acceptable by most people（性变态者）

pessimism.meaning: a feeling that bad things will happen and that sth will not be successful; the tendency to have this feeling（悲观；悲观情绪；悲观主义）

pessimist.meaning: a person who always expects bad things to happen（悲观主义者；悲观论者）

pessimistic.meaning: expecting bad things to happen or sth not to be successful; showing this（悲观的；悲观主义的）

pest.meaning: an insect or animal that destroys plants, food, etc.（害虫；害兽；害鸟）；(informal) an annoying person or thing（讨厌的人（或物））

pester.meaning: to annoy sb, especially by asking them sth many times（打扰；纠缠；烦扰）

pesticide.meaning: a chemical used for killing pests, especially insects（杀虫剂；除害药物）

pestilential.meaning: (literary) extremely annoying（极讨厌的；极烦人的）；(old use) connected with or causing a pestilence（瘟疫的；引起瘟疫的）

pet.meaning: the abbreviation for ‘polyethylene terephthalate’ (an artificial substance used to make materials for packaging food, including plastic drinks bottles)（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（全写为 polyethylene terephthalate，可做食品饮料包装材料））；(medical 医) the abbreviation for ‘positron emission tomography’ (a process that produces an image of your brain or of another part inside your body)（正电子发射扫描（全写为 positron emission tomography，大脑或其他体内部位的成像））；the abbreviation for ‘Preliminary English Test’ (a British test, set by the University of Cambridge, that measures a person's ability to speak and write English as a foreign language at an intermediate level)（中级英语证书考试（全写为 Preliminary English Test，由英国剑桥大学命题，测试英语作为外语的口语和写作能力是否达到中级水平））

petal.meaning: a delicate coloured part of a flower. The head of a flower is usually made up of several petals around a central part.（花瓣）

petition.meaning: a written document signed by a large number of people that asks sb in a position of authority to do or change sth（请愿书）；(law 律) an official document asking a court to take a particular course of action（申诉书；申请书）；(formal) a formal prayer to God or request to sb in authority（祈祷；祈求）；to make a formal request to sb in authority, especially by sending them a petition（祈求；请求；请愿）

petrify.meaning: to make sb feel extremely frightened（使吓呆；使惊呆）；to change or to make sth change into a substance like stone（（使）石化）

petrochemical.meaning: any chemical substance obtained from petroleum oil or natural gas（石油化学产品）

petrol.meaning: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc.（汽油）

petroleum.meaning: mineral oil that is found under the ground or the sea and is used to produce petrol/gas, paraffin, diesel oil, etc.（石油；原油）

petticoat.meaning: a piece of women's underwear like a thin dress or skirt, worn under a dress or skirt（衬裙）

petty.meaning: small and unimportant（小的；琐碎的；次要的）；caring too much about small and unimportant matters, especially when this is unkind to other people（小气的；狭隘的）

petunia.meaning: a garden plant with white, pink, purple or red flowers（矮牵牛）

pharaoh.meaning: a ruler of ancient Egypt（法老（古埃及国王））

pharmaceutical.meaning: connected with making and selling drugs and medicines（制药的；配药的；卖药的）；(technical 术语) a drug or medicine（药物）

pharmacy.meaning: a shop/store, or part of one, that sells medicines and drugs（药房；药店；医药柜台）；a place in a hospital where medicines are prepared（（医院的）药房，配药室）；the study of how to prepare medicines and drugs（药剂学；制药学）

phase.meaning: a stage in a process of change or development（阶段；时期）；each of the shapes of the moon as we see it from the earth at different times of the month（月相；（月亮的）盈亏）；(BrE) working/not working together in the right way（协调；不协调）；to arrange to do sth gradually in stages over a period of time（分阶段进行；逐步做）

phenomenal.meaning: very great or impressive（了不起的；非凡的）

phenomenon.meaning: a fact or an event in nature or society, especially one that is not fully understood（现象）；a person or thing that is very successful or impressive（杰出的人；非凡的人（或事物））

pheromone.meaning: a substance produced by an animal as a chemical signal, often to attract another animal of the same species（外激素；信息素）

philanthropist.meaning: a rich person who helps the poor and those in need, especially by giving money（慈善家；乐善好施的人）

philology.meaning: the scientific study of the development of language or of a particular language（语文学；语文研究）

philosopher.meaning: a person who studies or writes about philosophy（哲学家）；a person who thinks deeply about things（深思的人；善于思考的人）

philosophical.meaning: connected with philosophy（哲学的）；(approving) having a calm attitude towards a difficult or disappointing situation（达观的；处乱不惊的）；philo·soph·ic·al·ly AW /ˌfɪləˈsɒfɪkli; NAmEˌfɪləˈsɑːfɪkli/ adv. This kind of evidence is philosophically unconvincing.（这类证据在哲学上是不足为信的。）

philosophy.meaning: the study of the nature and meaning of the universe and of human life（哲学）；a particular set or system of beliefs resulting from the search for knowledge about life and the universe（哲学体系；思想体系）；a set of beliefs or an attitude to life that guides sb's behaviour（人生哲学；生活的信条（或态度））

phobia.meaning: a strong unreasonable fear of sth（恐怖症，恐惧症（无名的极度恐惧））；(in nouns（构成名词）；a strong unreasonable fear or hatred of a particular thing（对 … 的恐惧症）

phoenix.meaning: (in stories) a magic bird that lives for several hundred years before burning itself and then being born again from its ashes（（传说中的）凤凰，长生鸟）

phone.meaning: a system for talking to sb else over long distances using wires or radio; a machine used for this; a telephone（电话；电话系统；电话机）；the part of a phone that you hold in your hand and speak into; a telephone（电话听筒；电话）；(in nouns（构成名词）；an instrument that uses or makes sound（（发声或使用声音的）工具，仪器）

phonetic.meaning: using special symbols to represent each different speech sound（表示语音的；音标的）；(of a spelling or spelling system（拼写或拼写系统）；that closely matches the sounds represented（拼音的；与发音近似的）；connected with the sounds of human speech（语音的）

phonetics.meaning: the study of speech sounds and how they are produced（语音学）

phosphate.meaning: any compound containing phosphorus, used in industry or for helping plants to grow（磷酸盐；含磷化合物；磷肥）

phosphorus.meaning: a chemical element. Phosphorus is found in several different forms, including as a poisonous, pale yellow substance that shines in the dark and starts to burn as soon as it is placed in air.（磷）

photocopy.meaning: a copy of a document, etc. made by the action of light on a specially treated surface（影印本；复印件）；to make a photocopy of sth（影印；复制；复印）；(of printed material（印刷品）；to produce a good/bad photocopy（影印得好/不好）

photograph.meaning: a picture that is made by using a camera that has a film sensitive to light inside it（照片；相片）；to take a photograph of sb/sth（拍照；照相）；to look or not look attractive in photographs（（很、不等）上相，上镜）

photographer.meaning: a person who takes photographs, especially as a job（拍照者；摄影师）

photographic.meaning: connected with photographs or photography（摄影的；摄制的；照片的）

photography.meaning: the art, process or job of taking photographs or filming sth（照相术；摄影）

photojournalism.meaning: the work of giving news using mainly photographs, especially in a magazine（图片新闻报道；摄影新闻报道；摄影新闻工作）

photosynthesis.meaning: the process by which green plants turn carbon dioxide and water into food using energy obtained from light from the sun（光合作用）

phrasal.meaning: of or connected with a phrase（短语的；词组的）

phrase.meaning: (grammar 语法) a small group of words without a finite verb that together have a particular meaning and that typically form part of a sentence. ‘the green car’ and ‘on Friday morning’ are phrases.（短语；词组；片语）；a group of words which have a particular meaning when used together（成语；习语；惯用法；警句）；(music 音) a short series of notes that form a unit within a longer passage in a piece of music（乐句；乐节）；to say or write sth in a particular way（（以某种方式）表达，措辞，推敲）

phylum.meaning: a group into which animals, plants, etc. are divided, smaller than a kingdom and larger than a class（（生物分类学的）门）

physical.meaning: connected with a person's body rather than their mind（身体的；肉体的；躯体的）；connected with things that actually exist or are present and can be seen, felt, etc. rather than things that only exist in a person's mind（客观存在的；现实的；物质的；有形的）；according to the laws of nature（根据自然规律的；符合自然法则的）；connected with the scientific study of forces such as heat, light, sound, etc. and how they affect objects（物理学的）

physically.meaning: in a way that is connected with a person's body rather than their mind（身体上；肉体上）；according to the laws of nature or what is probable（依据自然规律；按自然法则；根本上）

physician.meaning: a doctor, especially one who is a specialist in general medicine and not surgery（医师；（尤指）内科医生）

physicist.meaning: a scientist who studies physics（物理学家；物理学研究者）

physics.meaning: the scientific study of matter and energy and the relationships between them, including the study of forces, heat, light, sound, electricity and the structure of atoms（物理学）

physiology.meaning: the scientific study of the normal functions of living things（生理学）；the way in which a particular living thing functions（生理机能）；physio·logic·al /ˌfɪziəˈlɒdʒɪkl; NAmEˌfɪziəˈlɑːdʒɪkl/ adj. the physiological effect of space travel（宇宙航行的生理影响）

physique.meaning: the size and shape of a person's body（体格；体形）

pianist.meaning: a person who plays the piano（钢琴弹奏者；钢琴家）

piano.meaning: a large musical instrument played by pressing the black and white keys on the keyboard. The sound is produced by small hammers hitting the metal strings inside the piano.（钢琴）；(music 音) played or sung quietly（轻柔地；安静地；弱）

pick.meaning: (rather informal) to choose sb/sth from a group of people or things（选择；挑选）；to take flowers, fruit, etc. from the plant or the tree where they are growing（采；摘）；to pull or remove sth or small pieces of sth from sth else, especially with your fingers（（用手指）摘掉，剔除，掐去）；to choose only those things that you like or want very much（挑拣；精挑细选）

pickaxe.meaning: a large heavy tool that has a curved metal bar with sharp ends fixed at the centre to a wooden handle. It is used for breaking rocks or hard ground.（镐；尖嘴镐；鹤嘴锄）

pickle.meaning: (BrE) a vegetable that has been preserved in vinegar or salt water and has a strong flavour, served cold with meat, salads, etc.（泡菜；腌菜）；(BrE) a cold thick spicy sauce made from fruit and vegetables that have been boiled, often sold in jars and served with meat, cheese, etc.（菜酱）；a small cucumber that has been preserved in vinegar before being eaten（醋泡小黄瓜）；(informal) in a difficult or unpleasant situation（处于困境；处境窘迫）

pickpocket.meaning: a person who steals money, etc. from other people's pockets, especially in crowded places（扒手；小偷）

pickup.meaning: a vehicle with low sides and no roof at the back used, for example, by farmers（轻型货车；敞篷小货车；皮卡货车）；a person sb meets for the first time, for example in a bar, with whom they start a sexual relationship（偶然结识的调情者）；an improvement（改进；好转；改善）；an occasion when sb/sth is collected（接人；收取物品；提货）

picky.meaning: (of a person（人）；liking only particular things and difficult to please（挑剔的；难伺候的）

picnic.meaning: an occasion when people pack a meal and take it to eat outdoors, especially in the countryside（野餐）；the meal, usually consisting of sandwiches, salad and fruit, etc. that you take with you when you go on a picnic（野餐食物）；(informal) to be difficult and cause a lot of problems（可不容易；不是好玩的）；to have a picnic（野餐）

pictorial.meaning: using or containing pictures（用图片的；有插图的）；connected with pictures（画片的；图画的）

picture.meaning: a painting or drawing, etc. that shows a scene, a person or thing（图画；绘画）；a photograph（相片；照片）；an image on a television screen（电视图像）；a description that gives you an idea in your mind of what sth is like（描绘；描述）

picturesque.meaning: (of a place, building, scene, etc.（地方、建筑物、景色等）；pretty, especially in a way that looks old-fashioned（优美的；古色古香的）；(of language（语言）；producing strong mental images by using unusual words（生动的；栩栩如生的）

pie.meaning: fruit baked in a dish with pastry on the bottom, sides and top（果馅饼；果馅派）；(especially BrE) meat, vegetables, etc. baked in a dish with pastry on the bottom, sides and top（肉馅饼；蔬菜馅饼）；a share of sth such as money, profits, etc.（（金钱、利润等的）一份；一杯羹）；(informal) an event that sb talks about that seems very unlikely to happen（难以实现的事；幻想的事；空中楼阁）

piece.meaning: (used especially with of and uncountable nouns（尤与 of 和不可数名词连用）；an amount of sth that has been cut or separated from the rest of it; a standard amount of sth（片；块；段；截；标准的量）；one of the bits or parts that sth breaks into（碎片；碎块）；one of the parts that sth is made of（零件；部件）

piecemeal.meaning: done or happening gradually at different times and often in different ways, rather than carefully planned at the beginning（逐渐做成（或发生）的；零敲碎打的；零散的）；piece·meal adv. The reforms were implemented piecemeal.（改革在零零星星地进行。）

piecework.meaning: work that is paid for by the amount done and not by the hours worked（计件工作）

pier.meaning: a long structure built in the sea and joined to the land at one end, often with places of entertainment on it（（常设有娱乐场所的）突堤）；a long low structure built in a lake, river or the sea and joined to the land at one end, used by boats to allow passengers to get on and off（（突入湖、河、海中的）码头；突码头）；(technical 术语) a large strong piece of wood, metal or stone that is used to support a roof, wall, bridge, etc.（柱子；墙墩；桥墩）

pierce.meaning: to make a small hole in sth, or to go through sth, with a sharp object（扎；刺破；穿透）；(of light, sound, etc.（光、声等）；to be suddenly seen or heard（刺破；穿过；透入）；to force a way through a barrier（冲破；突破）

piety.meaning: the state of having or showing a deep respect for sb/sth, especially for God and religion; the state of being pious（虔诚）

pig.meaning: an animal with pink, black or brown skin, short legs, a broad nose and a short tail which curls round itself. Pigs are kept on farms for their meat (called pork ) or live in the wild.（猪）；(informal, disapproving) an unpleasant or offensive person; a person who is dirty or greedy（令人不快（或讨厌）的人；贪婪（或肮脏）的人）；(slang) an offensive word for a police officer（（对警察的蔑称））；(BrE) (informal) to do sth badly; to make a mess of sth（把事情办砸；弄得一团糟）

pigeon.meaning: a fat grey and white bird with short legs. Pigeons are common in cities and also live in woods and fields where people shoot them for sport or food.（鸽子）；(old-fashioned) (BrE) to be sb's responsibility or business（是某人的职责（或事情））

piggyback.meaning: a ride on sb's back, while he or she is walking（背着；肩驮）；pig·gy·back adv. to ride piggyback（骑在肩上）；to use sth that already exists as a support for your own work; to use a larger organization, etc. for your own advantage（利用；借助；攀附利用）

pigment.meaning: a substance that exists naturally in people, animals and plants and gives their skin, leaves, etc. a particular colour（色素）；a coloured powder that is mixed with a liquid to produce paint, etc.（颜料）

pigmentation.meaning: the presence of pigments in skin, hair, leaves, etc. that causes them to be a particular colour（色素沉着；天然颜色）

pike.meaning: a large freshwater fish with very sharp teeth（狗鱼；（台）梭子鱼）；a weapon with a sharp blade on a long wooden handle, used in the past by soldiers on foot（长矛）；(dialect) a pointed top of a hill in the north of England（（英格兰北部的）山峰，陡峰）；(NAmE) (informal) to happen; to become noticeable（发生；显现）

pilchard.meaning: a small sea fish that is used for food（欧洲沙丁鱼；沙丁鱼）

pile.meaning: a number of things that have been placed on top of each other（摞；垛；沓）；a mass of sth that is high in the middle and wider at the bottom than at the top（堆；成堆的东西）；(informal) a lot of sth（大量；许多）；the short threads, pieces of wool, etc. that form the soft surface of carpets and some types of cloth such as velvet（绒头；绒毛）

pilgrim.meaning: a person who travels to a holy place for religious reasons（朝觐者；朝圣的人；香客）；a member of the group of English people (the Pilgrim Fathers) who sailed to America on the ship The Mayflower in 1620 and started a colony in Massachusetts（清教徒前辈移民（1620 年乘五月花号赴美洲，在马萨诸塞建立英国殖民地））

pilgrimage.meaning: a journey to a holy place for religious reasons（朝圣之旅）；a journey to a place that is connected with sb/sth that you admire or respect（参拜之行；瞻仰之旅）

pill.meaning: a small flat round piece of medicine that you swallow without chewing it（药丸；药片）；a pill that some women take to prevent them becoming pregnant（口服避孕药）；(NAmE) an annoying person（讨厌的人；讨厌鬼）；to do sth that makes an unpleasant situation seem less unpleasant（药里加糖；缓和情况；缓解苦感）

pillar.meaning: a large round stone, metal or wooden post that is used to support a bridge, the roof of a building, etc., especially when it is also decorative（（尤指兼作装饰的）柱子，桥墩）；a mass of sth that is shaped like a pillar（柱状物）；a strong supporter of sth; an important member of sth（台柱子；主心骨；中流砥柱）；a person who has a lot of a particular quality（富有某种素质的人；某种素质的化身）

pillow.meaning: a square or rectangular piece of cloth filled with soft material, used to rest your head on in bed（枕头）；(literary) to rest sth, especially your head, on an object（枕着（某物））

pilot.meaning: a person who operates the controls of an aircraft, especially as a job（飞行员；（飞行器）驾驶员）；a person with special knowledge of a difficult area of water, for example, the entrance to a harbour, whose job is to guide ships through it（领航员；引水员；领港员）；a single television programme that is made in order to find out whether people will like it and want to watch further programmes（（电视的）试播节目）；to fly an aircraft or guide a ship; to act as a pilot（驾驶（飞行器）；领航（船只））

pimple.meaning: a small raised red spot on the skin（丘疹；粉刺；小脓包）；pim·ply pimply pimplier pimpliest /ˈpɪmpli; NAmEˈpɪmpli/ adj. pimply skin（长丘疹的皮肤）

pin.meaning: the abbreviation for ‘personal identification number’ (a number given to you, for example by a bank, so that you can use a plastic card to take out money from a cash machine)（个人身分识别号码，个人密码（全写为 personal identification number，银行等向顾客提供的可与提款卡配合使用的号码））

pinch.meaning: to take a piece of sb's skin between your thumb and first finger and squeeze hard, especially to hurt the person（拧；捏；掐）；to hold sth tightly between the thumb and finger or between two things that are pressed together（捏住；夹紧）；if sth such as a shoe pinches part of your body, it hurts you because it is too tight（夹（脚）；夹痛）；(BrE) (informal) to steal sth, especially sth small and not very valuable（偷摸；行窃）

pine.meaning: an evergreen forest tree with leaves like needles（松树）；the pale soft wood of the pine tree, used in making furniture, etc.（松木）；to become very sad because sb has died or gone away（（因死亡、离别）难过，悲伤）；to become very sick and weak because you miss sb/sth very much（（因思念等）病重虚弱，憔悴）

pineapple.meaning: a large tropical fruit with thick rough skin, sweet yellow flesh with a lot of juice and stiff leaves on top（菠萝；凤梨）

pinhead.meaning: the very small flat surface at one end of a pin（大头针的平头）

pinhole.meaning: a very small hole, especially one made by a pin（针刺的孔；针孔）

pink.meaning: pale red in colour（粉红色的）；(BrE) connected with homosexual people（与同性恋者有关的）；(informal, disapproving) having or showing slightly left-wing political views（政治观点偏左的；略呈左倾的）；pink·ness /pɪŋknəs; NAmEpɪŋknəs/ noun [U] IDM see tickle v. noun ★ 1. ★ [U, C] the colour that is produced when you mix red and white together（粉红色）

pinnacle.meaning: the most important or successful part of sth（顶点；顶峰；鼎盛时期）；a small pointed stone decoration built on the roof of a building（（建筑物）小尖顶）；a high pointed piece of rock, especially at the top of a mountain（（尤指山顶的）尖岩，兀立岩石）

pinpoint.meaning: to find and show the exact position of sb/sth or the exact time that sth happened（明确指出，确定（位置或时间））；to be able to give the exact reason for sth or to describe sth exactly（准确解释（或说明））；if sth is done with pinpoint accuracy, it is done exactly and in exactly the right position（准确的；精确的）；a very small area of sth, especially light（极小的范围；光点）

pint.meaning: a unit for measuring liquids and some dry goods. There are 8 pints in a gallon, equal to 0.568 of a litre in the UK and some other countries, and 0.473 of a litre in the US（品脱（容量单位，为 ⅛ 加仑，在英国等国家约合 0.568 升，在美国约合 0.473 升））；(BrE) a pint of beer (especially in a pub)（一品脱啤酒（尤用于酒吧））

pioneer.meaning: a person who is the first to study and develop a particular area of knowledge, culture, etc. that other people then continue to develop（先锋；先驱；带头人）；one of the first people to go to a particular area in order to live and work there（开发者；拓荒者）；when sb pioneers sth, they are one of the first people to do, discover or use sth new（当开拓者；做先锋；倡导）

pioneering.meaning: introducing ideas and methods that have never been used before（开拓性的；先驱性的；探索性的）

pious.meaning: having or showing a deep respect for God and religion（虔诚的；虔敬的）；(disapproving) pretending to be religious, moral or good in order to impress other people（道貌岸然的；伪善的；假正经的）；something that you want to happen but is unlikely to be achieved（可望而不可及的；难以实现的）

pipe.meaning: a tube through which liquids and gases can flow（管子；管道）；a narrow tube with a bowl at one end, used for smoking tobacco（烟斗；烟袋）；a musical instrument in the shape of a tube, played by blowing（管乐器）；any of the tubes from which sound is produced in an organ（（管风琴的）音管）

pipeline.meaning: a series of pipes that are usually underground and are used for carrying oil, gas, etc. over long distances（输油管道，输气管道，输送管线（通常指地下的））；something that is in the pipeline is being discussed, planned or prepared and will happen or exist soon（在讨论（或规划、准备）中；在酝酿中）

pique.meaning: (formal) annoyed or bitter feelings that you have, usually because your pride has been hurt（怨恨；愤恨；恼怒）；(formal) to make sb annoyed or upset（使愤恨；使恼怒）；piqued /; NAmE/ adj. [not before noun] She couldn't help feeling a little piqued by his lack of interest.（她不禁对他的淡漠感到有些不乐。）；(especially NAmE) to make sb very interested in sth（使 … 兴趣盎然；引起 … 的好奇）

piracy.meaning: the crime of attacking ships at sea in order to steal from them（海上抢劫）；the act of making illegal copies of DVDs, computer programs, books, etc., in order to sell them（盗版行为；非法复制）

pirate.meaning: (especially in the past) a person on a ship who attacks other ships at sea in order to steal from them（（尤指旧时的）海盗）；(often used as an adjective（常用作形容词）；a person who makes illegal copies of DVDs, computer programs, books, etc., in order to sell them（盗版者；盗印者）；a person or an organization that broadcasts illegally（非法播音的人（或组织））

pistachio.meaning: the small green nut of an Asian tree（开心果；阿月浑子）；a pale green colour（淡绿色）

pistol.meaning: a small gun that you can hold and fire with one hand（手枪）

piston.meaning: a part of an engine that consists of a short cylinder that fits inside a tube and moves up and down or backwards and forwards to make other parts of the engine move（活塞）

pit.meaning: a large deep hole in the ground（深洞；深坑）；(especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a deep hole in the ground from which minerals are dug out（矿井）；a small shallow hole in the surface of sth, especially a mark left on the surface of the skin by some disease, such as chickenpox（麻子；痘瘢）

pitch.meaning: an area of ground specially prepared and marked for playing a sports game（（体育比赛的）场地；球场）；how high or low a sound is, especially a musical note（（尤指乐音的）音高）；the degree or strength of a feeling or activity; the highest point of sth（（感情、活动等的）程度，力度；（事物的）最高点）；talk or arguments used by a person trying to sell things or persuade people to do sth（推销的话；说教；宣传论点）

pitcher.meaning: a container with a handle and a lip, for holding and pouring liquids（（有柄有嘴的）壶，罐）；(BrE) a large clay container with a small opening and one or two handles, used, especially in the past, for holding liquids（（尤指旧时的）带柄的陶罐）；(in baseball（棒球）；the player who throws the ball to the batter（投球手）

pitfall.meaning: a danger or difficulty, especially one that is hidden or not obvious at first（危险；困难；（尤指）陷阱，隐患）

pity.meaning: a feeling of sympathy and sadness caused by the suffering and troubles of others（同情；怜悯）；used to show that you are disappointed about sth（（用于表示失望）遗憾，可惜）；(BrE) (informal) unfortunately（不幸地）；(not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）

pivot.meaning: the central point, pin or column on which sth turns or balances（支点；枢轴；中心点）；the central or most important person or thing（最重要的人（或事物）；中心；核心）；to turn or balance on a central point (= a pivot); to make sth do this（（使）在枢轴上旋转（或转动））；(of an argument, a theory, etc.（论点、理论等）

pivotal.meaning: of great importance because other things depend on it（关键性的；核心的）

pizza.meaning: an Italian dish consisting of a flat round bread base with cheese, tomatoes, vegetables, meat, etc. on top（比萨饼；意大利饼）

placard.meaning: a large written or printed notice that is put in a public place or carried on a stick in a march（标语牌；广告牌；招贴；海报）

place.meaning: a particular position, point or area（位置；地点；场所；地方）；a particular city, town, building, etc.（某处地方（如城镇或建筑物等））；(especially in compounds or phrases（尤用于构成复合词或词组）；a building or an area of land used for a particular purpose（有某用途的建筑（或土地））

placement.meaning: the act of finding sb a suitable job or place to live（（对人的）安置，安排）；(BrE) a job, often as part of a course of study, where you get some experience of a particular kind of work（实习工作；实习课）；the act of placing sth somewhere（（对物件的）安置，放置）

placental.meaning: (medical 医) of or related to the placenta（胎盘的）；(biology 生) having a placenta（有胎盘的；有胎座的）

placid.meaning: (of a person or an animal（人或动物）；not easily excited or irritated（温和的；平和的；文静的）；calm and peaceful, with very little movement（平静的；宁静的；安静的）

plagiarize.meaning: (disapproving) to copy another person's ideas, words or work and pretend that they are your own（剽窃；抄袭）

plague.meaning: any infectious disease that kills a lot of people（死亡率高的传染病）；large numbers of an animal or insect that come into an area and cause great damage（（大批动物或昆虫肆虐造成的）灾害，祸患）；to cause pain or trouble to sb/sth over a period of time（给 … 造成长时间的痛苦（或麻烦）；困扰；折磨；使受煎熬）；to annoy sb or create problems, especially by asking for sth, demanding attention, etc.（纠缠；缠磨；缠扰）

plain.meaning: easy to see or understand（清楚的；明显的；浅白的）；not trying to trick anyone; honest and direct（坦诚的；直率的；直接的）；not decorated or complicated; simple（不尚修饰的；朴素的；简单的）；without marks or a pattern on it（素的；无花纹的；单色的）

plaint.meaning: (BrE) (law 律) a complaint made against sb in court（起诉；诉状）；(literary) a sad cry or sound（凄凉的哭泣（或声音））

plaintive.meaning: sounding sad, especially in a weak complaining way（（声音）悲伤的，哀怨的）

plan.meaning: something that you intend to do or achieve（计划；打算）；a set of things to do in order to achieve sth, especially one that has been considered in detail in advance（（详细）规划，方案；精心安排）；a detailed map of a building, town, etc.（（建筑、城镇等的）详图）；(technical 术语) a detailed drawing of a machine, building, etc. that shows its size, shape and measurements（（机器、建筑等的）设计图，平面图；图解）

plane.meaning: a flying vehicle with wings and one or more engines（飞机）；(geometry 几何) any flat or level surface, or an imaginary flat surface through or joining material objects（平面）；a level of thought, existence or development（（思想、存在或发展的）水平，程度，阶段，境界）；a tool with a blade set in a flat surface, used for making the surface of wood smooth by shaving very thin layers off it（木工刨；刨子）

planet.meaning: a large round object in space that moves around a star (such as the sun) and receives light from it（行星）；used to mean ‘the world’, especially when talking about the environment（地球（尤指环境））；(informal, humorous) used to suggest that sb's ideas are not realistic or practical（（指某人的想法完全不切实际））

planetarium.meaning: a building with a curved ceiling to represent the sky at night, with moving images of the planets and stars, used to educate and entertain people（天文馆；天象馆）

planetary.meaning: relating to a planet or planets（行星的）

plank.meaning: a long narrow flat piece of wood that is used for making floors, etc.（木板；板条）；a main point in the policy of an organization, especially a political party（（政党等的）政策准则，政纲的核心）

plankton.meaning: the very small forms of plant and animal life that live in water（浮游生物）

planner.meaning: a person whose job is to plan the growth and development of a town（城市规划者）；a person who makes plans for a particular area of activity（设计者；规划者）；a book, chart, computer program, etc. that contains dates and is used for recording information, arranging meetings, etc.（记事簿；规划簿）

planning.meaning: the act or process of making plans for sth（计划制订；规划过程）

plant.meaning: a living thing that grows in the earth and usually has a stem, leaves and roots, especially one that is smaller than a tree or bush（植物）；a factory or place where power is produced or an industrial process takes place（发电厂；工厂）；the large machinery that is used in industrial processes（（工业用的）大型机器，设备）；(informal) something that sb has deliberately placed among another person's clothes or possessions in order to make them appear guilty of a crime（栽赃物品）

plantation.meaning: a large area of land, especially in a hot country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, etc. are grown（种植园，种植场（尤指热带国家种植咖啡、甘蔗、橡胶等的大庄园））；a large area of land that is planted with trees to produce wood（木材林地；人造林）

plasma.meaning: (biology 生 or medical 医) the clear liquid part of blood, in which the blood cells, etc. float（血浆）；(physics 物) a gas that contains approximately equal numbers of positive and negative electric charges and is present in the sun and most stars（等离子体；等离子气体）

plaster.meaning: a substance made of lime, water and sand, that is put on walls and ceilings to give them a smooth hard surface（灰泥）；a white powder that is mixed with water and becomes very hard when it dries, used especially for making copies of statues or holding broken bones in place（熟石膏）；material that can be stuck to the skin to protect a small wound or cut; a piece of this（膏药；创可贴；护创胶布）；to cover a wall, etc. with plaster（抹灰；用灰泥抹（墙等））

plastic.meaning: a light strong material that is produced by chemical processes and can be formed into shapes when heated. There are many different types of plastic, used to make different objects and fabrics.（塑料；（台）塑胶）；the science of making plastics（塑料学；（台）塑胶学）；(informal) a way of talking about credit cards（信用卡）；made of plastic（塑料制的；塑料的；（台）塑胶的）

plasticity.meaning: the quality of being easily made into different shapes（可塑性；塑性）

plate.meaning: a flat, usually round, dish that you put food on（盘子；碟子）；the amount of food that you can put on a plate（一盘所盛之量；一盘）；(especially NAmE) a whole main course of a meal, served on one plate（一道主菜）；a thin flat piece of metal, used especially to join or make sth stronger（（金属）板条，板材）

plateau.meaning: an area of flat land that is higher than the land around it（高原）；a time of little or no change after a period of growth or progress（（发展、增长后的）稳定期，停滞期）；to stay at a steady level after a period of growth or progress（（在一段时期的发展后）保持稳定水平，处于停滞状态）

platelet.meaning: a very small part of a cell in the blood, shaped like a disc. Platelets help to clot the blood from a cut or wound.（血小板）

platform.meaning: the raised flat area beside the track at a train station where you get on or off the train（站台；月台）；a flat surface raised above the level of the ground or floor, used by public speakers or performers so that the audience can see them（讲台；舞台）；a raised level surface, for example one that equipment stands on or is operated from（平台）；the aims of a political party and the things that they say they will do if they are elected to power（（政党的）纲领，政纲，宣言）

platinum.meaning: a chemical element. Platinum is a silver-grey precious metal, used in making expensive jewellery and in industry.（铂；白金）

platitude.meaning: a comment or statement that has been made very often before and is therefore not interesting（陈词滥调；老生常谈）

platypus.meaning: an Australian animal that is covered in fur and has a beak like a duck, webbed feet (= with skin between the toes) and a flat tail. Platypuses lay eggs but give milk to their young.（鸭嘴兽，鸭獭（栖于澳大利亚））

plausible.meaning: (of an excuse or explanation（借口或解释）；reasonable and likely to be true（有道理的；可信的）；(of a person（人）；good at sounding honest and sincere, especially when trying to trick people（巧言令色的；花言巧语的）

play.meaning: to do things for pleasure, as children do; to enjoy yourself, rather than work（玩耍；游戏；玩乐）；to pretend to be or do sth for fun（（为玩耍）假装，假扮）；to trick sb for fun（捉弄；戏弄）；to be involved in a game; to compete against sb in a game（参加比赛；（同某人）比赛）

player.meaning: a person who takes part in a game or sport（游戏者；运动员；参赛选手）；a company or person involved in a particular area of business or politics（（商业或政治方面的）参与者，竞争者，玩家）；(in compounds（构成复合词）；a machine for reproducing sound or pictures that have been recorded on CDs, etc.（播放机）

playful.meaning: full of fun; wanting to play（有趣的；爱嬉戏的；爱玩的）；(of a remark, an action, etc.（话语、动作等）；made or done in fun; not serious（打趣的；闹着玩的；嬉戏的）

playground.meaning: an outdoor area where children can play, especially at a school or in a park（（尤指学校或公园中的）游戏场，游乐场；操场）；a place where a particular type of people go to enjoy themselves（（某些集体聚会游乐的）园地，天地，活动场所）

playmate.meaning: a friend with whom a child plays（（儿童）玩耍的伙伴）

playwright.meaning: a person who writes plays for the theatre, television or radio（剧作家）

plaza.meaning: a public outdoor square especially in a town where Spanish is spoken（（尤指西班牙语城镇的）露天广场）；a small shopping centre, sometimes also with offices（购物中心）

plea.meaning: (formal) an urgent emotional request（请求；恳求）；(law 律) a statement made by sb or for sb who is accused of a crime（（被告或被告律师的）抗辩，答辩，辩护）；(law 律) a reason given to a court for doing or not doing sth（（向法庭提供的）理由，借口，辩解）

plead.meaning: to ask sb for sth in a very strong and serious way（乞求；恳求）；to state in court that you are guilty or not guilty of a crime（（在法庭）申辩，认罪，辩护）；to present a case to a court（（向法庭）陈述案情）；to give sth as an explanation or excuse for sth（解释；推说；找借口）

pleasant.meaning: enjoyable, pleasing or attractive（令人愉快的；可喜的；宜人的；吸引人的）；friendly and polite（友好的；和善的；文雅的）；pleas·ant·ly ★ /ˈplezntli; NAmEˈplezntli/ adv. a pleasantly cool room（凉爽宜人的房间）；pleas·ant·ness /ˈplezntnəs; NAmEˈplezntnəs/ noun [U] She remembered the pleasantness of the evening.（她对那个愉快的夜晚记忆犹新。）

please.meaning: used as a polite way of asking for sth or telling sb to do sth（（用于客气地请求或吩咐）请，请问）；used to add force to a request or statement（（用于加强请求或陈述的语气）请千万，请务必，的确）；used as a polite way of accepting sth（（表示接受的客气话）太感谢了，太好了）；(informal, often humorous) used to ask sb to stop behaving badly（（用于让别人停止不规矩行为）别闹了，收敛点儿）

pleased.meaning: feeling happy about sth（高兴；满意；愉快）；happy or willing to do sth（高兴，乐于（做某事））；(BrE) very pleased（称心满意；自满自足）；not pleased; angry（不悦；气愤）

pleasing.meaning: that gives you pleasure or satisfaction（令人高兴的；令人满意的）；pleas·ing·ly /ˈpliːzɪŋli; NAmEˈpliːzɪŋli/ adv. She had a pleasingly direct manner.（她为人直爽，令人愉快。）

ply.meaning: (of ships, buses, etc.（船、公共汽车等）；to travel regularly along a particular route or between two particular places（定时往来；定期行驶）；(formal) to use a tool, especially in a skilful way（（娴熟地）使用）；to do your work or business（从事工作；做事）

population.meaning: all the people who live in a particular area, city or country; the total number of people who live there（（地区、国家等的）人口，人口数量）；a particular group of people or animals living in a particular area（（统称）某领域的生物；族群；人口）

populous.meaning: where a large number of people live（人口众多的；人口密集的）

porcelain.meaning: a hard white shiny substance made by baking clay and used for making delicate cups, plates and decorative objects; objects that are made of this（瓷；瓷器）

porch.meaning: a small area at the entrance to a building, such as a house or a church, that is covered by a roof and often has walls（门廊；门厅）

porcupine.meaning: an animal covered with long stiff parts like needles (called quills ), which it can raise to protect itself when it is attacked（豪猪；箭猪）

pore.meaning: one of the very small holes in your skin that sweat can pass through; one of the similar small holes in the surface of a plant or a rock（（皮肤上的）毛孔；（植物的）气孔；孔隙）；to look at or read sth very carefully（仔细打量；审视；认真研读；审阅）

pork.meaning: meat from a pig that has not been cured (= preserved using salt or smoke)（猪肉）

porosity.meaning: the quality or state of being porous（渗透（性）；多孔（性））

porous.meaning: having many small holes that allow water or air to pass through slowly（多孔的；透水的；透气的）

porpoise.meaning: a sea animal that looks like a large fish with a pointed mouth. Porpoises are similar to dolphins but smaller.（钝吻海豚；鼠海豚）

porridge.meaning: a type of soft thick white food made by boiling oats in milk or water, eaten hot, especially for breakfast（麦片粥）；(EAfrE) a type of thick drink made by boiling flour with water（面糊；粥）

port.meaning: a town or city with a harbour, especially one where ships load and unload goods（港口城市；口岸城市）；a place where ships load and unload goods or shelter from storms（港口；避风港）；a strong sweet wine, usually dark red, that is made in Portugal. It is usually drunk at the end of a meal.（波尔图葡萄酒（葡萄牙产））；a glass of port（一杯波尔图葡萄酒）

portable.meaning: that is easy to carry or to move（便携式的；手提的；轻便的）；port·ab·il·ity /ˌpɔːtəˈbɪləti; NAmEˌpɔːrtəˈbɪləti/ noun [U] The new light cover increases this model's portability.（新型的轻质外壳使这种型号携带更轻便。）；a small type of machine that is easy to carry, especially a computer or a television（便携机；（尤指）手提电脑，便携式电视机）

portend.meaning: (formal) to be a sign or warning of sth that is going to happen in the future, especially sth bad or unpleasant（预兆，预示，预告（尤指坏事））

porter.meaning: a person whose job is carrying people's bags and other loads, especially at a train station, an airport or in a hotel（（尤指火车站、机场或旅馆）行李员，搬运工）；(BrE) a person whose job is to move patients from one place to another in a hospital（（医院里护送病人的）护工）；(BrE) a person whose job is to be in charge of the entrance to a hotel, large building, college, etc.（门卫；门房）；(NAmE) a person whose job is helping passengers on a train, especially in a sleeping car（（尤指卧铺车厢的）列车服务员）

portfolio.meaning: a thin flat case used for carrying documents, drawings, etc.（文件夹；公事包）；a collection of photographs, drawings, etc. that you use as an example of your work, especially when applying for a job（（求职时用以证明资历的）作品，整套照片）；(finance 财) a set of shares owned by a particular person or organization（（个人或机构的）投资组合，有价证券组合）；(formal) (especially BrE) the particular area of responsibility of a government minister（（部长或大臣的）职责，职务）

portion.meaning: one part of sth larger（部分）；an amount of food that is large enough for one person（（食物的）一份，一客）；a part of sth that is shared with other people（分享的部分；分担的责任）；to divide sth into parts or portions（把 … 分成若干份（或部分））

portrait.meaning: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the head and shoulders（肖像；半身画像；半身照）；a detailed description of sb/sth（详细的描述；描绘）；(of a page of a document（文件页面）；printed so that the top of the page is one of the shorter sides（竖式的；纵向打印格式的）

portraitist.meaning: a person who makes portraits（肖像画家（或摄影师等））

portraiture.meaning: the art of making portraits; the portraits that are made（画像技法；人像摄影法；肖像；画像；照片）

portray.meaning: to show sb/sth in a picture; to describe sb/sth in a piece of writing（描绘；描画；描写）；to describe or show sb/sth in a particular way, especially when this does not give a complete or accurate impression of what they are like（将 … 描写成；给人以某种印象；表现）；to act a particular role in a film/movie or play（扮演（某角色））

portrayal.meaning: the act of showing or describing sb/sth in a picture, play, book, etc; a particular way in which this is done（描绘；描述；描写；展现方式）

portuguese.meaning: from or connected with Portugal（葡萄牙的）；a person from Portugal（葡萄牙人）；the language used in Portugal and Brazil and some other countries（葡萄牙语）

pose.meaning: to create a threat, problem, etc. that has to be dealt with（造成（威胁、问题等）；引起；产生）；(formal) to ask a question, especially one that needs serious thought（提问；质询）；to sit or stand in a particular position in order to be painted, drawn or photographed（（为画像、摄影）摆好姿势）；to pretend to be sb in order to trick other people（佯装；冒充；假扮）

posit.meaning: (formal) to suggest or accept that sth is true so that it can be used as the basis for an argument or discussion（假设；认定；认为 … 为实）

position.meaning: the place where sb/sth is located（位置；地方）；the place where sb/sth is meant to be; the correct place（恰当位置；正确位置）；the way in which sb is sitting or standing, or the way in which sth is arranged（（坐或站的）姿态，姿势；放置方式）；the situation that sb is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do（处境；地位；状况）

positive.meaning: thinking about what is good in a situation; feeling confident and sure that sth good will happen（积极乐观的；自信的）；directed at dealing with sth or producing a successful result（积极的；建设性的；朝着成功的）；expressing agreement or support（表示赞同的；拥护的）；good or useful（良好的；有助益的；正面的）

positively.meaning: used to emphasize the truth of a statement, especially when this is surprising or when it contrasts with a previous statement（绝对地；肯定地）；in a way that shows you are thinking of the good things about a situation, not the bad（乐观地；肯定地；积极地）；in a way that shows you approve of or agree with sth/sb（赞成地；积极地）；in a way that leaves no possibility of doubt（明确地；明白无误地）

possess.meaning: (formal) to have or own sth（有；拥有）；(formal) to have a particular quality or feature（具有（特质））；(of a feeling, an emotion, etc.（感觉、情绪等）；to have a powerful effect on sb and control the way that they think, behave, etc.（攫住；支配；控制）

possession.meaning: (formal) the state of having or owning sth（具有；拥有）；something that you own or have with you at a particular time（个人财产；私人物品）；the state of having control of the ball（控球状态）；the state of having illegal drugs or weapons with you at a particular time（持有违禁物；私藏毒品（或武器））

possessive.meaning: demanding total attention or love; not wanting sb to be independent（要求悉心关爱的；占有欲强的）；not liking to lend things or share things with others（不愿分享的；有独占欲望的）；(grammar 语法) showing that sth belongs to sb/sth（表示所属关系的；所有格的）；pos·ses·sive·ly /pəˈzesɪvli; NAmEpəˈzesɪvli/ adv. ‘That's mine!’ she said possessively.（“那是我的！”她霸道地说。）

possibility.meaning: the fact that sth might exist or happen, but is not certain to（可能；可能性）；one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation（可选择的方法）；something that gives you a chance to achieve sth（机会；契机）；if sth has possibilities, it can be improved or made successful（潜力；改进的余地）

possible.meaning: that can be done or achieved（可能；能做到（或取得））；that might exist or happen but is not certain to（可能存在（或发生）的）；reasonable or acceptable in a particular situation（合理的；可接受的）；used after adjectives to emphasize that sth is the best, worst, etc. of its type（（用于形容词后表示强调）最 … 的）

possibly.meaning: used to say that sth might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain（可能；或许）；used to emphasize that you are surprised, annoyed, etc. about sth（（强调惊奇、恼怒等））；used to ask sb politely to do sth（（表示委婉的请求））；used to say that sb will do or has done as much as they can in order to make sth happen（尽量；尽可能）

post.meaning: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.（邮政；邮递；邮寄）；letters, packages, etc. that are sent and delivered（邮寄的信函（或包裹等）；邮件）；an occasion during the day when letters, etc. are collected or delivered（收集（或投递）邮件的时间；邮班）；a job, especially an important one in a large organization（职位；（尤指）要职）

postage.meaning: the cost of sending a letter, etc. by post（邮资；邮费）

postal.meaning: connected with the official system for sending and delivering letters, etc.（邮政的；邮递的）；(especially BrE) involving things that are sent by post（邮寄物品的；邮寄的）；(informal) (especially NAmE) to become very angry（大怒）

postcard.meaning: a card used for sending messages by post without an envelope, especially one that has a picture on one side（明信片）

poster.meaning: a large notice, often with a picture on it, that is put in a public place to advertise sth（招贴画；海报）；a large picture that is printed on paper and put on a wall as decoration（巨幅装饰画）；a person who posts a message on a message board (= a place on a website where people can read or write messages)（（在网络留言板上）发布消息的人，张贴信息的人）

posterity.meaning: all the people who will live in the future（后代；后裔；子孙；后世）

postgraduate.meaning: a person who already holds a first degree and who is doing advanced study or research; a graduate student（研究生）

posthumous.meaning: happening, done, published, etc. after a person has died（死后发生（或做、出版等）的）

postmodern.meaning: connected with or influenced by postmodernism（后现代主义的；受后现代主义影响的）

postpone.meaning: to arrange for an event, etc. to take place at a later time or date（延迟；延期；展缓）；post·pone·ment postponement postponements /pəˈspəʊnmənt; NAmEpoʊˈspoʊnmənt/ noun [U, C] Riots led to the postponement of local elections.（骚乱致使地方选举延期了。）

postscript.meaning: an extra message that you add at the end of a letter after your signature（（加于信末的）附言，又及）；extra facts or information about a story, an event, etc. that are added after it has finished（补充；补编；后话；跋）

postulate.meaning: (formal) to suggest or accept that sth is true so that it can be used as the basis for a theory, etc.（假定；假设）；(formal) a statement that is accepted as true, that forms the basis of a theory, etc.（假定；假设）

posture.meaning: the position in which you hold your body when standing or sitting（（坐立的）姿势）；your attitude to a particular situation or the way in which you deal with it（态度；看法；立场；处理方式）；(formal) to pretend to be sth that you are not by saying and doing things in order to impress or trick people（故作姿态；装样子）

pot.meaning: a deep round container used for cooking things in（锅）；(especially BrE) a container made of glass, clay or plastic, used for storing food in（（盛食品的）罐，瓶，壶）；(especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a container of various kinds, made for a particular purpose（（某种用途的）容器）

potash.meaning: a chemical containing potassium, used to improve soil for farming and in making soap（钾碱）

potassium.meaning: a chemical element. Potassium is a soft silver-white metal that exists mainly in compounds which are used in industry and farming.（钾）

potato.meaning: a round white vegetable with a brown or red skin that grows underground as the root of a plant also called a potato（马铃薯；土豆；洋芋）

potent.meaning: having a strong effect on your body or mind（有强效的；有力的；烈性的；影响身心的）；powerful（强大的；强有力的）

potential.meaning: that can develop into sth or be developed in the future（潜在的；可能的）；po·ten·tial·ly ★ AW /pəˈtenʃəli; NAmEpəˈtenʃəli/ adv. a potentially dangerous situation（有潜在危险的局势）；the possibility of sth happening or being developed or used（可能性；潜在性）；qualities that exist and can be developed（潜力；潜质）

potentiality.meaning: a power or a quality that exists and is capable of being developed（潜力；潜在的可能性）

potion.meaning: a drink of medicine or poison; a liquid with magic powers（药水；毒液；魔水）

potluck.meaning: a meal to which each guest brings some food, which is then shared out among the guests（百味餐（参加者带食物分享））

potter.meaning: to do things or move without hurrying, especially when you are doing sth that you enjoy and that is not important（从容做事；欣然从事；漫步；闲荡）；a person who makes clay pots by hand（陶工）

pottery.meaning: pots, dishes, etc. made with clay that is baked in an oven, especially when they are made by hand（陶器（尤指手工制的））；the clay that some dishes and pots are made of（陶土）；the skill of making pots and dishes from clay, especially by hand（制陶手艺；制陶技艺）；a place where clay pots and dishes are made（制陶作坊；陶窰；陶器工厂）

poultry.meaning: chickens, ducks and geese, kept for their meat or eggs（家禽）；meat from chickens, ducks and geese（禽的肉）

pounce.meaning: to move suddenly forwards in order to attack or catch sb/sth（猛扑；突袭）；to quickly notice sth that sb has said or done, especially in order to criticize it（一眼看出，抓紧机会（以便批评））

pound.meaning: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence（英镑（英国货币单位，等于 100 便士））；the unit of money of several other countries（镑（英国以外某些国家的货币单位））；(finance 财) the value of the British pound compared with the value of the money of other countries（英镑与外币的比值）；a unit for measuring weight, equal to 0.454 of a kilogram（磅（重量单位，合 0.454 千克））

pour.meaning: to make a liquid or other substance flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle（使（液体）连续流出；倾倒；倒出）；(of liquid, smoke, light, etc.（液体、烟、光等）；to flow quickly in a continuous stream（涌流；倾泻；喷发）；to serve a drink by letting it flow from a container into a cup or glass（倒，斟（饮料））

poverty.meaning: the state of being poor（贫穷；贫困）；a lack of sth; poor quality（贫乏；短缺；劣质）

powder.meaning: a dry mass of very small fine pieces or grains（粉末；细面）；a very fine, soft, dry substance that you can put on your face to make it look smooth and dry（扑面粉；美容粉）；(old-fashioned) to remain ready for a possible emergency（时刻准备应急；枕戈待旦；有备无患）；(NAmE) (informal) to leave suddenly; to run away（突然离开；跑掉；溜掉）

power.meaning: the ability to control people or things（控制力；影响力；操纵力）；political control of a country or an area（统治；政权）；(in people（人的）；the ability or opportunity to do sth（能力；机会）

powerful.meaning: (of people（人）；being able to control and influence people and events（有权势的；有影响力的）；having great power or force; very effective（强有力的；力量大的；很有效的）；having a strong effect on your mind or body（（对身心）有强烈作用的，效力大的）

practicable.meaning: able to be done; likely to be successful（可行的；行得通的）；prac·tic·abil·ity /ˌpræktɪkəˈbɪləti; NAmEˌpræktɪkəˈbɪləti/ noun [U] We were doubtful about the practicability of the plan.（我们怀疑这个计划是否切实可行。）；prac·tic·ably /ˌpræktɪkəbli; NAmEˌpræktɪkəbli/ adv. Please reply as soon as is practicably possible.（请尽早回复。）

practical.meaning: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories（实际的；真实的；客观存在的）；(of an idea, a method or a course of action（想法、方法或行动）；right or sensible; likely to be successful（切实可行的）；(of things（东西）

practicality.meaning: the quality of being suitable, or likely to be successful（可行性；适用性）；the quality of being sensible and realistic（实事求是）；the real facts and circumstances rather than ideas or theories（实际事物；实际情况）

practically.meaning: almost; very nearly（几乎；差不多；很接近）；in a realistic or sensible way; in real situations（实事求是地；实际地）

practice.meaning: action rather than ideas（实践；实际行动）；a way of doing sth that is the usual or expected way in a particular organization or situation（通常的做法；惯例；常规）；a thing that is done regularly; a habit or a custom（惯常做的事；习惯；习俗）；doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this（训练；练习（时间））

practise.meaning: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill（练习；实习；训练）；(formal) to do sth regularly as part of your normal behaviour（经常做；养成 … 的习惯）；to work as a doctor, lawyer, etc.（从事（医务工作、法律专业等）；执业）；to do the things yourself that you tell other people to do（身体力行；躬行所言；言行一致）

practitioner.meaning: (technical 术语) a person who works in a profession, especially medicine or law（（尤指医学或法律界的）从业人员）；(formal) a person who regularly does a particular activity, especially one that requires skill（习艺者；专门人才）

pragmatic.meaning: solving problems in a practical and sensible way rather than by having fixed ideas or theories（实用的；讲求实效的；务实的）

prairie.meaning: a flat wide area of land in N America and Canada, without many trees and originally covered with grass（北美草原；新大陆北部草原（美国北部和加拿大））

praise.meaning: words that show approval of or admiration for sb/sth（赞扬；称赞；赞美）；the expression of worship to God（（对上帝的）颂扬，赞颂）；to express your approval or admiration for sb/sth（表扬；赞扬；称赞）；to express your thanks to or your respect for God（颂扬，赞颂（上帝））

pram.meaning: a small vehicle on four wheels for a baby to go out in, pushed by a person on foot（婴儿车）

pray.meaning: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help（祈祷；祷告）；to hope very much that sth will happen（企盼；祈望）；(old use or ironic) used to mean ‘please’ when you are asking a question or telling sb to do sth（（用于询问或指示）请问，请）

prayer.meaning: words that you say to God giving thanks or asking for help（祷告，祈祷（的内容））；a fixed form of words that you can say when you speak to God（祈祷文；经文）；the act or habit of praying（祷告，祈祷（的行为））；a religious meeting that takes place regularly in which people say prayers（祈祷会；祷告式）

preach.meaning: to give a religious talk in a public place, especially in a church during a service（布道，讲道（尤指教堂中礼拜时））；to tell people about a particular religion, way of life, system, etc. in order to persuade them to accept it（宣传，宣扬，宣讲（教义、生活方式、体制等））；(disapproving) to give sb advice on moral standards, behaviour, etc., especially in a way that they find annoying or boring（说教）；to speak to people in support of views that they already hold（向教徒宣教；教读书人写大字）

preacher.meaning: a person, often a member of the clergy, who gives religious talks and often performs religious ceremonies, for example in a church（传道者；牧师）

precarious.meaning: (of a situation（情势）；not safe or certain; dangerous（不稳的；不确定的；不保险的；危险的）；likely to fall or cause sb to fall（摇摇欲坠的；不稳固的）；pre·car·ious·ly /prɪˈkeəriəsli; NAmEprɪˈkerəriəsli/ adv. The economy is precariously close to recession.（经济濒于衰退的边缘。）

precaution.meaning: something that is done in advance in order to prevent problems or to avoid danger（预防措施；预防；防备）；a way of referring to contraception（避孕措施）；pre·cau·tion·ary /prɪˈkɔːʃənəri; NAmEprɪˈkɔːʃəneri/ adj. He was kept in the hospital overnight as a precautionary measure.（为了谨慎起见，他被安排整晚留院观察。）

precede.meaning: to happen before sth or come before sth/sb in order（在 … 之前发生（或出现）；先于）；to go in front of sb（走在 … 前面）；to do or say sth to introduce sth else（以 … 开始（或引导））

precedence.meaning: the condition of being more important than sb else and therefore coming or being dealt with first（优先；优先权）

precedent.meaning: an official action or decision that has happened in the past and that is seen as an example or a rule to be followed in a similar situation later（可援用参考的具体例子；实例；范例）；a similar action or event that happened earlier（先前出现的事例；前例；先例）；the way that things have always been done（传统；常例；常规）

precinct.meaning: (BrE) a commercial area in a town where cars cannot go（步行商业区）；(NAmE) one of the parts into which a town or city is divided in order to organize elections（选区）；(NAmE) a part of a city that has its own police station; the police station in this area（警区；分区警察局；派出所）；(formal) the area around a place or a building, sometimes surrounded by a wall（（建筑物等的）外围，围墙内区域）

precious.meaning: rare and worth a lot of money（珍奇的；珍稀的）；valuable or important and not to be wasted（宝贵的；珍贵的）；loved or valued very much（受珍爱的；被珍惜的）；(informal) used to show you are angry that another person thinks sth is very important（（表示气愤）宝贝似的）

precipice.meaning: a very steep side of a high cliff, mountain or rock（悬崖；峭壁）

precipitate.meaning: to make sth, especially sth bad, happen suddenly or sooner than it should（使 … 突然降临；加速（坏事的发生））；to suddenly force sb/sth into a particular state or condition（使突然陷入（某种状态））；(of an action or a decision（行动或决定）；happening very quickly or suddenly and usually without enough care and thought（鲁莽的；草率的；仓促的）

precipitation.meaning: (technical 术语) rain, snow, etc. that falls; the amount of this that falls（降水，降水量（包括雨、雪等））；(chemistry 化) a chemical process in which solid material is separated from a liquid（沉淀；淀析）

precise.meaning: clear and accurate（准确的；确切的；精确的；明确的）；used to emphasize that sth happens at a particular time or in a particular way（（强调时间或方式等）就，恰好）；taking care to be exact and accurate, especially about small details（细致的；精细的；认真的；一丝不苟的）；used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about sth you have just mentioned（确切地说；准确地说）

precisely.meaning: exactly（准确地；恰好地）；accurately; carefully（精确地；细心地；仔细地）；used to emphasize that sth is very true or obvious（（强调真实或明显）正是，确实）；used to emphasize that you agree with a statement, especially because you think it is obvious or is similar to what you have just said（（加强同意的语气）对，的确如此，一点也不错）

precision.meaning: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful（精确；准确；细致）

preclude.meaning: to prevent sth from happening or sb from doing sth; to make sth impossible（使行不通；阻止；妨碍；排除）

precursor.meaning: (formal) a person or thing that comes before sb/sth similar and that leads to or influences its development（先驱；先锋；前身）

predate.meaning: to be built or formed, or to happen, at an earlier date than sth else in the past（早于；先于 … 建成（或形成、发生等））

predation.meaning: the act of an animal killing and eating other animals（（动物的）捕食，捕猎行为）

predator.meaning: an animal that kills and eats other animals（捕食性动物）；(disapproving) a person or an organization that uses weaker people for their own advantage（弱肉强食的人（或机构）；剥削者；掠夺者）

predatory.meaning: (of animals（动物）；living by killing and eating other animals（捕食性的）；(of people（人）；using weaker people for their own financial or sexual advantage（（在金钱或性关系上）欺负弱小的，压榨他人的）

predecessor.meaning: a person who did a job before sb else（前任）；a thing, such as a machine, that has been followed or replaced by sth else（原先的东西；被替代的事物）

predetermine.meaning: (formal) to decide sth in advance so that it does not happen by chance（预先决定；事先安排）；pre·de·ter·mined /; NAmE/ adj. An alarm sounds when the temperature reaches a predetermined level.（温度一达到预设的度数，警报就会响起来。）

predicament.meaning: a difficult or unpleasant situation, especially one where it is difficult to know what to do（尴尬的处境；困境；窘境）

predict.meaning: to say that sth will happen in the future（预言；预告；预报）

predictable.meaning: if sth is predictable, you know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like（可预见的；可预料的）；(often disapproving) behaving or happening in a way that you would expect and therefore boring（意料之中的；老套乏味的）；pre·dict·abil·ity AW /prɪˌdɪktəˈbɪləti; NAmEprɪˌdɪktəˈbɪləti/ noun [U] pre·dict·ably AW /prɪˌdɪktəbli; NAmEprɪˌdɪktəbli/ adv. Prices were predictably high.（价格高昂是意料中的事。）

prediction.meaning: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement（预言；预测；预告）

predispose.meaning: to influence sb so that they are likely to think or behave in a particular way（使倾向于；使受 … 的影响）；to make it likely that you will suffer from a particular illness（使易于患（某种病）；容易诱发）

predisposition.meaning: (formal) a condition that makes sb/sth likely to behave in a particular way or to suffer from a particular disease（倾向；癖性；（易患某种病的）体质）

predominance.meaning: the situation of being greater in number or amount than other things or people（（数量上的）优势）；the state of having more power or influence than others（主导地位；支配地位；霸业）

predominant.meaning: most obvious or noticeable（显著的；明显的；盛行的）；having more power or influence than others（占优势的；主导的）

predominantly.meaning: mostly; mainly（主要地；多数情况下）

predominate.meaning: to be greater in amount or number than sth/sb else in a place, group, etc.（（数量上）占优势；以 … 为主）；to have the most influence or importance（占主导地位；有最大影响（或重要性））

preen.meaning: (usually disapproving) to spend a lot of time making yourself look attractive and then admiring your appearance（刻意打扮，精心修饰（并自我欣赏））；(usually disapproving) to feel very pleased with yourself about sth and show other people how pleased you are（顾盼自雄；沾沾自喜；得意扬扬）；(of a bird（鸟）；to clean itself or make its feathers smooth with its beak（（用喙）整理羽毛）

preface.meaning: an introduction to a book, especially one that explains the author's aims（（书的）前言，序言）；to provide a book or other piece of writing with a preface（为 … 写序言）；(formal) to say sth before you start making a speech, answering a question, etc.（以 … 为开端；作 … 的开场白）

prefer.meaning: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than sth else because you like it better（较喜欢；喜欢 … 多于 …）

preferable.meaning: more attractive or more suitable; to be preferred to sth（较适合；更可取）；pref·er·ably /ˈprefrəbli; NAmEˈprefrəbli/ adv. We're looking for a new house, preferably one near the school.（我们正在找新房子，最好是靠近学校的。）

preference.meaning: a greater interest in or desire for sb/sth than sb/sth else（偏爱；爱好；喜爱）；a thing that is liked better or best（偏爱的事物；最喜爱的东西）；to treat sb/sth in a way that gives them an advantage over other people or things（给 … 以优惠；优待）；rather than sb/sth（而不是）

preferential.meaning: giving an advantage to a particular person or group（优先的；优惠的；优待的）

prefix.meaning: (grammar 语法) a letter or group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning, such as un- in unhappy and pre- in preheat（前缀，（台）词首）；a word, letter or number that is put before another（前置代号（置于前面的单词或字母、数字））；(old-fashioned) a title such as Dr or Mrs used before a person's name（（人名前的）称谓）；to add letters or numbers to the beginning of a word or number（在 … 前面加（字母或数字））

pregnancy.meaning: the state of being pregnant（怀孕；妊娠；孕期）

pregnant.meaning: (of a woman or female animal（妇女或母兽）；having a baby or young animal developing inside her/its body（怀孕的；妊娠的）；(formal) full of a quality or feeling（饱含；充溢着）；an occasion when nobody speaks, although people are aware that there are feelings or thoughts to express（耐人寻味的停顿；心照不宣的沉默）

prehistoric.meaning: connected with the time in history before information was written down（史前的；有文字记载以前的；远古的）

prehistory.meaning: the period of time in history before information was written down（史前时期；远古时期）；the earliest stages of the development of sth（（事物发展的）初期，开始阶段，萌芽时期）

prejudice.meaning: an unreasonable dislike of or preference for a person, group, custom, etc., especially when it is based on their race, religion, sex, etc.（偏见；成见）；(law 律) without affecting any other legal matter（不损害其他权益；无损于合法权利）；to influence sb so that they have an unfair or unreasonable opinion about sb/sth（使怀有（或产生）偏见）；(formal) to have a harmful effect on sth（损害；有损于）

preliminary.meaning: happening before a more important action or event（预备性的；初步的；开始的）；a preliminary is an action or event that is done in preparation for sth（初步行动（或活动）；预备性措施）

prelude.meaning: a short piece of music, especially an introduction to a longer piece（序曲；前奏曲）；an action or event that happens before another more important one and forms an introduction to it（序幕；前奏；先声）

premature.meaning: happening before the normal or expected time（未成熟的；过早的；提前的）；(of a birth or a baby（生产或婴儿）；happening or being born before the normal length of pregnancy has been completed（早产的）；happening or made too soon（草率的；仓促的）

premier.meaning: most important, famous or successful（首要的；最著名的；最成功的；第一的）；used especially in newspapers, etc. to mean ‘prime minister’（（尤用于报章等）首相，总理）；(in Canada) the first minister of a province or territory（（加拿大的）省总理，地方总理）

premiere.meaning: the first public performance of a film/movie or play（（电影、戏剧的）首次公演，首映）；to perform a play or piece of music or show a film/movie to an audience for the first time; to be performed or shown to an audience for the first time（首次公演（戏剧、音乐、电影））

premise.meaning: a statement or an idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument（前提；假定）

premises.meaning: the building and land near to it that a business owns or uses（（企业的）房屋建筑及附属场地，营业场所）

premium.meaning: an amount of money that you pay once or regularly for an insurance policy（保险费）；an extra payment added to the basic rate（额外费用；附加费）；if sth is at a premium, there is little of it available and it is difficult to get（稀少；难得）；at a higher than normal price（超出平常价；溢价）

preoccupation.meaning: a state of thinking about sth continuously; sth that you think about frequently or for a long time（盘算；思虑；长久思考的事情）；a mood created by thinking or worrying about sth and ignoring everything else（心事重重；忧心忡忡；全神贯注）

preoccupy.meaning: if sth is preoccupying you, you think or worry about it very often or all the time（使日夜思考；使忧心忡忡）

preparation.meaning: the act or process of getting ready for sth or making sth ready（准备；预备）；things that you do to get ready for sth or make sth ready（准备工作）；a substance that has been specially prepared for use as a medicine, cosmetic, etc.（（医药、化妆品等）配制品，制剂）

preparatory.meaning: done in order to prepare for sth（预备的；筹备的）

prepare.meaning: to make sth or sb ready to be used or to do sth（使做好准备；把 … 预备好）；to make yourself ready to do sth or for sth that you expect to happen（使（自己）有准备；防范）；to make food ready to be eaten（预备（饭菜）；做（饭））；to make a medicine or chemical substance, for example by mixing other substances together（调制，配制（药品等））

prepared.meaning: ready and able to deal with sth（准备好；有所准备）；willing to do sth（愿意）；done, made, written, etc. in advance（事先做好（或写好等）的）

preparedness.meaning: (formal) the state of being ready or willing to do sth（准备好的状态；愿意）

preponderance.meaning: if there is a preponderance of one type of people or things in a group, there are more of them than others（优势；多数；主体）

preposition.meaning: a word or group of words, such as in, from, to, out of and on behalf of, used before a noun or pronoun to show place, position, time or method（介词）；prep·os·ition·al /ˌprepəˈzɪʃənl; NAmEˌprepəˈzɪʃənl/ adj. a prepositional phrase (= a preposition and the noun following it, for example at night or after breakfast)（介词短语）

preposterous.meaning: completely unreasonable, especially in a way that is shocking or annoying（荒唐的；极不合情理的）；unusual in a silly or shocking way（怪诞的；离奇古怪的）；pre·pos·ter·ous·ly /prɪˈpɒstərəsli; NAmEprɪˈpɑːstərəsli/ adv. a preposterously expensive bottle of wine（一瓶天价的葡萄酒）

prerequisite.meaning: (formal) something that must exist or happen before sth else can happen or be done（先决条件；前提；必备条件）；pre·requis·ite adj. [only before noun] prerequisite knowledge（必备的知识）

prerogative.meaning: a right or advantage belonging to a particular person or group because of their importance or social position（特权；优先权）

presage.meaning: (literary) to be a warning or sign that sth will happen, usually sth unpleasant（预兆，警示，预言（尤指不祥之事））；pre·sage presage presages presaged presaging /ˈpresɪdʒ; NAmEˈpresɪdʒ/ noun the first presages of winter（第一丝冬意）

preschool.meaning: a school for children between the ages of about two and five（幼儿园；（台）幼稚园）

prescribe.meaning: (of a doctor（医生）；to tell sb to take a particular medicine or have a particular treatment; to write a prescription for a particular medicine, etc.（给 … 开（药）；让 … 采用（疗法）；开（处方））；(of a person or an organization with authority（当局）；to say what should be done or how sth should be done（规定；命令；指示）

prescription.meaning: an official piece of paper on which a doctor writes the type of medicine you should have, and which enables you to get it from a chemist's shop/drugstore（处方；药方）；medicine that your doctor has ordered for you（医生开的药）；the act of prescribing medicine（开处方；开药）；(formal) a plan or a suggestion for making sth happen or for improving it（计划；建议；秘诀）

presence.meaning: (of a person（人）；the fact of being in a particular place（在场；出席）；(of a thing or a substance（事物或物质）；the fact of being in a particular place or thing（存在；出现）

present.meaning: existing or happening now（现存的；当前的）；(of a person（人）；being in a particular place（出现；在场；出席）；(of a thing or a substance（事物或物质）

presentation.meaning: the act of showing sth or of giving sth to sb（提交；授予；颁发；出示）；the way in which sth is offered, shown, explained, etc. to others（提出（或展示、解释等）的方式）；a meeting at which sth, especially a new product or idea, or piece of work, is shown to a group of people（展示会；介绍会；发布会）；the series of computer slides (= images) that accompany the talk when sb gives a presentation at a meeting（幻灯片演示）

presently.meaning: (especially NAmE) at the time you are speaking or writing; now（此刻；现在；眼下）；used to show that sth happened after a short time（（表示马上就已发生了））；used to show that sth will happen soon（（表示即将发生））

preservation.meaning: the act of keeping sth in its original state or in good condition（保护；维护；保存）；the act of making sure that sth is kept（保留；维持；保持）；the degree to which sth has not been changed or damaged by age, weather, etc.（保存的状况；保养的程度）

preservative.meaning: a substance used to prevent food or wood from decaying（防腐剂；保护剂）

preserve.meaning: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc; to make sure that sth is kept（保护；维护；保留）；to keep sth in its original state in good condition（维持 … 的原状；保存；保养）；to prevent sth, especially food, from decaying by treating it in a particular way（贮存；保鲜）；to keep sb/sth alive, or safe from harm or danger（使继续存活；保护；保全）

preset.meaning: to set the controls of a piece of electrical equipment so that it will start to work at a particular time（预调；预置；给 … 预定时间）；to decide sth in advance（预先决定；事先安排）

preside.meaning: to lead or be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.（主持（会议、仪式等）；担任（会议）主席）

presidency.meaning: the job of being president of a country or an organization; the period of time sb holds this job（主席的职位（或任期等）；总统的职位（或任期等））

president.meaning: the leader of a republic, especially the US（总统；国家主席）；the person in charge of some organizations, clubs, colleges, etc.（（机构、俱乐部、学院等的）负责人，会长，院长，主席）；(especially NAmE) the person in charge of a bank or a commercial organization（银行行长；总经理；董事长；总裁）；presi·den·tial /ˌprezɪˈdenʃl; NAmEˌprezɪˈdenʃl/ adj. a presidential campaign/candidate/election（总统竞选活动/候选人/选举）

press.meaning: newspapers and magazines（报章杂志；报刊；印刷媒体）；the journalists and photographers who work for newspapers and magazines（记者；新闻工作者；新闻界）；the type or amount of reports that newspapers write about sb/sth（报道；评论）；a machine for printing books, newspapers, etc; the process of printing them（印刷机；印刷）

pressing.meaning: needing to be dealt with immediately（紧急的；急迫的）；difficult to refuse or to ignore（难以推却的；不容忽视的）；an object, especially a record, made by using pressure or weight to shape a piece of metal, plastic, etc; a number of such objects that are made at one time（模压制品，同批次的模压产品（尤指唱片））

pressure.meaning: the force or weight with which sth presses against sth else（压力；挤压）；the force produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space or container; the amount of this（压力；压强）；the force of the atmosphere on the earth's surface（大气压）；the act of trying to persuade or to force sb to do sth（催促；要求；呼吁；强迫）

pressurize.meaning: to persuade sb to do sth, especially by making them feel that they have to or should do it（逼迫；使迫不得已）；to keep the air pressure in a submarine, an aircraft, etc. the same as it is on earth（使（潜艇、飞机等内）保持正常气压）

prestige.meaning: the respect and admiration that sb/sth has because of their social position, or what they have done（威信；声望；威望）；that brings respect and admiration; important（令人敬仰的；受尊重的；重要的）；admired and respected because it looks important and expensive（名贵的；贵重的；讲究派头的）

prestigious.meaning: respected and admired as very important or of very high quality（有威望的；声誉高的）

presumably.meaning: used to say that you think that sth is probably true（很可能；大概；想必是）

presume.meaning: to suppose that sth is true, although you do not have actual proof（假设；假定）；to accept that sth is true until it is shown not to be true, especially in court（（尤指法庭上）推定，假定）；(formal) to accept sth as true or existing and to act on that basis（设定；设想；假设）；(formal) to behave in a way that shows a lack of respect by doing sth that you have no right to do（妄行；越权行事）

presumption.meaning: something that is thought to be true or probable（可能的事；认为真实的事）；(formal) behaviour that is too confident and shows a lack of respect for other people（非分的行为；妄自尊大）；(law 律) the act of supposing that sth is true, although it has not yet been proved or is not certain（推定；假定；假设）

pretence.meaning: the act of behaving in a particular way, in order to make other people believe sth that is not true（假象；伪装；虚伪的表现）；(formal or literary) a claim that you have a particular quality or skill（妄称；自称；标榜）

pretend.meaning: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe sth that is not true（假装；佯装）；(especially of children（尤指儿童）；to imagine that sth is true as part of a game（（在游戏中）装扮，扮作，模拟）；(usually used in negative sentences and questions（通常用于否定句和疑问句）

pretension.meaning: the act of trying to appear more important, intelligent, etc. than you are in order to impress other people（虚饰；虚夸）；a claim to be or to do sth（自命；声称；标榜）

pretentious.meaning: trying to appear important, intelligent, etc. in order to impress other people; trying to be sth that you are not, in order to impress（炫耀的；虚夸的；自命不凡的）

pretext.meaning: a false reason that you give for doing sth, usually sth bad, in order to hide the real reason; an excuse（借口；托辞）

pretty.meaning: to some extent; fairly（颇；相当）；very（十分；非常；极；很）；(informal) almost; almost completely（几乎；差不多）；(especially of a woman, or a girl（尤指女子或女孩）

prevail.meaning: to exist or be very common at a particular time or in a particular place（普遍存在；盛行；流行）；(of ideas, opinions, etc.（思想、观点等）；to be accepted, especially after a struggle or an argument（被接受；战胜；压倒）；to defeat an opponent, especially after a long struggle（（尤指长时间斗争后）战胜，挫败）

prevailing.meaning: existing or most common at a particular time（普遍的；盛行的；流行的）；the prevailing wind in an area is the one that blows over it most frequently（（指风）某地区常刮的，盛行的）

prevalent.meaning: (formal) that exists or is very common at a particular time or in a particular place（流行的；普遍存在的；盛行的）

prevent.meaning: to stop sb from doing sth; to stop sth from happening（阻止；阻碍；阻挠）；pre·vent·able /prɪˈventəbl; NAmEprɪˈventəbl/ adj. preventable diseases/accidents（可以防止的疾病/事故）

prevention.meaning: the act of stopping sth bad from happening（预防；防止；防范）；(saying) it is better to stop sth bad from happening rather than try to deal with the problems after it has happened（预防优于补救；防患于未然是上策）

preventive.meaning: intended to try to stop sth that causes problems or difficulties from happening（预防性的；防备的）

preview.meaning: an occasion at which you can see a film/movie, a show, etc. before it is shown to the general public（预映；预演；预展）；a description in a newspaper or a magazine that tells you about a film/movie, a television programme, etc. before it is shown to the public（（报刊上有关电影、电视节目等的）预先评述，预告）；to see a film/movie, a television programme, etc. before it is shown to the general public and write an account of it for a newspaper or magazine（为（影视节目）写预评）；(especially NAmE) to give sb a short account of sth that is going to happen, be studied, etc.（概述；扼要介绍）

previous.meaning: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about（先前的；以往的）；immediately before the time you are talking about（（时间上）稍前的）；pre·vi·ous·ly ★ AW /ˈpriːviəsli; NAmEˈpriːviəsli/ adv. The building had previously been used as a hotel.（这座楼房早先曾用作旅馆。）；pre·vi·ous to /; NAmE/ prep. Previous to this, she'd always been well.（这以前，她身体一向很好。）

prey.meaning: an animal, a bird, etc. that is hunted, killed and eaten by another（被捕食的动物；猎物）；a person who is harmed or tricked by sb, especially for dishonest purposes（受害者；受骗者）；(of an animal（动物）；to be killed and eaten by another animal or bird（被捕食；成为猎物）

prohibitive.meaning: (of a price or a cost（价格或费用）；so high that it prevents people from buying sth or doing sth（高昂得令人难以承受的；贵得买不起的）；preventing people from doing sth by law（（以法令）禁止的）；(of a person taking part in an election or a competition（参加竞选或比赛的人）

prompt.meaning: done without delay（立即的；迅速的；及时的）；(of a person（人）；acting without delay; arriving at the right time（敏捷；迅速；准时）；prompt·ness /prɒmptnəs; NAmEprɑːmptnəs/ noun [U] verb ★ 1. ★ [T] to make sb decide to do sth; to cause sth to happen（促使；导致；激起）

protection.meaning: the act of protecting sb/sth; the state of being protected（保护；防卫）；a thing that protects sb/sth against sth（保护物；护身符）；insurance against fire, injury, damage, etc.（保险）；the system of helping an industry in your own country by taxing foreign goods（贸易保护；关税保护制）
