protective.meaning: providing or intended to provide protection（保护的；防护的）；having or showing a wish to protect sb/sth（出于（对 … 的）保护）；intended to give an advantage to your own country's industry（贸易保护的；实行关税保护的）；pro·tect·ive·ly /prəˈtektɪvli; NAmEprəˈtektɪvli/ adv. She clutched her bag protectively.（她用力抓紧护着自己的提包。）

prove.meaning: to use facts, evidence, etc. to show that sth is true（证明；证实）；if sth proves dangerous, expensive, etc. or if it proves to be dangerous, etc., you discover that it is dangerous, etc. over a period of time（后来被发现是；最终显现为）；to show other people how good you are at doing sth or that you are capable of doing sth（展现，展示，显示（自己的才能））；to show other people that you are a particular type of person or that you have a particular quality（显示（自己）是；向人证明（自己）是）

proverb.meaning: a well-known phrase or sentence that gives advice or says sth that is generally true, for example ‘Waste not, want not. ’（谚语；格言）

proverbial.meaning: used to show that you are referring to a particular proverb or well-known phrase（谚语的；谚语表达的；如谚语所说的）；well known and talked about by a lot of people（众所周知；著名）

provide.meaning: to give sth to sb or make it available for them to use（提供；供应；给予）；(of a law or rule（法律或规则）；to state that sth will or must happen（规定）；(formal) to make preparations to deal with sth bad or unpleasant that might happen in the future（预防；防备）

provided.meaning: used to say what must happen or be done to make it possible for sth else to happen（如果；假如；在 … 条件下）

providence.meaning: God, or a force that some people believe controls our lives and the things that happen to us, usually in a way that protects us（上帝；苍天；天佑）

province.meaning: one of the areas that some countries are divided into with its own local government（省份；（某些国家的）一级行政区）；(BrE) all the parts of a country except the capital city（首都以外的地区）；(formal) a person's particular area of knowledge, interest or responsibility（知识（或兴趣、职责）范围；领域）

provincial.meaning: connected with one of the large areas that some countries are divided into, with its own local government（省的；一级行政区的）；(sometimes disapproving) connected with the parts of a country that do not include the capital city（都城以外的；首都以外的）；(disapproving) unwilling to consider new or different ideas or things（心胸狭隘的；守旧的；迂腐的）；pro·vin·cial·ly /prəˈvɪnʃəli; NAmEprəˈvɪnʃəli/ adv. noun (often disapproving) a person who lives in or comes from a part of the country that is not near the capital city（都城以外的人；乡巴佬；外乡人）

provincialism.meaning: the attitude of people who are unwilling to consider new or different ideas or things（胸襟狭隘；陈腐态度；排外主义）

provision.meaning: the act of supplying sb with sth that they need or want; sth that is supplied（提供；供给；给养；供应品）；preparations that you make for sth that might or will happen in the future（（为将来做的）准备）；supplies of food and drink, especially for a long journey（饮食供应；（尤指旅途中的）粮食）；a condition or an arrangement in a legal document（（法律文件的）规定，条款）

provisional.meaning: arranged for the present time only and likely to be changed in the future（临时的；暂时的）；arranged, but not yet definite（暂定的）；pro·vi·sion·al·ly /prəˈvɪʒənəli; NAmEprəˈvɪʒənəli/ adv. The meeting has been provisionally arranged for Friday.（会议暂定于星期五举行。）

provocation.meaning: the act of doing or saying sth deliberately in order to make sb angry or upset; something that is done or said to cause this（挑衅；刺激；激怒）

provocative.meaning: intended to make people angry or upset; intended to make people argue about sth（挑衅的；煽动性的；激起争端的）；intended to make sb sexually excited（引诱的；激起性欲的）

provoke.meaning: to cause a particular reaction or have a particular effect（激起；引起；引发）；to say or do sth that you know will annoy sb so that they react in an angry way（挑衅；激怒；刺激）

prowl.meaning: (of an animal（动物）；to move quietly and carefully around an area, especially when hunting（潜行（为捕猎等））；to walk around a room, an area, etc., especially because you are bored, anxious, etc., and cannot relax（（因无聊、焦躁等）徘徊，走来走去）；(of an animal or a person（人或动物）

proximity.meaning: (formal) the state of being near sb/sth in distance or time（（时间或空间）接近，邻近，靠近）

proxy.meaning: the authority that you give to sb to do sth for you, when you cannot do it yourself（代理权；代表权）；a person who has been given the authority to represent sb else（代理人；受托人；代表）；(formal or technical 术语) something that you use to represent sth else that you are trying to measure or calculate（（测算用的）代替物，指标）

prudent.meaning: sensible and careful when you make judgements and decisions; avoiding unnecessary risks（谨慎的；慎重的；精明的）

pry.meaning: to try to find out information about other people's private lives in a way that is annoying or rude（探听，打听，探查（隐私））

pseudonym.meaning: a name used by sb, especially a writer, instead of their real name（假名；化名；笔名）

psychiatry.meaning: the study and treatment of mental illness（精神病学；精神病治疗）

psychoanalyst.meaning: a person who treats patients using psychoanalysis（精神分析学家（或医生））

psychological.meaning: connected with a person's mind and the way in which it works（心灵的；心理的；精神上的）；connected with the study of psychology（心理学的；关于心理学的）；psy·cho·logic·al·ly AW /ˌsaɪkəˈlɒdʒɪkli; NAmEˌsaɪkəˈlɑːdʒɪkli/ adv. psychologically harmful（精神上有害的）；the best time to do sth in order for it to be successful（最佳时机；最适当时机）

psychologist.meaning: a scientist who studies and is trained in psychology（心理学家；心理学研究者）

psychology.meaning: the scientific study of the mind and how it influences behaviour（心理学）；the kind of mind that sb has that makes them think or behave in a particular way（心理；心理特征）；how the mind influences behaviour in a particular area of life（心理影响）

ptarmigan.meaning: a type of grouse (= a bird with a fat body and feathers on its legs), found in mountain areas and in Arctic regions（雷鸟（栖息于山区和北极地区））

pub.meaning: a building where people go to drink and meet their friends. Pubs serve alcoholic and other drinks, and often also food.（酒吧；酒馆）

public.meaning: connected with ordinary people in society in general（平民的；大众的；公众的；百姓的）；provided, especially by the government, for the use of people in general（公共的；公立的）；connected with the government and the services it provides（政府的；有关政府所提供服务的）；known to people in general（人人皆知的；公开的）

publication.meaning: the act of printing a book, a magazine, etc. and making it available to the public; a book, a magazine, etc. that has been published（（书刊等的）出版，发行；出版物）；the act of printing sth in a newspaper, report, etc. so that the public knows about it（发表；刊登；公布）

publicity.meaning: the attention that is given to sb/sth by newspapers, television, etc.（（媒体的）关注，宣传，报道）；the business of attracting the attention of the public to sth/sb; the things that are done to attract attention（宣传业；广告宣传工作；传播工作）

publicize.meaning: to make sth known to the public; to advertise sth（宣传；推广；宣扬；传播）

publish.meaning: to produce a book, magazine, CD-ROM, etc. and sell it to the public（出版；发行）；to print a letter, an article, etc. in a newspaper or magazine（（在报刊）发表，刊登，登载）；to make sth available to the public on the Internet（（在互联网上）发表，公布）；(of an author（作者）

publisher.meaning: a person or company that prepares and prints books, magazines, newspapers or electronic products and makes them available to the public（出版人（或机构）；发行人（或机构））

publishing.meaning: the profession or business of preparing and printing books, magazines, CD-ROMs, etc. and selling or making them available to the public（出版（业）；发行（业））

pudding.meaning: (BrE) a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal（（餐末的）甜食，甜点）；(BrE) a hot sweet dish, often like a cake, made from flour, fat and eggs with fruit, jam, etc. in or on it（热布丁糕（用面粉、油、蛋制作，加水果、果酱等））；(BrE) a hot dish like a pie with soft pastry made from flour, fat and eggs and usually filled with meat（热布丁饼（用面粉、油、蛋制作，通常用肉填充））；(especially NAmE) a cold dessert (= a sweet dish) like cream flavoured with fruit, chocolate, etc.（冷布丁（有水果、巧克力等口味））

puddle.meaning: a small amount of water or other liquid, especially rain, that has collected in one place on the ground（水洼；小水坑；（尤指）雨水坑）

pueblo.meaning: a member of a group of Native American people who live in the US states of Arizona and New Mexico（普韦布洛人（美洲土著，居于美国亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州））

puff.meaning: to smoke a cigarette, pipe, etc.（吸，抽（香烟、烟斗等））；to make smoke or steam blow out in clouds; to blow out in clouds（使喷出，冒出（烟或蒸汽））；(informal) to breathe loudly and quickly, especially after you have been running（急促喘息；气喘吁吁）；to move in a particular direction, sending out small clouds of smoke or steam（喷着汽（或烟）移动）

puffin.meaning: a black and white bird with a large, brightly coloured beak that lives near the sea, common in the N Atlantic（角嘴海雀，海鹦（常见于北大西洋，喙大而色艳））

pull.meaning: to hold sth firmly and use force in order to move it or try to move it towards yourself（拉；拽；扯；拖）；to remove sth from a place by pulling（拔出；抽出）；to move sb/sth in a particular direction by pulling（（向某方向）拖，拉动）；to hold or be attached to sth and move it along behind you（将 … 拖在身后；拉；牵引）

pulley.meaning: a wheel or set of wheels over which a rope or chain is pulled in order to lift or lower heavy objects（滑轮；滑轮组；滑车）

pullman.meaning: a type of very comfortable coach/car on a train（普尔曼豪华火车车厢）

pulp.meaning: a soft wet substance that is made especially by crushing sth（浆状物）；a soft substance that is made by crushing wood, cloth or other material and then used to make paper（纸浆）；the soft part inside some fruit and vegetables（（瓜果等的）肉质部分，髓）；pulpy pulpy pulpier pulpiest /; NAmE/ adj. Cook the fruit slowly until soft and pulpy.（把水果慢慢地煮成软糊状。）

pulse.meaning: the regular beat of blood as it is sent around the body, that can be felt in different places, especially on the inside part of the wrist; the number of times the blood beats in a minute（脉搏；脉率）；a strong regular beat in music（强劲的音乐节拍）；a single short increase in the amount of light, sound or electricity produced by a machine, etc.（脉冲）；the seeds of some plants that are eaten as food, such as peas and lentils（豆果果实；荚果；豆子）

pump.meaning: a machine that is used to force liquid, gas or air into or out of sth（抽水机；泵；打气筒）；a woman's formal shoe that is plain and does not cover the top part of the foot（无带低帮女鞋，无带半高跟女鞋（正式场合穿的一种女鞋））；(BrE) a woman's light soft flat shoe worn for dancing or exercise; a similar style of shoe worn as a fashion item（轻软舞鞋，休闲女鞋（女子跳舞、运动时穿或用作时装））；to make water, air, gas, etc. flow in a particular direction by using a pump or sth that works like a pump（用泵（或泵样器官等）输送）

pumpkin.meaning: a large round vegetable with thick orange skin. The seeds can be dried and eaten and the soft flesh can be cooked as a vegetable or in sweet pies.（南瓜；南瓜大果）

punch.meaning: to hit sb/sth hard with your fist (= closed hand)（拳打；以拳痛击）；to make a hole in sth with a punch n. (3) or some other sharp object（给 … 打孔；（用打孔器等）打孔）；to press buttons or keys on a computer, telephone, etc. in order to operate it（按（键）；压（按钮））；punch·er puncher punchers /pʌntʃə(r); NAmEpʌntʃər/ noun He's one of boxing's strongest punchers.（他是拳坛的铁榔头之一。）

punctual.meaning: happening or doing sth at the arranged or correct time; not late（按时的；准时的；守时的）；punc·tu·al·ity /ˌpʌŋktʃuˈæləti; NAmEˌpʌŋktʃuˈæləti/ noun [U] punc·tu·al·ly /ˈpʌŋktʃuəli; NAmEˈpʌŋktʃuəli/ adv. They always pay punctually.（他们一向按时付款。）

punctuation.meaning: the marks used in writing that divide sentences and phrases; the system of using these marks（标点符号；标点符号用法）

puncture.meaning: (BrE) a small hole in a tyre made by a sharp point（（轮胎上刺破的）小孔，小洞）；a small hole, especially in the skin, made by a sharp point（（尤指皮肤上被刺破的）扎孔；刺伤）；to make a small hole in sth; to get a small hole（在 … 上扎孔（或穿孔）；（被）刺破）；to suddenly make sb feel less confident, proud, etc.（使突然泄气；挫伤（锐气等））

pungent.meaning: having a strong taste or smell（味道（或气味）强烈的；刺激性的）；direct and having a strong effect（说穿的；一语道破的；一针见血的）

punish.meaning: to make sb suffer because they have broken the law or done sth wrong（处罚；惩罚）；to set the punishment for a particular crime（对 … 判罪；判定 … 的处罚方式）；to blame yourself for sth that has happened（责怪（自己）；自责）

punishment.meaning: an act or a way of punishing sb（惩罚；处罚；刑罚）；rough treatment（粗暴对待；虐待）

pupil.meaning: (especially BrE) (becoming old-fashioned) a person who is being taught, especially a child in a school（学生；（尤指）小学生）；a person who is taught artistic, musical, etc. skills by an expert（弟子；门生；门徒）；the small round black area at the centre of the eye（瞳孔；眸子；瞳人）

puppet.meaning: a model of a person or an animal that can be made to move, for example by pulling strings attached to parts of its body or by putting your hand inside it. A puppet with strings is also called a marionette.（木偶）；(usually disapproving) a person or group whose actions are controlled by another（傀儡）

puppy.meaning: a young dog（小狗；幼犬）；(old-fashioned, informal) a proud or rude young man（傲慢小子；自负无礼的青年）

purchase.meaning: the act or process of buying sth（购买；采购）；something that you have bought（购买的东西；购买项目）；(technical 术语) a firm hold on sth with the hands or feet, for example when you are climbing（握紧；抓牢；蹬稳）；(formal) to buy sth（买；购买；采购）

purchaser.meaning: a person who buys sth（购买人；采购人员；买主）

pure.meaning: not mixed with anything else; with nothing added（纯的；纯净的；纯粹的）；clean and not containing any harmful substances（干净的；不含有害物质的）；complete and total（完全的；纯粹的）；very clear; perfect（清晰的；纯正的）

purge.meaning: to remove people from an organization, often violently, because their opinions or activities are unacceptable to the people in power（清除，清洗（组织中的异己分子））；(formal) to make yourself/sb/sth pure, healthy or clean by getting rid of bad thoughts or feelings（净化（心灵、风气等）；涤荡（污秽））；the act of removing people, often violently, from an organization because their views are unacceptable to the people who have power（（对异己的）清洗，清除，暴力铲除）

purify.meaning: to make sth pure by removing substances that are dirty, harmful or not wanted（使（某物）洁净；净化）；to make sb pure by removing evil from their souls（洗涤（思想）；净化（心灵））；(technical 术语) to take a pure form of a substance out of another substance that contains it（提纯；精炼）；puri·fi·ca·tion purification purifications /ˌpjʊərɪfɪˈkeɪʃn; NAmEˌpjʊrɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ noun [U] a water purification plant（滤水厂）

puritan.meaning: (usually disapproving) a person who has very strict moral attitudes and who thinks that pleasure is bad（禁欲者；苦行者）；a member of a Protestant group of Christians in England in the 16th and 17th centuries who wanted to worship God in a simple way（清教徒（属于 16 和 17 世纪的英国教会））；connected with the Puritans and their beliefs（清教徒的；清教主义的；禁欲的；苦行的）

purity.meaning: the state or quality of being pure（纯洁；纯净；纯粹）

purple.meaning: having the colour of blue and red mixed together（紫色的）；writing or a piece of writing that is too grand in style（华丽的文辞；雕琢的章句）；pur·ple noun [U, C] She was dressed in purple.（她穿一身紫色衣裳。）

purplish.meaning: similar to purple in colour（带紫色的；发紫的）

purpose.meaning: the intention, aim or function of sth; the thing that sth is supposed to achieve（意图；目的；用途；目标）；what is needed in a particular situation（情势的需要）；meaning that is important and valuable to you（重要意义；有价值的意义）；the ability to plan sth and work successfully to achieve it（意志；毅力；决心）

purposeful.meaning: having a useful purpose; acting with a clear aim and with determination（有意义的；有目的的；坚毅的；果断的）

purposely.meaning: on purpose; deliberately（故意地；蓄意地）

purse.meaning: (especially BrE) a small bag made of leather, plastic, etc. for carrying coins and often also paper money, cards, etc., used especially by women（钱包，皮夹子（尤指女用的））；the amount of money that is available to a person, an organization or a government to spend（资金；财源；备用款）；(sport 体) a sum of money given as a prize in a boxing match（（拳击赛的）奖金）；to form your lips into a small tight round shape, for example to show disapproval（噘嘴，撮起嘴唇（以表示反对等））

pursuance.meaning: (formal or law 律) in order to do sth; in the process of doing sth（为了；在 … 过程中）

pursuant.meaning: (formal or law 律) according to or following sth, especially a rule or law（依照，根据，按照（尤指规则或法律））

pursue.meaning: to do sth or try to achieve sth over a period of time（追求；致力于；执行；贯彻）；to continue to discuss, find out about or be involved in sth（继续探讨（或追究、从事））；to follow or chase sb/sth, especially in order to catch them（追逐；跟踪；追赶）

pursuit.meaning: the act of looking for or trying to find sth（追求；寻找）；the act of following or chasing sb（追赶；跟踪；追捕）；something that you give your time and energy to, that you do as a hobby（事业；消遣；爱好）

push.meaning: to use your hands, arms or body in order to make sb/sth move forward or away from you; to move part of your body into a particular position（推动（人或物）；移动（身体部位））；to use force to move past sb/sth using your hands, arms, etc.（推进（道路）；挤开）；to affect sth so that it reaches a particular level or state（推动；促使（达到某程度或状态））；to press a switch, button, etc., for example in order to make a machine start working（按；揿；摁）

pushy.meaning: trying hard to get what you want, especially in a way that seems rude（执意强求的；死缠硬磨的）

put.meaning: to move sth into a particular place or position（放；安置）；to cause sb/sth to go to a particular place（将 … 送往；使 … 前往）；to attach or fix sth to sth else（使与 … 连接；安装）；to write sth or make a mark on sth（（在 … 上）书写，记，做标记）

putrefaction.meaning: the process of decaying, especially that of a dead body（腐烂；（尸体）腐化）

putrefy.meaning: to decay and smell very bad（腐烂；腐化）

putt.meaning: (in golf（高尔夫球）；to hit the ball gently when it is on the short grass near the hole, so that it rolls across the ground a short distance into or towards the hole（轻击；推球入洞）

puzzle.meaning: a game, etc. that you have to think about carefully in order to answer it or do it（谜；智力游戏）；something that is difficult to understand or explain（不解之谜；疑问）；to make sb feel confused because they do not understand sth（迷惑；使困惑）；puz·zling /ˈpʌzlɪŋ; NAmEˈpʌzlɪŋ/ adj. one of the most puzzling aspects of the crime（这桩罪案最费解的一面）

puzzlement.meaning: a feeling of being confused because you do not understand sth（迷惘；困惑）

pygmy.meaning: a member of a race of very short people living in parts of Africa and SE Asia（俾格米人（生活于非洲和东南亚部分地区，身材矮小））；(disapproving) a very small person or thing or one that is weak in some way（矮小的人（或物）；侏儒；弱小者）；used to describe a plant or species (= type) of animal that is much smaller than other similar kinds（（比同类动植物）小得多的，矮小的，微小的）

pyjamas.meaning: a loose jacket and trousers/pants worn in bed（（一套）睡衣裤）；py·jama /pəˈdʒɑːmə; NAmEpəˈdʒæmə/ (especially US pa·jama) adj. [only before noun] pyjama bottoms（睡裤）

pylon.meaning: a tall metal structure that is used for carrying electricity wires high above the ground（电缆塔）

pyramid.meaning: a large building with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top. The ancient Egyptians built stone pyramids as places to bury their kings and queens.（（古埃及的）金字塔）；(geometry 几何) a solid shape with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top（锥体；棱锥体）；an object or a pile of things that has the shape of a pyramid（金字塔形的物体（或一堆东西））；an organization or a system in which there are fewer people at each level as you get near the top（金字塔式的组织（或系统））

pyre.meaning: a large pile of wood on which a dead body is placed and burned in a funeral ceremony（（火葬用的）柴堆）

quagmire.meaning: an area of soft wet ground（泥淖；湿地；泥沼）；a difficult or dangerous situation（困境；险境）

quaint.meaning: attractive in an unusual or old-fashioned way（新奇有趣的；古色古香的）

quake.meaning: (of a person（人）；to shake because you are very frightened or nervous（（因恐惧或紧张）发抖，颤抖，哆嗦）；(of the earth or a building（地面或建筑物）；to move or shake violently（震动；颤动）

rear.meaning: the back part of sth（后部）；(informal) the part of the body that you sit on（屁股；臀部）；to be at the back of a line of people, or last in a race（站在队尾；落在最后；殿后）；at or near the back of sth（后面的；后部的）

rearrange.meaning: to change the position or order of things; to change your position（重新排列；改变位置）；to change the time, date or place of an event（重新安排；改变时间（或日期、地点））

reason.meaning: a cause or an explanation for sth that has happened or that sb has done（原因；理由；解释）；a fact that makes it right or fair to do sth（正当理由；道理；情理）；the power of the mind to think in a logical way, to understand and have opinions, etc.（思考力；理解力；理性）；what is possible, practical or right（道理；情理；明智）

reasonable.meaning: fair, practical and sensible（公平的；合理的；有理由的；明智的）；acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation（可以接受的；合乎情理的；公道的）；(of prices（价格）；not too expensive（不太贵的；公道的）

reasonably.meaning: to a degree that is fairly good but not very good（尚可；过得去）；in a logical and sensible way（合乎逻辑地；明智地；通情达理地）；in a fair way（公平合理地；适度地）

reassure.meaning: to say or do sth that makes sb less frightened or worried（使 … 安心；打消 … 的疑虑）

rebate.meaning: an amount of money that is paid back to you because you have paid too much（退还款）；an amount of money that is taken away from the cost of sth, before you pay for it（回扣，返还（退还的部分货价）；折扣）

rebel.meaning: a person who fights against the government of their country（反政府的人；叛乱者；造反者）；a person who opposes sb in authority over them within an organization, a political party, etc.（反抗权威者）；a person who does not like to obey rules or who does not accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.（叛逆者；不守规矩者）；to fight against or refuse to obey an authority, for example a government, a system, your parents, etc.（造反；反抗；背叛）

rebellion.meaning: an attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government, using violence（谋反；叛乱；反叛）；opposition to authority within an organization, a political party, etc.（（对权威的）反抗，不服从）；opposition to authority; being unwilling to obey rules or accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.（不顺从；叛逆）

rebellious.meaning: unwilling to obey rules or accept normal standards of behaviour, dress, etc.（反叛的；叛逆的；桀骜不驯的）；opposed to the government of a country; opposed to those in authority within an organization（叛乱的；造反的；反对权威的）；re·bel·li·ous·ly /rɪˈbeljəsli; NAmErɪˈbeljəsli/ adv. ‘I don't care!’ she said rebelliously.（“我不在乎！”她桀骜不驯地说道。）

rebirth.meaning: a period of new life, growth or activity（新生；复活；复兴）；a spiritual change when a person's faith becomes stronger or they convert to another religion（（信仰加强或皈依另一宗教后精神上的）新生，再生）

rebound.meaning: to bounce back after hitting sth（弹回；反弹）；(formal) if sth that you do rebounds on you, it has an unpleasant effect on you, especially when the effect was intended for sb else（报应；反作用于）；(of prices, etc.（价格等）；to rise again after they have fallen（回升；反弹）

rebuild.meaning: to build or put sth together again（重建；重组；重新装配）；to make sth/sb complete and strong again（使复原；使恢复）

rebuke.meaning: (formal) to speak severely to sb because they have done sth wrong（指责；批评）；re·buke noun [C, U] He was silenced by her stinging rebuke.（她的尖锐批评使他哑口无言。）

recall.meaning: (formal) (not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to remember sth（记起；回忆起；回想起）；(not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to make sb think of sth（使想起；使想到；勾起）

recapture.meaning: to win back a place, position, etc. that was previously taken from you by an enemy or a rival（赢回；夺回）；to catch a person or an animal that has escaped（抓回；再次捕获）；to bring back a feeling or repeat an experience that you had in the past（回忆；再体验；重温）；re·cap·ture noun [U] the recapture of towns occupied by the rebels（夺回被叛军占领的城镇）

recede.meaning: to move gradually away from sb or away from a previous position（逐渐远离；渐渐远去）；(especially of a problem, feeling or quality（尤指问题、感觉或特质）；to become gradually weaker or smaller（逐渐减弱；慢慢变小）；(of hair（头发）

receipt.meaning: a piece of paper that shows that goods or services have been paid for（收据；收条）；(formal) the act of receiving sth（接收；收到）；(business 商) money that a business, bank or government receives（（企业、银行、政府等）收到的款项，收入）

receive.meaning: (rather formal) to get or accept sth that is sent or given to you（拿到；接到；收到）；to experience or be given a particular type of treatment or an injury（体验；受到（某种待遇或伤害））；to react to sth new, in a particular way（对 … 作出反应）；(formal) to welcome or entertain a guest, especially formally（接待；欢迎；招待）

receiver.meaning: the part of a telephone that you hold close to your mouth and ear（听筒；受话器）；a piece of radio or television equipment that changes broadcast signals into sound or pictures（无线电接收机；收音机；电视机）；(law 律) a person who is chosen by a court to be in charge of a company that is bankrupt（（破产公司的）财产管理人，官方接管人）；a person who receives sth（接收者）

recent.meaning: that happened or began only a short time ago（近来的；新近的）

receptacle.meaning: (formal) a container for putting sth in（容器：）

reception.meaning: (especially BrE) the area inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go first when they arrive（接待处；接待区）；a formal social occasion to welcome sb or celebrate sth（接待仪式；欢迎会；招待会）；the type of welcome that is given to sb/sth（欢迎；接受）；the quality of radio and television signals that are broadcast（（无线电和电视信号的）接收效果）

receptionist.meaning: a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, an office building, a doctor's surgery, etc.（接待员）

receptive.meaning: willing to listen to or to accept new ideas or suggestions（（对新观点、建议等）愿意倾听的，乐于接受的）；re·cep·tive·ness /rɪˈseptɪvnəs; NAmErɪˈseptɪvnəs/ re·cep·tiv·ity /ˌriːsepˈtɪvəti; NAmEˌriːsepˈtɪvəti/ noun [U] receptivity to change（对变化的适应能力）

receptor.meaning: a sense organ or nerve ending in the body that reacts to changes such as heat or cold and makes the body react in a particular way（感受器；受体）

recess.meaning: a period of time during the year when the members of a parliament, committee, etc. do not meet（休会期）；a short break in a trial in court（休庭）；a period of time between lessons at school（课间休息）；a part of a wall that is set further back than the rest of the wall, forming a space（壁龛；壁橱；凹室）

recession.meaning: a difficult time for the economy of a country, when there is less trade and industrial activity than usual and more people are unemployed（经济衰退；经济萎缩）；(formal) the movement backwards of sth from a previous position（退后；撤回）

recharge.meaning: to fill a battery with electrical power; to be filled with electrical power（给（电池）充电；充电）；(informal) to get back your strength and energy by resting for a time（恢复体力；恢复精力；休整）；re·charge·able /; NAmE/ adj. rechargeable batteries（可充电电池）；to get back your strength and energy by resting for a while（养精蓄锐；休整）

recipe.meaning: a set of instructions that tells you how to cook sth and the ingredients (= items of food) you need for it（烹饪法；食谱）；a method or an idea that seems likely to have a particular result（方法；秘诀；诀窍）

recipient.meaning: a person who receives sth（受方；接受者）

reciprocal.meaning: involving two people or groups who agree to help each other or behave in the same way to each other（互惠的；相应的）

reciprocate.meaning: to behave or feel towards sb in the same way as they behave or feel towards you（回报；回应）；(technical 术语) to move backwards and forwards in a straight line（沿直线往复移动）

recital.meaning: a public performance of music or poetry, usually given by one person or a small group（音乐演奏会；诗歌朗诵会）；a spoken description of a series of events, etc. that is often long and boring（（口述）逐一列举；赘述）

recitation.meaning: an act of saying a piece of poetry or literature that you have learned to an audience（朗诵；朗读）；an act of talking or writing about a series of things（逐一列举；逐个叙述）

recite.meaning: to say a poem, piece of literature, etc. that you have learned, especially to an audience（（尤指对听众）背诵，吟诵，朗诵）；to say a list or series of things（（口头）列举；逐一讲述）

reckless.meaning: showing a lack of care about danger and the possible results of your actions（鲁莽的；不计后果的；无所顾忌的）；reck·less·ly /ˈrekləsli; NAmEˈrekləsli/ adv. He admitted driving recklessly.（他承认鲁莽驾驶。）

reckon.meaning: (informal) (especially BrE) to think sth or have an opinion about sth（想；认为）；(not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to be generally considered to be sth（被普遍认为是；被看作是）；(BrE) (informal) to expect to do sth（料想；预计；指望）

reclaim.meaning: to get sth back or to ask to have it back after it has been lost, taken away, etc.（取回；拿回；要求归还）；to make land that is naturally too wet or too dry suitable to be built on, farmed, etc.（开垦，利用，改造（荒地））；if a piece of land is reclaimed by desert, forest, etc., it turns back into desert, etc. after being used for farming or building（重新变为沙漠（或森林等）；沙化；荒漠化；抛荒）；to obtain materials from waste products so that they can be used again（回收（废品中有用的东西））

recline.meaning: (formal) to sit or lie in a relaxed way, with your body leaning backwards（斜倚；斜躺；向后倚靠）；when a seat reclines or when you recline a seat, the back of it moves into a comfortable sloping position（（使座椅靠背）向后倾）

recognition.meaning: the act of remembering who sb is when you see them, or of identifying what sth is（认出；认识；识别）；the act of accepting that sth exists, is true or is official（承认；认可）；public praise and reward for sb's work or actions（赞誉；赏识；奖赏）；to change so much that you can hardly recognize it（变得面目全非；沧海桑田）

recognizable.meaning: easy to know or identify（容易认出的；易于识别的）

recognize.meaning: to know who sb is or what sth is when you see or hear them, because you have seen or heard them or it before（认识；认出；辨别出）；to admit or to be aware that sth exists or is true（承认；意识到）；to accept and approve of sb/sth officially（（正式）认可，接受，赞成）；to be thought of as very good or important by people in general（赞赏；赏识；看重；公认）

recoil.meaning: to move your body quickly away from sb/sth because you find them or it frightening or unpleasant（退缩；畏缩）；to react to an idea or a situation with strong dislike or fear（对 … 作出厌恶（或恐惧）的反应）；(of a gun（枪炮）；to move suddenly backwards when you fire it（反冲；产生后坐力）

recollect.meaning: (not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to remember sth, especially by making an effort to remember it（记起；回忆起；记得）

recollection.meaning: the ability to remember sth; the act of remembering sth（记忆力；回忆；记忆）；a thing that you remember from the past（往事；回忆的事）

recommend.meaning: to tell sb that sth is good or useful, or that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.（推荐；举荐；介绍）；to advise a particular course of action; to advise sb to do sth（劝告；建议）；to make sb/sth seem attractive or good（使显得吸引人；使受欢迎）

recommendation.meaning: an official suggestion about the best thing to do（正式建议；提议）；the act of telling sb that sth is good or useful or that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.（推荐；介绍）；(especially NAmE) a formal letter or statement that sb would be suitable for a particular job, etc.（推荐信；求职介绍信）

recompense.meaning: (formal) something, usually money, that you are given because you have suffered in some way, or as a payment for sth（赔偿；补偿；报酬）；(formal) to do sth for sb or give them a payment for sth that they have suffered（给 … 以补偿；赔偿）

reconcile.meaning: to find an acceptable way of dealing with two or more ideas, needs, etc. that seem to be opposed to each other（使和谐一致；调和；使配合）；to make people become friends again after an argument or a disagreement（使和解；使和好如初）；to make sb/yourself accept an unpleasant situation because it is not possible to change it（将就；妥协）

reconnaissance.meaning: the activity of getting information about an area for military purposes, using soldiers, planes, etc.（侦察）

reconsider.meaning: to think about sth again, especially because you might want to change a previous decision or opinion（重新考虑；重新审议）

reconstitute.meaning: (formal) to form an organization or a group again in a different way（重组；重新设立）；to bring dried food, etc. back to its original form by adding water（使（脱水食物等）恢复原状；使还原）

reconstruct.meaning: to build or make sth again that has been damaged or that no longer exists（修复；重建；重造）；to be able to describe or show exactly how a past event happened, using the information you have gathered（重现描述；使重现）

reconstruction.meaning: the process of changing or improving the condition of sth or the way it works; the process of putting sth back into the state it was in before（重建；改造；复原）；the activity of building again sth that has been damaged or destroyed（修复；修理）；a copy of sth that no longer exists（重现）；a short film showing events that are known to have happened, made in order to try and get more information or better understanding, especially about a crime（再现（犯罪过程等的）影片）

record.meaning: a written account of sth that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future（记录；记载）；a thin round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded（唱片）；a piece or collection of music released as a record, or on CD, the Internet, etc.（唱片；专辑）；the best result or the highest or lowest level that has ever been reached, especially in sport（（尤指体育运动中最高或最低的）纪录）

recorder.meaning: (in compounds（构成复合词）；a machine for recording sound or pictures or both（录音机；录像机；（台）录影机）；a musical instrument in the shape of a pipe that you blow into, with holes that you cover with your fingers（竖笛；直笛）；a judge in a court in some parts of Britain and the US（（英国和美国某些地区的）法院法官，法官）

recording.meaning: sound or pictures that have been recorded on CD, DVD, video, etc.（录制的音像；录音；视频；录像）；the process of making a record, film/movie, radio or television show, etc.（录制）；the process or act of writing down and storing information for official purposes（（正式的）记录，记载）

recount.meaning: to tell sb about sth, especially sth that you have experienced（讲述，叙述（亲身经历））；to count sth again, especially votes（重数；重新清点（选票））；re·count /ˈriːkaʊnt; NAmEˈriːkaʊnt/ noun The defeated candidate demanded a recount.（落选的候选人要求重新计票。）

recourse.meaning: the fact of having to, or being able to, use sth that can provide help in a difficult situation（依靠；依赖；求助）

recover.meaning: to get well again after being ill/sick, hurt, etc.（恢复健康；康复；痊愈）；to return to a normal state after an unpleasant or unusual experience or a period of difficulty（复原；恢复常态）；to get back the same amount of money that you have spent or that is owed to you（全额收回；追回）；to get back or find sth that was lost, stolen or missing（找回；寻回；找到）

recovery.meaning: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury（恢复；痊愈）；the process of improving or becoming stronger again（改善；回升；复苏）；the action or process of getting sth back that has been lost or stolen（取回；收回；复得）；the room in a hospital where patients are kept immediately after an operation（（供刚做完手术的病人使用的）监护室）

recreate.meaning: to make sth that existed in the past exist or seem to exist again（再现；再创造）；re·cre·ation recreation recreations /ˌriːkriˈeɪʃn; NAmEˌriːkriˈeɪʃn/ noun [C, U] The writer attempts a recreation of the sights and sounds of his childhood.（作家试图再现他童年的所见所闻。）

recreation.meaning: the fact of people doing things for enjoyment, when they are not working（娱乐；消遣）；(BrE) a particular activity that sb does when they are not working（娱乐活动；游戏）

recreational.meaning: connected with activities that people do for enjoyment when they are not working（娱乐的；消遣的）

recruit.meaning: to find new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.（吸收（新成员）；征募（新兵））；to persuade sb to do sth, especially to help you（动员 …（提供帮助））；to form a new army, team, etc. by persuading new people to join it（（通过招募）组成，组建）；re·cruit·er recruiter recruiters /rɪˈkruːtə(r); NAmErɪˈkruːtər/ noun re·cruit·ment recruitment recruitments /rɪˈkruːtmənt; NAmErɪˈkruːtmənt/ noun [U] the recruitment of new members（新成员的招募）

rectangle.meaning: a flat shape with four straight sides, two of which are longer than the other two, and four angles of 90°（长方形；矩形）

rectify.meaning: (formal) to put right sth that is wrong（矫正；纠正；改正）；rec·ti·fi·able /ˌrektɪˈfaɪəbl; NAmEˌrektɪˈfaɪəbl/ adj. The damage will be easily rectifiable.（所受损坏很容易修复。）

recur.meaning: to happen again or a number of times（再发生；反复出现）

recurrence.meaning: if there is a recurrence of sth, it happens again（重现；复发）

recurrent.meaning: that happens again and again（反复出现的；重复发生的）

recyclable.meaning: able to be recycled（可回收利用的；可再循环的）

recycle.meaning: to treat things that have already been used so that they can be used again（回收利用；再利用）；to use the same ideas, methods, jokes, etc. again（再次应用，重新使用（概念、方法、玩笑等））；re·cyc·ling /ˌriːˈsaɪklɪŋ; NAmE/ noun [U] the recycling of glass（玻璃的回收利用）

red.meaning: having the colour of blood or fire（红的；红色的）；(of the eyes（眼睛）；bloodshot (= with thin lines of blood in them) or surrounded by red or very pink skin（充血的；布满血丝的；红肿的）；(of the face（脸）

reddish.meaning: fairly red in colour（微红的；略带红色的）

redeem.meaning: to make sb/sth seem less bad（补救；弥补；掩饰 … 之不足）；to do sth to improve the opinion that people have of you, especially after you have done sth bad（挽回影响；改变印象；维护）；(in Christianity（基督教）；to save sb from the power of evil（拯救；救赎）

redefine.meaning: to change the nature or limits of sth; to make people consider sth in a new way（改变 … 的本质（或界限）；重新定义；使重新考虑）

redesign.meaning: to design sth again, in a different way（重新设计）

rediscover.meaning: to find again sth that had been forgotten or lost（重新发现；重新找到）

redistribute.meaning: to share sth out among people in a different way（重新分配）；re·dis·tri·bu·tion AW redistribution redistributions /ˌriːdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn; NAmEˌriːdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/ noun [U, sing.] the redistribution of wealth（财富的重新分配）

redound.meaning: (formal) to improve the impression that people have of you（改进，提高（印象））

reduce.meaning: to make sth less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc.（减少，缩小（尺寸、数量、价格等））；if you reduce a liquid or a liquid reduces, you boil it so that it becomes less in quantity（（使）蒸发）；(NAmE) (informal) to lose weight by limiting the amount and type of food that you eat（减轻体重；节食）；(chemistry 化) to add one or more electrons to a substance or to remove oxygen from a substance（使还原；去氧；脱氧）

reduction.meaning: an act of making sth less or smaller; the state of being made less or smaller（减少；缩小；降低）；an amount of money by which sth is made cheaper（减价；折扣）；a copy of a photograph, map, picture, etc. that is made smaller than the original one（（照片、地图、图片等的）缩图，缩版）；(chemistry 化) the fact of adding one or more electrons to a substance or of removing oxygen from a substance（还原；去氧；脱氧）

redundancy.meaning: (BrE) the situation when sb has to leave their job because there is no more work available for them（（因劳动力过剩而造成的）裁员，解雇）；(formal or technical 术语) the state of not being necessary or useful（多余；累赘）

redundant.meaning: (of a person（人）；without a job because there is no more work available for you in a company（被裁减的）；not needed or useful（多余的；不需要的）

redwood.meaning: a very tall type of tree that grows especially in California and Oregon（红杉，红木（多生长于加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州））；the reddish wood of the redwood tree（红杉木）

reed.meaning: a tall plant like grass with a hollow stem that grows in or near water（芦苇）；a small thin piece of cane, metal or plastic in some musical instruments such as the oboe or the clarinet that moves very quickly when air is blown over it, producing a sound（簧舌，簧片（金属或塑料制成，用于双簧管、单簧管等吹奏乐器））

reef.meaning: a long line of rocks or sand near the surface of the sea（礁；礁脉）；a part of a sail that can be tied or rolled up to make the sail smaller in a strong wind（缩帆部；帆的可收缩部）；(technical 术语) to make a sail smaller by tying or rolling up part of it（收帆；卷起缩帆部；叠起缩帆部）

reel.meaning: a round object around which you wind such things as thread, wire or film; a reel together with the film, wire, thread, etc. that is wound around it（卷轴；卷盘；卷筒；一卷胶卷（或金属丝、线等））；a fast Scottish, Irish or American dance, usually for two or four couples; a piece of music for this dance（里尔舞（流行于苏格兰、爱尔兰或美国的一种轻快舞蹈，通常由两对或四对表演）；里尔舞曲）；to move in a very unsteady way, for example because you are drunk or have been hit（踉跄；摇摇晃晃地挪动；蹒跚）；to feel very shocked or upset about sth（感到震惊；感觉心烦意乱）

refer.meaning: to mention or speak about sb/sth（提到；谈及；说起）；to describe or be connected to sb/sth（描述；涉及；与 … 相关）；to look at sth or ask a person for information（查阅；参考；征询）；to send sb/sth to sb/sth for help, advice or a decision（让（某人）求助于 … ；把（某事）移交给 …）

referee.meaning: the official who controls the game in some sports（（某些体育比赛的）裁判，裁判员）；(BrE) a person who gives information about your character and ability, usually in a letter, for example when you are applying for a job（介绍人；推荐人）；a person who is asked to settle a disagreement（仲裁员；调解人）；a person who reads and checks the quality of a technical article before it is published（（专业性文章的）审阅人，鉴定专家）

reference.meaning: a thing you say or write that mentions sb/sth else; the act of mentioning sb/sth（说到（或写到）的事；提到；谈及；涉及）；the act of looking at sth for information（参考；查询；查阅）；(formal) the act of asking sb for help or advice（（帮助或意见的）征求，征询）；a number, word or symbol that shows where sth is on a map, or where you can find a piece of information（（为方便查询所用的）标记，标识，编号）

referendum.meaning: an occasion when all the people of a country can vote on an important issue（全民投票；全民公决）

refill.meaning: to fill sth again（再装满；重新装满）；re·fill·able /ˌriːˈfɪləbl; NAmEˌriːˈfɪləbl/ adj. a refillable gas cylinder（可重新灌注的煤气罐）；another drink of the same type（又一份同种饮料）；an amount of sth, sold in a cheap container, that you use to fill up a more expensive container that is now empty（补充装材料（用以补充产品容器内用完的物品））

refine.meaning: to make a substance pure by taking other substances out of it（精炼；提纯；去除杂质）；to improve sth by making small changes to it（改进；改善；使精练）

refined.meaning: (of a substance（物质）；made pure by having other substances taken out of it（精炼的；提纯的；精制的）；(of a person（人）；polite, well educated and able to judge the quality of things; having the sort of manners that are considered typical of a high social class（有礼貌的；优雅的；有教养的）

refinement.meaning: a small change to sth that improves it（（精细的）改进，改善）；a thing that is an improvement on an earlier, similar thing（改良品；经过改进的东西）；the process of improving sth or of making sth pure（精炼；提炼；提纯）；the quality of being polite and well educated and able to judge the quality of things; the state of having the sort of manners that are considered typical of a high social class（优雅；礼貌；有教养）

refiner.meaning: a person or company that refines substances such as sugar or oil（从事精炼加工的人（或公司）；炼制者）

refinery.meaning: a factory where a substance such as oil is refined (= made pure)（精炼厂；提炼厂；精制厂）

reflect.meaning: to show the image of sb/sth on the surface of sth such as a mirror, water or glass（反映；映出（影像））；to throw back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface（反射（声、光、热等））；to show or be a sign of the nature of sth or of sb's attitude or feeling（显示，表明，表达（事物的自然属性或人们的态度、情感等））；to think carefully and deeply about sth（认真思考；沉思）

reflection.meaning: an image in a mirror, on a shiny surface, on water, etc.（映像；映照出的影像）；the action or process of sending back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface（（声、光、热等的）反射）；a sign that shows the state or nature of sth（反映；显示；表达）；careful thought about sth, sometimes over a long period of time（沉思；深思；审慎的思考）

reflective.meaning: (formal) thinking deeply about things（沉思的；深思的）；reflective surfaces send back light or heat（（指物体表面）反射热的，反光的）；typical of a particular situation or thing; showing the state or nature of sth（典型的；代表性的；体现状态（或本质）的）；re·flect·ive·ly /rɪˈflektɪvli; NAmErɪˈflektɪvli/ adv. She sipped her wine reflectively.（她一边品酒，一边沉思。）

reflectivity.meaning: the degree to which a material reflects light or radiation（（材料对光或辐射的）反射率）

reform.meaning: to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc. by making changes to it（改革；改进；改良）；to improve your behaviour; to make sb do this（（使）改正，改造（行为）；（使）悔改）；re·formed /; NAmE/ adj. a reformed character（改过自新的人）；change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc. in order to improve or correct it（改革；变革；改良；改善）

reformation.meaning: (formal) the act of improving or changing sb/sth（改革；改进；变革）；new ideas in religion in 16th century Europe that led to attempts to reform the Roman Catholic Church and to the forming of the Protestant Churches; the period of time when these changes were taking place（宗教改革（欧洲 16 世纪改革罗马天主教从而导致新教的产生）；宗教改革时期）

reformer.meaning: a person who works to achieve political or social change（改革者；改良者；改造者）

reformist.meaning: wanting or trying to change political or social situations（主张改革的；改革派的；改良主义的）

refractory.meaning: (of a person（人）；difficult to control; behaving badly（难以驾驭的；行为乖戾的）；(of a disease or medical condition（疾病）；difficult to treat or cure（难以诊治的；难以治愈的）

refrain.meaning: (formal) to stop yourself from doing sth, especially sth that you want to do（克制；节制；避免）；a comment or complaint that is often repeated（经常重复的评价（或抱怨））；the part of a song or a poem that is repeated after each verse（副歌；叠歌；迭句）

refresh.meaning: to make sb feel less tired or less hot（使恢复精力；使凉爽）；(informal) (especially NAmE) to fill sb's glass or cup again（重新斟满）；to remind yourself/sb of sth, especially with the help of sth that can be seen or heard（提醒；提示；使想起）；(computing 计) to get the most recent information, for example on an Internet page, by clicking on a button on the screen（刷新；更新；重新整理）

refreshing.meaning: pleasantly new or different（令人耳目一新的；别具一格的）；making you feel less tired or hot（使人精力充沛的；使人凉爽的）；re·fresh·ing·ly /rɪˈfreʃɪŋli; NAmErɪˈfreʃɪŋli/ adv. refreshingly different（焕然一新）

refreshment.meaning: drinks and small amounts of food that are provided or sold to people in a public place or at a public event（（在公共活动场所供应或销售的）饮料，小食）；(formal) food and drink（食物和饮料）；(formal) the fact of making sb feel stronger or less tired or hot（恢复活力；焕发精神）

refrigerate.meaning: (formal) to make food, etc. cold in order to keep it fresh or preserve it（使冷却；使变冷；冷藏）；re·friger·ation /rɪˌfrɪdʒəˈreɪʃn; NAmErɪˌfrɪdʒəˈreɪʃn/ noun [U] Keep all meat products under refrigeration.（把所有的肉制品都冷藏起来。）

refuge.meaning: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.（庇护；避难）；a place, person or thing that provides shelter or protection for sb/sth（避难所；庇护者；慰藉）；a building that provides a temporary home for people in need of shelter or protection from sb/sth（收容所；避难所）

refugee.meaning: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons（避难者；逃亡者；难民）

refund.meaning: a sum of money that is paid back to you, especially because you paid too much or because you returned goods to a shop/store（退款；返还款；偿还金额）；to give sb their money back, especially because they have paid too much or because they are not satisfied with sth they bought（退还；退（款）；偿付）；re·fund·able /; NAmE/ adj. a refundable deposit（可退还的保证金）

refurbish.meaning: to clean and decorate a room, building, etc. in order to make it more attractive, more useful, etc.（再装修；清理装修）；re·fur·bish·ment refurbishment refurbishments /ˌriːˈfɜːbɪʃmənt; NAmEˌriːˈfɜːrbɪʃmənt/ noun [U, C] The hotel is closed for refurbishment.（酒店停业整修。）

refusal.meaning: an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept sth（拒绝；回绝）

refuse.meaning: to say that you will not do sth that sb has asked you to do（拒绝；回绝）；to say that you do not want sth that has been offered to you（推却；回绝）；to say that you will not allow sth; to say that you will not give or allow sb sth that they want or need（不准许；拒绝给（所需之物））；waste material that has been thrown away（废弃物；垃圾）

refute.meaning: to prove that sth is wrong（驳斥；批驳）；to say that sth is not true or fair（反驳；否认）；re·fut·able /rɪˈfjuːtəbl; NAmErɪˈfjuːtəbl/ adj. refu·ta·tion refutation refutations /ˌrefjuˈteɪʃn; NAmEˌrefjuˈteɪʃn/ noun [C, U] a refutation of previously held views（对过去所坚持的观点的驳斥）

regain.meaning: to get back sth you no longer have, especially an ability or a quality（重新获得，恢复（能力或品质等））；(literary) to get back to a place that you have left（回到（原位）；返回）

regard.meaning: to think about sb/sth in a particular way（将 … 认为；把 … 视为；看待）；(formal) to look at sb/sth, especially in a particular way（（尤指以某种方式）注视，凝视）；(formal) concerning or in connection with sb/sth（关于；至于）；(formal) attention to or thought and care for sb/sth（注意；关注；关心）

regarding.meaning: concerning sb/sth; about sb/sth（关于；至于）

regardless.meaning: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties（不顾；不加理会）

regenerate.meaning: to make an area, institution, etc. develop and grow strong again（使振兴；使复兴；发展壮大）；(biology 生) to grow again; to make sth grow again（再生；使再生）；re·gen·er·ation regeneration regenerations /rɪˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn; NAmErɪˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn/ noun [U] economic regeneration（经济复兴）；re·gen·era·tive /rɪˈdʒenərətɪv; NAmErɪˈdʒenərətɪv/ adj. the regenerative powers of nature（大自然的再生力）

regime.meaning: a method or system of government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way（（尤指未通过公正选举的）统治方式，统治制度，政权，政体）；a method or system of organizing or managing sth（组织方法；管理体制）

regiment.meaning: a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel（（军队的）团）；(formal) a large number of people or things（一大群人（或事物））

region.meaning: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders（（通常界限不明的）地区，区域，地方）；one of the areas that a country is divided into, that has its own customs and/or its own government（行政区）；(BrE) all of a country except the capital city（（一国除首都以外的）全部地区，所有区域）；a part of the body, usually one that has a particular character or problem（（通常指有某种特性或问题的）身体部位）

regional.meaning: of or relating to a region（地区的；区域的；地方的）；re·gion·al·ly AW /ˈriːdʒənəli; NAmEˈriːdʒənəli/ adv. regionally based television companies（地方经营的电视公司）

register.meaning: to record your/sb's/sth's name on an official list（登记；注册）；(formal) to make your opinion known officially or publicly（（正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张）；if a measuring instrument registers an amount or sth registers an amount on a measuring instrument, the instrument shows or records that amount（显示（读数）；记录）；(formal) to show or express a feeling（流露出；显得；表达出）

registrar.meaning: a person whose job is to keep official records, especially of births, marriages and deaths（登记员；户籍管理员）；the senior officer who organizes the affairs of a college or university（（大学的）教务长，教务主任，注册主任）；a doctor working in a British hospital who is training to become a specialist in a particular area of medicine（（英国医院的）专科住院医生）

registration.meaning: the act of making an official record of sth/sb（登记；注册；挂号）；a document showing that an official record has been made of sth（登记文档；注册项目）；(BrE) the time when a teacher looks at the list of students on the class register and checks that the students are present（（教师对上课学生的）点名）

regret.meaning: to feel sorry about sth you have done or about sth that you have not been able to do（感到遗憾；惋惜；懊悔）；(formal) used to say in a polite or formal way that you are sorry or sad about a situation（（有礼貌地或正式地表示抱歉、痛惜或悲伤））；a feeling of sadness or disappointment that you have because of sth that has happened or sth that you have done or not done（痛惜；懊悔；遗憾；失望）

regretful.meaning: feeling or showing sadness or disappointment because of sth that has happened or sth that you have done or not done（后悔的；失望的；令人惋惜的；遗憾的）

regretfully.meaning: in a way that shows you are sad or disappointed about sth（遗憾地；痛惜地；失望地；懊悔地）；used to show that you are sorry that sth is the case and you wish the situation were different（遗憾的是；十分遗憾）

regrettable.meaning: (formal) that you are sorry about and wish had not happened（令人惋惜的；可惜的；令人遗憾的）；re·gret·tably /rɪˈɡretəbli; NAmErɪˈɡretəbli/ adv. Regrettably, crime has been increasing in this area.（令人遗憾的是这一地区的犯罪率在不断上升。）

regular.meaning: following a pattern, especially with the same time and space in between each thing and the next（规则的；有规律的；间隙均匀的；定时的）；done or happening often（频繁的；经常做（或发生）的）；(of people（人）；doing the same thing or going to the same place often（经常做某事的；常去某地的）

regularity.meaning: the fact that the same thing happens again and again, and usually with the same length of time between each time it happens（规律性；经常性）；the fact that sth is arranged in an even way or in an organized pattern（匀称；端正；有规则的分布）；a thing that has a pattern to it（有规则的东西；有规律的事物）

regularize.meaning: to make a situation that already exists legal or official（使合法化；使正式存在）

regularly.meaning: at regular intervals or times（有规律地；间隙均匀地）；often（经常）；in an even or balanced way（均匀地；匀称地）

regulate.meaning: to control sth by means of rules（（用规则条例）约束，控制，管理）；to control the speed, pressure, temperature, etc. in a machine or system（调节，控制（速度、压力、温度等））

regulation.meaning: an official rule made by a government or some other authority（章程；规章制度；规则；法规）；controlling sth by means of rules（（运用规则条例的）管理，控制）；that must be worn or used according to the official rules（规定的；必须穿戴的；必须使用的）

regulator.meaning: a person or an organization that officially controls an area of business or industry and makes sure that it is operating fairly（（某行业等的）监管者，监管机构）；a device that automatically controls sth such as speed, temperature or pressure（（速度、温度、压力的）自动调节器）

regulatory.meaning: having the power to control an area of business or industry and make sure that it is operating fairly（（对工商业）具有监管权的，监管的）

regurgitate.meaning: (formal) to bring food that has been swallowed back up into the mouth again（使（咽下的食物）返回到口中；反刍）；(disapproving) to repeat sth you have heard or read without really thinking about it or understanding it（照搬；照本宣科）

rehabilitate.meaning: to help sb to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill/sick or in prison for a long time（使（重病患者）康复；使（长期服刑者）恢复正常生活）；to begin to consider that sb is good or acceptable after a long period during which they were considered bad or unacceptable（恢复 … 的名誉；给 … 平反昭雪）；to return a building or an area to its previous good condition（使（建筑物或地区）恢复原状；修复）；re·habili·ta·tion rehabilitation rehabilitations /ˌriːəˌbɪlɪˈteɪʃn; NAmEˌriːəˌbɪlɪˈteɪʃn/ noun [U] a drug rehabilitation centre（吸毒者康复中心）

rehearsal.meaning: time that is spent practising a play or piece of music in preparation for a public performance（排演；排练）；an experience or event that helps to prepare you for sth that is going to happen in the future（预演；演习）；(formal) the act of repeating sth that has been said before（复述；重复；叙述）

rehearse.meaning: to practise or make people practise a play, piece of music, etc. in preparation for a public performance（排练；排演）；to prepare in your mind or practise privately what you are going to do or say to sb（默诵；背诵；默默地练习）；(formal, usually disapproving) to repeat ideas or opinions that have often been expressed before（照搬；重复）

reheat.meaning: to heat cooked food again after it has been left to go cold（重新加热（凉了的熟食））

reign.meaning: the period during which a king, queen, emperor, etc. rules（君主统治时期）；the period during which sb is in charge of an organization, a team, etc.（任期；当政期）；to rule as king, queen, emperor, etc.（统治；当政；为王；为君）；to be the best or most important in a particular situation or area of skill（成为最佳；成为最重要的）

reimburse.meaning: to pay back money to sb which they have spent or lost（偿还；补偿）

rein.meaning: a long narrow leather band that is attached to a metal bar in a horse's mouth (= a bit) and is held by the rider in order to control the horse（缰绳）；(BrE) strips of leather, etc. worn by a small child and held by an adult in order to stop the child from walking off and getting lost（（成人携带幼儿以防走失的）保护带）；the state of being in control or the leader of sth（控制；主宰；掌管）；to give sb complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely（对 … 不加约束；放任自由；充分表达（感情））

reindeer.meaning: a large deer with long antlers (= horns shaped like branches), that lives in cold northern regions（驯鹿）

reinforce.meaning: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger（加强；充实；使更强烈）；to make a structure or material stronger, especially by adding another material to it（加固；使更结实）；to send more people or equipment in order to make an army, etc. stronger（给 … 加强力量（或装备）；使更强大）

reinforcement.meaning: extra soldiers or police officers who are sent to a place because more are needed（援军；增援警力）；the act of making sth stronger, especially a feeling or an idea（（感情或思想等的）巩固，加强，强化）

reiterate.meaning: to repeat sth that you have already said, especially to emphasize it（反复地说；重申）；re·iter·ation reiteration reiterations /riˌɪtəˈreɪʃn; NAmEriˌɪtəˈreɪʃn/ noun [sing.] a reiteration of her previous statement（重申她说过的话）

reject.meaning: to refuse to accept or consider sth（拒绝接受；不予考虑）；to refuse to accept sb for a job, position, etc.（拒收；不录用；拒绝接纳）；to decide not to use, sell, publish, etc. sth because its quality is not good enough（（因质量差）不用，不出售，不出版）；(of the body（身体）

rejoice.meaning: to express great happiness about sth（非常高兴；深感欣喜）；(BrE) (humorous) to have a name that sounds funny（有个滑稽的名字）

rejoin.meaning: to join sb/sth again after leaving them（重新加入；和 … 重新在一起）；(formal) to say sth as an answer, especially sth quick, critical or amusing（回答；反驳）

relapse.meaning: the fact of becoming ill/sick again after making an improvement（旧病复发）；to go back into a previous condition or into a worse state after making an improvement（退回原状；（好转后）再倒退）

relate.meaning: show or make a connection between two or more things（联系；使有联系；把 … 联系起来）；(formal) to give a spoken or written report of sth; to tell a story（叙述；讲述；讲（故事））；to be connected with sth/sb; to refer to sth/sb（涉及；与 … 相关；谈到）；to be able to understand and have sympathy with sb/sth（能够理解并同情；了解；体恤）

related.meaning: connected with sth/sb in some way（相关的；有联系的）；in the same family（属同一家族的；有亲属关系的）；belonging to the same group（属于同一种类的；同一组别的）

relation.meaning: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other（（人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系，交往）；the way in which two or more things are connected（（事物之间的）关系，关联，联系）；a person who is in the same family as sb else（亲戚；亲属）

relational.meaning: existing or considered in relation to sth else（有关的；相关的）

relationship.meaning: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other（（人、团体、国家之间的）关系，联系）；a loving and/or sexual friendship between two people（情爱关系；性爱关系）；the way in which two or more things are connected（（事物之间的）关联，联系，关系）；the way in which a person is related to sb else in a family（血缘关系；姻亲关系）

relax.meaning: to rest while you are doing sth enjoyable, especially after work or effort（放松；休息）；to become or make sb become calmer and less worried（宽慰；（使）冷静，放心，镇定）；to become or make sth become less tight or stiff（（使）放松，松懈；松开）；to allow rules, laws, etc. to become less strict（放宽（限制等））

relaxed.meaning: (of a person（人）；calm and not anxious or worried（放松的；冷静的；镇定的）；(of a place（地方）；calm and informal（安静的；自在的）

relaxing.meaning: helping you to rest and become less anxious（有助于休息的；令人放松的；轻松的）

relevant.meaning: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are thinking about（紧密相关的；切题的）；having ideas that are valuable and useful to people in their lives and work（有价值的；有意义的）；rele·vance AW /ˈreləvəns; NAmEˈreləvəns/ noun [U] I don't see the relevance of your question.（我不懂你这个问题有什么意义。）；rele·vant·ly /ˈreləvəntli; NAmEˈreləvəntli/ adv. reliance.meaning: the state of needing sb/sth in order to survive, be successful, etc; the fact of being able to rely on sb/sth（依赖；依靠；信任）

reliant.meaning: needing sb/sth in order to survive, be successful, etc.（依赖性的；依靠的）

relic.meaning: an object, a tradition, a system, etc. that has survived from the past（遗物；遗迹；遗风；遗俗）；a part of the body or clothing of a holy person, or sth that they owned, that is kept after their death and respected as a religious object（圣髑；圣骨；圣人遗物）

relief.meaning: the feeling of happiness that you have when sth unpleasant stops or does not happen（（不快过后的）宽慰，轻松；解脱）；the act of removing or reducing pain, anxiety, etc.（（焦虑、痛苦等的）减轻，消除，缓和）；food, money, medicine, etc. that is given to help people in places where there has been a war or natural disaster（（给灾区或交战地区人民提供的）救济，救援物品）；(especially NAmE) financial help given by the government to people who need it（救济金）

relieve.meaning: to remove or reduce an unpleasant feeling or pain（解除，减轻，缓和（不快或痛苦））；to make a problem less serious（减轻（问题的严重性）；缓和；缓解）；to make sth less boring, especially by introducing sth different（调剂；使有趣）；to replace sb who is on duty（接替；给 … 换班）

relocate.meaning: (especially of a company or workers（尤指公司或工人）；to move or to move sb/sth to a new place to work or operate（（使）搬迁，迁移）；re·loca·tion AW relocation relocations /ˌriːləʊˈkeɪʃn; NAmEˌriːloʊˈkeɪʃn/ noun [U] relocation costs（搬迁费用）

reluctant.meaning: hesitating before doing sth because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do（不情愿的；勉强的）；re·luc·tance AW /rɪˈlʌktəns; NAmErɪˈlʌktəns/ noun [U, sing.] reluctance~ (to do sth) There is still some reluctance on the part of employers to become involved in this project.（雇主们仍然不太愿意涉足这项计划。）；re·luc·tant·ly AW /rɪˈlʌktəntli; NAmErɪˈlʌktəntli/ adv. rely.meaning: to need or depend on sb/sth（依赖；依靠）；to trust or have faith in sb/sth（信任；信赖）

remember.meaning: to have or keep an image in your memory of an event, a person, a place, etc. from the past（回想起；记得；记起）；to bring back to your mind a fact, piece of information, etc. that you knew（想起；记起）；to keep an important fact in your mind（记住；把 … 牢记在心）；to not forget to do sth; to actually do what you have to do（记着，不忘（去做）；动手做（必须做的事））

remorse.meaning: the feeling of being extremely sorry for sth wrong or bad that you have done（懊悔；非常遗憾；自责）

removal.meaning: the act of taking sb/sth away from a particular place（移动；调动；去除）；the act of getting rid of sth（除去；消除；清除）；the act of dismissing sb from their job（免职；解职）；(BrE) an act of taking furniture, etc. from one house to another（搬迁；迁移）

restrain.meaning: to stop sb/sth from doing sth, especially by using physical force（（尤指用武力）制止，阻止，管制）；to stop yourself from feeling an emotion or doing sth that you would like to do（约束（自己）；控制（自己）；忍住）；to stop sth that is growing or increasing from becoming too large（抑制；控制）

restriction.meaning: a rule or law that limits what you can do or what can happen（限制规定；限制法规）；the act of limiting or controlling sb/sth（限制；约束）；a thing that limits the amount of freedom you have（制约因素）

retail.meaning: the selling of goods to the public, usually through shops/stores（零售）；to sell goods to the public, usually through shops/stores（零售）；(business 商) to be sold at a particular price（以 … 价格销售）；(formal) to tell people about sth, especially about a person's behaviour or private life（详说，述说（尤指别人的事情））

revolve.meaning: to go in a circle around a central point（旋转；环绕；转动）；to move around sth in a circle（绕 … 旋转（或做圆周运动））；to have sb/sth as the main interest or subject（围绕；以 … 为中心；将 … 作为主要兴趣（或主题））

rheumatism.meaning: a disease that makes the muscles and joints painful, stiff and swollen（风湿（病））；rheum·at·ic /ruˈmætɪk; NAmEruˈmætɪk/ adj. rheumatic pains（风湿痛）

rhinoceros.meaning: a large heavy animal with very thick skin and either one or two horns on its nose, that lives in Africa and Asia（犀，犀牛（栖于非洲和亚洲））
