ribbon.meaning: a narrow strip of material, used to tie things or for decoration（（用于捆绑或装饰的）带子；丝带）；something that is long and narrow in shape（带状物；狭长的东西）；a ribbon in special colours, or tied in a special way, that is given to sb as a prize or as a military honour, or that is worn by sb to show that they belong to a particular political party（绶带；勋带）；a long strip of material containing ink that you put into typewriters and some computer printers（（打字机或打印机的）色带）

rice.meaning: short, narrow white or brown grain grown on wet land in hot countries as food; the plant that produces this grain（大米；稻米；稻）

rich.meaning: having a lot of money or property（富有的；富裕的）；people who have a lot of money or property（富人；有钱人）；(of a country（国家）；producing a lot of wealth so that many of its people can live at a high standard（富庶的；富饶的）

richly.meaning: in a beautiful and expensive manner（富丽堂皇地）；used to express the fact that sth has a pleasant strong colour, taste or smell（（色彩）鲜艳富丽地；（口味）醇美地；（气味）浓郁芬芳地）；in a generous way（慷慨地；大方地）；in a way that people think is right and good（恰如其分地；理所当然地；完全地）

richness.meaning: the state of being rich in sth, such as colour, minerals or interesting qualities（丰富；富饶；浓烈）

rickety.meaning: not strong or well made; likely to break（不结实的；不稳固的；易折断的）

rid.meaning: (formal) to be free of sb/sth that has been annoying you or that you do not want（摆脱）；to make yourself free of sb/sth that is annoying you or that you do not want; to throw sth away（摆脱；丢弃；扔掉）；(formal) to remove sth that is causing a problem from a place, group, etc.（去除；清除）；(formal) to make yourself free from sb/sth that is annoying you or causing you a problem（摆脱；从 … 中解脱）

riddle.meaning: a question that is difficult to understand, and that has a surprising answer, that you ask sb as a game（谜；谜语）；a mysterious event or situation that you cannot explain（神秘事件；无法解释的情况）；to make a lot of holes in sb/sth（使布满窟窿）；to be full of sth, especially sth bad or unpleasant（充满；充斥）

ride.meaning: to sit on a horse, etc. and control it as it moves（驾驭马匹；骑马）；to spend time riding a horse for pleasure（骑马（消遣））；to sit on and control a bicycle, motorcycle, etc.（骑；驾驶）；to travel in a vehicle, especially as a passenger（搭乘；乘坐）

rider.meaning: a person who rides a horse, bicycle or motorcycle（骑手；骑马（或自行车、摩托车）的人）；an extra piece of information that is added to an official document（公文的附加材料；附文）

ridge.meaning: a narrow area of high land along the top of a line of hills; a high pointed area near the top of a mountain（山脊；山脉）；a raised line on the surface of sth; the point where two sloping surfaces join（隆起；脊；垄）；(technical 术语) a long narrow area of high pressure in the atmosphere（（大气层的）高压脊，高压带）；to make narrow raised lines or areas on the surface of sth（使隆起；使形成脊状）

ridicule.meaning: unkind comments that make fun of sb/sth or make them look silly（嘲笑；奚落；讥笑）；to make sb/sth look silly by laughing at them or it in an unkind way（嘲笑；奚落；讥笑）

ridiculous.meaning: very silly or unreasonable（愚蠢的；荒谬的；荒唐的）；ri·dicu·lous·ly /rɪˈdɪkjələsli; NAmErɪˈdɪkjələsli/ adv. The meal was ridiculously expensive.（这顿饭贵得离谱。）

riding.meaning: the sport or activity of riding horses（骑马）；one of the three former parts of the English county of Yorkshire called the East Riding, the North Riding and the West Riding（区（英格兰约克郡以前的东、西、北三个行政分区之一））

rifle.meaning: a gun with a long barrel which you hold to your shoulder to fire（步枪；来复枪）；to search quickly through sth in order to find or steal sth（快速搜寻；匆忙翻找）；to steal sth from somewhere（偷窃；盗取）；to kick a ball very hard and straight in a game of football (soccer)（猛踢（足球））

rift.meaning: a serious disagreement between people that stops their relationship from continuing（分裂；分歧；严重不和）；a large crack or opening in the ground, rocks or clouds（断裂；裂缝；裂口）

rig.meaning: to arrange or influence sth in a dishonest way in order to get the result that you want（（以不正当的手段）操纵，控制）；to provide a ship or boat with ropes, sails, etc; to fit the sails, etc. in position（（给船只）装帆，提供索具）；to fit equipment somewhere, sometimes secretly（（秘密地）安装，装配）；(old-fashioned) to provide sb/sth with a particular kind of clothes or equipment（给 … 提供（服装或设备））

right.meaning: morally good or acceptable; correct according to law or a person's duty（正当；妥当）；true or correct as a fact（正确的；真正的；真实的）；correct for a particular situation or thing, or for a particular person（适当的；正好的；恰当的）；correct in your opinion or judgement（（意见或判断）准确，确切，恰当）

righteous.meaning: morally right and good（公正的；正直的；正当的）；that you think is morally acceptable or fair（正当的；公平合理的；正义的）

right-hand.meaning: on the right side of sth（右手的；右边的；右面的）；intended for use by your right hand（右手的；供右手用的）

right-handed.meaning: a person who is right-handed uses their right hand for writing, using tools, etc.（惯用右手的）；a right-handed tool is designed to be used with the right hand（供右手使用的）

rightly.meaning: for a good reason（正当地；理由充分地）；in a correct or accurate way（正确地；恰当地；精确地）

rigid.meaning: (of rules, methods, etc.（规则、方法等）；very strict and difficult to change（死板的；僵硬的）；(of a person（人）；not willing to change their ideas or behaviour（固执的；僵化的；一成不变的）

rigorous.meaning: done carefully and with a lot of attention to detail（谨慎的；细致的；彻底的）；demanding that particular rules, processes, etc. are strictly followed（严格的；严厉的）；rig·or·ous·ly /ˈrɪɡərəsli; NAmEˈrɪɡərəsli/ adv. The country's press is rigorously controlled.（这个国家的新闻出版事业受到严格控制。）

rim.meaning: the edge of sth in the shape of a circle（（圆形物体的）边沿）；the metal edge of a wheel onto which the tyre is fixed（轮辋；轮圈）；having a particular type of rim（有 … 框（或边）的）；(formal) to form an edge around sth（形成 … 的边沿；给 … 镶边）

ring.meaning: a piece of jewellery that you wear on your finger, consisting of a round band of gold, silver, etc., sometimes decorated with precious stones（戒指；指环）；an object in the shape of a circle with a large hole in the middle（环状物；圈形的东西）；a round mark or shape（圆形标记；圆形）；a confined area in which animals or people perform or compete, with seats around the outside for the audience（圆形表演场（或竞技场））

rinse.meaning: to wash sth with clean water only, not using soap（（用清水）冲洗，洗涮）；to remove the soap from sth with clean water after washing it（冲掉 … 的皂液；漂洗；清洗）；to remove dirt, etc. from sth by washing it with clean water（（用清水）冲掉，洗刷）；to make sth clean, especially a container, by washing it with water（冲洗，洗刷干净（容器等））

riot.meaning: a situation in which a group of people behave in a violent way in a public place, often as a protest（暴乱；骚乱）；(formal) a collection of a lot of different types of the same thing（丰富多彩；品种繁多）；(old-fashioned, informal) a person or an event that is very amusing and enjoyable（非常有趣的人（或事））；(of people（人）

riotous.meaning: (formal or law 律) noisy and/or violent, especially in a public place（骚乱的；暴乱的）；noisy, exciting and enjoyable in an uncontrolled way（狂欢的；纵情欢闹的）

rip.meaning: rest in peace (often written on graves)（安息（通常书于墓碑））

ripe.meaning: (of fruit or crops（水果或庄稼）；fully grown and ready to be eaten（成熟的）；(of cheese or wine（干酪或果酒）；having a flavour that has fully developed（口味浓郁的；成熟的；醇美可口的）

ripen.meaning: to become ripe; to make sth ripe（（使）成熟）

ripple.meaning: a small wave on the surface of a liquid, especially water in a lake, etc.（波纹；细浪；涟漪）；a thing that looks or moves like a small wave（（外观或运动）如波纹的东西）；a sound that gradually becomes louder and then quieter again（起伏的声音）；a feeling that gradually spreads through a person or group of people（逐渐扩散的感觉）

rise.meaning: an increase in an amount, a number or a level（（数量或水平的）增加，提高）；an increase in the money you are paid for the work you do（加薪；工资增长）；the act of becoming more important, successful, powerful, etc.（（重要性、优势、权力等的）增强）；an upward movement（上升）

risk.meaning: the possibility of sth bad happening at some time in the future; a situation that could be dangerous or have a bad result（危险；风险）；a person or thing that is likely to cause problems or danger at some time in the future（危险人物；会带来风险的事物）；a person or business that a bank or an insurance company is willing/unwilling to lend money or sell insurance to because they are likely/unlikely to pay back the money etc.（（风险很小/很大的）借款人，保险对象）；in danger of sth unpleasant or harmful happening（有危险；冒风险）

risky.meaning: involving the possibility of sth bad happening（有危险（或风险）的）

rite.meaning: a ceremony performed by a particular group of people, often for religious purposes（（宗教等的）仪式，典礼）

ritual.meaning: a series of actions that are always performed in the same way, especially as part of a religious ceremony（程序；仪规；礼节；（尤指）宗教仪式）；something that is done regularly and always in the same way（习惯；老规矩）；done as part of a ritual or ceremony（仪式上的；庆典的）；always done or said in the same way, especially when this is not sincere（习惯的；老套的；例行公事的）

ritualize.meaning: (formal) to do sth in the same way or pattern every time（使仪式化；使程式化）

rival.meaning: a person, company, or thing that competes with another in sport, business, etc.（竞争对手）；rival adj. [only before noun] a rival bid/claim/offer（竞标；对立的权利要求；竞价）；to be as good, impressive, etc. as sb/sth else（与 … 相匹敌；比得上）

rivalry.meaning: a state in which two people, companies, etc. are competing for the same thing（竞争；竞赛；较量）

river.meaning: a natural flow of water that continues in a long line across land to the sea/ocean（河；江）；a large amount of liquid that is flowing in a particular direction（（液体）涌流）

riverbank.meaning: the ground at the side of a river（河岸；河堤）

rivet.meaning: a metal pin that is used to fasten two pieces of leather, metal, etc. together（铆钉）；to hold sb's interest or attention so completely that they cannot look away or think of anything else（吸引住）；to fasten sth with rivets（铆接；（用铆钉）固定）；to be so shocked or frightened that you cannot move（吓呆了；呆若木鸡）

road.meaning: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on（路；道路；公路）；used in names of roads, especially in towns（（用于道路名称，尤指城镇的）路）；the way to achieving sth（途径；方法；路子）；at some time in the future（今后；在将来）

roadway.meaning: a road or the part of a road used by vehicles（道路；车行道）

roam.meaning: to walk or travel around an area without any definite aim or direction（徜徉；闲逛；漫步）；(of the eyes or hands（眼睛或手）；to move slowly over every part of sb/sth（（缓慢地）扫遍，摸遍）

roar.meaning: to make a very loud, deep sound（吼叫；咆哮）；to shout sth very loudly（叫喊；大声地说）；to laugh very loudly（放声大笑）；(of a vehicle or its rider/driver（车辆或驾驶者）

roast.meaning: to cook food, especially meat, without liquid in an oven or over a fire; to be cooked in this way（烘，烤，焙（肉等））；to cook nuts, beans, etc. in order to dry them and turn them brown; to be cooked in this way（烘烤，焙，炒（坚果、豆子等））；(informal or humorous) to be very angry with sb; to criticize sb strongly（（对某人）非常生气，严厉批评）；(informal) to become or to make sth become very hot in the sun or by a fire（曝晒；烘烤）

rob.meaning: to steal money or property from a person or place（抢劫；掠夺；盗取）；(informal) to cheat or trick sb so that they lose a lot of money（骗取某人大量钱财）；(NAmE) (informal) to have a sexual relationship with a much younger person（老牛吃嫩草，劫摇篮（指跟比自己年龄小很多的人发生性关系））；(saying) to borrow money from one person to pay back what you owe to another person; to take money from one thing to use for sth else（借新债还旧账；拆东墙补西墙）

robber.meaning: a person who steals from a person or place, especially using violence or threats（强盗；盗贼；抢劫犯）

robbery.meaning: the crime of stealing money or goods from a bank, shop/store, person, etc., especially using violence or threats（盗窃；抢劫；掠夺）

robe.meaning: a long loose outer piece of clothing, especially one worn as a sign of rank or office at a special ceremony（袍服，礼袍（常于典礼中穿着以显示身分））；(formal) to dress sb/yourself in long loose clothes or in the way mentioned（（给某人）穿上礼袍）

robin.meaning: a small brown European bird with a red breast（欧亚鸲；欧洲知更鸟）；a grey American bird with a red breast, larger than a European robin（旅鸫，美洲知更鸟（毛灰色，胸部红色，比欧亚鸲大））

robot.meaning: a machine that can perform a complicated series of tasks automatically（机器人；机械人）；(especially in stories) a machine that is made to look like a human and that can do some things that a human can do（（尤指故事中的）机器人，机械人）；(SAfrE) a traffic light（交通信号灯）

robotic.meaning: connected with robots（机器人的）；like a robot, making stiff movements, speaking without feeling or expression, etc.（像机器人的；呆板机械的）

robust.meaning: strong and healthy（强健的；强壮的）；strong; able to survive being used a lot and not likely to break（结实的；耐用的；坚固的）；(of a system or an organization（体制或机构）；strong and not likely to fail or become weak（强劲的；富有活力的）

rock.meaning: the hard solid material that forms part of the surface of the earth and some other planets（岩石）；a mass of rock standing above the earth's surface or in the sea/ocean（石山；礁石）；a large single piece of rock（巨石块；岩块）；(NAmE) a small stone（碎石；石子；小石块）

rocket.meaning: a spacecraft in the shape of a tube that is driven by a stream of gases let out behind it when fuel is burned inside（火箭）；a missile (= a weapon that travels through the air) that carries a bomb and is driven by a stream of burning gases（火箭武器；火箭（弹））；a firework that goes high into the air and then explodes with coloured lights（焰火；烟花）；a plant with long green leaves that have a strong flavour and are eaten raw in salads（大蒜芥；芝麻菜；紫花南芥）

rocky.meaning: made of rock; full of rocks（岩石的；多岩石的）；difficult and not certain to continue or to be successful（困难的；难以维持的；不稳定的）

rod.meaning: (often used in compounds（常用于构成复合词）；a long straight piece of wood, metal or glass（杆；竿；棒）；(old-fashioned) a stick that is used for hitting people as a punishment（（责打人用的）棍棒）；(NAmE) (slang) a small gun（手枪）

rodent.meaning: any small animal that belongs to a group of animals with strong sharp front teeth. Mice, rats and squirrels are all rodents.（啮齿动物）

rodeo.meaning: a public competition, especially in the US, in which people show their skill at riding wild horses and catching cattle with ropes（（尤指美国的）牛仔竞技比赛）

roe.meaning: the mass of eggs inside a female fish (hard roe) or the sperm of a male fish (soft roe), used as food（鱼子）

role.meaning: the function or position that sb has or is expected to have in an organization, in society or in a relationship（职能；地位；角色）；an actor's part in a play, film/movie, etc.（（演员的）角色）；the degree to which sb/sth is involved in a situation or an activity and the effect that they have on it（影响程度；作用）

roll.meaning: a long piece of paper, cloth, film, etc. that has been wrapped around itself or a tube several times so that it forms the shape of a tube（卷；卷轴）；(NAmE) a paper tube wrapped around sweets/candy, etc.（一管）；a small loaf of bread for one person（小面包条；小圆面包）；an act of rolling the body over and over（翻滚；打滚）

roller.meaning: a piece of wood, metal or plastic, shaped like a tube, that rolls over and over and is used in machines, for example to make sth flat, or to move sth（滚筒；滚轴）；(often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a machine or piece of equipment with a part shaped like a tube so that it rolls backwards and forwards. It may be used for making sth flat, crushing or spreading sth.（碾轧机；碾子）；a piece of wood or metal, shaped like a tube, that is used for moving heavy objects（滚轴；滚柱）

roman.meaning: connected with ancient Rome or the Roman Empire（古罗马的；古罗马帝国的）；connected with the modern city of Rome（罗马的；罗马城的）；connected with the Roman Catholic Church（天主教的）；roman type is ordinary printing type which does not lean forward（罗马体的；西文白正体的）

romance.meaning: Romance languages, such as French, Italian and Spanish, are languages that developed from Latin（罗曼语的（由拉丁语演变而成，如法语、意大利语、西班牙语等））

romantic.meaning: connected or concerned with love or a sexual relationship（浪漫的；爱情的；情爱的）；(of people（人）；showing feelings of love（多情的；表达爱情的）；beautiful in a way that makes you think of love or feel strong emotions（浪漫的；富有情调的；美妙的）

romanticism.meaning: a style and movement in art, music and literature in the late 18th and early 19th century, in which strong feelings, imagination and a return to nature were more important than reason, order and intellectual ideas（浪漫主义（18 世纪末 19 世纪初盛行于艺术、音乐及文学领域，以情感强烈、想像和回归自然为特征））；the quality of seeing people, events and situations as more exciting and interesting than they really are（浪漫精神；浪漫的态度）；strong feelings of love; the fact of showing emotion, affection, etc.（强烈的爱情；情感的表达）

romanticize.meaning: to make sth seem more attractive or interesting than it really is（使浪漫化；使传奇化；使更加富有吸引力）

rome.meaning: (saying) used to say that a complicated task will take a long time and needs patience（罗马不是一天建成的；复杂的工作不会一蹴而就）；(saying) used to say that when you are in a foreign country, or a situation you are not familiar with, you should behave in the way that the people around you behave（入乡随俗）

roof.meaning: the structure that covers or forms the top of a building or vehicle（顶部；屋顶；车顶）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type of roof mentioned（有 … 顶的）；the top of an underground space such as a tunnel or cave（洞顶；隧道顶）

rooftop.meaning: the outside part of the roof of a building（屋顶外部；外屋顶）；to talk about sth in a very public way（公开谈论）

rook.meaning: a large black bird of the crow family. Rooks build their nests in groups at the tops of trees.（秃鼻乌鸦）

room.meaning: a part of a building that has its own walls, floor and ceiling and is usually used for a particular purpose（房间；室）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the number of rooms mentioned（有 … 室的；有 … 个房间的）；a bedroom in a hotel, etc.（客房）

roost.meaning: a place where birds sleep（（鸟类的）栖息处）；(of birds（鸟类）；to rest or go to sleep somewhere（栖息）

rooster.meaning: an adult male chicken（公鸡；雄鸡）

root.meaning: the part of a plant that grows under the ground and absorbs water and minerals that it sends to the rest of the plant（根；根茎）；the part of a hair, tooth, nail or tongue that attaches it to the rest of the body（根；根部）；the main cause of sth, such as a problem or difficult situation（根源；起因）；the origin or basis of sth（起源；基础；根基）

rootless.meaning: having nowhere that you really think of as home, or as the place where you belong（无根的；没有归宿的；漂泊的）

rope.meaning: very strong thick string made by twisting thinner strings, wires, etc. together（粗绳；线缆；绳索）；the fence made of rope that is around the edge of the area where a boxing or wrestling match takes place（（拳击或摔跤场四周的）围绳，圈绳）；a number of similar things attached together by a string or thread（串在一起的相似的东西）；to allow sb freedom to do what they want, especially in the hope that they will make a mistake or look silly（放任自由，任其为所欲为（使其犯错误或出丑））

rose.meaning: a flower with a sweet smell that grows on a bush with thorns (= sharp points) on its stems（玫瑰（花）；蔷薇（花））；a pink colour（粉红色）；a piece of metal or plastic with small holes in it that is attached to the end of a pipe or watering can so that the water comes out in a fine spray when you are watering plants（（水管或喷壶的）莲蓬式喷嘴）；(of a situation（形势）

rosy.meaning: pink and pleasant in appearance（粉红色的；红润的）；likely to be good or successful（美好的；乐观的）

rot.meaning: to decay, or make sth decay, naturally and gradually（（使）腐烂，腐败变质）；the process or state of decaying and falling apart（腐烂；腐败变质）；used to describe the fact that a situation is getting worse（形势恶化）；(old-fashioned) (BrE) nonsense; silly things that sb says（废话；胡说）

rotary.meaning: (of a movement（运动）；moving in a circle around a central fixed point（旋转的；绕轴转动的）；(of a machine or piece of equipment（机器或设备）；having parts that move in this way（转动的）

rotate.meaning: to move or turn around a central fixed point; to make sth do this（（使）旋转，转动）；if a job rotates, or if people rotate a job, they regularly change the job or regularly change who does the job（（工作）由 … 轮值；（人员）轮换，轮值）；ro·tat·ing /rəʊˈteɪtɪŋ; NAmEˈroʊteɪtɪŋ/ adj. [only before noun] rotating parts（旋转的部件）

rotation.meaning: the action of an object moving in a circle around a central fixed point（旋转；转动）；one complete movement in a circle around a fixed point（（旋转的）一周，一圈）；the act of regularly changing the thing that is being used in a particular situation, or of changing the person who does a particular job（轮换；交替；换班）

rote.meaning: (often used as an adjective（常用作形容词）；the process of learning sth by repeating it until you remember it rather than by understanding the meaning of it（死记硬背）

rotten.meaning: (of food, wood, etc.（食物、树木等）；that has decayed and cannot be eaten or used（腐烂的；腐败的；腐朽的）；(informal) very bad（非常糟糕的；恶劣的）；(informal) dishonest（不诚实的；腐败的）

rough.meaning: having a surface that is not even or regular（粗糙的；不平滑的；高低不平的）；not exact; not including all details（不确切的；粗略的；大致的）；not gentle or careful; violent（粗暴的；粗野的；猛烈的）；where there is a lot of violence or crime（犯罪盛行的；充斥暴力的；危险的）

roughly.meaning: approximately but not exactly（大约；大致；差不多）；using force or not being careful and gentle（粗暴地；粗鲁地）；in a way that does not leave a smooth surface（粗糙地；凹凸不平地）

round.meaning: shaped like a circle or a ball（圆形的；环形的；球形的）；having a curved shape（弧形的；圆弧的）；a round figure or amount is one that is given as a whole number, usually one ending in 0 or 5（整数的；尾数是 0（或 5）的）；round·ness /raʊndnəs; NAmEraʊndnəs/ noun [U] His face had lost its boyish roundness.（他的脸已不是小时候那副圆圆的娃娃脸了。）

roundabout.meaning: a place where two or more roads meet, forming a circle that all traffic must go around in the same direction（（交通）环岛）；a round platform for children to play on in a park, etc. that is pushed round while the children are sitting on it（（游乐设施）旋转平台）；not done or said using the shortest, simplest or most direct way possible（迂回的；间接的；兜圈子的）

rounded.meaning: having a round shape（圆形的）；having a wide variety of qualities that combine to produce sth pleasant, complete and balanced（全面的；一应俱全的；完善的）；(of a speech sound（语音）；produced with the lips in a narrow round position（圆唇的）

rouse.meaning: (formal) to wake sb up, especially when they are sleeping deeply（唤醒；使醒来）；to make sb want to start doing sth when they were not active or interested in doing it（使活跃起来；使产生兴趣）；(formal) to make sb feel a particular emotion（激起（某种情感））；to make sb angry, excited or full of emotion（激怒；使激动）

route.meaning: a way that you follow to get from one place to another（路线；路途）；a fixed way along which a bus, train, etc. regularly travels or goods are regularly sent（（公共汽车和列车等的）常规路线，固定线路）；a particular way of achieving sth（途径；渠道）；used before the number of a main road in the US（（用于美国干线公路号码前））

routine.meaning: the normal order and way in which you regularly do things（常规；正常顺序）；(disapproving) a situation in which life is boring because things are always done in the same way（生活乏味；无聊）；a series of movements, jokes, etc. that are part of a performance（（演出中的）一套动作，一系列笑话（等））；(computing 计) a list of instructions that enable a computer to perform a particular task（例行程序；例程）

row.meaning: a number of people standing or sitting next to each other in a line; a number of objects arranged in a line（一排；一列；一行）；a line of seats in a cinema/movie theater, etc.（（剧院、电影院等的）一排座位）；a complete line of stitches in knitting or crochet（（编织中的）针行，一整行）；used in the name of some roads（（用于某些道路名称））

royal.meaning: connected with or belonging to the king or queen of a country（国王的；女王的；皇家的；王室的）；used in the names of organizations that serve or are supported by a king or queen（（用于服务于国王或女王或受其赞助的组织名称））；impressive; suitable for a king or queen（庄严的；盛大的；高贵的；适合国王（或女王）的）；(informal) a member of a royal family（王室成员）

royalty.meaning: one or more members of a royal family（王室成员）；a sum of money that is paid to sb who has written a book, piece of music, etc. each time that it is sold or performed（版税）；a sum of money that is paid by an oil or mining company to the owner of the land that they are working on（矿区土地使用费（由采矿或石油公司等付给土地所有人））

rub.meaning: to move your hand, or sth such as a cloth, backwards and forwards over a surface while pressing firmly（擦；磨；搓）；to press two surfaces against each other and move them backwards and forwards; to be pressed together and move in this way（（使）相互磨擦；搓）；(of a surface（表面）；to move backwards and forwards many times against sth while pressing it, especially causing pain or damage（磨，摩擦（尤指引起疼痛或损害））

rubber.meaning: a strong substance that can be stretched and does not allow liquids to pass through it, used for making tyres, boots, etc. It is made from the liquid (= sap) inside a tropical plant or is produced using chemicals.（橡胶）；a small piece of rubber or a similar substance, used for removing pencil marks from paper; a piece of soft material used for removing chalk marks from a blackboard（橡皮；黑板擦）；(in some card games or sports) a competition consisting of a series of games or matches between the same teams or players（（某些纸牌游戏或体育运动中相同的对手或队伍间）多轮决胜负的比赛）；(NAmE) the point at which sth is tested and you really find out whether it is successful or true（接受考验的时刻；检验成败的时刻；检验真伪的时刻）

rubbish.meaning: (especially BrE) things that you throw away because you no longer want or need them（垃圾；废弃物）；(BrE, informal) (also used as an adjective（也用作形容词）；something that you think is of poor quality（劣质的东西）；(BrE) (informal) comments, ideas, etc. that you think are stupid or wrong（废话；瞎说）

rubble.meaning: broken stones or bricks from a building or wall that has been destroyed or damaged（碎石；碎砖）

rubric.meaning: a title or set of instructions written in a book, an exam paper, etc.（（书本或试卷等上的）标题，提示，说明）

ruby.meaning: a dark red precious stone（红宝石）；a dark red colour（深红色）；ruby adj. ruby lips（深红色的嘴唇）

rude.meaning: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings（粗鲁的；无礼的；粗野的）；connected with sex or the body in a way that people find offensive or embarrassing（猥亵的；下流的）；(formal) sudden, unpleasant and unexpected（突然的；突如其来的；猛烈的）；(literary) made in a simple, basic way（简单的；粗糙的；原始的）

rudely.meaning: in a way that shows a lack of respect for other people and their feelings（粗鲁地；无礼地）；in a way that is sudden, unpleasant and unexpected（突然地；猛烈地；突如其来地）

rudimentary.meaning: (formal) dealing with only the most basic matters or ideas（基础的；基本的）；(formal or technical 术语) not highly or fully developed（未充分发展的；原始的）

ruffle.meaning: to disturb the smooth surface of sth, so that it is not even（弄皱；弄乱；使不平整）；to make sb annoyed, worried or upset（搅扰；激怒；使沮丧；使担心）；(informal) to annoy or upset sb or a group of people（激怒；骚扰；使不安）；a strip of cloth that is sewn in folds and is used to decorate a piece of clothing at the neck or wrists（（领口、袖口等的）褶饰，花边，荷叶边）

rug.meaning: a piece of thick material like a small carpet that is used for covering or decorating part of a floor（小地毯；垫子）；(BrE) a piece of thick warm material, like a blanket, that is used for wrapping around your legs to keep warm（（盖腿的）厚毯子）

rugged.meaning: (of the landscape（地形）；not level or smooth and having rocks rather than plants or trees（崎岖的；凹凸不平的；多岩石的）；(of a man's face（男人的脸）；having strong, attractive features（强健而富有魅力的；粗犷的）

ruin.meaning: to damage sth so badly that it loses all its value, pleasure, etc; to spoil sth（毁坏；破坏；糟蹋）；to make sb/sth lose all their money, their position, etc.（使破产（或失去地位等）；毁灭）；the state or process of being destroyed or severely damaged（毁坏；破坏；毁灭）；the fact of having no money, of having lost your job, position, etc.（破产；一无所有；失去工作（或地位等））

ruined.meaning: (of a building, town, etc.（建筑、城镇等）；destroyed or severely damaged so that only parts remain（毁坏的；严重受损的）

ruinous.meaning: costing a lot of money and more than you can afford（耗资巨大的；无法承担的）；causing serious problems or damage（破坏性的；导致严重问题的；灾难性的）；(of a town, building, etc.（城镇、建筑等）；destroyed or severely damaged（破败的；严重受损的；已成废墟的）

rule.meaning: a statement of what may, must or must not be done in a particular situation or when playing a game（规则；规章；条例）；a statement of what you are advised to do in a particular situation（建议；应做之事）；a habit; the normal state of things; what is true in most cases（习惯；常规；惯常的做法）；a statement of what is possible according to a particular system, for example the grammar of a language（定律；规则）

ruler.meaning: a person who rules or governs（统治者；支配者）；a straight strip of wood, plastic or metal, marked in centimetres or inches, used for measuring or for drawing straight lines（直尺）

ruling.meaning: an official decision made by sb in a position of authority, especially a judge（裁决；裁定；判决）；having control over a particular group, country, etc.（统治的；支配的；占统治地位的）

rumble.meaning: to make a long deep sound or series of sounds（发出持续而低沉的声音；发出隆隆声）；to move slowly and heavily, making a rumbling sound（轰鸣着缓慢行进）；(BrE) (informal) to discover the truth about sb or what they are trying to hide（发现 … 的真相；看穿（阴谋））；(of a gang of young people（一伙年轻人）

ruminant.meaning: any animal that brings back food from its stomach and chews it again. Cows and sheep are both ruminants.（反刍动物）；ru·min·ant adj. ruminant animals（反刍动物）

ruminate.meaning: (formal) to think deeply about sth（沉思；认真思考）

rumour.meaning: a piece of information, or a story, that people talk about, but that may not be true（谣言；传闻）；to be reported as a rumour and possibly not true（谣传；传说）；ru·moured /; NAmE/ adj. [only before noun] He denied his father's rumoured love affair.（他否认他父亲被谣传的风流韵事。）

run.meaning: to move using your legs, going faster than when you walk（跑；奔跑）；In spoken English run can be used with and plus another verb, instead of with to and the infinitive, especially to tell somebody to hurry and do something.（在英语口语中，run 可以和 and 加另一个动词连用，而不和 to 加动词不定式连用，尤用于叫某人赶快去做某事）；to travel a particular distance by running（跑（某段距离））；to run as a sport（跑步；做跑步运动）

runner.meaning: a person or an animal that runs, especially one taking part in a race（奔跑的人，奔跑的动物（尤指参加速度比赛者））；(especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a person who takes goods illegally into or out of a place（走私者；偷运者）；a strip of metal, plastic or wood that sth slides on or can move along on（（金属、塑料或木制的）条状滑行装置）

running.meaning: the action or sport of running（跑；跑步（运动））；the activity of managing or operating sth（管理；操纵；操作）；(in compounds（构成复合词）；the activity of bringing sth such as drugs, guns, etc. into a country secretly and illegally（走私；偷运）

runway.meaning: a long narrow strip of ground with a hard surface that an aircraft takes off from and lands on（飞机跑道）

rupture.meaning: (medical 医) an injury in which sth inside the body breaks apart or bursts（（体内组织等的）断裂，破裂）；a situation when sth breaks or bursts（断裂；爆裂）；(informal) a hernia of the abdomen（疝气）；(formal) the ending of agreement or of good relations between people, countries, etc.（（关系的）破裂，决裂；绝交）

rural.meaning: connected with or like the countryside（乡村的；农村的；似农村的）

rush.meaning: to move or to do sth with great speed, often too fast（迅速移动；急促）；to transport or send sb/sth somewhere with great speed（快速运输；速送）；to do sth or to make sb do sth without thinking about it carefully（（使）仓促行事，匆忙行事，做事草率）；to try to attack or capture sb/sth suddenly（突袭；突击抓捕）

russian.meaning: from or connected with Russia（俄罗斯的）；a person from Russia（俄罗斯人）；the language of Russia（俄语）

rust.meaning: a reddish-brown substance that is formed on some metals by the action of water and air（锈；铁锈）；a plant disease that causes reddish-brown spots; the fungus that causes this disease（（植物的）锈病；锈菌）；if metal rusts or sth rusts it, it becomes covered with rust（（使）生锈）；rust·ed /; NAmE/ adj. rusted iron（生锈的铁）

rustproof.meaning: rustproof metal has had a substance put on it so that it will not rust（防锈的；经过防锈处理的）

rusty.meaning: covered with rust（生锈的）；(of a sport, skill, etc.（体育运动、技能等）；not as good as it used to be, because you have not been practising（荒疏；荒废；退步）

rut.meaning: a deep track that a wheel makes in soft ground（车辙）；a boring way of life that does not change（刻板乏味的生活）；the time of year when male animals, especially deer, become sexually active（（雄鹿等雄性动物的）发情期）

ruthless.meaning: (of people or their behaviour（人或其行为）；hard and cruel; determined to get what you want and not caring if you hurt other people（残酷无情的；残忍的）

rye.meaning: a plant that looks like barley but that produces larger grain, grown as food for animals and for making flour and whisky; the grain of this plant（黑麦；黑麦粒）

sabotage.meaning: the act of doing deliberate damage to equipment, transport, machines, etc. to prevent an enemy from using them, or to protest about sth（（为防止敌人利用或表示抗议而对设备、交通等进行的）蓄意毁坏）；the act of deliberately spoiling sth in order to prevent it from being successful（故意妨碍；捣乱；刻意阻碍）；to damage or destroy sth deliberately to prevent an enemy from using it or to protest about sth（蓄意破坏，阴谋破坏（以防止敌方利用或表示抗议））；to prevent sth from being successful or being achieved, especially deliberately（刻意阻碍；妨碍；捣乱）

sac.meaning: a part inside the body of a person, an animal or a plant, that is shaped like a bag, has thin skin around it, and contains liquid or air（（人、动植物体内的）囊，液囊，气囊）

sack.meaning: a large bag with no handles, made of strong rough material or strong paper or plastic, used for storing and carrying, for example flour, coal, etc.（麻布（或厚纸、塑料等）大袋）；(NAmE) a strong paper bag for carrying shopping（（厚纸的）购物袋）；the contents of a sack（一满袋；一大袋东西）；(BrE) (informal) being told by your employer that you can no longer continue working for a company, etc., usually because of sth that you have done wrong（开除；解雇；炒鱿鱼）

sacred.meaning: connected with God or a god; considered to be holy（上帝的；神的；神圣的）；very important and treated with great respect（受尊重的；受崇敬的）

sacrifice.meaning: the fact of giving up sth important or valuable to you in order to get or do sth that seems more important; sth that you give up in this way（牺牲；舍弃）；the act of offering sth to a god, especially an animal that has been killed in a special way; an animal, etc. that is offered in this way（祭献；祭祀；祭献的牲畜；祭品）；to give up sth that is important or valuable to you in order to get or do sth that seems more important for yourself or for another person（牺牲；献出）；to kill an animal or a person and offer it or them to a god, in order to please the god（以（人或动物）作祭献）

sacrificial.meaning: offered as a sacrifice（用于祭献的）

sad.meaning: seasonal affective disorder（季节性情感障碍）

sadden.meaning: to make sb sad（使悲伤；使伤心；使难过）

saddle.meaning: a leather seat for a rider on a horse（马鞍）；a seat on a bicycle or motorcycle（（自行车或摩托车的）车座）；a piece of meat from the back of an animal（（动物的）脊肉）；in a position of authority and control（担任领导职务；掌权；在位）

sadly.meaning: unfortunately（令人遗憾；不幸地）；in a sad way（悲伤地；伤心地）；very much and in a way that makes you sad（极为；苦苦地）

sadness.meaning: the feeling of being sad（悲伤；悲痛；难过）；something which makes you sad（使人悲伤（或难过）的事）

safe.meaning: protected from any danger or harm（处境（或情况）安全）；not likely to lead to any physical harm or danger（不损害（或危害）健康的；安全的）；not harmed, damaged, lost, etc.（未受伤害（或未遭损害、未丢失等）的）；where sb/sth is not likely to be in danger or to be lost（无危险的；无丢失之虞的）

safeguard.meaning: (formal) to protect sth/sb from loss, harm or damage; to keep sth/sb safe（保护；保障；捍卫）；something that is designed to protect people from harm, risk or danger（安全设施；保护措施）

safely.meaning: without being harmed, damaged or lost（未受损伤（或损坏）；未丢失）；in a way that does not cause harm or that protects sb/sth from harm（安全地；无危害地）；without much possibility of being wrong（不大可能出错地；有把握地）；without any possibility of the situation changing（安稳地；安定地）

safety.meaning: the state of being safe and protected from danger or harm（安全；平安）；the state of not being dangerous（安全性；无危险）；a place where you are safe（安全处所）；(NAmE) (in American football) a defending player who plays in a position far away from the other team（（美式足球）安全卫，防守队员）

saffron.meaning: a bright yellow powder made from crocus flowers, used in cooking to give colour to food（藏红花粉（用作烹饪时的染色调料））；a bright orange-yellow colour（橘黄色）；saf·fron adj. Buddhist monks in saffron robes（身穿黄袍的和尚）

sag.meaning: to hang or bend down in the middle, especially because of weight or pressure（（尤指由于承重或受压）中间下垂，下凹）；to become weaker or fewer（减弱；减少）；sag noun [U, C, usually sing.] Weight has caused the sag.（承重导致下垂。）；(BrE) (informal) to stay away from school or work when you should be there, or leave before you should（逃学；旷课；旷工；早退）

sage.meaning: a plant with flat, light green leaves that have a strong smell and are used in cooking as a herb（鼠尾草（可用作调料））；(formal) a very wise person（哲人；智者；圣人）；(literary) wise, especially because you have a lot of experience（睿智的，贤明的（尤指因经验丰富））；sage·ly /seɪdʒli; NAmEseɪdʒli/ adv. She nodded sagely.（她点点头，一副洞悉一切的样子。）

sago.meaning: hard white grains made from the soft inside of a type of palm tree, often cooked with milk to make a dessert（西谷米，西米（由一种棕榈茎髓制成的白色硬粒状食物，常加牛奶制成甜点））

saguaro.meaning: a very large cactus that grows in the southern US and Mexico（萨瓜罗掌，巨山影掌（生长于美国南部和墨西哥的仙人掌））

sail.meaning: (of a boat or ship or the people on it（船或船上的人）；to travel on water using sails or an engine（（船）航行；（人）乘船航行）；to control or travel on a boat with a sail, especially as a sport（驾驶（或乘坐）帆船航行（尤指作为体育运动））；(of a boat or ship or the people in it（船只或船上的人）

sailing.meaning: the sport or activity of travelling in a boat with sails（帆船运动；（乘帆船的）航行）；one of the regular times that a ship leaves a port（（从某港口开出的）航班）

sailor.meaning: a person who works on a ship as a member of the crew（水手；海员）；a person who sails a boat（驾船人）；a person who rarely/often becomes sick at sea（很少/经常晕船的人）

saint.meaning: a person that the Christian Church recognizes as being very holy, because of the way they have lived or died（（因其生平或殉教事迹而获基督教会追封的）圣人，圣徒）；a very good, kind or patient person（圣人般的人（指特别善良、仁爱或有耐性的人））

sake.meaning: used to emphasize that it is important to do sth or when you are annoyed about sth（（强调重要或表示恼火）看在上帝分上，天哪，行行好吧，千万）；because of the interest or value sth has, not because of the advantages it may bring（为某事本身的缘故；鉴于某事本身的价值）；in order to help sb/sth or because you like sb/sth（为了某人（或某事）起见；因某人（或某事）的缘故）；in order to get or keep sth（为获得（或保持）某物）

salad.meaning: a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, tomato and cucumber, usually served with other food as part of a meal（（生吃的）蔬菜色拉，蔬菜沙拉）；(in compounds（构成复合词）；meat, fish, cheese, etc. served with salad（（拌有肉、鱼、奶酪等的）混合色拉，混合沙拉）；raw or cooked vegetables, etc. that are cut into small pieces, often mixed with mayonnaise and served cold with other food（（或生或熟，多拌有蛋黄酱，与面食、豆类等一起食用的）蔬菜色拉，蔬菜沙拉）

salary.meaning: money that employees receive for doing their job, especially professional employees or people working in an office, usually paid every month（薪金，薪水（尤指按月发放的））

salmon.meaning: a large fish with silver skin and pink flesh that is used for food. Salmon live in the sea but swim up rivers to lay their eggs.（鲑；大麻哈鱼）

salty.meaning: containing or tasting of salt（含盐的；咸的）；(of language or humour（语言或幽默）；amusing and sometimes slightly rude（有趣的；逗笑的；有趣而略嫌粗俗的）；salti·ness /; NAmE/ noun [U] She could taste the saltiness of her tears.（她尝到了她眼泪的咸味。）

salvation.meaning: (in Christianity（基督教）；the state of being saved from the power of evil（得救；救恩；救世）；a way of protecting sb from danger, disaster, loss, etc.（（危险、灾难、损失等的）避免方式，解救途径）

same.meaning: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different（同一的；相同的）；exactly like the one or ones referred to or mentioned（（与 … ）相同的，一模一样的）；(informal) (especially NAmE) used to say that a situation has not changed at all（老样子；照旧不变）；the same thing or things（（和 … ）同样的事物，相同的事物）

sandwich.meaning: two slices of bread, often spread with butter, with a layer of meat, cheese, etc. between them（夹心面包片；三明治）；(BrE) (in compounds（构成复合词）；a sponge cake consisting of two layers with jam and/or cream between them（夹心蛋糕）；to fit sth/sb into a very small space between two other things or people, or between two times（把 … 夹（或插）在 … 中间）

sandy.meaning: covered with or containing sand（铺满沙子的；含沙的）；(of hair（头发）；having a light colour, between yellow and red（沙褐色的；浅棕色的）

sane.meaning: having a normal healthy mind; not mentally ill（精神健全的；神志正常的）；sensible and reasonable（明智的；理智的；合乎情理的）

satisfied.meaning: pleased because you have achieved sth or because sth that you wanted to happen has happened（满意的；满足的；欣慰的）；believing or accepting that sth is true（确信的；信服的）

satisfy.meaning: (not used in the progressive tenses（不用于进行时）；to make sb pleased by doing or giving them what they want（使满意；使满足）；to provide what is wanted, needed or asked for（满足（要求、需要等））；to make sb certain sth is true or has been done（向 … 证实；使确信）

satisfying.meaning: giving pleasure because it provides sth you need or want（令人满意（或满足）的）；sat·is·fy·ing·ly /ˈsætɪsfaɪɪŋli; NAmEˈsætɪsfaɪɪŋli/ adv. sauce.meaning: a thick liquid that is eaten with food to add flavour to it（调味汁；酱）；(old-fashioned) (BrE informal) talk or behaviour that is annoying or lacking in respect（讨厌的话（或举动）；无礼的话（或举动））；(old-fashioned, saying) what one person is allowed to do, another person must be allowed to do in a similar situation（适于此者亦应适于彼；应该一视同仁）

savannah.meaning: a wide flat open area of land, especially in Africa, that is covered with grass but has few trees（（尤指非洲的）稀树草原）

save.meaning: to keep sb/sth safe from death, harm, loss, etc.（救；救助；挽救；拯救）；to keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy a particular thing（储蓄；攒钱）；to collect sth because you like it or for a special purpose（收集；收藏）；to keep sth to use or enjoy in the future（保留；保存）

saw.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a tool that has a long blade with sharp points (called teeth ) along one of its edges. scandinavia.meaning: a cultural region in NW Europe consisting of Norway, Sweden and Denmark and sometimes also Iceland, Finland and the Faroe Islands（斯堪的纳维亚（欧洲西北部文化区，包括挪威、瑞典和丹麦，有时也包括冰岛、芬兰和法罗群岛））

scanner.meaning: a device for examining sth or recording sth using light, sound or X-rays（扫描仪；扫描器；扫描设备）；(computing 计) a device which copies pictures and documents so that they can be stored on a computer（扫描仪；扫描器）；a machine used by doctors to produce a picture of the inside of a person's body on a computer screen（（医用）扫描器）；a piece of equipment for receiving and sending radar signals（扫掠天线；自动旋转雷达天线）

scarcity.meaning: if there is a scarcity of sth, there is not enough of it and it is difficult to obtain it（缺乏；不足；稀少）

scare.meaning: to frighten sb（惊吓；使害怕；使恐惧）；to become frightened（受惊吓；害怕；恐惧）；(taboo, slang) to frighten sb very much（吓得某人屁滚尿流）；to make sb go away by frightening them（把 … 吓跑）

scared.meaning: frightened of sth or afraid that sth bad might happen（害怕；恐惧；畏惧；担心）

scarf.meaning: a piece of cloth that is worn around the neck, for example for warmth or decoration. Women also wear scarves over their shoulders or hair.（围巾；披巾；头巾）；(informal) to eat a lot of sth quickly（贪婪地吃；狼吞虎咽）

scene.meaning: the place where sth happens, especially sth unpleasant（（尤指不愉快事件发生的）地点，现场）；an event or a situation that you see, especially one of a particular type（事件；场面；情景）；a part of a film/movie, play or book in which the action happens in one place or is of one particular type（场面；片段；镜头）；one of the small sections that a play or an opera is divided into（（戏剧或歌剧的）场）
