title.meaning: the name of a book, poem, painting, piece of music, etc.（（书、诗歌、图画、乐曲等的）名称，标题，题目）；a particular book or magazine（（书刊的）一种，一本）；a word in front of a person's name to show their rank or profession, whether or not they are married, etc.（（人名前表示地位、职业、婚否等的）称号，头衔，职称，称谓）；a name that describes a job（职位名称；职称）

to.meaning: in the direction of sth; towards sth（向，朝，往，对着（某方向或某处））；located in the direction mentioned from sth（位于 … 方向）；as far as sth（到，达（某处））；reaching a particular state（到，达（某种状态））

toad.meaning: a small animal like a frog but with a drier and less smooth skin, that lives on land but breeds in water (= is an amphibian)（蟾蜍；癞蛤蟆）；(informal, disapproving) an unpleasant person（讨厌的人；使人恶心的人）

toast.meaning: slices of bread that have been made brown and crisp by heating them on both sides in a toaster or under a grill（烤面包片；吐司）；the act of a group of people wishing sb happiness, success, etc. by drinking a glass of sth, especially alcohol, at the same time（干杯；祝酒；敬酒）；a person who is praised by a lot of people in a particular place because of sth that they have done well（（在某领域）广受赞誉的人，有口皆碑的人）；(informal) (especially NAmE) to be likely to die or be destroyed（会死；要完蛋）

tobacco.meaning: the dried leaves of the tobacco plant that are used for making cigarettes, smoking in a pipe or chewing（烟叶；烟草）

today.meaning: on this day（在今天；在今日）；at the present period（现在；当今；当代）；this day（今天；今日）；the present period of time（现在；当今；当代）

toddle.meaning: when a young child who has just learnt to walk toddles, he/she walks with short, unsteady steps（（幼儿学步时）摇摇摆摆地走，蹒跚行走）；(informal) to walk or go somewhere（步行；去）

toddler.meaning: a child who has only recently learnt to walk（学步的儿童；刚学会走路的孩子）

toe.meaning: one of the five small parts that stick out from the foot（脚趾）；the part of a sock, shoe, etc. that covers the toes（（袜、鞋等的）足尖部）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type or number of toes mentioned（有 … 脚趾的）

toehold.meaning: a position in a place or an activity which you hope will lead to more power or success（初步的地位；立足点）；a very small hole or space on a cliff, just big enough to put your foot in when you are climbing（（攀登时可放进脚去的）小立足点，小支撑点）

together.meaning: with or near to sb/sth else; with each other（在一起；共同）；so that two or more things touch or are joined to or combined with each other（以使接触（或相结合）；到一起）；(of two people（两个人）；in a close relationship, for example a marriage（关系密切；有婚姻关系）

toil.meaning: to work very hard and/or for a long time, usually doing hard physical work（（长时间）苦干，辛勤劳作）；to move slowly and with difficulty（艰难缓慢地移动；跋涉）；toil·er toiler toilers /tɔɪlə(r); NAmEtɔɪlər/ noun noun [U] (formal or literary) hard unpleasant work that makes you very tired（苦工；劳累的工作）

toilet.meaning: a large bowl attached to a pipe that you sit on or stand over when you get rid of waste matter from your body（坐便器；抽水马桶）；a room containing a toilet（厕所；卫生间；盥洗室）；a room or small building containing several toilets, each in a separate smaller room（（有几个分隔坐便器的）厕所间，厕所）；(old-fashioned) the process of washing and dressing yourself, arranging your hair, etc.（梳洗；打扮）

token.meaning: a round piece of metal or plastic used instead of money to operate some machines or as a form of payment（（用以启动某些机器或用作支付方式的）代币，专用辅币）；(BrE) a piece of paper that you pay for and that sb can exchange for sth in a shop/store（代价券）；a piece of paper that you can collect when you buy a particular product and then exchange for sth（赠券；礼券）；something that is a symbol of a feeling, a fact, an event, etc.（（感觉、事实、事件等的）象征，标志，表示，信物）

tolerable.meaning: fairly good, but not of the best quality（尚好的；过得去的；还可以的）；that you can accept or bear, although unpleasant or painful（可接受的；可忍受的；可容忍的）；tol·er·ably /ˈtɒlərəbli; NAmEˈtɑːlərəbli/ adv. He plays the piano tolerably (well).（他钢琴弹得还算不错。）

tolerance.meaning: the willingness to accept or tolerate sb/sth, especially opinions or behaviour that you may not agree with, or people who are not like you（忍受；容忍；宽容；宽恕）；the ability to suffer sth, especially pain, difficult conditions, etc. without being harmed（忍耐力；忍受性；耐力；耐量）；(technical 术语) the amount by which the measurement of a value can vary without causing problems（公差；容限）

tolerant.meaning: able to accept what other people say or do even if you do not agree with it（忍受的；容忍的；宽容的）；(of plants, animals or machines（植物、动物或机器）；able to survive or operate in difficult conditions（能在困难条件下生存（或操作）的；能耐 … 的）

tolerate.meaning: to allow sb to do sth that you do not agree with or like（容许，允许（不同意或不喜欢的事物））；to accept sb/sth that is annoying, unpleasant, etc. without complaining（忍受；容忍；包容）；to be able to be affected by a drug, difficult conditions, etc. without being harmed（（对药物）有耐受性；能经受（困难条件））

toll.meaning: money that you pay to use a particular road or bridge（（道路、桥梁的）通行费）；the amount of damage or the number of deaths and injuries that are caused in a particular war, disaster, etc.（（战争、灾难等造成的）毁坏；伤亡人数）；the sound of a bell ringing with slow regular strokes（（缓慢而有规律的）钟声）；(NAmE) a charge for a telephone call that is calculated at a higher rate than a local call（长途电话费）

tomato.meaning: a soft fruit with a lot of juice and shiny red skin that is eaten as a vegetable either raw or cooked（番茄；西红柿）

tomb.meaning: a large grave, especially one built of stone above or below the ground（坟墓；冢）

tombstone.meaning: a large, flat stone that lies over a grave or stands at one end, that shows the name, age, etc. of the person buried there（墓碑）

tomorrow.meaning: on or during the day after today（在明天；在明日）；the day after today（明天；明日）；the future（未来；将来；来日）；to do sth a lot or as though you do not care what effects it will have（不顾后果地一个劲 …）

ton.meaning: a unit for measuring weight, in Britain 2 240 pounds (long ton) and in the US 2 000 pounds (short ton)（吨（英国为 2 240 磅，即长吨；美国为 2 000 磅，即短吨））；a unit for measuring the size of a ship. 1 ton is equal to 100 cubic feet.（注册吨，吨位（船舶大小的计量单位，1 吨等于 100 立方英尺））；(informal) a lot（大量；许多）；(BrE) (informal) 100, especially when connected with a speed of 100 miles per hour（*）

tonal.meaning: (technical 术语) relating to tones of sound or colour（音调的；声调的；色调的）；(music 音) having a particular key（调性的）

tone.meaning: the quality of sb's voice, especially expressing a particular emotion（语气；口气；腔调；口吻）；the general character and attitude of sth such as a piece of writing, or the atmosphere of an event（风格；特色；气氛；情调）；the quality of a sound, especially the sound of a musical instrument or one produced by electronic equipment（（尤指乐器或电子音响设备的）音质，音色）；a shade of a colour（色调；明暗；影调）

toneless.meaning: (of a voice, etc.（声音等）；dull or flat; not expressing any emotion or interest（单调的；呆板的；沉闷的）

tongue.meaning: the soft part in the mouth that moves around, used for tasting, swallowing, speaking, etc.（舌；舌头）；the tongue of some animals, cooked and eaten（口条）；(formal or literary) a language（语言）；a particular way of speaking（说话方式）

tonic.meaning: a clear fizzy drink (= with bubbles in it) with a slightly bitter taste, that is often mixed with a strong alcoholic drink, especially gin or vodka（奎宁水，汤力水（一种味微苦、常加于烈性酒中的有气饮料））；a medicine that makes you feel stronger and healthier, taken especially when you feel tired（补药；滋补品）；a liquid that you put on your hair or skin in order to make it healthier（护发液；护肤液）；(old-fashioned) anything that makes people feel healthier or happier（使精神振奋的东西）

tonight.meaning: on or during the evening or night of today（在今夜；在今晚）；the evening or night of today（今夜；今晚）

tonnage.meaning: the size of a ship or the amount it can carry, expressed in tons（（表示船舶大小或载重量的）吨位）；the total amount that sth weighs（（某物的）总重量）

tonne.meaning: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1 000 kilograms（公吨（等于 1 000 公斤））

too.meaning: used before adjectives and adverbs to say that sth is more than is good, necessary, possible, etc.（（用于形容词和副词前）太，过于，过度）；(usually placed at the end of a clause（通常置于句末）；also; as well（也；又；还）；used to comment on sth that makes a situation worse（（评说某事物使情况更糟）而且，还）

tool.meaning: an instrument such as a hammer, screwdriver, saw, etc. that you hold in your hand and use for making things, repairing things, etc.（工具）；a thing that helps you to do your job or to achieve sth（（有助于做工或完成某事的）用具，器具，手段，方法）；a person who is used or controlled by another person or group（受人利用的人；工具）；(taboo, slang) a penis（鸡巴；阴茎）

toolmaker.meaning: a person or company that makes tools, especially ones used in industry（（尤指工业用）工具制造者，工具制造厂）

tooth.meaning: any of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing food（牙；齿）；a narrow pointed part that sticks out of an object（齿状部分；齿）；to do sth that gives you your first experience of a particular type of work（从 … 中获得初步经验；初次涉足）；(of a baby（婴儿）

toothache.meaning: a pain in your teeth or in one tooth（牙痛）

toothbrush.meaning: a small brush for cleaning your teeth（牙刷）

toothpaste.meaning: a substance that you put on a brush and use to clean your teeth（牙膏）

top.meaning: the highest part or point of sth（顶；顶部；顶端）；the upper flat surface of sth（表面；上面）；the highest or most important rank or position（最高的级别；最重要的职位）；the end of a street, table, etc. that is farthest away from you or from where you usually come to it（尽头；远端）

topi.meaning: a light hard hat worn to give protection from the sun in very hot countries（遮阳帽；通草帽）

topic.meaning: a subject that you talk, write or learn about（话题；题目；标题）；(NAmE) appropriate or relevant to the situation（切题）

topical.meaning: connected with sth that is happening or of interest at the present time（有关时事的；当前关注的；热门话题的）；(medical 医) connected with, or put directly on, a part of the body（（身体）局部的，表面的）

topography.meaning: the physical features of an area of land, especially the position of its rivers, mountains, etc; the study of these features（地形；地貌；地势；地形学）；topo·graph·ic·al /ˌtɒpəˈɡræfɪkl; NAmEˌtɑːpəˈɡræfɪkl/ (also topo·graph·ic /ˌtɒpəˈɡræfɪk; NAmEˌtɑːpəˈɡræfɪk/) adj. a topographical map/feature（地形图；地貌特征）

topple.meaning: to become unsteady and fall down; to make sth do this（（使）失去平衡而坠落，倒塌，倒下）；to make sb lose their position of power or authority（打倒；推翻；颠覆）

topsoil.meaning: the layer of soil nearest the surface of the ground（表土；表土层）

torch.meaning: a small electric lamp that uses batteries and that you can hold in your hand（手电筒）；a long piece of wood that has material at one end that is set on fire and that people carry to give light（火炬；火把）；(literary) to set fire to sth deliberately（将 … 付之一炬）；to set fire to a building or vehicle deliberately in order to destroy it（放火烧，纵火烧（建筑物或汽车））

torment.meaning: (formal) extreme suffering, especially mental suffering; a person or thing that causes this（（尤指精神上的）折磨，痛苦；苦难之源）；(formal) to make sb suffer very much（使备受折磨；使痛苦；烦扰）；to annoy a person or an animal in a cruel way because you think it is amusing（戏弄；捉弄；纠缠）

tornado.meaning: a violent storm with very strong winds which move in a circle. There is often also a long cloud which is narrower at the bottom than the top.（龙卷风；旋风）

torpedo.meaning: a long narrow bomb that is fired under the water from a ship or submarine and that explodes when it hits a ship, etc.（鱼雷）；to attack a ship or make it sink using a torpedo（用鱼雷袭击（或击沉））；to completely destroy the possibility that sth could succeed（彻底破坏，完全摧毁（某事成功的可能性））

torpor.meaning: the state of not being active and having no energy or enthusiasm（迟钝；死气沉沉；懒散）

torque.meaning: a twisting force that causes machinery, etc. to rotate (= turn around)（（使机器等旋转的）转矩）

torrent.meaning: a large amount of water moving very quickly（急流；激流；湍流；洪流）；a large amount of sth that comes suddenly and violently（迸发；连发；狂潮）

torrential.meaning: (of rain（雨）；falling in large amounts（倾泻的；如注的）

torrid.meaning: full of strong emotions, especially connected with sex and love（（尤指情爱）热烈的，狂热的，热情洋溢的）；(of a climate or country（气候或国家）；very hot or dry（炎热而干燥的；酷热的；灼热的）；(BrE) very difficult（艰难的）

tortoise.meaning: a reptile with a hard round shell, that lives on land and moves very slowly. It can pull its head and legs into its shell.（陆龟；龟）

torture.meaning: the act of causing sb severe pain in order to punish them or make them say or do sth（拷打；拷问；酷刑）；(informal) mental or physical suffering; sth that causes this（（精神上或肉体上的）折磨，痛苦；折磨人的事物）；to hurt sb physically or mentally in order to punish them or make them tell you sth（拷打；拷问；严刑逼供）；to make sb feel extremely unhappy or anxious（使痛苦；使苦恼；使焦急；使受煎熬）

toss.meaning: to throw sth lightly or carelessly（（轻轻或漫不经心地）扔，抛，掷）；to move your head suddenly upwards, especially to show that you are annoyed or impatient（甩（头，以表示恼怒或不耐烦））；to move or make sb/sth move from side to side or up and down（（使）摇摆，挥动，颠簸）；to shake or turn food in order to cover it with oil, butter, etc.（摇匀；翻动（以沾油、黄油等））

total.meaning: being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together（总的；总计的；全体的；全部的）；including everything（彻底的；完全的）；the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together; the final number of people or things when they have all been counted（总数；总额；合计；总计）；to reach a particular total（总数达；共计）

totality.meaning: the state of being complete or whole; the whole number or amount（全体；全部；整个；总数；总额）

touch.meaning: to put your hand or another part of your body onto sb/sth（触摸；碰）；(of two or more things, surfaces, etc.（两个或以上的东西、表面等）；to be or come so close together that there is no space between（接触；触及）；to move sth, especially in such a way that you damage it; to hit or harm sb（移动；碰到；打（人）；使受伤）

touchy.meaning: (of a person（人）；easily upset or offended（易烦恼；易生气；易怒）；(of a subject（课题）；that may upset or offend people and should therefore be dealt with carefully（敏感性的；需要小心处理的；棘手的）

tough.meaning: having or causing problems or difficulties（艰苦的；艰难的；棘手的）；demanding that particular rules be obeyed and showing a lack of sympathy for any problems or suffering that this may cause（严厉的；强硬的；无情的）；strong enough to deal successfully with difficult conditions or situations（坚强的；健壮的；能吃苦耐劳的；坚韧不拔的）；(of a person（人）

tour.meaning: a journey made for pleasure during which several different towns, countries, etc. are visited（旅行；旅游）；an act of walking around a town, building, etc. in order to visit it（游览；参观；观光）；an official series of visits made to different places by a sports team, an orchestra, an important person, etc.（巡回比赛（或演出等）；巡视）；to travel around a place, for example on holiday/vacation, or to perform, to advertise sth, etc.（在 … 旅游；在 … 巡回演出（或做宣传广告等））

tourism.meaning: the business activity connected with providing accommodation, services and entertainment for people who are visiting a place for pleasure（旅游业；观光业）

tourist.meaning: a person who is travelling or visiting a place for pleasure（旅游者；观光者；游客）；(BrE) a member of a sports team that is playing a series of official games in a foreign country（（在国外参加）巡回比赛的运动队队员）

tournament.meaning: a sports competition involving a number of teams or players who take part in different games and must leave the competition if they lose. The competition continues until there is only the winner left.（锦标赛；联赛）；a competition in the Middle Ages between soldiers on horseback fighting to show courage and skill（（中世纪的）骑士比武）

tourniquet.meaning: a piece of cloth, etc. that is tied tightly around an arm or a leg to stop the loss of blood from a wound（（扎在手臂或腿上的）止血带）

tow.meaning: to pull a car or boat behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain（（用绳索或链条）拖，拉，牵引，拽）；an act of one vehicle pulling another vehicle using a rope or chain（（车、船等的）牵引，拽引）；(informal) if you have sb in tow, they are with you and following closely behind（紧随着；陪伴着）；if a ship is taken in tow, it is pulled by another ship（（船）被拖着走）

towards.meaning: in the direction of sb/sth（向；朝；对着）；getting closer to achieving sth（趋向，接近，将近（完成某事））；close or closer to a point in time（接近，将近（某一时间））；in relation to sb/sth（对；对于；关于）

towel.meaning: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things, especially your body（毛巾；手巾；抹布；纸巾）；(informal) to admit that you have been defeated and stop trying（认输；承认失败；放弃努力）；to dry yourself/sb/sth with a towel（用毛巾擦干）

tower.meaning: a tall narrow building or part of a building, especially of a church or castle（塔；建筑物的塔形部分；（尤指教堂或城堡的）塔楼）；(often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a tall structure used for sending television or radio signals（（电视或无线电信号的）发射塔）；(usually in compounds（通常构成复合词）

town.meaning: a place with many houses, shops/stores, etc. where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.（镇；市镇；集镇）；the people who live in a particular town（（某一市镇的）居民，市民）；the area of a town where most of the shops/stores and businesses are（（城镇的）商业区）；(especially NAmE) a particular town where sb lives and works or one that has just been referred to（（生活、工作或刚提到的）城镇）

township.meaning: (in South Africa in the past) a town or part of a town that black people had to live in, and where only black people lived（（旧时南非的）黑人城镇，黑人居住区）；(in the US or Canada) a division of a county that is a unit of local government（镇区（美国和加拿大县以下一级的地方政府））

townspeople.meaning: people who live in towns, not in the countryside; the people who live in a particular town（镇民；市民；城里人；（某一城镇的）居民）

toxic.meaning: containing poison; poisonous（有毒的；引起中毒的）；a level of debt or high-risk investment that causes very serious problems for a bank or other financial institution（有毒的（指能引致银行或其他金融机构出现严重问题的高水平债务或高风险投资））；(of a person（人）；having a very unpleasant personality, especially in the way they like to control and influence other people in a dishonest way（卑鄙无耻的；（尤指）爱摆布人的）

toy.meaning: an object for children to play with（玩具）；an object that you have for enjoyment or pleasure rather than for a serious purpose（玩物；玩意儿）；made as a copy of a particular thing and used for playing with（玩具的；作玩具的）；(of a dog（狗）

trace.meaning: to find or discover sb/sth by looking carefully for them/it（查出；找到；发现；追踪）；to find the origin or cause of sth（追溯；追究）；to describe a process or the development of sth（描绘（事物的过程或发展）；追述；记述）；to draw a line or lines on a surface（画（线））

track.meaning: a rough path or road, usually one that has not been built but that has been made by people walking there（（人踩出的）小道，小径）；marks left by a person, an animal or a moving vehicle（（人、动物或车辆留下的）足迹，踪迹；车辙）；rails that a train moves along（轨道）；(NAmE) a track with a number at a train station that a train arrives at or leaves from（（火车站的）站台）

tract.meaning: (biology 生) a system of connected organs or tissues along which materials or messages pass（（连通身体组织或器官的）道，束）；an area of land, especially a large one（大片土地；地带）；(sometimes disapproving) a short piece of writing, especially on a religious, moral or political subject, that is intended to influence people's ideas（（尤指宣扬宗教、伦理或政治的）短文，传单，小册子）

traction.meaning: the action of pulling sth along a surface; the power that is used for doing this（牵引；拖拉；牵引力；拉力）；a way of treating a broken bone in your body that involves using special equipment to pull the bone gradually back into its correct place（牵引（使体内断骨复位的疗法））；the force that stops sth, for example the wheels of a vehicle, from sliding on the ground（（车轮等对地面的）附着摩擦力）

tractor.meaning: a powerful vehicle with two large and two smaller wheels, used especially for pulling farm machinery（拖拉机；牵引机）；(NAmE) the front part of a tractor-trailer, where the driver sits（（牵引式挂车的）牵引车，拖车头）

trade.meaning: the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries（贸易；买卖；商业；交易）；a particular type of business（行业；职业；生意）；a particular area of business and the people or companies that are connected with it（同业；同行；同人）；the amount of goods or services that you sell（营业额；交易量）

trademark.meaning: a name, symbol or design that a company uses for its products and that cannot be used by anyone else（商标）；a special way of behaving or dressing that is typical of sb and that makes them easily recognized（（人的行为或衣着的）特征，标记）

trader.meaning: a person who buys and sells things as a job（商人；经商者；买卖人；证券交易人）

tradesman.meaning: a person whose job involves going to houses to sell or deliver goods（上门推销商；送货员）；(especially BrE) a person who sells goods, especially in a shop/store（售货的商人；店主）；(especially NAmE) a skilled person, especially one who makes things by hand（工匠；手艺人）

trading.meaning: the activity of buying and selling things（贸易；经商；营业；交易）

tradition.meaning: a belief, custom or way of doing sth that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people; a set of these beliefs or customs（传统；传统的信仰（或风俗））

traditional.meaning: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time（传统的；习俗的；惯例的）；(sometimes disapproving) following older methods and ideas rather than modern or different ones（传统的；因袭的；守旧的）；trad·ition·al·ly ★ AW /trəˈdɪʃənəli; NAmEtrəˈdɪʃənəli/ adv. The festival is traditionally held in May.（这个节日按照传统是在五月份过的。）

traffic.meaning: the vehicles that are on a road at a particular time（路上行驶的车辆；交通）；the movement of ships, trains, aircraft, etc. along a particular route（（沿固定路线的）航行，行驶，飞行）；the movement of people or goods from one place to another（运输；人流；货流）；the movement of messages and signals through an electronic communication system（信息流量；通信（量））

tragedy.meaning: a very sad event or situation, especially one that involves death（悲惨的事；不幸；灾难；惨案）；a serious play with a sad ending, especially one in which the main character dies; plays of this type（悲剧；悲剧作品）

tragic.meaning: making you feel very sad, usually because sb has died or suffered a lot（悲惨的；悲痛的；可悲的）；connected with tragedy (= the style of literature)（悲剧的）；tra·gic·al·ly /ˈtrædʒɪkli; NAmEˈtrædʒɪkli/ adv. Tragically, his wife was killed in a car accident.（他的妻子在车祸中不幸身亡。）

trail.meaning: a long line or series of marks that is left by sb/sth（（长串的）痕迹，踪迹，足迹）；a track, sign or smell that is left behind and that can be followed, especially in hunting（（尤指打猎时跟踪的）踪迹，足迹，臭迹）；a path through the countryside（（乡间的）小路，小径）；a route that is followed for a particular purpose（（特定）路线，路径）

trailer.meaning: a truck, or a container with wheels, that is pulled by another vehicle（拖车；挂车）；a vehicle without an engine, that can be pulled by a car or truck or used as a home or an office when it is parked（（拖车式）活动房屋，活动工作室）；a series of short scenes from a film/movie or television programme, shown in advance to advertise it（（电影或电视节目的）预告片）

train.meaning: a railway/railroad engine pulling a number of coaches/cars or trucks, taking people and goods from one place to another（火车；列车）；a number of people or animals moving in a line（列队行进的人（或动物）；队列；行列）；a series of events or actions that are connected（一系列相关的事情（或行动））；the part of a long formal dress that spreads out on the floor behind the person wearing it（拖裾，裙裾（长礼服的曳地部分））

trainee.meaning: a person who is being taught how to do a particular job（接受培训者；实习生；见习生）

trainer.meaning: a shoe that you wear for sports or as informal clothing（运动鞋；便鞋）；a person who teaches people or animals to perform a particular job or skill well, or to do a particular sport（教员；驯兽师；教练员）

training.meaning: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job（训练；培训）；the process of preparing to take part in a sports competition by doing physical exercises（（为参加体育比赛而进行的）训练，锻炼）

trait.meaning: a particular quality in your personality（（人的个性的）特征，特性，特点）

traitor.meaning: a person who gives away secrets about their friends, their country, etc.（背叛者；叛徒；卖国贼）

tram.meaning: a vehicle driven by electricity, that runs on rails along the streets of a town and carries passengers（有轨电车）

tramp.meaning: a person with no home or job who travels from place to place, usually asking people in the street for food or money（流浪汉；流浪乞丐）；the sound of sb's heavy steps（沉重的脚步声）；a long walk（长途步行；徒步旅行）；(old-fashioned) (NAmE disapproving) a woman who has many sexual partners（淫妇；荡妇）

trample.meaning: to step heavily on sb/sth so that you crush or harm them/it with your feet（踩碎；踩伤；践踏）；to ignore sb's feelings or rights and treat them as if they are not important（践踏，摧残（人权、心灵等））

trance.meaning: a state in which sb seems to be asleep but is aware of what is said to them, for example if they are hypnotized（昏睡状态；催眠状态）；a state in which you are thinking so much about sth that you do not notice what is happening around you（出神；发呆）；a type of electronic dance music with hypnotic rhythms and sounds（迷幻音乐）

tranquil.meaning: quiet and peaceful（安静的；平静的；安宁的）

transact.meaning: (formal) to do business with a person or an organization（（与人或组织）做业务，做交易）

transaction.meaning: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling（（一笔）交易，业务，买卖）；(formal) the process of doing sth（办理；处理）

transcend.meaning: (formal) to be or go beyond the usual limits of sth（超出，超越（通常的界限））

transcript.meaning: a written or printed copy of words that have been spoken（抄本；誊本；打印本）；(especially NAmE) an official record of a student's work that shows the courses they have taken and the marks/grades they have achieved（学生成绩报告单）

transfer.meaning: to move from one place to another; to move sth/sb from one place to another（（使）转移，搬迁）；to move from one job, school, situation, etc. to another; to arrange for sb to move（（使）调动；转职；转学；改变（环境））；if you transfer a feeling, a disease, or power, etc., or if it transfers from one person to another, the second person has it, often instead of the first（转移（感情）；传染（疾病）；让与，转让（权力等））；to officially arrange for sth to belong to sb else or for sb else to control sth（转让；让与）

transferable.meaning: that can be moved from one place, person or use to another（可转移的；可调动的；可转让的；可转录的；可中转的）

transference.meaning: the process of moving sth from one place, person or use to another（转移；转递；调动；转让）

transform.meaning: to change the form of sth（使改变形态）；to completely change the appearance or character of sth, especially so that it is better（使改变外观（或性质）；使改观）

transformation.meaning: a complete change in sb/sth（（彻底的）变化，改观，转变，改革）；used in South Africa to describe the process of making institutions and organizations more democratic（（用于南非）民主改革）

transformer.meaning: a device for reducing or increasing the voltage of an electric power supply, usually to allow a particular piece of electrical equipment to be used（变压器）

transgress.meaning: (formal) to go beyond the limit of what is morally or legally acceptable（越轨；违背（道德）；违犯（法律））

transient.meaning: continuing for only a short time（短暂的；转瞬即逝的）；staying or working in a place for only a short time, before moving on（暂住的；过往的；临时的）；tran·si·ence /ˈtrænziəns; NAmEˈtrænʃəns/ noun [U] the transience of human life（人生的短暂）；(especially NAmE) a person who stays or works in a place for only a short time, before moving on（暂住某地的人；过往旅客；临时工）

transistor.meaning: a small electronic device used in computers, radios, televisions, etc. for controlling an electric current as it passes along a circuit（晶体管）；a small radio with transistors（晶体管收音机）

transit.meaning: the process of being moved or carried from one place to another（运输；运送；搬运；载运）；the act of going through a place on the way to somewhere else（通过；经过；通行；过境；中转）；(NAmE) the system of buses, trains, etc. which people use to travel from one place to another（交通运输系统）；to pass across or through an area（穿过；经过；越过）

transition.meaning: the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another（过渡；转变；变革；变迁）；tran·si·tion·al AW /trænˈzɪʃənl; NAmEtrænˈzɪʃənl/ /trænˈsɪʃənl; NAmEtrænˈsɪʃənl/ adj. a transitional period（过渡时期）

transitive.meaning: (of verbs（动词）；used with a direct object（及物的）；tran·si·tive·ly /ˈtrænsətɪvli; NAmEˈtrænsətɪvli/ adv. The verb is being used transitively.（这个动词在此用作及物动词。）

translate.meaning: to express the meaning of speech or writing in a different language（翻译；译）；to be changed from one language to another（被翻译；被译成）；to change sth, or to be changed, into a different form（（使）转变，变为）；to understand sth in a particular way or give sth a particular meaning（（以某种方式）理解；给予（某种含义））

translation.meaning: the process of changing sth that is written or spoken into another language（翻译；译）；a text or work that has been changed from one language into another（译文；译本；译作）；the process of changing sth into a different form（转变；转化）

translator.meaning: a person who translates writing or speech into a different language, especially as a job（（尤指专职）翻译，译员，译者，翻译家）

translucent.meaning: allowing light to pass through but not transparent（半透明的）

transmission.meaning: the act or process of passing sth from one person, place or thing to another（传送；传递；传达；传播；传染）；the act or process of sending out an electronic signal or message or of broadcasting a radio or television programme（（电子信号或信息的）发射，发送；（电台或电视节目的）播送）；a radio or television message or broadcast（（电台或电视）信息，广播）；the system in a vehicle by which power is passed from the engine to the wheels（（车辆的）传动装置，变速器）

transmit.meaning: to send an electronic signal, radio or television broadcast, etc.（传送；输送；发射；播送）；(formal) to pass sth from one person to another（传播；传染）；(technical 术语) to allow heat, light, sound, etc. to pass through（传（热、声等）；透（光等）；使通过）

transmitter.meaning: a piece of equipment used for sending electronic signals, especially radio or television signals（（尤指电台或电视信号的）发射机，发射台，发报台）；(formal) a person or thing that transmits sth from one person or thing to another（传送者；传输者；传播者；传染媒介）

transparency.meaning: a picture printed on a piece of film, usually in a frame, that can be shown on a screen by shining light through the film（幻灯片；透明正片）；the quality of sth, such as glass, that allows you to see through it（透明；透明性）；the quality of sth, such as an excuse or a lie, that allows sb to see the truth easily（显而易见；一目了然）；the quality of sth, such as a situation or an argument, that makes it easy to understand（易懂；清楚；透明度）

transparent.meaning: (of glass, plastic, etc.（玻璃、塑料等）；allowing you to see through it（透明的；清澈的）；(of an excuse, a lie, etc.（借口、谎言等）；allowing you to see the truth easily（易识破的；易看穿的；显而易见的）

transplant.meaning: to take an organ, skin, etc. from one person, animal, part of the body, etc. and put it into or onto another（移植（器官、皮肤等））；to move a growing plant and plant it somewhere else（移栽，移种，移植（植物））；(formal) to move sb/sth to a different place or environment（使迁移；使移居）；trans·plan·ta·tion /ˌtrænsplɑːnˈteɪʃn; NAmEˌtrænsplænˈteɪʃn/ /ˌtrænzplɑːnˈteɪʃn; NAmEˌtrænzplænˈteɪʃn/ noun [U] liver transplantation（肝脏移植）

transport.meaning: a system for carrying people or goods from one place to another using vehicles, roads, etc.（交通运输系统）；a vehicle or method of travel（交通车辆；运输工具；旅行方式）；the activity or business of carrying goods from one place to another using lorries/trucks, trains, etc.（运输；运送；输送；搬运）；a ship, plane or lorry/truck used for carrying soldiers, supplies, etc. from one place to another（（运送部队、给养等的）运输船，运输机，运输卡车）

transportation.meaning: (in the past) the act of sending criminals to a place that is far away as a form of punishment（（旧时的）流放）

transpose.meaning: (formal) to change the order of two or more things（使掉换顺序）；(formal) to move or change sth to a different place or environment or into a different form（使转移；使换位；使变形）；(music 音) to write or play a piece of music or a series of notes in a different key（使（乐曲）变调，移调）

transverse.meaning: placed across sth（横（向）的；横断的；横切的）

trap.meaning: a piece of equipment for catching animals（（捕捉动物的）陷阱，罗网，夹，捕捉器）；a clever plan designed to trick sb, either by capturing them or by making them do or say sth that they did not mean to do or say（圈套；诡计）；an unpleasant situation from which it is hard to escape（（难以逃脱的）困境，牢笼）；a light carriage with two wheels, pulled by a horse（双轮轻便马车）

trapper.meaning: a person who traps and kills animals, especially for their fur（捕杀动物者（尤指为获取毛皮））

trash.meaning: (NAmE) things that you throw away because you no longer want or need them（废物；垃圾）；(informal, disapproving) objects, writing, ideas, etc. that you think are of poor quality（劣质品；拙劣的作品；糟粕；谬论）；(NAmE) (informal) an offensive word used to describe people that you do not respect（窝囊废；废物；没出息的人）；to damage or destroy sth（损坏；毁坏）

trauma.meaning: (psychology 心) a mental condition caused by severe shock, especially when the harmful effects last for a long time（精神创伤）；an unpleasant experience that makes you feel upset and/or anxious（痛苦经历；挫折）；(medical 医) an injury（损伤；外伤）

travel.meaning: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance（长途行走；旅行；游历）；to go or move at a particular speed, in a particular direction, or a particular distance（（以某速度、朝某方向或在某距离内）行进，转送，传播）；(of food, wine, an object, etc.（食物、葡萄酒、物体等）；to be still in good condition after a long journey（经长途运输仍不变质；经得住长途运输）

traveller.meaning: a person who is travelling or who often travels（旅行者；旅游者；旅客；游客）；(BrE) a person who does not live in one place but travels around, especially as part of a group（（尤指结队而行的）漂泊者）

traverse.meaning: (formal or technical 术语) to cross an area of land or water（横过；横越；穿过；横渡）；(in mountain climbing（爬山）；an act of moving sideways or walking across a steep slope, not climbing up or down it; a place where this is possible or necessary（（在陡坡上的）侧向移动，横过，横越；可横越的地方）

tray.meaning: a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic with raised edges, used for carrying or holding things, especially food（盘；托盘）；(often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a shallow plastic box, used for various purposes（（各种用途的）浅塑料盒）

tread.meaning: (especially BrE) to put your foot down while you are stepping or walking（踩；踏；践踏）；to crush or press sth with your feet（踩碎；践踏）；(formal or literary) to walk somewhere（行走；步行；走）；to be very careful about what you do or say（小心谨慎地说；小心翼翼地做）

treason.meaning: the crime of doing sth that could cause danger to your country, such as helping its enemies during a war（危害国家罪，叛国罪（如战时通敌））；treas·on·able /ˈtriːzənəbl; NAmEˈtriːzənəbl/ adj. a treasonable act（叛国行为）

treasure.meaning: a collection of valuable things such as gold, silver and jewellery（金银财宝；珠宝；财富）；a highly valued object（极贵重的物品；珍宝；宝物；珍品）；a person who is much loved or valued（备受宠爱（或珍爱）的人；心肝宝贝儿）；to have or keep sth that you love and that is extremely valuable to you（珍视；珍爱；珍重；珍藏）

treasurer.meaning: a person who is responsible for the money and accounts of a club or an organization（（俱乐部或组织的）司库，会计，出纳，财务主管）

treasury.meaning: (in Britain, the US and some other countries) the government department that controls public money（（英国、美国和其他一些国家的）财政部）；a place in a castle, etc. where valuable things are stored（（城堡等中的）金银财宝库，宝库）

treat.meaning: to behave in a particular way towards sb/sth（以 … 态度对待；以 … 方式对待）；to consider sth in a particular way（把 … 看作；把 … 视为）；to deal with or discuss sth in a particular way（处理；讨论）；to give medical care or attention to a person, an illness, an injury, etc.（医治；治疗）

treatise.meaning: (formal) a long and serious piece of writing on a particular subject（（专题）论文）

treatment.meaning: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make sb look and feel good（治疗；疗法；诊治；护理）；a way of behaving towards or dealing with a person or thing（对待；待遇）；a way of dealing with or discussing a subject, work of art, etc.（处理；讨论；论述）；a process by which sth is cleaned, or protected against sth（（净化或防治）处理，加工）

treaty.meaning: a formal agreement between two or more countries（（国家之间的）条约，协定）

treble.meaning: the high tones or part in music or a sound system（（音乐或音响系统的）高音，高音部）；a child's high voice; a boy who sings with a treble voice（童声高音；唱高音的男童歌手）；a musical part written for a treble voice（高音声部）；(BrE) three successes in a row（三连胜）

tree.meaning: a tall plant that can live a long time. Trees have a thick central wooden trunk from which branches grow, usually with leaves on them.（树；树木；乔木）；(informal) to be behaving in a crazy or stupid way, perhaps because of drugs or alcohol（（药物或酒精等引起的）发疯，发傻）

treetop.meaning: the branches at the top of a tree（树梢）

trek.meaning: a long, hard walk lasting several days or weeks, especially in the mountains（长途跋涉，艰难的旅程（尤指在山区））；(informal) a long walk（远距离行走）；(informal) to make a long or difficult journey, especially on foot（（尤指徒步）长途跋涉）；to spend time walking, especially in mountains and for enjoyment and interest（（尤指在山中）远足，徒步旅行）

tremble.meaning: to shake in a way that you cannot control, especially because you are very nervous, excited, frightened, etc.（（因紧张、激动、惊慌等）颤抖，哆嗦，抖动，战栗）；to shake slightly（颤动；轻轻摇晃）；to be very worried or frightened（极担心；焦虑；恐惧）；a feeling, movement or sound of trembling（颤抖；战栗；哆嗦）

tremendous.meaning: very great（巨大的；极大的）；extremely good（极好的；精彩的；了不起的）；tre·men·dous·ly /trəˈmendəsli; NAmEtrəˈmendəsli/ adv. tremendously exciting（极其令人兴奋）

tremor.meaning: a small earthquake in which the ground shakes slightly（轻微地震；小震；微震）；a slight shaking movement in a part of your body caused, for example, by cold or fear（（由于寒冷或恐惧引起的）颤抖，战栗，哆嗦）

trench.meaning: a long deep hole dug in the ground, for example for carrying away water（沟；渠）；a long deep hole dug in the ground in which soldiers can be protected from enemy attacks (for example in northern France and Belgium in the First World War)（战壕；堑壕）；a long deep narrow hole in the ocean floor（海沟；大洋沟）

trend.meaning: a general direction in which a situation is changing or developing（趋势；趋向；倾向；动态；动向）

trespass.meaning: to enter land or a building that you do not have permission or the right to enter（擅自进入，非法侵入（他人的土地或建筑物））；(old use) to do sth wrong（做错事）；(formal) to make unfair use of sb's time, help, etc.（滥用，不公正地利用（别人的时间、帮助等））；an act of trespassing on land（非法侵入（他人土地））

trespasser.meaning: a person who goes onto sb's land without their permission（不法进入者）

trestle.meaning: a wooden or metal structure with two pairs of sloping legs. Trestles are used in pairs to support a flat surface, for example the top of a table.（（放置桌面等成对的）支架，条凳）

trial.meaning: a formal examination of evidence in court by a judge and often a jury, to decide if sb accused of a crime is guilty or not（（法院的）审讯，审理，审判）；the process of testing the ability, quality or performance of sb/sth, especially before you make a final decision about them（（对能力、质量、性能等的）试验，试用）；a competition or series of tests to find the best players for a sports team or an important event（预赛；选拔赛）；an event at which animals compete or perform（比赛；表演）

triangle.meaning: a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles; a thing in the shape of a triangle（三角形；三角形物体）；a simple musical instrument that consists of a long piece of metal bent into the shape of a triangle, that you hit with another piece of metal（三角铁（打击乐器））；a situation involving three people in a complicated relationship（三角关系）；an instrument for drawing straight lines and angles, made from a flat piece of plastic or metal in the shape of a triangle with one angle of 90°（三角板；三角尺）

triangular.meaning: shaped like a triangle（三角的；三角形的）；involving three people or groups（涉及三人的；三组的；三方面的）

tribal.meaning: connected with a tribe or tribes（部落的；部族的）；a member of a tribe, especially in S Asia（（尤指南亚的）部落成员）

tribe.meaning: (sometimes offensive) (in developing countries) a group of people of the same race, and with the same customs, language, religion, etc., living in a particular area and often led by a chief（部落）；(usually disapproving) a group or class of people, especially of one profession（（尤指同一职业的）一伙（人），一帮（人），一类（人））；(biology 生) a group of related animals or plants（（动物或植物的）群，族）；(informal or humorous) a large number of people（大群；大帮；大批）

tribespeople.meaning: the people who belong to a particular tribe（部落成员）

tributary.meaning: a river or stream that flows into a larger river or a lake（（流入大河或湖泊的）支流）；tribu·tary adj. [only before noun] a tributary stream（支流）

tribute.meaning: an act, a statement or a gift that is intended to show your respect or admiration, especially for a dead person（（尤指对死者的）致敬，颂辞；悼念；致哀；吊唁礼物）；showing the good effects or influence of sth/sb（（良好效果或影响的）体现，显示）；(especially in the past) money given by one country or ruler to another, especially in return for protection or for not being attacked（（尤指旧时一国向他国交纳的）贡品，贡金）

trick.meaning: something that you do to make sb believe sth which is not true, or to annoy sb as a joke（诡计；花招；骗局；把戏）；something that confuses you so that you see, understand, remember, etc. things in the wrong way（引起错觉（或记忆紊乱）的事物）；a clever action that sb/sth performs as a way of entertaining people（戏法；把戏）；a way of doing sth that works well; a good method（技巧；诀窍；窍门）

trickle.meaning: to flow, or to make sth flow, slowly in a thin stream（（使）滴，淌，小股流淌）；to go, or to make sth go, somewhere slowly or gradually（（使）慢慢走，缓慢移动）；(especially of money（尤指钱）；to spread from rich to poor people through the economic system of a country（（经国家经济体制）由富人向穷人滴流）

tricky.meaning: (rather informal) difficult to do or deal with（难办的；难对付的）；(of people（人）；clever but likely to trick you（狡猾的；诡计多端的）

tricycle.meaning: a vehicle similar to a bicycle, but with one wheel at the front and two at the back（三轮脚踏车）

trifle.meaning: (used as an adverb（用作副词）；slightly（稍微；一点儿）；something that is not valuable or important（小事；琐事；不值钱的东西）；(BrE) a cold dessert (= a sweet dish) made from cake and fruit with wine and/or jelly poured over it, covered with custard and cream（蛋奶水果松蛋糕，屈莱弗（在蛋糕和水果上浇葡萄酒或果冻，上覆蛋奶冻等））

trigger.meaning: the part of a gun that you press in order to fire it（（枪的）扳机）；something that is the cause of a particular reaction or development, especially a bad one（（尤指引发不良反应或发展的）起因，诱因）；the part of a bomb that causes it to explode（触发器；引爆器）；to make sth happen suddenly（发动；引起；触发）

trillion.meaning: ; one million million（万亿；兆）；(informal) a very large amount（大量；无数）；(old-fashioned) (BrE) one million million million; 1 000 000 000 000 000 000（百万兆）

trilobite.meaning: a small sea creature that lived millions of years ago and is now a fossil（三叶虫（生活于几百万年前的小型海洋生物，已成化石））

trilogy.meaning: a group of three books, films/movies, etc. that have the same subject or characters（（书籍、电影等的）三部曲；三部剧）

trim.meaning: to make sth neater, smaller, better, etc., by cutting parts from it（修剪；修整）；to cut away unnecessary parts from sth（切去，割掉，剪下，除去（不必要的部分））；to decorate sth, especially around its edges（装饰，修饰，点缀（尤指某物的边缘））；to arrange the sails of a boat to suit the wind so that the boat moves faster（随风扬帆；见风转舵）

trip.meaning: a journey to a place and back again, especially a short one for pleasure or a particular purpose（（尤指短程往返的）旅行，旅游，出行）；(slang) the experience that sb has if they take a powerful drug that affects the mind and makes them imagine things（（服用毒品后所产生的）幻觉，迷幻感受）；an act of falling or nearly falling down, because you hit your foot against sth（绊；绊倒）；to catch your foot on sth and fall or almost fall（绊；绊倒）

triple.meaning: having three parts or involving three people or groups（三部分的；三人的；三组的）；three times as much or as many as sth（三倍的；三重的）；triply /ˈtrɪpli; NAmEˈtrɪpli/ adv. verb [I, T] triple~ (sth) to become, or to make sth, three times as much or as many（成为三倍；使增至三倍）

triplicate.meaning: done three times（做过三次）；(of a document（文件）；copied twice, so that there are three copies in total（一式三份）

trite.meaning: (of a remark, an opinion, etc.（言语、想法等）；dull and boring because it has been expressed so many times before; not original（老生常谈的；陈腐的；老一套的）

triumph.meaning: a great success, achievement or victory（巨大成功；重大成就；伟大胜利）；the feeling of great satisfaction or joy that you get from a great success or victory（（巨大成功或胜利的）心满意足，喜悦，狂喜）；an excellent example of how successful sth can be（（成功的）典范，楷模）；to defeat sb/sth; to be successful（打败；战胜；成功）

triumphant.meaning: very successful in a way that causes great satisfaction（高奏凯歌的；大获全胜的；巨大成功的）；showing great satisfaction or joy about a victory or success（欢欣鼓舞的；扬扬得意的；耀武扬威的）

trivial.meaning: not important or serious; not worth considering（不重要的；琐碎的；微不足道的）

upgrade.meaning: to make a piece of machinery, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient（使（机器、计算机系统等）升级；提高；改进）；to give sb a more important job（提升；提拔）；to give sb a better seat on a plane, room in a hotel, etc. than the one that they have paid for（提高（飞机乘客、旅馆住客等的）待遇；优待）；to improve the condition of a building, etc. in order to provide a better service（提高（设施、服务等的）档次；改善；使升格）

upheaval.meaning: a big change that causes a lot of confusion, worry and problems（剧变；激变；动乱；动荡）

uphold.meaning: to support sth that you think is right and make sure that it continues to exist（支持，维护（正义等））；(especially of a court of law（尤指法庭）；to agree that a previous decision was correct or that a request is reasonable（维持（原判）；受理（申诉））；up·hold·er upholder upholders /ʌpˈhəʊldə(r); NAmEʌpˈhoʊldər/ noun an upholder of traditional values（支持传统价值观的人）

upload.meaning: (computing 计) to move data to a larger computer system from a smaller one（上载；上传）；(computing 计) data that has been moved to a larger computer system from a smaller one（上载（或上传）的数据）

upon.meaning: Although the word upon has the same meaning as on, it is usually used in more formal contexts or in phrases such as once upon a time and row upon row of seats.（*）；used to emphasize that there is a large number or amount of sth（（强调数目或数量大））；if sth in the future is almost upon you, it is going to arrive or happen very soon（近在咫尺；即将来临）

upright.meaning: (of a person（人）；not lying down, and with the back straight rather than bent（直立的；挺直的）；placed in a vertical position（竖直的；直立的；垂直的）；behaving in a moral and honest way（正直的；诚实的；规矩的）

upsetting.meaning: making you feel unhappy, anxious or annoyed（令人不快（或忧虑、苦恼）的）

upside.meaning: the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad（（糟糕局面的）好的一面，光明的一面，正面）

urban.meaning: connected with a town or city（城市的；都市的；城镇的）；connected with types of music such as rhythm and blues and reggae that are played by black musicians（都市音乐的，城市音乐的（如节奏布鲁斯音乐、雷盖音乐））

urbane.meaning: (especially of a man（尤指男子）；good at knowing what to say and how to behave in social situations; appearing relaxed and confident（温文儒雅的；练达的；从容不迫的）

urge.meaning: to advise or try hard to persuade sb to do sth（敦促；催促；力劝）；to recommend sth strongly（大力推荐；竭力主张）；(formal) to make a person or an animal move more quickly and/or in a particular direction, especially by pushing or forcing them（驱赶；鞭策）；to encourage sb to do sth or support them so that they do it better（鼓励；激励；为 … 加油）

New equipment is urgently needed.（急需新设备。）

urn.meaning: a tall decorated container, especially one used for holding the ashes of a dead person（瓮；（尤指）骨灰缸）；a large metal container with a tap, used for making and/or serving tea or coffee（（带龙头的）茶水桶，咖啡桶）

us.meaning: used when the speaker or writer and another or others are the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be（我们）；(BrE) (informal) me（我）

usable.meaning: that can be used; in good enough condition to be used（能用的；可用的；适用的）

usage.meaning: the way in which words are used in a language（（词语的）用法，惯用法）；the fact of sth being used; how much sth is used（使用；利用；利用率）

ute.meaning: a member of a Native American people many of whom live in the US states of Colorado and Utah（犹他人（美洲土著，很多居于美国科罗拉多州和犹他州））

utilize.meaning: (formal) to use sth, especially for a practical purpose（使用；利用；运用；应用）

vacation.meaning: (in Britain) one of the periods of time when universities or courts of law are closed; (in the US) one of the periods of time when schools, colleges, universities or courts of law are closed（（英国大学的）假期；（美国学校的）假期；（法庭的）休庭期）；a period of time spent travelling or resting away from home（度假）；to spend a holiday somewhere（度假；休假）

vary.meaning: (of a group of similar things（一组类似的事物）；to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.（（大小、形状等）相异，不同，有别）；to change or be different according to the situation（（根据情况）变化，变更，改变）；to make changes to sth to make it slightly different（（略为）变更，改变）

virtual.meaning: almost or very nearly the thing described, so that any slight difference is not important（很接近的；几乎 … 的；事实上的；实际上的；实质上的）；made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the Internet（（通过计算机软件，如在互联网上）模拟的，虚拟的）

virtually.meaning: almost or very nearly, so that any slight difference is not important（几乎；差不多；事实上；实际上）；(computing 计) by the use of computer software that makes sth appear to exist; using virtual reality technology（模拟；虚拟；以模拟现实技术）

virtue.meaning: (formal) behaviour or attitudes that show high moral standards（高尚的道德；正直的品性；德行）；a particular good quality or habit（美德；优秀品质；良好习惯）；an attractive or useful quality（优点；长处；用处）；(formal) by means of or because of sth（凭藉；依靠；由于；因为）

virtuosity.meaning: a very high degree of skill in performing or playing（（表演或演奏方面的）高超技艺，精湛演技）

virtuous.meaning: (formal) behaving in a very good and moral way（品行端正的；品德高的；有道德的）；(disapproving or humorous) claiming to behave better or have higher moral standards than other people（自命不凡的；自命清高的）

virus.meaning: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope, that causes infectious disease in people, animals and plants（病毒；滤过性病毒）；(informal) a disease caused by a virus（病毒性疾病；病毒病）；instructions that are hidden within a computer program and are designed to cause faults or destroy data（（计算机程序中的）病毒）

visa.meaning: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country（（护照的）签证）

viscera.meaning: the large organs inside the body, such as the heart, lungs and stomach（内脏；脏腑）

viscous.meaning: (of a liquid（液体）；thick and sticky; not flowing freely（黏稠的；黏滞的）

visibility.meaning: how far or well you can see, especially as affected by the light or the weather（可见度；能见度；能见距离）；the fact or state of being easy to see（可见性；明显性）

visible.meaning: that can be seen（看得见的；可见的）；that is obvious enough to be noticed（明显的；能注意到的）

vision.meaning: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position（视力；视野）；an idea or a picture in your imagination（想像；幻象）；a dream or similar experience, especially of a religious kind（梦幻；幻象；神示；异象）；the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence（想像力；眼力；远见卓识）

visionary.meaning: (approving) original and showing the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence（有眼力的；有创见的；有远见卓识的）；relating to dreams or strange experiences, especially of a religious kind（梦幻的；耽于幻想的；（尤指）宗教异象的；神示的）；(usually approving) a person who has the ability to think about or plan the future in a way that is intelligent or shows imagination（有眼力的人；有远见卓识的人）

visit.meaning: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time（访问；拜访；看望；参观）；(computing 计) to go to a website on the Internet（访问（互联网上的网站））；to stay somewhere for a short time（（短暂地）作客，逗留）；to make an official visit to sb, for example to perform checks or give advice（视察；巡视）

visitor.meaning: a person who visits a person or place（来访者；访问者；参观者；游客）

visual.meaning: of or connected with seeing or sight（视力的；视觉的）；visu·al·ly AW /ˈvɪʒuəli; NAmEˈvɪʒuəli/ adv. visually handicapped/impaired（有视力障碍的；视力受损的）；a picture, map, piece of film, etc. used to make an article or a talk easier to understand or more interesting（视觉资料（指说明性的图片、影片等））

visualize.meaning: to form a picture of sb/sth in your mind（使形象化；想像；构思；设想）

vital.meaning: necessary or essential in order for sth to succeed or exist（必不可少的；对 … 极重要的）；connected with or necessary for staying alive（生命的；维持生命所必需的）；(of a person（人）；full of energy and enthusiasm（生气勃勃的；充满生机的；热情洋溢的）

vitality.meaning: energy and enthusiasm（生命力；活力；热情）

vitamin.meaning: a natural substance found in food that is an essential part of what humans and animals eat to help them grow and stay healthy. There are many different vitamins.（维生素；维他命）

vivid.meaning: (of memories, a description, etc.（记忆、描述等）；producing very clear pictures in your mind（清晰的；生动的；逼真的）；(of light, colours, etc.（光、颜色等）；very bright（鲜明的；耀眼的；鲜艳的；强烈的）

vocabulary.meaning: all the words that a person knows or uses（（某人掌握或使用的）词汇，词汇量）；all the words in a particular language（（某一语言的）词汇，词汇量）；the words that people use when they are talking about a particular subject（（某学科中所使用的）词汇）；a list of words with their meanings, especially in a book for learning a foreign language（（尤指外语教科书中附有释义的）词汇表）

vocal.meaning: connected with the voice（嗓音的；发声的）；telling people your opinions or protesting about sth loudly and with confidence（大声表达的；直言不讳的）；the part of a piece of music that is sung, rather than played on a musical instrument（（乐曲中的）歌唱部分，声乐部分）

vocation.meaning: a type of work or way of life that you believe is especially suitable for you（（认为特别适合自己的）工作，职业，生活方式）；a belief that a particular type of work or way of life is especially suitable for you（（认为某种工作或生活方式特别适合自己的）信心，使命感）；a belief that you have been chosen by God to be a priest or nun（圣召；神召）

vocational.meaning: connected with the skills, knowledge, etc. that you need to have in order to do a particular job（职业的；职业技术的；业务知识的）

vogue.meaning: a fashion for sth（流行；时髦；风行；风尚）

voice.meaning: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing（嗓音；说话声；歌唱声）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having a voice of the type mentioned（有 … 嗓音的；嗓音 … 的）；the right to express your opinion and influence decisions（发言权；发表意见的权利；影响）

voiceless.meaning: (of consonants（辅音）；produced without moving your vocal cords. For example, the consonants /p/, /t/ and /k/ are voiceless.（清音的）

void.meaning: (formal or literary) a large empty space（空间；空白；真空；空虚）；(formal) completely lacking sth（缺乏；没有）；(of a contract, an agreement etc.（合同、协议等）；not valid or legal（无效的）

volatile.meaning: (of a person or their moods（人或其情绪）；changing easily from one mood to another（易变的；无定性的；无常性的）；(of a situation（情况）；likely to change suddenly; easily becoming dangerous（可能急剧波动的；不稳定的；易恶化的）

volcanic.meaning: caused or produced by a volcano（火山的；火山引起的；火山产生的）

volcano.meaning: a mountain with a large opening at the top through which gases and lava (= hot liquid rock) are forced out into the air, or have been in the past（火山）

vole.meaning: a small animal like a mouse or rat that lives in fields or near rivers（田鼠）

volley.meaning: (in some sports, for example tennis or football (soccer)（某些体育运动，如网球或足球）；a hit or kick of the ball before it touches the ground（截击空中球；凌空击球（或踢球））；a lot of bullets, stones, etc. that are fired or thrown at the same time（（子弹的）群射，齐发；（石块的）齐投）；a lot of questions, comments, insults, etc. that are directed at sb quickly one after the other（（质问、评论、辱骂等的）接连发出）

volleyball.meaning: a game in which two teams of six players use their hands to hit a large ball backwards and forwards over a high net while trying not to let the ball touch the ground on their own side（排球运动）

volt.meaning: a unit for measuring the force of an electric current（伏，伏特（电压单位））

voltage.meaning: electrical force measured in volts（电压；伏特数）

volume.meaning: the amount of space that an object or a substance fills; the amount of space that a container has（体积；容积；容量）；the amount of sth（量；额）；the amount of sound that is produced by a television, radio, etc.（音量；响度）；a book, that is part of a series of books（（成套书籍中的）一卷，一册）

voluminous.meaning: (of clothing（衣服）；very large; having a lot of cloth（肥大的；宽松的；用布料多的）；(of a piece of writing, a book, etc.（文章、书等）；very long and detailed（浩繁的；大部头的；长篇的；冗长的）

voluntary.meaning: done willingly, not because you are forced（自愿的；志愿的；主动的；自告奋勇的）；(of work（工作）；done by people who choose to do it without being paid（自愿性的；无偿的；义务性的）；(of a person（人）

volunteer.meaning: a person who does a job without being paid for it（义务工作者；志愿者）；a person who offers to do sth without being forced to do it（自告奋勇者；主动做某事的人）；a person who chooses to join the armed forces without being forced to join（志愿兵；义勇兵）；to offer to do sth without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it（自愿做；义务做；无偿做）

voluptuous.meaning: (of a woman（女人）；attractive in a sexual way with large breasts and hips（体态丰满的；性感的；肉感的）；(literary) giving you physical pleasure（令人舒服的；舒适的）

vomit.meaning: to bring food from the stomach back out through the mouth（呕；吐；呕吐）；food from the stomach brought back out through the mouth（呕吐物）

voracious.meaning: eating or wanting large amounts of food（饭量大的；贪吃的；狼吞虎咽的）；wanting a lot of new information and knowledge（（对信息、知识）渴求的；求知欲强的）

vortex.meaning: (technical 术语) a mass of air, water, etc. that spins around very fast and pulls things into its centre（低涡；涡漩）；(literary) a very powerful feeling or situation that you cannot avoid or escape from（感情（或局势）的漩涡）

vote.meaning: a formal choice that you make in an election or at a meeting in order to choose sb or decide sth（选票；票）；an occasion when a group of people vote on sth（投票；选举；表决）；the total number of votes in an election（投票总数；选票总数）；the vote given by a particular group of people, or for a particular party, etc.（（某一群体的）投票总数；（某一政党等的）得票总数）

voter.meaning: a person who votes or has the right to vote, especially in a political election（（尤指政治性选举的）投票人，选举人，有选举权的人）

voting.meaning: the action of choosing sb/sth in an election or at a meeting（投票；选举；表决）

vouch.meaning: (formal) to say that you believe that sb will behave well and that you will be responsible for their actions（替 … 担保（或保证））；(formal) to say that you believe that sth is true or good because you have evidence for it（（因有证据而）为 … 作证）

voucher.meaning: a printed piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for sth, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price of sth（代币券；票券）

vow.meaning: a formal and serious promise, especially a religious one, to do sth（（尤指宗教的）誓，誓言，誓约）；to make a formal and serious promise to do sth or a formal statement that is true（起誓；立誓；发誓）

vowel.meaning: a speech sound in which the mouth is open and the tongue is not touching the top of the mouth, the teeth, etc., for example /ɑː, e, ɔː/（元音；（台）母音）；a letter that represents a vowel sound. In English the vowels are a, e, i, o, and u.（元音字母）

voyage.meaning: a long journey, especially by sea or in space（航行；（尤指）航海，航天）；(literary) to travel, especially in a ship and over a long distance（航行；远行；（尤指）远航）

voyager.meaning: a person who goes on a long journey, especially by ship to unknown parts of the world（航行者；远行者；（尤指）远航探险者）

vulgar.meaning: not having or showing good taste; not polite, elegant or well behaved（庸俗的；粗俗的；粗野的；不雅的）；rude and likely to offend（粗野的；粗鲁的；下流的）；vul·gar·ly /; NAmE/ adv. He eyed her vulgarly.（他色迷迷地瞅着她。）

vulnerable.meaning: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally（（身体上或感情上）脆弱的，易受 … 伤害的）；vul·ner·abil·ity /ˌvʌlnərəˈbɪləti; NAmEˌvʌlnərəˈbɪləti/ noun [U] vulnerability~ (of sb/sth) (to sth) financial vulnerability（在财政上易受打击）

wad.meaning: a thick pile of pieces of paper, paper money, etc. folded or rolled together（（纸张、钞票等的）卷，沓，捆）；a mass of soft material, used for blocking sth or keeping sth in place（用以填塞（或填衬等）的软材料；填料；填絮；衬料）；(especially NAmE) to fold or press sth into a tight wad（将 … 揉成团；使成沓；使成卷）；to fill sth with soft material for warmth or protection（（用柔软的材料）填塞，填充，衬垫）

wade.meaning: to walk with an effort through sth, especially water or mud（跋涉，涉，蹚（水或淤泥等））；to walk or stand with no shoes or socks in shallow water in the sea, a lake, etc.（蹚水；赤足涉水）；(informal) to enter a fight, a discussion or an argument in an aggressive or not very sensitive way（强行加入，介入，插手（打架、讨论、争论等））；(informal) to attack sb with words in an angry aggressive way（抨击）

wag.meaning: one of a group of ‘wives and girlfriends’ of famous men, especially members of a sports team（（名人的，尤指运动队明星的）妻子女友团成员）

wage.meaning: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week, for work or services（（通常指按周领的）工资，工钱）；to begin and continue a war, a battle, etc.（开始，发动，进行，继续（战争、战斗等））

wager.meaning: (old-fashioned or formal) an arrangement to risk money on the result of a particular event（打赌）；to bet money（打赌；押（赌注））；used to say that you are so confident that sth is true or will happen that you would be willing to bet money on it（打赌；打包票）

wagon.meaning: a railway/railroad truck for carrying goods（（铁路）货车车厢，车皮）；a vehicle with four wheels, pulled by horses or oxen and used for carrying heavy loads（四轮载重马车（或牛车））；a small table on very small wheels, used for carrying or serving food or drink（（运送食品、饮料的）小推车，台车）；(informal) to not drink alcohol, either for a short time or permanently（（短期或永久地）不喝酒，戒酒，滴酒不沾）

wail.meaning: to make a long loud high cry because you are sad or in pain（（因悲伤或疼痛）哭号，恸哭）；to cry or complain about sth in a loud high voice（大声呼叫；哀号；高声抱怨）；(of things（物）；to make a long high sound（发出长而高的声音；呼啸）

waist.meaning: the area around the middle of the body between the ribs and the hips, often narrower than the areas above and below（腰；腰部；腰围）；the part of a piece of clothing that covers the waist（（衣服的）腰部，腰）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）；having the type of waist mentioned（有 … 腰身的；腰身 … 的）

wait.meaning: to stay where you are or delay doing sth until sb/sth comes or sth happens（等；等待；等候）；to hope or watch for sth to happen, especially for a long time（（尤指长期地）希望，盼望，期待）；(of things（事物）；to be ready for sb to have or use（准备妥；在手边；可得到；可使用）

waiter.meaning: a person whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.（（餐馆等的）服务员，侍者）

waive.meaning: to choose not to demand sth in a particular case, even though you have a legal or official right to do so（放弃（权利、要求等））

wake.meaning: to stop sleeping; to make sb stop sleeping（醒；醒来；唤醒；弄醒）；(literary or formal) to make sb remember sth or feel sth again（唤起（记忆）；使再次感觉到）；(informal) (usually in orders（通常用于命令）；to become more lively and interested（活跃起来；更感兴趣）

waken.meaning: to wake, or make sb wake, from sleep（醒来；睡醒；唤醒；弄醒）；to make sb remember sth or feel sth again（唤起（记忆）；使感觉到）

walk.meaning: to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground, but without running（走；行走；步行）；to spend time walking for pleasure（徒步旅行；散步）；to go somewhere with sb on foot, especially in order to make sure they get there safely（陪伴 … 走；护送 … 走）；to take an animal for a walk; to make an animal walk somewhere（牵着（动物）走；遛；赶着 … 走）

walker.meaning: (especially BrE) a person who walks, usually for pleasure or exercise（步行者；散步的人；徒步旅行者）；a person who walks fast, slow, etc.（走路快（或慢等）的人）；a metal frame that people use to help them to walk, for example people who are old or who have sth wrong with their legs（助行器）；a frame with wheels and a harness for a baby who can walk around a room, supported by the frame（（幼儿）学步车）

walking.meaning: (especially BrE) the activity of going for walks in the countryside for exercise or pleasure（行走；步行；散步；徒步旅行）；the sport of walking a long distance as fast as possible without running（竞走）；(informal) used to describe a human or living example of the thing mentioned（似人的；活的）

wall.meaning: a long vertical solid structure, made of stone, brick or concrete, that surrounds, divides or protects an area of land（城墙；围墙）；any of the vertical sides of a building or room（墙；壁；墙壁）；something that forms a barrier or stops you from making progress（屏障；隔阂；壁垒）；the outer layer of sth hollow such as an organ of the body or a cell of an animal or a plant（（身体器官或动植物细胞等的）外壁）

wallaby.meaning: an Australian animal like a small kangaroo, that moves by jumping on its strong back legs and keeps its young in a pouch (= a pocket of skin) on the front of the mother's body（沙袋鼠（袋鼠科动物，产于澳大利亚））

wallet.meaning: a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic used for keeping paper money and credit cards in（（放钞票、信用卡的）钱包，皮夹子）；(BrE) a flat leather, plastic or cardboard case for carrying documents in（（携带文件用的）皮夹，塑料夹，硬纸夹）

wallpaper.meaning: thick paper, often with a pattern on it, used for covering the walls and ceiling of a room（壁纸；墙纸）；(computing 计) the background pattern or picture that you choose to have on the screen of your computer, mobile/cell phone, etc.（（计算机、手机屏幕上的）壁纸，桌面背景）；to put wallpaper onto the walls of a room（往（屋里墙上）贴壁纸）

walnut.meaning: the light brown nut of the walnut tree that has a rough surface and a hard round shell in two halves（核桃；胡桃）；the tree on which walnuts grow（核桃树；胡桃树）；the brown wood of the walnut tree, used in making furniture（核桃木；胡桃木）

walrus.meaning: an animal like a large seal (= a sea animal with thick fur, that eats fish and lives around coasts), that has two long outer teeth called tusks and lives in Arctic regions（海象（形似海豹，獠牙较长，栖息在北极海域））

wan.meaning: the abbreviation for ‘wide area network’ (a system in which computers in different places are connected, usually over a large area)（广域网（全写为 wide area network，将大范围内不同地方的电脑联网的系统））

wand.meaning: a straight thin stick that is held by sb when performing magic or magic tricks（魔杖）；any object in the shape of a straight thin stick（棍；棒；杆；杖）

wander.meaning: to walk slowly around or to a place, often without any particular sense of purpose or direction（闲逛；漫游；游荡）；to move away from the place where you ought to be or the people you are with（偏离（正道）；走失；离散）；(of a person's mind or thoughts（人的思想或想法）；to stop being directed on sth and to move without much control to other ideas, subjects, etc.（走神；神志恍惚；（思想）开小差）

wanderer.meaning: a person who keeps travelling from place to place with no permanent home（漂泊者；漫游者；流浪者）

wane.meaning: to become gradually weaker or less important（衰落；衰败；败落；减弱）；(of the moon（月亮）；to appear slightly smaller each day after being round and full（缺；亏）；becoming smaller, less important or less common（变小；衰落；减弱；败落）

want.meaning: to have a desire or a wish for sth（要；想要；希望）；Notice that you cannot say ‘want that … ’.（注意不能说 want that ...：）；When the infinitive is used after want, it must have to.（*）；(informal) to need sth（需要）

war.meaning: a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other over a period of time（战争；战争状态）；a situation in which there is aggressive competition between groups, companies, countries, etc.（（群体、公司、国家之间的）竞争，斗争，对抗，冲突）；a fight or an effort over a long period of time to get rid of or stop sth unpleasant（（为消灭有害事物的）长期斗争；顽强抵御）；(informal) to have been injured in a fight or an accident（打架受伤；在事故中受伤）

warbler.meaning: a small bird. There are many types of warbler, some of which have a musical call.（莺（有些能发出悦耳的啭鸣））

ward.meaning: a separate room or area in a hospital for people with the same type of medical condition（病房；病室）；(in Britain) one of the areas into which a city is divided and which elects and is represented by a member of the local council（（英国城市中可选出一位地方议员的）区，选区）；(law 律) a person, especially a child, who is under the legal protection of a court or another person (called a guardian )（受监护人（受法院或监护人保护的人，尤指儿童））；to protect or defend yourself against danger, illness, attack, etc.（防止，避免，抵御（危险、疾病、攻击等））

warden.meaning: a person who is responsible for taking care of a particular place and making sure that the rules are obeyed（管理人；看守人；监护人）；(especially NAmE) the person in charge of a prison（监狱长）；(in Britain) a title given to the head of some colleges and institutions（（英国）学院院长，协会会长，机构主管）

wardrobe.meaning: a large cupboard for hanging clothes in which is either a piece of furniture or (in British English) built into the wall（衣柜；衣橱；（英国）放置衣物的壁橱）；the clothes that a person has（（一个人的）全部衣物）；the department in a theatre or television company that takes care of the clothes that actors wear（（剧院或电视公司的）服装部，戏装保管室）

ware.meaning: (in compounds（构成复合词）；objects made of the material or in the way or place mentioned（用某材料（或以某方式、在某地）制造的物品）；objects used for the purpose or in the room mentioned（作 … 用的器皿； … 室的物品）；(old-fashioned) things that sb is selling, especially in the street or at a market（（尤指小商贩在大街上或市场里出售的）物品）

warehouse.meaning: a building where large quantities of goods are stored, especially before they are sent to shops/stores to be sold（仓库；货栈；货仓）

warehousing.meaning: the practice or business of storing things in a warehouse（仓贮；仓贮业）

warfare.meaning: the activity of fighting a war, especially using particular weapons or methods（战；作战；战争）；the activity of competing in an aggressive way with another group, company, etc.（（群体、公司等之间的）斗争，竞争，冲突）

warm.meaning: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold（温暖的；暖和的）；keeping you warm or staying warm in cold weather（保暖的；保温的）；showing enthusiasm and/or affection; friendly（温情的；热心的；友好的）；(of colours（颜色）

warm-blooded.meaning: (of animals（动物）；having a warm blood temperature that does not change if the temperature around them changes（温血的；恒温的）

warmer.meaning: (especially in compounds（尤用于构成复合词）；a piece of clothing, a device, etc. that warms sb/sth（保温衣；保温器；加热器）

warmth.meaning: the state or quality of being warm, rather than hot or cold（温暖；暖和）；the state or quality of being enthusiastic and/or friendly（热情；友情）

warn.meaning: to tell sb about sth, especially sth dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it（提醒注意（可能发生的事）；使警惕）；to strongly advise sb to do or not to do sth in order to avoid danger or punishment（劝告（使有所防备）；警告；告诫）；(in sport, etc.（体育运动等）；to give sb an official warning after they have broken a rule（警告）

warning.meaning: a statement, an event, etc. telling sb that sth bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it（（就可能发生的意外等提出的）警告，警示；先兆）；a statement telling sb that they will be punished if they continue to behave in a particular way（（就将要遭受的处罚等提出的）警告，警戒）；warn·ing adj. [only before noun] She had ignored the warning signs of trouble ahead.（她没有理会警示前方危险的标志。）

warp.meaning: to become, or make sth become, twisted or bent out of its natural shape, for example because it has become too hot, too damp, etc.（（使）扭曲，弯曲，变形）；to influence sb so that they begin to behave in an unacceptable or shocking way（使（行为等）不合情理；使乖戾）；(technical 术语) the threads on a loom (= a machine used for making cloth) that other threads are passed over and under in order to make cloth（（织布机上的）经线，经纱）

warrant.meaning: a legal document that is signed by a judge and gives the police authority to do sth（执行令；授权令）；a document that gives you the right to receive money, services, etc.（（接受款项、服务等的）凭单，许可证）；(formal) (usually in negative sentences（通常用于否定句）；an acceptable reason for doing sth（（做某事的）正当理由，依据）

warranty.meaning: a written agreement in which a company selling sth promises to repair or replace it if there is a problem within a particular period of time（（商品）保用单）

warrior.meaning: (especially in the past) a person who fights in a battle or war（（尤指旧时的）武士，勇士，斗士）

warship.meaning: a ship used in war（军舰；舰艇）

wartime.meaning: the period during which a country is fighting a war（战时）；war·time adj. [only before noun] Fruit was a luxury in wartime Britain.（在战时的英国，水果是一种奢侈品。）

wary.meaning: careful when dealing with sb/sth because you think that there may be a danger or problem（（对待人或事物时）小心的，谨慎的，留神的，小心翼翼的）；wari·ly /ˈweərəli; NAmEˈwerəli/ adv. The cat eyed him warily.（那只猫警惕地注视着他。）；wari·ness /ˈweərinəs; NAmEˈwerinəs/ noun [U] feelings of wariness（小心谨慎）

wash.meaning: to make sth/sb clean using water and usually soap（洗；洗涤）；(especially BrE) to make yourself clean using water and usually soap（洗澡；洗脸；洗手）；(of clothes, cloth, etc.（衣服、织物等）；to be able to be washed without losing colour or being damaged（耐洗；洗后不褪色（或破损））

washing.meaning: the act of cleaning sth using water and usually soap（洗；洗涤；洗刷；冲洗）；(BrE) clothes, sheets, etc. that are waiting to be washed, being washed or have just been washed（待洗的（或正在洗的、刚洗过的）衣物）

wasp.meaning: the abbreviation for ‘White Anglo-Saxon Protestant’ (a white American whose family originally came from northern Europe and is therefore thought to be from the most powerful section of society)（白种盎格鲁 — 撒克逊裔新教徒（全写为 White Anglo-Saxon Protestant，祖先为来自北欧的白种人，被认为是美国社会中势力最强大的族群））

waste.meaning: to use more of sth than is necessary or useful（浪费；滥用）；to give, say, use, etc. sth good where it is not valued or used in the way that it should be（白费；糟蹋）；to not make good or full use of sb/sth（未充分利用；使 … 屈才）；(informal) (especially NAmE) to get rid of sb, usually by killing them（干掉；把 … 废了；杀死）

wasteful.meaning: using more of sth than is necessary; not saving or keeping sth that could be used（浪费的；挥霍的）

waster.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a person or thing that uses too much of sth in an unnecessary way（浪费 … 的人；耗费 … 的东西）；(informal, disapproving) a person who is useless or no good at anything（废物；无用的人；饭桶；酒囊饭袋）

watch.meaning: to look at sb/sth for a time, paying attention to what happens（看；注视；观看；观察）；to take care of sb/sth for a short time（（短时间）照看，看护，照管）；(informal) to be careful about sth（小心；当心；留意）；(disapproving) to be careful not to work longer than the required time; to think more about when your work will finish than about the work itself（盯着钟表（算计着不超过规定的工作时间，或只盼望下班而无心工作））

watcher.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a person who watches and studies sb/sth regularly（… 观察家； … 观察员）

watchful.meaning: paying attention to what is happening in case of danger, accidents, etc.（注意的；警惕的；提防的）

water.meaning: a liquid without colour, smell or taste that falls as rain, is in lakes, rivers and seas, and is used for drinking, washing, etc.（水）；an area of water, especially a lake, river, sea or ocean（大片的水；水域；（尤指）江，河，湖，海）；the water in a particular lake, river, sea or ocean（（某一江、河、湖、海的）水域）；the surface of a mass of water（（一片）水面）

waterborne.meaning: spread or carried by water（水传播的；水源传染的；经水路的）

waterfall.meaning: a place where a stream or river falls from a high place, for example over a cliff or rock（瀑布）

waterfowl.meaning: a bird that can swim and lives near water, especially a duck or goose（水鸟；水禽（尤指鸭或鹅））

waterfront.meaning: a part of a town or an area that is next to water, for example in a harbour（滨水路；滨水区；码头区）

waterproof.meaning: that does not let water through or that cannot be damaged by water（不透水的；防水的；耐水的）；a piece of clothing made from material that does not let water through（防水衣物；雨衣）；to make sth waterproof（使不透水；使防水）

watershed.meaning: an event or a period of time that marks an important change（转折点，分界线，分水岭（标志着重大变化的事件或时期））；a line of high land where streams on one side flow into one river, and streams on the other side flow into a different river（分水线；分水岭；分水界）；(in Britain) the time before which programmes that are not considered suitable for children may not be shown on television（（英国）儿童不宜节目可在电视上播放的起始时间）

waterside.meaning: the area at the edge of a river, lake, etc.（水边；河边；湖滨；海滨）

watertight.meaning: that does not allow water to get in or out（不透水的；防水的；水密的）；(of an excuse, a plan, an argument, etc.（借口、计划、论点等）；carefully prepared so that it contains no mistakes, faults or weaknesses（严密的；无懈可击的；天衣无缝的）

waterway.meaning: a river, canal, etc. along which boats can travel（水路；航道）

waterworks.meaning: a building with machinery for supplying water to an area（自来水厂）；(informal or humorous) the organs of the body through which urine (= waste water) is passed（（人体的）排水系统；泌尿系统）；(informal, disapproving) to start crying, especially in order to get sympathy or attention（开始哭鼻子（尤指为博得同情或引人关注））

watery.meaning: of or like water; containing a lot of water（水的；似水的；含水的；水分很多的）；weak and/or pale（虚弱的；苍白无力的）；(of food, drink, etc.（食物、饮料等）；containing too much water; thin and having no taste（水分过多的；稀薄无味的）

watt.meaning: a unit for measuring electrical power（瓦，瓦特（电功率单位））

wave.meaning: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea, ocean, etc.（海浪；波浪；波涛）；a sudden increase in a particular activity or feeling（汹涌的行动（或思想）态势；心潮；风潮）；a large number of people or things suddenly moving or appearing somewhere（涌现的人（或事物）；涌动的人（或物））；a movement of your arm and hand from side to side（挥臂；挥手；招手；摆手）

wavelength.meaning: the distance between two similar points on a wave of energy, such as light or sound（波长）；the size of a radio wave that is used by a particular radio station, etc. for sending signals or broadcasting programmes（（广播电台等使用的）频道，波道）；(informal) to have the same way of thinking or the same ideas or feelings as sb else（具有（与他人）相同的思路；合拍；与 … 所见略同）

waver.meaning: to be or become weak or unsteady（减弱；动摇；颤抖）；to hesitate and be unable to make a decision or choice（踌躇；犹豫不决；举棋不定）；(especially of light（尤指光）；to move in an unsteady way（摇曳；闪烁；忽明忽暗）

wavy.meaning: having curves; not straight（起伏不平的；波浪形的；拳曲的）

wax.meaning: a solid substance that is made from beeswax or from various fats and oils and used for making candles, polish, models, etc. It becomes soft when it is heated.（蜡；蜂蜡；动物蜡；植物蜡；石蜡）；a soft sticky yellowish substance that is found in your ears（耳垢；耳屎）；to polish sth with wax（给 … 打蜡）；to cover sth with wax（给 … 上蜡；给 … 涂蜡）

waxy.meaning: made of wax; looking or feeling like wax（蜡制的；似蜡的；质地光滑的）

way.meaning: a method, style or manner of doing sth（方法；手段；途径；方式）；a particular manner or style of behaviour（作风；风度；样子）；the typical way of behaving and living of a particular group of people（（群体的）行为方式，生活方式，习俗）；a route or road that you take in order to reach a place（路线；路；道路）

we.meaning: I and another person or other people; I and you（我们；咱们）；people in general（人们）

weak.meaning: not physically strong（虚弱的；无力的）；that cannot support a lot of weight; likely to break（不牢固的；易损坏的；易破的）；easy to influence; not having much power（易受影响的；懦弱的；软弱无力的）；people who are poor, sick or without power（穷人；病人；弱者）

weaken.meaning: to make sb/sth less strong or powerful; to become less strong or powerful（（使）虚弱，衰弱；减弱；削弱）；to make sth less physically strong; to become less physically strong（使强度减弱；削弱）；to become or make sb become less determined or certain about sth（使（肯定程度）减弱；动摇；犹豫）

weakly.meaning: in a weak way（虚弱地；软弱无力地；懦弱地；冷淡地）

weakness.meaning: lack of strength, power or determination（软弱；虚弱；疲软；衰弱；懦弱）；a weak point in a system, sb's character, etc.（（系统、性格等的）弱点，缺点，不足）；difficulty in resisting sth/sb that you like very much（（对人或事物的）迷恋，无法抗拒）

wealth.meaning: a large amount of money, property, etc. that a person or country owns（钱财；财产；财物；财富）；the state of being rich（富有；富裕；富足）；a large amount of sth（大量；丰富；众多；充裕）

wealthy.meaning: having a lot of money, possessions, etc.（富有的；富裕的；富饶的）；people who are rich（富人；有钱人；阔人）

wean.meaning: to gradually stop feeding a baby or young animal with its mother's milk and start feeding it with solid food（使（婴儿或动物幼崽）断奶）；to make sb gradually stop doing or using sth（使逐渐戒除某些习惯（或使用某些东西））；to make sb experience sth regularly, especially from an early age（使 … 经常经历（尤指从早年））

weapon.meaning: an object such as a knife, gun, bomb, etc. that is used for fighting or attacking sb（武器；兵器；凶器）；something such as knowledge, words, actions, etc. that can be used to attack or fight against sb/sth（武器，手段，工具（指用作攻击或斗争的知识、言语、行动等））

wear.meaning: to have sth on your body as a piece of clothing, a decoration, etc.（穿；戴；佩戴）；to have your hair in a particular style; to have a beard or moustache（蓄，留（发、须等））；to have a particular expression on your face（流露，面带，呈现（某种神态））；to become, or make sth become thinner, smoother or weaker through continuous use or rubbing（磨损；消耗；用旧）

wearer.meaning: the person who is wearing sth; a person who usually wears the thing mentioned（穿戴者；佩戴人；常穿戴 … 的人）

weary.meaning: very tired, especially after you have been working hard or doing sth for a long time（（尤指长时间努力工作后）疲劳的，疲倦的，疲惫的）；(literary) making you feel tired or bored（使人疲劳的；使人厌烦的）；(formal) no longer interested in or enthusiastic about sth（（对 … ）不再感兴趣，不再热心，感到不耐烦）；wear·ily /ˈwɪərəli; NAmEˈwɪrəli/ adv. He closed his eyes wearily.（他疲惫地闭上了眼睛。）

weather.meaning: the condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, such as the temperature, and if there is wind, rain, sun, etc.（天气；气象）；(informal) a report of what the weather will be like, that is on the radio or television, or in the newspapers（气象预报）；(BrE) in all kinds of weather, good and bad（不论天气好坏；风雨无阻）；to watch sb/sth carefully in case you need to take action（对 … 随时留意；对 … 小心提防）

weave.meaning: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or strips across, over and under each other by hand or on a machine called a loom（（用手或机器）编，织）；to make sth by twisting flowers, pieces of wood, etc. together（（用 … ）编成）；to put facts, events, details, etc. together to make a story or a closely connected whole（（把 … ）编成，编纂成，编造（故事等））；to move along by running and changing direction continuously to avoid things that are in your way（迂回行进，穿行（以避开障碍））

weaver.meaning: a person whose job is weaving cloth（织布工；编织工）

web.meaning: a complicated pattern of things that are closely connected to each other（网状物；网络；错综复杂的事物）；a piece of skin that joins the toes of some birds and animals that swim, for example ducks and frogs（蹼）

webcast.meaning: a live broadcast that is sent out on the Internet（网络直播）

website.meaning: a place connected to the Internet, where a company or an organization, or an individual person, puts information（网站）

wedding.meaning: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it（婚礼；结婚庆典）

wedge.meaning: a piece of wood, rubber, metal, etc. with one thick end and one thin pointed end that you use to keep a door open, to keep two things apart, or to split wood or rock（楔子；三角木）；something that is shaped like a wedge or that is used like a wedge（楔形物；用作楔子的东西）；a golf club that has the part that you hit the ball with shaped like a wedge（（击高尔夫球的）楔形铁头球棒）；to put or squeeze sth tightly into a narrow space, so that it cannot move easily（将 … 挤入（或塞进、插入））

wednesday.meaning: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday（星期三）

wee.meaning: (especially ScotE) very small in size（很小的；极小的）；small in amount; little（微量的；很少的；一丁点儿的）；an act of passing liquid waste (called urine ) from your body（尿尿；撒尿）；(informal, especially BrE) (often used by young children or when you are talking to them（常用作儿语）
