weed.meaning: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted, especially among crops or garden plants（杂草，野草（尤指庄稼或花园中的））；any wild plant without flowers that grows in water and forms a green floating mass（水草）；(humorous) tobacco or cigarettes（烟草；烟叶；香烟；烟卷）；(informal) the drug cannabis（大麻烟）

weedy.meaning: (BrE) (informal, disapproving) having a thin weak body（瘦弱的；弱不禁风的）；full of or covered with weeds（杂草丛生的；长满杂草的）

week.meaning: a period of seven days, either from Monday to Sunday or from Sunday to Saturday（周；星期；礼拜）；any period of seven days（一周；七天的时间）；the five days other than Saturday and Sunday（（除星期六和星期日以外的）五天）；the part of the week when you go to work（工作周（一个星期中的工作时间））

weekday.meaning: any day except Saturday and Sunday（工作日（星期一至星期五的任何一天））；week·days /; NAmE/ adv. open weekdays from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.（星期一至星期五上午 9 点至下午 6 点开放）

weekend.meaning: Saturday and Sunday（星期六和星期日；周末）；Saturday and Sunday, or a slightly longer period, as a holiday/vacation（星期六和星期日（或略长一点的）假日）；to spend the weekend somewhere（（在某处）过周末；度周末）

weekly.meaning: happening, done or published once a week or every week（每周的）；week·ly adv. Employees are paid weekly.（雇员按周领工资。）；a newspaper or magazine that is published every week（周报；周刊）

weep.meaning: (formal or literary) to cry, usually because you are sad（（通常因悲伤）哭泣，流泪）；(of a wound（伤口）；to produce liquid（流出，渗出（液体））；an act of crying（哭泣；落泪）

weft.meaning: the threads that are twisted under and over the threads that are held on a loom (= a frame or machine for making cloth)（（织布机上的）纬线，纬纱）

weigh.meaning: to have a particular weight（有 … 重；重）；to measure how heavy sb/sth is, usually by using scales（称重量，量体重（通常用磅秤））；to consider sth carefully before making a decision（认真考虑；权衡；斟酌）；to have an influence on sb's opinion or the result of sth（（对看法或结果）有影响；有分量）

weight.meaning: how heavy sb/sth is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms or pounds（重量；分量）；the fact of being heavy（重）；an object that is heavy（重物）；an object used to keep sth in position or as part of a machine（（用于固定某物或用作机器部件的）重体，重物）

weird.meaning: very strange or unusual and difficult to explain（奇异的；不寻常的；怪诞的）；strange in a mysterious and frightening way（离奇的；诡异的）；weird·ly /wɪədli; NAmEwɪrdli/ adv. The town was weirdly familiar.（这个城镇怪面熟的。）；weird·ness /wɪədnəs; NAmEwɪrdnəs/ noun [U] verb PHR V ˌweird sb ˈout (informal) to seem strange or worrying to sb and make them feel uncomfortable（使感到奇怪；使感到烦恼；使感到不舒服）

welcome.meaning: to say hello to sb in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere（（打招呼）欢迎（某人的到来））；to be pleased that sb has come or has joined an organization, activity, etc.（欢迎（新来的人）；迎新）；to be pleased to receive or accept sth（乐意接纳；欣然接受）；that you are pleased to have, receive, etc.（令人愉快的；受欢迎的）

weld.meaning: to join pieces of metal together by heating their edges and pressing them together（焊接；熔接；锻接）；to unite people or things into a strong and effective group（使紧密结合；使连成整体）；a joint made by welding（焊接点；焊接处）

welfare.meaning: the general health, happiness and safety of a person, an animal or a group（（个体或群体的）幸福，福祉，安康）；practical or financial help that is provided, often by the government, for people or animals that need it（（政府给予的）福利）；money that the government pays regularly to people who are poor, unemployed, sick, etc.（社会保障金（政府定期向贫穷、失业、患病等人员发放））

well.meaning: in a good, right or acceptable way（好；对；令人满意地）；thoroughly and completely（完全地；彻底地；全部地）；to a great extent or degree（很；相当；大大地；远远地）；easily（容易地；轻松地）

well-being.meaning: general health and happiness（健康；安乐；康乐）

well-to-do.meaning: having a lot of money（有钱的；富有的；富裕的）

welt.meaning: a raised mark on the skin where sth has hit or rubbed you（（撞击或擦伤所致的）红肿）

west.meaning: the direction that you look towards to see the sun go down; one of the four main points of the compass（西；西方）；Europe, N America and Canada, contrasted with Eastern countries（西方（与东方国家相对照的欧洲和北美））；(NAmE) the western side of the US（美国西部）；(in the past) Western Europe and N America, when contrasted with the Communist countries of Eastern Europe（（旧时与共产党执政的东欧国家相对照的）西方国家，西欧及北美）

western.meaning: located in the west or facing west（西方的；向西的；西部的）；connected with the west part of the world, especially Europe and N America（西方的；西方国家的；（尤指）欧美的）；a film/movie or book about life in the western US in the 19th century, usually involving cowboys（（描写 19 世纪美国西部，尤指有关牛仔生活的）西部电影，西部小说）

westerner.meaning: a person who comes from or lives in the western part of the world, especially western Europe or N America（西方人；（尤指）欧美人）；a person who was born in or who lives in western Canada or the US（（加拿大或美国）西部人）

wet.meaning: covered with or containing liquid, especially water（潮的；湿的；潮湿的）；(of weather, etc.（天气等）；with rain（有雨的；下雨的）；(of paint, ink, etc.（油漆、墨水等）

wetland.meaning: an area of wet land（湿地；沼泽地）；wet·land adj. [only before noun] wetland birds（沼泽地区的鸟）

whale.meaning: a very large animal that lives in the sea and looks like a very large fish. There are several types of whale, some of which are hunted.（鲸）；(informal) to enjoy yourself very much; to have a very good time（玩得很痛快；过得非常快活）

whaling.meaning: the activity or business of hunting and killing whales（捕鲸（业）；鲸加工（业））

wharf.meaning: a flat structure built beside the sea or a river where boats can be tied up and goods unloaded（码头）

what.meaning: used in questions to ask for particular information about sb/sth（什么）；the thing or things that; whatever（… 的事物；无论什么；凡是 … 的事物）；used to say that you think that sth is especially good, bad, etc.（多么；真；太）；(informal) and other things of the same type（以及其他同样的东西；诸如此类）

whatever.meaning: any or every; anything or everything（任何；每一；任何事物；一切事物）；used when you are saying that it does not matter what sb does or what happens, because the result will be the same（（表示做什么或发生什么都没关系，因结果都一样）无论什么，不管什么）；(especially BrE) used in questions to express surprise or confusion（（用于问句，表示惊讶或困惑）到底是什么，究竟是什么）；(informal, ironic) used as a reply to tell sb that you do not care what happens or that you are not interested in what they are talking about（（用于回应，表示不在乎或不感兴趣）或许吧，无所谓）

wheat.meaning: a plant grown for its grain that is used to produce the flour for bread, cakes, pasta, etc; the grain of this plant（小麦；小麦籽）；to distinguish useful or valuable people or things from ones that are not useful or have no value（识别优劣；分清好坏；去芜存菁）

wheel.meaning: one of the round objects under a car, bicycle, bus, etc. that turns when it moves（轮；车轮；轮子）；the round object used to steer a car, etc. or ship（（汽车等的）方向盘；（轮船的）舵轮）；(informal) a car（汽车）；a flat round part in a machine（机轮）

when.meaning: (used in questions（用于问句）；at what time; on what occasion（什么时候；何时；什么情况下；什么场合下）；used after an expression of time to mean ‘at which’ or ‘on which’（（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时，其时）；at which time; on which occasion（其时；当时；当场）

whenever.meaning: at any time that; on any occasion that（在任何 … 的时候；无论何时；在任何 … 的情况下）；every time that（每当；每次）；used when the time when sth happens is not important（别的什么时候（也可以）；任何时间（都行））；used in questions to mean ‘when’, expressing surprise（（用于问句，表示惊奇）究竟什么时候）

where.meaning: in or to what place or situation（在哪里；到哪里；处于哪种情形）；used after words or phrases that refer to a place or situation to mean ‘at, in or to which’（（用于表示地点或情况的词语后）在那（地方），到那（地方））；the place or situation in which（在那里；在该处；在该情况下）；(in) the place or situation in which（（在）… 的地方；（在）… 情况下）

whereabouts.meaning: the place where sb/sth is（（人或物）所在的地方；下落；行踪）；used to ask the general area where sb/sth is（（用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方，在哪里）

whereas.meaning: used to compare or contrast two facts（（用以比较或对比两个事实）然而，但是，尽管）；(law 律) used at the beginning of a sentence in an official document to mean ‘because of the fact that … ’（（用于正式文件中句子的开头）鉴于）

whereby.meaning: by which; because of which（凭此；借以；由于）

wherein.meaning: in which place, situation or thing; in what way（其中；在那里；在那种情况下；以什么方式）

wherever.meaning: in any place（在任何地方）；in all places that（在 … 的各个地方；各处；处处）；in all cases that（在所有 … 的情况下）；(informal) or any other place（或其他任何地方）

whether.meaning: used to express a doubt or choice between two possibilities（（表示迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择）是否）；used to show that sth is true in either of two cases（（表示两种情况都真实）是 …（还是），或者 …（或者），不管 …（还是））

which.meaning: used in questions to ask sb to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number（哪一个；哪一些）；used to be exact about the thing or things that you mean（（明确所指的事物）… 的那个， … 的那些）；used to give more information about sth（（进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些）；used to talk about distinguishing one person or thing from another（（区分人或事物）谁是谁，哪个是哪个）

whichever.meaning: used to say what feature or quality is important in deciding sth（（表示什么特征或品质在作决定时重要）… 的那个， … 的那些）；used to say that it does not matter which, as the result will be the same（无论哪个；无论哪些）

whig.meaning: in Britain in the past, a member of a party that supported progress and reform and that later became the Liberal Party（辉格党党员（属于英国旧时的激进党派，自由党的前身））

while.meaning: during the time that sth is happening（在 … 期间；当 … 的时候）；at the same time as sth else is happening（与 … 同时）；used to contrast two things（（对比两件事物）… 而， … 然而）；(used at the beginning of a sentence（用于句首）

whim.meaning: a sudden wish to do or have sth, especially when it is sth unusual or unnecessary（心血来潮；一时的兴致；突发的奇想）

whip.meaning: a long thin piece of rope or leather, attached to a handle, used for making animals move or punishing people（鞭子）；an official in a political party who is responsible for making sure that party members attend and vote in important government debates（纪律委员，党鞭（在政党中负责确保党员出席政府重要辩论并表决））；a written instruction telling members of a political party how to vote on a particular issue（（政党发给党员的）投票通知书，投票指示）；a sweet dish made from cream, eggs, sugar and fruit mixed together（搅打奶油甜食（用奶油、鸡蛋、糖和水果搅打而成））

whirl.meaning: to move, or make sb/sth move, around quickly in a circle or in a particular direction（（使）旋转，回旋，打转）；if your mind, thoughts, etc. whirl, you feel confused and excited and cannot think clearly（（头脑、思想等）混乱不清，激动，恍惚）；a movement of sth spinning round and round（旋转；回旋；急转）；a number of activities or events happening one after the other（接连不断的活动；纷至沓来的事件）

whirlwind.meaning: a very strong wind that moves very fast in a spinning movement and causes a lot of damage（旋风；旋流）；a situation or series of events where a lot of things happen very quickly（一片忙乱）；happening very fast（快速的；匆匆忙忙的；旋风似的）

whisker.meaning: any of the long stiff hairs that grow near the mouth of a cat, mouse, etc.（（猫、鼠等的）须）；(old-fashioned or humorous) the hair growing on a man's face, especially on his cheeks and chin（络腮胡子；连鬓胡子）；(BrE) to almost do sth（几乎要做；险些要做）；by a very small amount（差一点儿）

whisky.meaning: a strong alcoholic drink made from malted grain. It is sometimes drunk with water and/or ice.（威士忌）；a glass of whisky（一杯威士忌）

whisper.meaning: to speak very quietly to sb so that other people cannot hear what you are saying（耳语；低语；私语；小声说）；to say or suggest sth about sb/sth in a private or secret way（私下说；秘密告诉；悄声暗示）；(of leaves, the wind, etc.（叶子、风等）；to make a soft, quiet sound（沙沙作响；发飒飒声）

whistle.meaning: a small metal or plastic tube that you blow to make a loud high sound, used to attract attention or as a signal（哨子）；the sound made by blowing a whistle（哨子声）；the sound that you make by forcing your breath out when your lips are closed（口哨）；the high loud sound produced by air or steam being forced through a small opening, or by sth moving quickly through the air（汽笛声；警笛声；呼啸声）

white.meaning: having the colour of fresh snow or of milk（白的；白色的）；belonging to or connected with a race of people who have pale skin（白种人的；白人的）；(of the skin（皮肤）；pale because of emotion or illness（脸色苍白的）

whitewash.meaning: a mixture of chalk or lime and water, used for painting houses and walls white（（粉刷用的）石灰水，白涂料）；(disapproving) an attempt to hide unpleasant facts about sb/sth（粉饰；掩盖）；(informal) (in sport) a victory in every game in a series（（在体育比赛中接连击败对手的）全胜）；to cover sth such as a wall with whitewash（粉刷（墙壁等）；刷石灰水）

whiting.meaning: a small sea fish with white flesh that is used for food（牙鳕（一种肉为白色可食用的小海鱼））

whittle.meaning: to form a piece of wood, etc. into a particular shape by cutting small pieces from it（把（木头等）削成 …）；to make sth gradually decrease in value or amount（削减，减少，降低（ … 的价值或数量））；to reduce the size or number of sth（减少，缩减（ … 的大小或数目））

who.meaning: World Health Organization (an international organization that aims to fight and control disease)（世界卫生组织）

whoever.meaning: the person or people who; any person who（… 的那个人（或那些人）； … 的任何人）；used to say that it does not matter who, since the result will be the same（无论谁；不管什么人）；used in questions to mean ‘who’, expressing surprise（（用于问句，表示惊讶）究竟是谁，到底是谁）

whole.meaning: full; complete（全部的；整体的；完全的；所有的）；used to emphasize how large or important sth is（（强调大小或重要性）整个的，全部的）；not broken or damaged（完整的；完好无损的）；whole·ness /həʊlnəs; NAmEhoʊlnəs/ noun [U] ➔ see also wholly IDM Most idioms containing whole are at the entries for the nouns and verbs in the idioms, for example go the whole hog is at hog.（大多数含 whole 的习语，都可在该等习语中的名词及动词相关词条找到，如 go the whole hog 在词条 hog 下。）

wholesale.meaning: connected with goods that are bought and sold in large quantities, especially so they can be sold again to make a profit（批发的；趸售的）；(especially of sth bad（尤指负面的事物）；happening or done to a very large number of people or things（大规模的）；whole·sale adv. We buy the building materials wholesale.（我们批量购买建筑材料。）

wholesome.meaning: good for your health（有益健康的）；morally good; having a good moral influence（有道德的；有良好道德影响的）

whom.meaning: used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition（（与 who 同义，作为动词或介词的宾语）谁，什么人）

whose.meaning: used in questions to ask who sth belongs to（（用于问句）谁的）；used to say which person or thing you mean（（特指）那个人的，那一个的，其）；used to give more information about a person or thing（（进一步提供信息时用））

why.meaning: used in questions to ask the reason for or purpose of sth（（用于问句）为什么，为何）；used in questions to suggest that it is not necessary to do sth（（反问，表示不必）何必）；used to give or talk about a reason（（说明理由）为什么， … 的原因）；used in questions to mean ‘why’, expressing surprise（（用于问句，语带惊讶）究竟为什么）

wick.meaning: the piece of string in the centre of a candle which you light so that the candle burns（烛芯）；the piece of material in an oil lamp which absorbs the oil and which you light so that the lamp burns（灯芯）；(BrE) (informal) to annoy sb（激怒（某人）；招惹（某人））；(of a material) to take small drops of liquid from an area and move them away（（指材料）吸干，吸取，吸走）

wicked.meaning: morally bad（邪恶的；缺德的）；(informal) slightly bad but in a way that is amusing and/or attractive（淘气的；调皮的；恶作剧的）；dangerous, harmful or powerful（危险的；有害的；强大的）；(slang) very good（极好的；很棒的）

wicker.meaning: thin sticks of wood twisted together to make baskets, furniture, etc.（（编制筐篮、家具等用的）柳条，枝条）

wide.meaning: measuring a lot from one side to the other（宽的；宽阔的）；measuring a particular distance from one side to the other（… 宽的；宽度为 … 的）；including a large number or variety of different people or things; covering a large area（大量的；广泛的；范围大的）；very big（很大的）

widely.meaning: by a lot of people; in or to many places（普遍地；广泛地；范围广地）；to a large degree; a lot（很大程度上；大大地）

widen.meaning: to become wider; to make sth wider（（使）变宽；加宽；拓宽；放宽）；to become larger in degree or range; to make sth larger in degree or range（（使）扩展，程度加深，范围扩大）

widespread.meaning: existing or happening over a large area or among many people（分布广的；普遍的；广泛的）

widow.meaning: a woman whose husband has died and who has not married again（寡妇；遗孀）；if sb is widowed, their husband or wife has died（使丧偶；使成为寡妇（或鳏夫））；widowed /; NAmE/ adj. his widowed father（他鳏居的父亲）

widower.meaning: a man whose wife has died and who has not married again（鳏夫）

width.meaning: the measurement from one side of sth to the other; how wide sth is（宽度；广度）；a piece of material of a particular width（某一宽度的材料）；the distance between the two long sides of a swimming pool（（游泳池两长边之间的）池宽）

wield.meaning: to have and use power, authority, etc.（拥有，运用，行使，支配（权力等））；to hold sth, ready to use it as a weapon or tool（挥，操，使用（武器、工具等））

wife.meaning: the woman that a man is married to; a married woman（妻子；太太；夫人；已婚妇女）

wiggle.meaning: to move from side to side or up and down in short quick movements; to make sth move in this way（（使）扭动，摆动，摇动，起伏）；a small movement from side to side or up and down（（轻微的）摆动，扭动，摇动，起伏）

wild.meaning: living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm（自然生长的；野的；野生的）；in its natural state; not changed by people（天然的；荒凉的；荒芜的）；lacking discipline or control（缺乏管教的；无法无天的；放荡的）；full of very strong feeling（感情炽烈的）

wildebeest.meaning: a large antelope with curved horns（牛羚；角马）

wilderness.meaning: a large area of land that has never been developed or used for growing crops because it is difficult to live there（未开发的地区；荒无人烟的地区；荒野）；a place that people do not take care of or control（荒芜的地方；杂草丛生处）；no longer in an important position, especially in politics（在野；不再当政（或掌权））

wildlife.meaning: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment（野生动物；野生生物）

wildly.meaning: in a way that is not controlled（失控地；紊乱地）；extremely; very（极其；非常）

will.meaning: used for talking about or predicting the future（（谈及将来））；used for showing that sb is willing to do sth（（表示愿意）愿，要，会，定要）；used for asking sb to do sth（（烦劳别人做事时用））；used for ordering sb to do sth（（命令时用））

willing.meaning: not objecting to doing sth; having no reason for not doing sth（愿意；乐意）；ready or pleased to help and not needing to be persuaded; done or given in an enthusiastic way（自愿的；乐于相助的；积极肯干的）；will·ing·ly ★ /ˈwɪlɪŋli; NAmEˈwɪlɪŋli/ adv. People would willingly pay more for better services.（有好一些的服务，人们是愿意多花钱的。）

willow.meaning: a tree with long thin branches and long thin leaves, that often grows near water（柳；柳树）；the wood of the willow tree, used especially for making cricket bats（柳木（常用以制作板球拍））

willpower.meaning: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do（意志力）

win.meaning: to be the most successful in a competition, race, battle, etc.（（在比赛、赛跑、战斗等中）获胜，赢）；to get sth as the result of a competition, race, election, etc.（（在比赛、赛跑、选举等中）赢得，夺取，获得，挣得）；to achieve or get sth that you want, especially by your own efforts（（尤指通过自己的努力）取得，获得）；(informal) used to say that there is no acceptable way of dealing with a particular situation（怎么做都不讨好；没有令人满意的方法）

wind.meaning: air that moves quickly as a result of natural forces（风；气流）；air that you swallow with food or drink; gas that is produced in your stomach or intestines that makes you feel uncomfortable（（随食物或饮料）吞下的气；胃气；肠气）；breath that you need when you do exercise or blow into a musical instrument（（运动或吹奏乐器时的）呼吸）；the group of musical instruments in an orchestra that produce sounds when you blow into them; the musicians who play those instruments（（管弦乐团的）管乐器，管乐器组）

winding.meaning: having a curving and twisting shape（曲折的；弯曲的；蜿蜒的）

windmill.meaning: a building with machinery for grinding grain into flour that is driven by the power of the wind turning long arms (called sails )（风车磨房）；a tall thin structure with parts that turn round, used to change the power of the wind into electricity（（通过转动将风能转化为电能的）风车）；a toy with curved plastic parts that form the shape of a flower which turns round on the end of a stick when you blow on it（玩具风车）

window.meaning: an opening in the wall or roof of a building, car, etc., usually covered with glass, that allows light and air to come in and people to see out; the glass in a window（窗；窗户；窗口；窗玻璃）；an area within a frame on a computer screen, in which a particular program is operating or in which information of a particular type is shown（（计算机屏幕的）窗口，视窗）；a small area of sth that you can see through, for example to talk to sb or read sth on the other side（墙上（或信封等上）开的窗形的口；透明窗口）；a way of seeing and learning about sth（了解信息的渠道；窗口）

windowsill.meaning: a narrow shelf below a window, either inside or outside（窗沿；窗台）

windswept.meaning: (of a place（地方）；having strong winds and little protection from them（受大风吹的；当风的）；looking as though you have been in a strong wind（似被风吹散的；乱蓬蓬的）

windy.meaning: (of weather, etc.（天气等）；with a lot of wind（多风的；风大的）；(of a place（地方）；getting a lot of wind（当风的；受大风吹的）

wine.meaning: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes that has been left to ferment. There are many different kinds of wine.（葡萄酒）；an alcoholic drink made from plants or fruits other than grapes（（用植物或除葡萄以外的水果酿制的）酒，果酒）；a dark red colour（紫红色；深红色）；to go to restaurants, etc. and enjoy good food and drink; to entertain sb by buying them good food and drink（（去餐馆等）大吃大喝；用酒宴款待）

winery.meaning: a place where wine is made（葡萄酒厂；酿酒厂）

wing.meaning: one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or bat that it uses for flying（（鸟、昆虫或蝙蝠）翅膀，翼）；one of the large flat parts that stick out from the side of a plane and help to keep it in the air when it is flying（（飞行器的）翅膀；机翼）；one of the parts of a large building that sticks out from the main part（侧翼部分；侧厅；耳房；厢房）；a part of a car that is above a wheel（挡泥板；翼子板）

wingless.meaning: (especially of insects（尤指昆虫）；without wings（无翅的；无翼的）

wingspan.meaning: the distance between the end of one wing and the end of the other when the wings are fully stretched（翼展；翼幅）

wink.meaning: to close one eye and open it again quickly, especially as a private signal to sb, or to show sth is a joke（眨一只眼，眨眼示意（尤指使眼色或表示开玩笑））；to shine with an unsteady light; to flash on and off（闪烁；明灭）；to pretend that you have not noticed sth, especially sth bad or illegal（（尤指对坏事）视而不见；睁一只眼闭一只眼）；an act of winking, especially as a signal to sb（眨一只眼；眨眼示意；眼色）

winner.meaning: a person, a team, an animal, etc. that wins sth（获胜的人（或队、动物等）；优胜者）；(informal) a thing or person that is successful or likely to be successful（成功者；可能成功的人（或事物））；(sport 体) a goal or point that causes a team or a person to win a game（致胜的一记入球；赢得比赛的一分）

winning.meaning: that wins or has won sth, for example a race or competition（获胜的；赢的）；attractive in a way that makes other people like you（吸引人的；动人的；迷人的；可爱的）

winter.meaning: the coldest season of the year, between autumn/fall and spring（冬天；冬季）；to spend the winter somewhere（过冬）

wintertime.meaning: the period of time when it is winter（冬季；冬天；冬令）

wipe.meaning: to rub sth against a surface, in order to remove dirt or liquid from it; to rub a surface with a cloth, etc. in order to clean it（擦；拭；抹；揩；蹭）；to remove dirt, liquid, etc. from sth by using a cloth, your hand, etc.（（用布、手等）擦干净，抹掉）；to remove information, sound, images, etc. from a computer, tape or video（消除，抹去（计算机、磁带或录像带上的信息等））；to deliberately forget an experience because it was unpleasant or embarrassing（抹去（旧事））

wire.meaning: metal in the form of thin thread; a piece of this（金属丝；金属线；一段金属丝（或线））；a piece of wire that is used to carry an electric current or signal（电线；导线）；a wire fence（金属丝编制的栏栅；铁丝网）；(informal) to become confused about what sb has said to you so that you think they meant sth else（误会（别人的意思））

wireless.meaning: (old-fashioned) (especially BrE) a radio（无线电收音机）；a system of sending and receiving signals（无线电发射和接收系统；无线电报）；not using wires（无线的）

wisdom.meaning: the ability to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have（智慧；才智；精明）；how sensible sth is（明智）；the knowledge that a society or culture has gained over a long period of time（（社会或文化长期积累的）知识，学问）；the view or belief that most people hold（大多数人的看法；普遍信念）

wise.meaning: (of people（人）；able to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have（充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；明察善断的）；(of actions and behaviour（行动和行为）；sensible; based on good judgement（明智的；高明的；有判断力的）

wish.meaning: (not usually used in the present progressive tense（通常不用于现在进行时）；to want sth to happen or to be true even though it is unlikely or impossible（希望（不大可能的事）发生；怀着（不可能实现的）愿望）；‘That’ is nearly always left out, especially in speech.（尤其在口语中 that 几乎总是给省略掉。）；(especially BrE) (formal) to want to do sth; to want sth to happen（希望（做某事）；想要（某事发生））

wispy.meaning: consisting of small, thin pieces; not thick（一绺绺的；一缕缕的；成束的；纤细的）

wit.meaning: the ability to say or write things that are both clever and amusing（措辞巧妙的能力；风趣；才思）；a person who has the ability to say or write things that are both clever and amusing（才思敏捷说话诙谐的人；机智幽默的人）；your ability to think quickly and clearly and to make good decisions（理解力；颖悟力；头脑；智力）；(in adjectives（构成形容词）

witch.meaning: a woman who is believed to have magic powers, especially to do evil things. In stories, she usually wears a black pointed hat and flies on a broomstick.（女巫；巫婆）；(disapproving) an ugly unpleasant old woman（丑老太婆）

with.meaning: in the company or presence of sb/sth（和 … 在一起；和；同；跟）；having or carrying sth（有；具有；带有）；using sth（用；使用；以；藉）；used to say what fills, covers, etc. sth（（表示以某物填充、覆盖等））

withdraw.meaning: to move back or away from a place or situation; to make sb/sth do this（（使）撤回，撤离）；to stop giving or offering sth to sb（停止提供；不再给予）；to stop taking part in an activity or being a member of an organization; to stop sb/sth from doing these things（（使）退出）；to take money out of a bank account（提，取（银行账户中的款））

withdrawal.meaning: the act of moving or taking sth away or back（撤走；收回；取回）；the act of no longer taking part in sth or being a member of an organization（不再参加；退出（组织））；the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account（（从银行账户中）提款，取款）；the period of time when sb is getting used to not taking a drug that they have become addicted to, and the unpleasant effects of doing this（戒毒过程；脱瘾期）

wither.meaning: if a plant withers or sth withers it, it dries up and dies（（使）枯萎，凋谢）；to become less or weaker, especially before disappearing completely（萎缩；（尤指渐渐）破灭，消失）

withhold.meaning: (formal) to refuse to give sth to sb（拒绝给；不给）

within.meaning: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time（不出（某段时间）；在（某段时间）之内）；not further than a particular distance from sth（不出（某段距离）；在（某段距离）之间）；inside the range or limits of sth（不出（某范围或限度）；在（某范围）之内）；(formal) inside sth/sb（在 … 里；在 … 内部）

without.meaning: not having, experiencing or showing sth（没有；缺乏）；not in the company of sb（不和 … 在一起；无 … 相伴）；not using or taking sth（不用；不拿；不带）；not doing the action mentioned（不（做某事）；无；没）

withstand.meaning: (formal) to be strong enough not to be hurt or damaged by extreme conditions, the use of force, etc.（承受；抵住；顶住；经受住）

witness.meaning: a person who sees sth happen and is able to describe it to other people（目击者；见证人）；a person who gives evidence in court（证人）；a person who is present when an official document is signed and who also signs it to prove that they saw this happen（见证人；连署人）；evidence of a person's strong religious beliefs, that they show by what they say and do in public（见证（以言行证实信仰））

witty.meaning: able to say or write clever, amusing things（言辞诙谐的；巧妙的；妙趣横生的；机智的）

woad.meaning: a blue substance that people used to paint their bodies and faces with in ancient times（靛蓝（古时人们用来涂染身体和脸））

woe.meaning: the troubles and problems that sb has（麻烦；问题；困难）；great unhappiness（痛苦；苦恼；悲伤；悲哀）；(formal or humorous) a phrase that is used to warn sb that there will be trouble for them if they do sth or do not do sth（（用以警告某人会有麻烦）… 就要倒霉， … 将会遭殃）；(old use or humorous) a phrase that is used to say that you are very unhappy（我好苦哇！）

wok.meaning: a large pan shaped like a bowl, used for cooking food, especially Chinese food（炒菜锅；镬子）

wolf.meaning: a large wild animal of the dog family, that lives and hunts in groups（狼）；(informal) to have enough money to avoid going hungry; to stop sb feeling hungry（勉强度日；糊口）；to leave sb to be roughly treated or criticized without trying to help or defend them（弃 … 于险境而不顾；见死不救）；a person who seems to be friendly or harmless but is really an enemy（披着羊皮的狼）

woman.meaning: an adult female human（成年女子；妇女）；female humans in general（（泛指）女性）；(in compounds（构成复合词）；a woman who comes from the place mentioned or whose job or interest is connected with the thing mentioned（来自 …（或做 … 、喜欢 … 等）的女子）

womanhood.meaning: the state of being a woman, rather than a girl（成年女子的状态）；women in general（（统称）妇女）

womb.meaning: the organ in women and female animals in which babies develop before they are born（子宫）

wonder.meaning: to think about sth and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc.（想知道；想弄明白；琢磨）；used as a polite way of asking a question or asking sb to do sth（（礼貌地提问或请人做事时说））；to be very surprised by sth（感到诧异；非常惊讶）；a feeling of surprise and admiration that you have when you see or experience sth beautiful, unusual or unexpected（惊讶；惊奇；惊异；惊叹）

wonderful.meaning: very good, pleasant or enjoyable（精彩的；绝妙的；令人高兴的；使人愉快的）；making you feel surprise or admiration（令人惊奇的；令人赞叹的）

wonderfully.meaning: very; very well（非常；很好地）；unusually; in a surprising way（异乎寻常地；令人惊奇地）

wood.meaning: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of; this material when it is used to build or make things with, or as a fuel（木；木头；木料；木材；木柴）；an area of trees, smaller than a forest（树林；林地）；a heavy wooden ball used in the game of bowls（（草地滚球戏的）木瓶）；a golf club with a large head, that was usually made of wood in the past（木头球棒（旧时通常有木制顶部的高尔夫球棒））

woodblock.meaning: each of the small flat pieces of wood that are fitted together to cover a floor（（铺地板用的）木条，木块）；a piece of wood with a pattern cut into it, used for printing（木刻印版；版木）

woodcarving.meaning: the process of shaping a piece of wood with a sharp tool; a decorative object made in this way（木雕；木雕品）

woodcut.meaning: a print that is made from a pattern cut in a piece of wood（木版画；木刻）

wooden.meaning: made of wood（木制的；木头的）；not showing enough natural expression, emotion or movement（木头似的；死板的；呆板的；木讷的）；wood·en·ly /ˈwʊdnli; NAmEˈwʊdnli/ adv. She speaks her lines very woodenly.（她台词念得毫无表情。）

woodpecker.meaning: a bird with a long beak that it uses to make holes in trees when it is looking for insects to eat（啄木鸟）

woodwind.meaning: the group of musical instruments in an orchestra that are mostly made of wood or metal and are played by blowing. Flutes, clarinets and bassoons are all woodwind instruments.（（管弦乐团的）木管乐器，木管乐器组）

woody.meaning: (of plants（植物）；having a thick, hard stem like wood（木本的；木质的）；covered with trees（长满树木的；树木茂盛的）；having a smell like wood（像木头味的）

wool.meaning: the soft fine hair that covers the body of sheep, goats and some other animals（（羊等的）绒，毛）；long thick thread made from animal's wool, used for knitting（毛线；绒线）；cloth made from animal's wool, used for making clothes, etc.（毛料；毛织物）

woollen.meaning: made of wool（毛纺的；羊毛的；毛料的；毛线的）；involved in making cloth from wool（毛纺的；毛纺织业的）

word.meaning: a single unit of language which means sth and can be spoken or written（单词；词；字）；a thing that you say; a remark or statement（说的话；话语；言语）；a promise or guarantee that you will do sth or that sth will happen or is true（诺言；许诺；保证）；a piece of information or news（信息；消息）

wording.meaning: the words that are used in a piece of writing or speech, especially when they have been carefully chosen（措辞；用词）

wordy.meaning: using too many words, especially formal ones（话多的；冗长的；罗嗦的）

work.meaning: to do sth that involves physical or mental effort, especially as part of a job（做体力（或脑力）工作；劳动；干活）；to have a job（受雇于；从事 … 工作）；to make yourself/sb work, especially very hard（使工作；（尤指）使卖力干活）；to make efforts to achieve sth（争取；力争；努力取得）

workable.meaning: (of a system, an idea, etc.（系统、想法等）；that can be used successfully and effectively（可行的；行得通的）；that you can shape, spread, dig, etc.（可成形（或延长、挖掘等）的）；(of a mine, etc.（矿等）

workaholic.meaning: a person who works very hard and finds it difficult to stop working and do other things（工作狂；工作迷；醉心于工作的人）

workday.meaning: the part of a day during which you work（工作日（一天中的工作时间））

worker.meaning: (often in compounds（常构成复合词）；a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work（工作者；人员）；a person who is employed in a company or industry, especially sb who does physical work rather than organizing things or managing people（雇员；（尤指）劳工，工人）；(usually after an adjective（通常置于形容词后）

workforce.meaning: all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.（全体员工）；all the people in a country or an area who are available for work（（国家或地区的）劳动力，劳动大军，劳动人口）

working.meaning: having a job for which you are paid（有工作的；有职业的）；having a job that involves hard physical work rather than office work, studying, etc.（做工的；从事体力劳动的）；connected with your job and the time you spend doing it（工作上的；工作时间的）；a working breakfast or lunch is one at which you discuss business（（早餐或午餐等）边吃边谈公事的）

workman.meaning: a man who is employed to do physical work（男工人；工匠）；(with an adjective（与形容词连用）；a person who works in the way mentioned（工作 … 的人）

workmanship.meaning: the skill with which sb makes sth, especially when this affects the way it looks or works（手艺；技艺；工艺）

workout.meaning: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit（锻炼）

workplace.meaning: the office, factory, etc. where people work（工作场所）

worksheet.meaning: a piece of paper on which there is a series of questions and exercises to be done by a student（（学生做的）活页练习题）；a piece of paper on which work that has been done or has to be done is recorded（工作记录（或进度）表）

workshop.meaning: a room or building in which things are made or repaired using tools or machinery（车间；工场；作坊）；a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience（研讨会；讲习班）

workweek.meaning: the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week（一周的工作时间；工作周）

world.meaning: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features（世界；地球；天下）；a particular part of the earth; a particular group of countries or people; a particular period of history and the people of that period（某地域（或民族、历史时期等）的人类社会；世界）；a planet like the earth（（像地球的）星球，天体）；the people or things belonging to a particular group or connected with a particular interest, job, etc.（按性质（或职业等）划分的类别；界；界别）

worldwide.meaning: affecting all parts of the world（影响全世界的；世界各地的）；ˌworld·ˈwide /ˈwɜːldwaɪd; NAmEˈwɜːrldwaɪd/ adv. We have 2 000 members worldwide.（我们在全世界有 2 000 名成员。）

worm.meaning: a long thin creature with no bones or legs, that lives in soil（蠕虫）；long thin creatures that live inside the bodies of humans or animals and can cause illness（（人或动物体内的）寄生虫；肠虫）；the young form of an insect when it looks like a short worm（（昆虫的）幼虫）；(computing 计) a computer program that is a type of virus and that spreads across a network by copying itself（蠕虫；蠕虫程序；蠕虫病毒）

worried.meaning: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen and therefore feeling unhappy and afraid（担心的；担忧的；发愁的）；wor·ried·ly /ˈwʌridli; NAmEˈwɜːridli/ adv. He glanced worriedly at his father.（他忧心忡忡地瞥了他父亲一眼。）；(informal) used to tell sb that you were worried because you had not understood what they had said correctly（（误会所致）你让我虚惊一场）

worry.meaning: to keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have（担心；担忧；发愁）；to make sb/yourself anxious about sb/sth（使担心；使担忧；使发愁）；to annoy or disturb sb（骚扰；烦扰；使不安宁）；(of a dog（狗）

worrying.meaning: that makes you worry（令人担忧的；令人发愁的）；worry·ing·ly /ˈwʌriɪŋli; NAmEˈwɜːriɪŋli/ adv. worryingly high levels of radiation（令人担忧的强辐射）

worse.meaning: of poorer quality or lower standard; less good or more unpleasant（更差的；更糟的；更坏的）；more serious or severe（更严重的；更严厉的）；more ill/sick or unhappy（病情更重；健康恶化；更不愉快）；to lose a fight, competition, etc. or suffer more compared with others（（战斗、比赛等）失败，输得更惨）

worsen.meaning: to become or make sth worse than it was before（（使）变得更坏，变得更糟，恶化）；worsen·ing /ˈwɜːsnɪŋ; NAmEˈwɜːrsnɪŋ/ noun [sing.] a worsening of the international debt crisis（国际债务危机的加剧）；worsen·ing /ˈwɜːsnɪŋ; NAmEˈwɜːrsnɪŋ/ adj. worsening weather conditions（正在变坏的天气）

worship.meaning: the practice of showing respect for God or a god, by saying prayers, singing with others, etc; a ceremony for this（（对上帝或神的）崇拜，敬仰，礼拜）；a strong feeling of love and respect for sb/sth（崇拜；崇敬；爱慕）；(BrE) (formal) a polite way of addressing or referring to a magistrate or mayor（（对治安官或市长的尊称）阁下）；to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building（崇敬，崇拜（上帝或神）；（尤指在宗教场所）做礼拜）

worshipper.meaning: a person who worships God or a god（崇拜上帝（或神）的人；做礼拜的人；敬神者；拜神者）

worst.meaning: (superlative of bad（*）；of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind（最差的；最坏的；最糟的）；to be the cause of your own problems（自讨苦吃；是自己问题的根源）；to lose a fight, competition, etc. or suffer more compared with others（（在战斗、比赛等中）吃败仗，输得最惨）

worth.meaning: having a value in money, etc.（有 … 价值；值 … 钱）；used to recommend the action mentioned because you think it may be useful, enjoyable, etc.（（指行动）值得，有价值）；important, good or enjoyable enough to make sb feel satisfied, especially when difficulty or effort is involved（值得（费周折））；(of a person（人）

worthless.meaning: having no practical or financial value（没用的；无价值的）；(of a person（人）；having no good qualities or useful skills（品质坏的；不中用的）；worth·less·ness /ˈwɜːθləsnəs; NAmEˈwɜːrθləsnəs/ noun [U] a sense of worthlessness（没有价值的感觉）

worthwhile.meaning: important, enjoyable, interesting, etc; worth spending time, money or effort on（重要的；令人愉快的；有趣的；值得花时间（或花钱、努力等））

worthy.meaning: (formal) having the qualities that deserve sb/sth（值得（或应得）… 的）；having qualities that deserve your respect, attention or admiration（值得尊敬的；值得注意的；值得敬仰的）；having good qualities but not very interesting or exciting（值得尊敬的，有价值的（但不太令人感兴趣或激动的））；typical of what a particular person or thing might do, give, etc.（有（某人或事物）的典型特征）

would.meaning: used as the past form of will when reporting what sb has said or thought（（will 的过去式，用于转述）将，将会）；used for talking about the result of an event that you imagine（（带出想像的结果））；used for describing a possible action or event that did not in fact happen, because sth else did not happen first（（表示可能发生的事情没有发生，是因为之前另一件事没有发生）就会）；used for saying why sb does sth（（说明动机））

wound.meaning: an injury to part of the body, especially one in which a hole is made in the skin using a weapon（（身体上的）伤，伤口；（武器造成的）伤）；mental or emotional pain caused by sth unpleasant that has been said or done to you（（心灵上的）伤，创伤）；to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon（使（身体）受伤；（用武器）伤害）；to hurt sb's feelings（使（心灵）受伤；伤感情）

wounded.meaning: injured by a weapon, for example in a war（（身体）受伤的；负伤的）；feeling emotional pain because of sth unpleasant that sb has said or done（（感情）受损害的，受伤害的）；people who are wounded, for example in a war（伤员；伤兵；伤号）

wrap.meaning: to cover sth completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present（包，裹（礼物等））；to cover sth/sb in material, for example in order to protect it/them（用 … 包裹（或包扎、覆盖等））；to put sth firmly around sth/sb（用 … 缠绕（或围紧））；(computing 计) to cause text to be carried over to a new line automatically as you reach the end of the previous line; to be carried over in this way（（使文字）换行）

wrapper.meaning: a piece of paper, plastic, etc. that is wrapped around sth, especially food, when you buy it in order to protect it and keep it clean（（食品等的）包装材料，包装纸，包装塑料）；(WAfrE) a piece of cloth that is worn as an item of clothing around the waist and legs（（腰际和腿部的）围裹式服装）

wrapping.meaning: paper, plastic, etc. used for covering sth in order to protect it（包装材料；包装纸；包装塑料）

wreath.meaning: an arrangement of flowers and leaves, especially in the shape of a circle, placed on graves, etc. as a sign of respect for sb who has died（花圈（用于祭奠））；an arrangement of flowers and/or leaves in the shape of a circle, traditionally hung on doors as a decoration at Christmas（花环（传统上圣诞节时挂在门上））；a circle of flowers or leaves worn on the head, and used in the past as a sign of honour（花冠（旧时用作荣誉的象征））；(literary) a circle of smoke, cloud, etc.（（烟、云等的）圈，缭绕）

wreathe.meaning: to surround or cover sth（环绕；覆盖；笼罩）；to move slowly and lightly, especially in circles（缓缓移动；盘绕；缠绕；萦绕）

wreck.meaning: a ship that has sunk or that has been very badly damaged（沉船；严重损毁的船）；a car, plane, etc. that has been very badly damaged in an accident（（事故中）遭严重毁坏的汽车（或飞机等））；(informal) a person who is in a bad physical or mental condition（（身体或精神上）受到严重损伤的人）；(informal) a vehicle, building, etc. that is in very bad condition（状况非常糟糕的车辆（或建筑物等））

wreckage.meaning: the parts of a vehicle, building, etc. that remain after it has been badly damaged or destroyed（（车辆等的）残骸；（建筑物等的）废墟）

wren.meaning: a very small brown bird（鹪鹩（形小，浅褐色））

wrench.meaning: to pull or twist sth/sb/yourself suddenly and violently（猛拉；猛扭；猛拧）；to twist and injure a part of your body, especially your ankle or shoulder（扭伤（脚踝、肩膀等））；(formal) to make sb feel great pain or unhappiness, especially so that they make a sound or cry（使痛苦，使十分难过（尤指以致哭喊出声））；a metal tool with a specially shaped end for holding and turning things, including one which can be adjusted to fit objects of different sizes, also called a monkey wrench or an adjustable spanner（扳钳；扳手）

wrestle.meaning: to fight sb by holding them and trying to throw or force them to the ground, sometimes as a sport（摔跤）；to struggle to deal with sth that is difficult（奋力对付；努力处理；全力解决）

wretched.meaning: (of a person（人）；feeling ill/sick or unhappy（感到不适的；难受的；不愉快的）；(formal) extremely bad or unpleasant（极坏的；恶劣的）；(formal) making you feel sympathy or pity（可怜的；悲惨的）

wring.meaning: to twist and squeeze clothes, etc. in order to get the water out of them（拧，绞，拧出，绞出（衣服等中的水））；if you wring a bird's neck, you twist it in order to kill the bird（拧，扭（鸟的脖子，以将其杀死））；to squeeze sb's hand very tightly when you shake hands（（握手时）攥紧 … 的手）；to hold your hands together, and twist and squeeze them in a way that shows you are anxious or upset, especially when you cannot change the situation（（尤指出于焦急或烦恼）扭绞双手）

wrinkle.meaning: a line or small fold in your skin, especially on your face, that forms as you get older（（尤指脸上的）皱纹）；a small fold that you do not want in a piece of cloth or paper（（布或纸上的）皱褶，皱痕）；to make the skin on your face form into lines or folds; to form lines or folds in this way（（使脸上）起皱纹；皱起）；to form raised folds or lines in an untidy way; to make sth do this（（使）起皱褶）

wrist.meaning: the joint between the hand and the arm（手腕；腕关节）

write.meaning: to make letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or a pencil（书写；写字）；to produce sth in written form so that people can read, perform or use it, etc.（写作；作曲；编写）；to put information, a message of good wishes, etc. in a letter and send it to sb（写信）；to state the information or the words mentioned（写道；（以文字）说）

writer.meaning: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.（作家；作者；著者）；a person who has written a particular thing（写 … 的人；执笔者；撰写人）；(with an adjective（与形容词连用）；a person who forms letters in a particular way when they are writing（写字 … 的人）

writhe.meaning: to twist or move your body without stopping, often because you are in great pain（（常指因剧痛不停地）扭动，翻滚）

writing.meaning: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.（写；书写；写作）；the activity of writing books, articles, etc., especially as a job（（专职）写作；著书立说）；books, articles, etc. in general（著作；文字作品；文章）；a group of pieces of writing, especially by a particular person or on a particular subject（（某作家或专题的）著作，作品）

written.meaning: expressed in writing rather than in speech（书面的）；(of an exam, a piece of work, etc.（测验、工作等）；involving writing rather than speaking or practical skills（书面的；笔头的）；in the form of a letter, document, etc. and therefore official（以书信（或文件等）形式的；书面的；成文的；正式的）

wrong.meaning: not right or correct（错误的；不对的；不正确的）；(of a person（人）；not right about sth/sb（出错；搞错；有错误）；causing problems or difficulties; not as it should be（引起问题（或麻烦）；有毛病；不正常）

wrongly.meaning: in a way that is unfair, immoral or not correct（不公正地；不道德地；错误地）

wrought.meaning: (formal or literary) (used only in the past tense（仅用于过去时）；caused sth to happen, especially a change（使发生了，造成了（尤指变化））

xenon.meaning: a chemical element. Xenon is a gas that is found in very small quantities in the air and is used in some special electric lamps.（氙；氙气）

xerox.meaning: a process for producing copies of letters, documents, etc. using a special machine; a copy made using this process（施乐复印；施乐复印件；（台）全录影印）

x-ray.meaning: a type of radiation that can pass through objects that are not transparent and make it possible to see inside them（*）；a photograph made by X-rays, especially one showing bones or organs in the body（*）；a medical examination using X-rays（用 X 射线进行的临床检查）；to photograph and examine bones and organs inside the body, using X-rays（用 X 射线拍摄检查）

yacht.meaning: a large sailing boat, often also with an engine and a place to sleep on board, used for pleasure trips and racing（帆船；游艇；快艇）

yam.meaning: the large root of a tropical plant that is cooked as a vegetable（薯蓣；山药）

yard.meaning: (BrE) an area outside a building, usually with a hard surface and a surrounding wall（院子）；a piece of land next to or around your house where you can grow flowers, fruit, vegetables, etc., usually with a lawn (= an area of grass)（（住宅旁或周围的）庭园，花园，果园，菜园）；(usually in compounds（通常构成复合词）；an area of land used for a special purpose or business（（某种用途的）区域，场地）

yardstick.meaning: (especially NAmE) a ruler for measuring one yard（码尺）；a standard used for judging how good or successful sth is（（好坏或成败的）衡量标准；准绳）

yarn.meaning: thread that has been spun, used for knitting, making cloth, etc.（纱；纱线）；(informal) a long story, especially one that is exaggerated or invented（（尤指夸张的或编造的）长故事）

yawn.meaning: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply through it, usually because you are tired or bored（打哈欠）；(of a large hole or an empty space（大的洞穴或空间）；to be very wide and often frightening and difficult to get across（非常宽；难以逾越）；an act of yawning（哈欠）

yeah.meaning: yes（是的；对）；used when you are commenting on what sb has just said（（回应时用）哦，是吗）；used to say that you do not believe what sb has just said, disagree with it, or are not interested in it（（表示不相信、不同意或不感兴趣）算了吧）

year.meaning: the period from 1 January to 31 December, that is 365 or 366 days, divided into 12 months（年；日历年）；a period of 12 months, measured from any particular time（一年时间）；a period of 12 months connected with a particular activity（与某事相关的一年；年度）；(at a school, etc.（学校等）

yearly.meaning: happening once a year or every year（每年的；一年一次的）；paid, valid or calculated for one year（年度的；一年的）；year·ly adv. The magazine is issued twice yearly (= twice every year).（这份杂志每年发行两期。）

yearn.meaning: to want sth very much, especially when it is very difficult to get（渴望；渴求）

yeast.meaning: a fungus used in making beer and wine, or to make bread rise（酵母；酵母菌）；yeasty yeasty yeastier yeastiest /; NAmE/ adj. a yeasty smell（发酵的气味）

yell.meaning: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain（叫喊；大喊；吼叫）；a loud cry of pain, excitement, etc.（喊叫；叫嚷；大喊）；(NAmE) an organized shout of support for a team at a sports event（（为运动队加油的）呐喊，欢呼）

yellow.meaning: having the colour of lemons or butter（黄的；黄色的）；(taboo) an offensive word used to describe the light brown skin of people from some E Asian countries（（轻蔑语）黄皮肤的，黄色人种的）；(informal, disapproving) easily frightened（胆怯的）；yel·low·ness /ˈjeləʊnəs; NAmEˈjeloʊnəs/ noun [U, sing.] noun ★ [U, C] the colour of lemons or butter（黄；黄色）

yelp.meaning: to give a sudden short cry, usually of pain（（因疼痛等）突然尖叫）

yes.meaning: used to answer a question and say that sth is correct or true（（答话时表示正确或真实））；used to show that you agree with what has been said（（表示同意所说的话））；used to disagree with sth negative that sb has just said（（反驳否定的话））；used to agree to a request or to give permission（（表示答应或许可））

yesterday.meaning: on the day before today（在昨天）；the day before today（昨天）；the recent past（不久前；近日；往昔）；(informal, often humorous) no longer fashionable or new（过时）

yesteryear.meaning: the past, especially a time when attitudes and ideas were different（（尤指思想观念有别于当今的）旧时，往昔，过去）

yet.meaning: used in negative sentences and questions to talk about sth that has not happened but that you expect to happen（（用于否定句和疑问句，谈论尚未发生但可能发生的事））；(used in negative sentences（用于否定句）；now; as soon as this（现在；即刻；马上）；from now until the period of time mentioned has passed（从现在起直至某一时间；还）

yew.meaning: a small tree with dark green leaves and small red berries（紫杉；红豆杉）；the wood of the yew tree（紫杉木）

yield.meaning: to produce or provide sth, for example a profit, result or crop（出产（作物）；产生（收益、效益等）；提供）；(formal) to stop resisting sth/sb; to agree to do sth that you do not want to do（屈服；让步）；(formal) to allow sb to win, have or take control of sth that has been yours until now（放弃；缴出）；to move, bend or break because of pressure（（受压）活动，变形，弯曲，折断）

yoga.meaning: a Hindu philosophy that teaches you how to control your body and mind in the belief that you can become united with the spirit of the universe in this way（瑜伽派（印度哲学派别））；a system of exercises for your body and for controlling your breathing, used by people who want to become fitter or to relax（瑜伽术（健体和控制呼吸的锻炼））；yogic /ˈjəʊɡɪk; NAmEˈjoʊɡɪk/ adj. yogic techniques（瑜伽技巧）

yoke.meaning: a long piece of wood that is fastened across the necks of two animals, especially oxen, so that they can pull heavy loads（轭；（尤指）牛轭）；(literary or formal) rough treatment or sth that restricts your freedom and makes your life very difficult to bear（奴役；束缚；枷锁；羁绊）；a piece of wood that is shaped to fit across a person's shoulders so that they can carry two equal loads（轭形扁担）；a part of a dress, skirt, etc. that fits around the shoulders or hips and from which the rest of the cloth hangs（上衣抵肩；裙（或裤）腰）

yolk.meaning: the round yellow part in the middle of an egg（蛋黄）

you.meaning: used as the subject or object of a verb or after a preposition to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to（你；您；你们）；used with nouns and adjectives to speak to sb directly（（与名词及形容词连用，直接称呼某人））；used for referring to people in general（（泛指任何人））

young.meaning: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed（幼小的；未成熟的）；not yet old; not as old as others（年轻的；岁数不大的；相对年轻的）；consisting of young people or young children; with a low average age（由年轻人（或儿童）构成的；青少年的；平均年龄小的）；suitable or appropriate for young people（年轻人的；青年的；适合青年人的）

youngster.meaning: a young person or a child（年轻人；少年；儿童）

your.meaning: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to（你的；您的；你们的）；of or belonging to people in general（（泛指）大家的，人们的）；(informal) used to show that sb/sth is well known or often talked about（（指有名或经常被谈论的人或事物））；used in some titles, especially those of royal people（（用于某些称呼，尤指王室成员））

yours.meaning: of or belonging to you（你的；您的；你们的）；used at the end of a letter before signing your name（（用于书信结尾的签名前））；(BrE) (informal) your home（你的住所）

yourself.meaning: (the reflexive form of you（*）；used to emphasize the fact that the person who is being spoken to is doing sth（（强调说话对象做某事））；you（你；您）；alone; without anyone else（（你/你们）独自，单独）

youth.meaning: the time of life when a person is young, especially the time before a child becomes an adult（青年时期（尤指成年以前））；the quality or state of being young（年轻；青春；朝气）；(often disapproving) a young man（青年男子；小伙子）；young people considered as a group（（统称）青年，年轻人）

youthful.meaning: typical of young people（年轻人的；青年的；青春的）；young or seeming younger than you are（年轻的；显得年轻的）

yuan.meaning: the unit of money in China（元（中国货币单位））

zeal.meaning: (formal) great energy or enthusiasm connected with sth that you feel strongly about（热情；激情）

zealous.meaning: showing great energy and enthusiasm for sth, especially because you feel strongly about it（热情的；热烈的；充满激情的）

zebra.meaning: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white lines (= stripes) on its body（斑马）

zero.meaning: a temperature, pressure, etc. that is equal to zero on a scale（（气温、压力等的）零度，零点）；the lowest possible amount or level; nothing at all（最少量；最低点；最低程度；毫无）；to turn an instrument, control, etc. to zero（将（仪器、控制装置等）调到零）；to fix all your attention on the person or thing mentioned（集中全部注意力于）

zest.meaning: enjoyment and enthusiasm（热情；狂热）；the quality of being exciting, interesting and enjoyable（兴奋；激动；有趣；愉快）；the outer skin of an orange, a lemon, etc., when it is used to give flavour in cooking（柑橘外皮（包括柠檬或橙子等的外皮层，用于调味））

ziggurat.meaning: in ancient Mesopotamia, a tower with steps going up the sides, sometimes with a temple at the top（塔庙，庙塔（古代美索不达米亚的阶梯式金字塔形建筑））

zigzag.meaning: a line or pattern that looks like a series of letter W's as it bends to the left and then to the right again（锯齿形线条（或形状）；之字形）；zig·zag adj. [only before noun] a zigzag line/path/pattern（弯弯曲曲的线条/小路/形状）；to move forward by making sharp sudden turns first to the left and then to the right（曲折前进）

zinc.meaning: a chemical element. Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is mixed with copper to produce brass and is often used to cover other metals to prevent them from rusting.（锌）；(informal) (in some places in Africa) a sheet of corrugated iron that is used to make a roof, shelter, etc.（（非洲某些地方用于搭建屋顶、棚子等的）波纹铁板，瓦楞铁板）

zip.meaning: a thing that you use to fasten clothes, bags, etc. It consists of two rows of metal or plastic teeth that you can pull together to close sth or pull apart to open it.（拉链；拉锁）；(informal) energy or speed（能量；速度）；(informal) (especially NAmE) nothing（零；没有；毫无）；to fasten clothes, bags, etc. with a zip/zipper（拉上拉链）

zipper.meaning: a thing that you use to fasten clothes, bags, etc. It consists of two rows of metal or plastic teeth that you can pull together to close sth or pull apart to open it.（拉链；拉锁）

zirconium.meaning: a chemical element. Zirconium is a hard silver-grey metal that does not corrode very easily.（锆）

zone.meaning: an area or a region with a particular feature or use（（有某特色或作用的）地区，地带）；one of the areas that a larger area is divided into for the purpose of organization（（规划的）区域，分区）；an area or a part of an object, especially one that is different from its surroundings（（尤指有别于周围的）区域，部分）；one of the parts that the earth's surface is divided into by imaginary lines that are parallel to the equator（（地球表面与赤道平行的）气候带）

zoo.meaning: a place where many kinds of wild animals are kept for the public to see and where they are studied, bred and protected（动物园）

zoological.meaning: connected with the science of zoology（动物学的）

zoologist.meaning: a scientist who studies zoology（动物学家）

zoology.meaning: the scientific study of animals and their behaviour（动物学）

zoom.meaning: (informal) to move or go somewhere very fast（快速移动；迅速前往）；(of prices, costs, etc.（价格、费用等）；to increase a lot quickly and suddenly（急剧增长；猛涨）；(of a camera（摄影机或摄像机）
